Ensonga eri nti okusaba kwe kwa kutuukiriza mukolo bukozi. Omutima gwe teguli mu kusinza kwe. Agula ekitabo ekirimu ebiyitibwa, “essaala eziwandiikiddwa,” n’azisoma mu kamwa, kubanga okuddiŋŋana kwanguyira okusinga okusaba, era tekwetaaga kulowooza! Sirina kye nziyiza ggwe okukozesa essaala ewandiikiddwa bw’oba ng’osaba nayo, naye mmanyi bangi nnyo abatasaba nayo, wabula baddiŋŋana bubuzi ebigambo. Lowooza ku bandibaddewo mu maka gaffe singa, mu kifo ky’abaana baffe okutubuulira mu bwesimbu bwe babeera n’ekyetaago, buli kiseera balowooza nti kibagwanira okugenda mu kisenge ky’ebitabo ne banoonya essaala ewandiikiddwa ne bagitusomera! Mazima okuwulira kw’awaka n’okwagala byonna byandikomye! Obulamu bwanditambulidde mu njegere! Amaka gaffe gandifuuse ng’essomero ery’ekisulo, oba enkambi y’amagye—era byonna byandibadde bya kuyimirira mu nnyiriri na mikolo—mu kifo ky’amaaso agasanyufu agatunula waggulu n’obwesige obw’okwagala mu maaso agaagala agasanyukira okuddamu! Abantu bangi ab’omwoyo bakozesa essaala ewandiikiddwa, naye abantu ab’omubiri kumpi bulijjo bagikozesa, kubanga bakoma ku mukolo ogwo. Okusaba kw’omuntu ono kwe kusaba okukyamu kubanga kwonna kwa ku lulwe. Ayagala okugaggawala alyoke yeesanyuse. Ayagala okuba omukulu kyokka alyoke yeegombebwe—okusaba kwe kutandikira era ne kukoma ku ye kennyini. Laba obuswavu bw’okusaba okw’engeri eyo, ne bwe kuba nga kwa mazima. Omuntu bw’asaba bw’atyo, asaba Katonda okufuuka omuweereza we amutuukirize okwegomba kwe. Nedda, kisinga n’okwo obubi! Ayagala Katonda yeegatte naye mu kuweereza okuyaayaana kwe! Ajja kutuukiriza okuyaayaana kwe, ne Katonda ajje amuyambe okukikola! Okusaba ng’okwo kuvvoola, naye kungi nnyo okuweebwayo, era kuteekwa okuba kimu ku bintu ebisinga okusunguwaza Katonda eggulu bye lyali lirabye! Nedda, omuntu bw’aba ayagala okwebeerera yekka n’okuyaayaana kwe, akikole, era gy’akoma okweyawula ku Katonda gy’akoma okubeera omwesimbu mu bye yeeyisaamu. Aleme kwogera Essaala ya Mukama nga Katonda Kitaawe, oba okuwalula erinnya ettukuvu erya Kristo okutukuza omululu gwe, oba okuyita amaanyi ag’omukisa ag’Omwoyo mu by’okwegulumiza kwe oba mu kwegomba kwe okw’okwefaako! Bw’akola bw’atyo, taliba bulungi kusinga bwe yali ku ntandikwa—alisaba, n’atafuna. Okusaba kwe kulyonoonekera kubanga asaba mu ngeri enkyamu, ng’agenderera kubikozesa ku masanyu ge gokka. Okwegomba kwo bwe kuba nga kwe kuyaayaana kw’obuntu obwagwa; okwegomba kwo bwe kuba nga kutandikira era ne kukoma ku ggwe wekka, era ekigendererwa ekikulu ky’obeererawo bwe kiba nga si kugulumiza Katonda, wabula okwegulumiza ggwe wekka, kale oyinza okulwana, naye tolifuna! Oyinza okeera mu makya n’olwawo okwebaka, naye tewali kintu kya mugaso kirivaamu! Jjukira Mukama bwe yayogedde mu Zabbuli 37—“Tonyiiganga era weewale ekiruyi; teweeraliikiriranga kubanga bivaamu bibi byereere. Wanaayitawo akabanga katono ababi baggweerewo ddala; wadde mulibanoonya temulibalabako. Naye abateefu baligabana ensi ne beeyagalira mu ddembe eritatendeka.” Ebyo bimala ku bwavu bw’okuyaayaana okubi. II. Eky’okubiri, kaakano nnina omulimu omukulu, era gwe guno, okulaga ENGERI EKKANISA ZA KRISTO GYE ZIYINZA OKUBONAABONA N’OBWAVU OBW’OMWOYO ne kiba nti nazo, beegomba okufuna, “so ne mutasobola kubifuna.” Kya lwatu Omukristaayo anoonya ebintu eby’awaggulu okusinga omuntu ow’ensi, bwe kitaba bwe kityo teyandisaanidde linnya eryo n’akatono. Waakiri, nga bw’ayatula, ekigendererwa kye kwe kufuna obugagga obw’amazima n’okugulumiza Katonda mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Ye, naye laba, Abooluganda abaagalwa, Ekkanisa zonna tezifuna ekyo kye zeegomba. Tulina okwemulugunya, si wano na wali, wabula mu bifo bingi, ku Kkanisa ezikumpi okwebaka era ezigenda zikendeera mpolampola. Kya lwatu zifuna ensonga ez’okwekwasa. Abantu bagenda bakendeera, oba ekifo ekirala eky’okusinzizaamu kisikiriza abantu. Bulijjo wabaawo ensonga ey’okwekwasa eri kumpi, omuntu bw’agyetaaga. Naye era, ekituufu kikyali awo—okusinza okw’olukale kumpi kwalekebwa ddala mu bifo ebimu, obuweereza tebulina maanyi gakuŋŋaanya bantu—era abo abalabikako tebamatidde oba tebafaayo. Mu Kkanisa ng’ezo temuli bakyuka. Singa beeyongerako abantu mukaaga mu mwaka, bandyetaaze okuyimba “Oluyimba lwa Aleruuya”! Naye ku by’okuleeta enkumi n’enkumi eri Kristo, mu kyama batya nti ekyo kyandibadde kintu ekitali kirungi, kubanga kiyinza okuleeta okusasamala—era beekuuma nnyo mu mpisa ne kiba nti batya buli kintu eky’engeri eyo! Obutakola kintu kyonna ne baleka abantu okuzikirira, mu ndowooza yaabwe, kye kituufu era eky’ekitiibwa. Naye okuba abalamu era ab’amaanyi mbeera ya kabi, kubanga eyinza okutuusa ku bulalu n’obutaba na mpisa! Batya nnyo naddala ekintu kyonna ekifaanana “okwesiikuula okw’amaanyi.” Ekigambo ekyo ekirabika obubi bakiteeka mu maaso gaffe ng’Abachina bwe bagezaako okutiisa abalabe baabwe nga basiiga ku ngabo zaabwe amaaso ag’entiisa! Togenda kufaayo ku kigambo ekyo eky’entiisa—tekirina gwe kirituusaako kabi! Ekkanisa zino “tezirina,” kubanga tewali Mazima ga Katonda gabuna olw’obunyiikivu bwazo; tewali kibi kikubibwa; tewali butukuvu bwongerwamu maanyi; tewali kikolebwa Katonda kye yandigulumiziddwamu. Era nsonga ki ereeta kino? Ekisooka, ne mu abo abeeyita Abakristaayo wayinza okubaawo okunoonya ebintu ebirungi mu ngeri enkyamu. “Nga mulwana era nga muyomba,” kyokka temulina. Ekkanisa tezirowoozezza kugaggawala nga zivuganya n’Ekkanisa endala? Mu kifo kino na kino eky’okusinzizaamu balina omusajja omugezi ennyo—naffe tuteekwa okufuna omusajja omugezi! Mazima, ateekwa okuba omugezi katono okusinga omuzira wa baliraanwa baffe. Kye kyo ekyo—omusajja omugezi! Woowe, nga tubeera mu mulembe mwe twogerera ku basajja abagezi mu kubuulira Enjiri ya Yesu Kristo! Kitalo, okulowooza nti obuweereza buno obutukuvu bwesigamye ku magezi g’abantu! Ekkanisa zivuganyizza mu kuzimba, mu ndongo, mu by’okwambala ne mu kitiibwa mu bantu. Abakulembeze balowooza nti okusobola okukulaakulana bateekwa okuba n’ekintu ekisinga obulungi, ekisinga okuyooyootebwa, oba ekisinga ebbeeyi okusinga baliraanwa baabwe—noolwekyo bazimba amasinzizo ag’engeri ya Gothic, eddoboozi ly’omubuulizi mwe lirinnya mu mikiikiro ne litawulirwa bulungi n’akatono—oba si ekyo bagula ennanga ennene erimu buli kisumuluzo okuggyako ekyo ekiwa eddoboozi ery’amaanyi lyonna! Endowooza eyo erabika nga yabuna wonna nti mu nnanga ennene mulimu ekisa kingi. Okusaba Katonda ng’okozesa namuziga w’empewo, ng’Abatatali, kyandibadde kya busirusiru nnyo! Naye okutendereza Katonda n’empewo eyita mu nseke kye kisaanira ennyo! Sirabangako njawulo era ne kaakano sigiraba. Ennanga ennene oba obutabaawo nnanga si kye kibuuzo kaakano, naye njogera ku mbeera ebyuma bino mwe biteekebwawo olw’okuvuganya. Ebigendererwa by’abangi si bya kukulaakulana nga balina ekizimbe ekisinga obulungi, endongo ennungi okusingawo, n’obuweereza obw’amagezi okusinga abalala? Si kye kimu n’okuvuganya kw’abatunzi b’engoye mu maaso g’amaduuka gaabwe n’amadirisa agayooyooteddwa? Eyo y’engeri Obwakabaka bwa Katonda gye bulikula mu ffe? Mu mbeera ezimu mu kuvuganya kuno mulimu n’obukyayi. Si kirungi eri ebirowoozo ebitono okulaba Ekkanisa endala nga zikulaakulana okusinga ezaabwe. Ziyinza okuba nga zinyiikivu okutusinga era nga zikola omulimu gwa Katonda bulungi okutusinga, naye twanguwa okuzitunuulira n’eriiso ery’obuggya—era, mu bwesimbu, twandyagadde obutakulaakulana nnyo bwe batyo. Mulowooza nti Ekyawandiikibwa kyogera bwereere nti, “Omwoyo gwe yassa mu ffe” gwegomba n’obuggya? Singa twandirabye enkaayana mu bo, ne beeyawula ne bazikirira mu by’ekkanisa, tetwandisanyuse. Kya lwatu nedda! Naye era tetwandinakuwadde nnyo! Mu Kkanisa ezimu omwoyo omubi gusigala omwo. Sireeta kuvuma kwa kulumiriza, noolwekyo sigamba kisingawo ku kino—Katonda taliwa mukisa nkola ng’ezo n’omwoyo ng’ogwo—abo abazigoberera balyegomba okufuna, naye tebalifuna. Bwe kityo, nsonga ki lwaki tezifuna mukisa? Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti, “Kubanga mulemeddwa okubisaba.” Ntya nti waliwo Ekkanisa ezitasaba. Okusaba mu ngeri zaakwo zonna kulagajjalirwa nnyo. Okusaba okw’omu kyama kulekebwa ne kuvunda. Nja kukirekera omuntu ow’omunda owa buli muntu okusalawo okusaba okw’omu kyama gye kukoma okufaayibwako, n’okussa ekimu ne Katonda mu kyama gye kukoma okubaawo mu bammemba b’Ekkanisa zaffe. Kya mazima nti okubeerawo kwakwo okulamu kwa nkizo nnyo eri okukulaakulana kw’Ekkanisa. Okusaba okw’omu maka kwangu okusalirako omusango, kubanga tusobola okukulaba. Ntya nti mu nnaku zino bangi baalekera ddala okusabira awamu mu maka. Mbeegayiridde temubakoppa! Nandyagadde mwenna mubeere n’endowooza y’emu ng’omupakasi Omuskooti eyafuna omulimu mu nnyumba y’omulimi omugagga eyali amanyiddwa nti asasula bulungi. Mikwano gye gyonna ne gimukwatirwa obuggya olw’okugenda okukola mu nnyumba ng’eyo. Mu bbanga ttono n’akomawo ku kyalo kye eky’obuzaaliranwa. Bwe baamubuuza lwaki yaleka omulimu gwe, n’addamu nti, “teyasobola kubeera mu nnyumba etaliiko kasolya.” Ennyumba etaliimu kusaba, nnyumba etaliiko kasolya! Tetuyinza kusuubira mikisa ku Kkanisa zaffe bwe tutaba nagyo ku maka gaffe! Ate okusaba kw’ekibiina, okukuŋŋaana awamu mu bye tuyita Enkuŋŋaana z’Okusaba—tewali kukendeera? Mu bifo bingi Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba lunyoomebwa era lutunuulirwa ng’olukuŋŋaana olw’eddaala ery’okubiri. Waliwo bammemba b’Ekkanisa abatalabikako n’akatono era nga tekibalumiriza mu mutima nti tebajja. Ebibiina ebimu bitabula Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba n’okusomesa, ne bisigaza okusinza kumu kwokka mu wiiki. Lumu nasomye ensonga y’okwekwasa ku bino byonna—kigambibwa nti abantu basinga okubeera awaka, nga balabirira eby’omu maka. Ebyo byogera bya bwereere! Ani mu ffe ayagala abantu okulagajjalira eby’omu maka gaabwe? Kirizuulibwa nti abo abasinga okulabirira obulungi eby’omu maka gaabwe beebo abanyiikira okuteekateeka buli kimu, balyoke bagende mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusinza. Okulagajjalira Ennyumba ya Katonda emirundi mingi kabonero akalaga okulagajjalira ennyumba zaabwe! Sirina kubuusabuusa nti tebaleeta baana baabwe eri Kristo, kubanga singa babadde babaleeta bandibaleese mu kusinza. Mu ngeri yonna, okusaba kw’Ekkanisa kwe kupima okukulaakulana kwayo. Bwe tuziyiza okusaba, tuziyiza omukisa. Obuwanguzi bwaffe obw’amazima nga Ekkanisa busobola kufunibwa lwa kubusaba Mukama yekka. Tetuli beetegefu kwekyusa n’okutereeza mu nsonga eno? Woowe, singa ekiseera kya Sayuuni eky’okulumwa okuzaala kituuka, okulumwa okw’okusaba lwe kulisiikuula omubiri gwonna ogw’abeesigwa! Naye abamu baddamu nti, “Waliwo Enkuŋŋaana z’Okusaba era tusaba omukisa, naye tegujja.” Ennyinnyonnyola teyinza kusangibwa mu kitundu ekirala eky’ekyawandiikibwa nti, “temubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kikyamu”? Enkuŋŋaana z’Okusaba bwe zifuuka omukolo obukozi; Abooluganda bwe bayimirira ne bamalira ebiseera mu kwogera emboozi empanvu mu kifo ky’okwogera ne Katonda mu bigambo eby’amaanyi era ebyaka; bwe wataba kusuubira mukisa—okusaba bwe kuba okunnyogovu era okutaliimu bbugumu—olwo tewali kirivaamu. Oyo asaba awatali bbugumu tasabye n’akatono! Tetuyinza kussa kimu ne Katonda, gwe muliro ogwokya, bwe wataba muliro mu kusaba kwaffe! Okusaba kungi kulemwa okutuuka ku kye kutumiddwa kubanga tekulimu kukkiriza. Okusaba okujjudde okubuusabuusa kwe kusaba okugaanibwa. Lowooza nti owandiikidde mukwano gwo n’ogamba nti, “Mukwano gwange omwagalwa, ndi mu buzibu bungi, noolwekyo nkutegeeza, era nkusaba obuyambi bwo kubanga kirabika kituufu okukola bwe ntyo. Naye wadde nga mpandiika bwe nti, sikkiriza nti ojja kumpeereza buyambi bwonna. Mazima, nandyewuunyizza nnyo singa obuweereza, era nandibwogeddeko ng’ekyamagero ekinene.” Olowooza ojja kufuna obuyambi? Nnandigambye nti mukwano gwo yandibadde n’amagezi agamala okulaba obwesige obutono bw’omulinamu, era yandikuddamu nti, olw’okuba tewasuubira kintu kyonna, tagenda kukwewuunyisa. Endowooza yo ku bugabi bwe ya wansi nnyo ne kiba nti tawulira nti kimugwanira kweteganya ku lulwo. Okusaba bwe kuba okw’engeri eyo, tewandyewuunyizza nti “tetubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyaffe kikyamu.” Ate era, singa okusaba kwaffe, ne bwe kuba kwa bunyiikivu n’okukkiriza kutya, kuba kusaba bukozi Ekkanisa yaffe ekulaakulane kubanga twagala okwenyumiririza mu kukulaakulana kwayo—singa twagala okulaba ekibiina kyaffe eky’eddiini nga kyeyongera nnyo era nga kifuna ekitiibwa kingi, tulyoke tugabane ku kitiibwa kyakyo—kale okwegomba kwaffe tekuli kirala wabula okuyaayaana okubi, ku nkomerero! Kiyinzika abaana ba Katonda okulaga okuvuganya kwe kumu, obuggya n’okwegulumiza ng’abantu b’ensi? Omulimu gw’eddiini gunaabanga gwa kuvuganya na kukaayana? Woowe, kale, okusaba okunoonya obuwanguzi obwo tekulikkirizibwa ku Ntebe ey’Okusaasira! Katonda tajja kutuwulira, wabula ajja kutugamba tugende, kubanga tafaayo ku kwegayirira okulina ekigendererwa eky’okwefaako. “Temulina kubanga mulemeddwa okubisaba, oba temubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kikyamu.” III. Eky’okusatu, nnina omulimu ogusinga ennyo okusanyusa, era gwe guno, okulaga mu bufunze OBUGAGGA OBULINDIRIDDE OKUKOZESA ENGERI ENTUUFU, kwe kugamba, okusaba Katonda mu ngeri entuufu. Mbayita mussaayo omwoyo gwammwe ennyo ku nsonga eno, kubanga ya mugaso munene nnyo. Era ekisooka kye njogera kye kino—nga kitono nnyo, ku nkomerero, kye Katonda kye tusaba! Okusaba? Kale, kye kintu ekisinga obutono ky’ayinza okusuubira gye tuli, era tekisukka ku kye tusaba buli lunaku abo abeetaaga obuyambi okuva gye tuli! Tusuubira omwavu okusaba era bw’atasaba, ebbula lye tumuteekako omusango. Singa Katonda agaba eri abo abasaba, ffe ne tusigala nga tuli baavu, ani nannyini musango? Omusango ogwo tegusinga obunene? Tekirabika nga tetuli bulungi ne Katonda, ne tutaagala n’okukkakkana okumusaba ekisa? Mazima, mu mitima gyaffe mulina okubaamu obulabe obwekwese gy’ali, bwe kitaba bwe kityo, mu kifo ky’okuba ekyetaago kye tutayagala, okusaba kwandibadde kutwalibwa ng’essanyu eddene! Naye, Abooluganda, ka tube nga tukyagala oba tetukyagala, mujjukire, okusaba lye tteeka ly’Obwakabaka. “Musabe, munaaweebwa.” Tteeka eritalikyusibwa ku muntu yenna. Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ye Muganda omukulu mu maka, naye Katonda teyamuggya ku tteeka eryo! Mujjukire ekyawandiikibwa kino—Yakuwa agamba Omwana we yennyini nti, “Nsaba, nange ndikuwa amawanga gonna okuba obusika bwo, era n’ensi yonna gy’ekoma okuba amatwale go.” Bwe kiba nti Omwana wa Katonda ow’obwakabaka era ow’obwakatonda tasobola kuggibwa ku tteeka ery’okusaba alyoke afune, ggwe nange tetuyinza kusuubira tteeka eryo kulekezebwa ku lwaffe! Lwaki kyandibadde bwe kityo? Nsonga ki eyinza okuwolerezebwa lwaki twandiggiddwa ku kusaba? Nsonga ki eyinza okubaawo lwaki twandiggiddwako enkizo n’okununulibwa okuva mu bwetaavu bw’okwegayirira? Sirina gye ndaba—ggwe olina gy’olaba? Katonda ajja kuwa Eriya omukisa atonnyese enkuba ku Isirayiri, naye Eriya ateekwa okugisaba. Eggwanga eddonde bwe liba ligenda kukulaakulana, Samwiri ateekwa okulyegayiririra. Abayudaaya bwe baba bagenda kununulibwa, Danyeri ateekwa okubeegayiririra. Katonda ajja kuwa Pawulo omukisa era amawanga galikyusibwa okuyita mu ye, naye Pawulo ateekwa okusaba! Era yasaba obutayosa—ebbaluwa ze ziraga nti teyasuubira kintu kyonna okuggyako ng’akisabye. Bw’oba ng’oyinza okufuna buli kintu ng’osaba, so tewali ky’ofuna nga tosabye, mbeegayiridde mulabe okusaba bwe kuli okw’omugaso ennyo ddala! Era mbeegayirira mukunyiikiremu nnyo. Ate era, n’omuntu asinga obutalowooza nnyo akiraba nti waliwo ebintu ebimu Ekkanisa ya Katonda by’eyetaaga bye tutayinza kufuna okuggyako nga tusabye. Oyinza okufuna omusajja oyo omugezi gwe njogeddeko—oboolyawo gy’onookoma okumusabira obutono, gye kinaakoma okuba ekirungi! N’ekkanisa eyo empya, n’ennanga ennene empya, n’abayimbi, oyinza okubifuna awatali kusaba—naye toyinza kufuna kufukibwako mafuta okuva mu ggulu—ekirabo kya Katonda tekiyinza kugulibwa na nsimbi! Bammemba abamu ab’Ekkanisa mu kyalo ekimu ekitannakula mu Amerika baalowooza nti bandikuŋŋaanyizza ekibiina nga bawanika ettaala ennene ennyo ennungi ey’amatabi mu Kisinzizo. Abantu ne boogera ku ttaala eyo era abamu ne bagenda okugiraba—naye ekitangaala kyayo mangu ddala kyakendeera. Oyinza okugula ebintu ebya buli ngeri eby’omu kkanisa! Oyinza okugula langi eya buli kika, ebikomo, engoye ennyogovu, olugoye olwa bbululu, n’olwa kakobe, n’olumyufu, n’olugoye olwa linena—wamu n’endere, n’ennanga, n’amadinda, n’ebivuga ebya buli ngeri—oyinza okubifuna byonna awatali kusaba. Mazima, kyandibadde kya kujooga okusaba ku byonna ebyo ebitaliimu! Naye toyinza kufuna Mwoyo Mutukuvu awatali kusaba. Ng’empewo, “ekuntira gy’eyagala.” Tasobola kusembezebwa mu ngeri yonna oba mu nkola yonna gye tuyinza okukozesa okuggyako okusaba. Tewali byuma oba nkola ya buntu biyinza kujjuza bbanga lye ng’ataliiwo! Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’aba nga taliiwo, omusajja wo oyo omugezi agasa ki? Waliwo anaakyuka? Waliwo emmeeme eneebudaabudibwa? Waliwo abaana ba Katonda abanaazzibwa obuggya mu bulamu obw’omwoyo awatali Mwoyo Mutukuvu? Era toyinza kussa kimu ne Katonda awatali kusaba. Oyo atayagala kusaba, tayinza kussa kimu ne Katonda. Ate era, tewali kussa kimu okw’amazima okw’omwoyo wakati w’Ekkanisa ne bammemba baayo okusaba bwe kusirisibwa. Okusaba kuteekwa okubeera mu nkola, bwe kitaba bwe kityo emikisa egyo egy’omugaso ennyo eri okukulaakulana kw’Ekkanisa tegirijja gy’eri. Okusaba gwe mulyango omunene ogw’omukisa ogw’omwoyo, era bw’oguggalawo, oba osibye ekisa wabweru. Abooluganda abaagalwa, temulowooza nti okusaba kuno, Katonda kw’atwetaagisa, nkizo ennene nnyo? Lowooza singa wabaddewo ekiragiro ekifulumiziddwa nti temuteekwa kusaba—ekyo kyandibadde kizibu ddala! Singa okusaba kwalinga kusalako mugga gwa mukisa mu kifo ky’okugwongera, kyandibadde kabi kanene. Wali olabye kasiru ali mu kweraliikirira okw’amaanyi, oba ng’alumwa nnyo era, olw’ekyo, ng’ayagala nnyo okwogera? Kintu kya ntiisa okulaba! Amaaso ge gakyukakyuka, omubiri gwe gukankana nnyo—kasiru yeenyoola era afuba ng’ali mu nnaku nnyingi. Buli kitundu kyonna eky’omubiri gwe kinyoolebwa olw’okwagala okuyamba olulimi, naye terusobola kumenya njegere zaalwo! Amaloboozi amatono gava mu kifuba, n’okugotaagota okw’ebigambo ebitategeerekeka kusikiriza abantu okussaayo omwoyo, newaakubadde nga tebituuka ku kwogera kwennyini. Ekitonde ekyo ekinaku kiri mu bulumi obutayogerekeka! Lowooza singa twali, mu buntu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, nga tujjudde okwegomba okw’amaanyi, kyokka nga tuli bakasiru ku lulimi lw’okusaba? Ndowooza kyandibadde kimu ku bibonoobono ebisinga obubi ebiyinza okututuukako! Twandibadde balema era abatemeddwako ebitundu—era obulumi bwaffe bwandibadde bwa maanyi nnyo! Erinnya lye litenderezebwe, Mukama ateekawo ekkubo ery’okwogeramu era agamba omutima gwaffe okwogera naye mu lwatu! Abaagalwa, tuteekwa okusaba—gye ndi, kirina okuba ekintu ekisooka kye tulowooza okukola bwe tuba mu bwetaavu. Singa abantu babadde balungi ne Katonda era nga bamwagala ddala, bandisabye ng’obuntu bwabwe bwe bubalagira, nga bwe bassa omukka! Nsuubira abamu ku ffe tuli bulungi ne Katonda era tetwetaaga kuwalirizibwa kusaba, kubanga kufuuse obuzaaliranwa bwaffe. Mukwano gwange yambuulidde, jjo, olugero lw’omulenzi omuto Omugirimaani—olugero omusumba we lwe yali ayagala ennyo okubuulira. Omwana oyo omuto omwagalwa yakkiriza Katonda we era yasanyukiranga okusaba. Omusomesa we yali akubirizza abayizi okutuuka ku ssomero mu budde era omwana ono bulijjo yafubanga okukikola. Naye kitaawe ne nnyina baali bantu abagayaavu era, lumu ku makya, olw’ensobi yaabwe yokka, yafuluma oluggi nga essaawa ekuba ekiseera essomero we liggulirwako. Omuntu omu eyali ayimiridde okumpi n’awulira omwana oyo omuto ng’akaaba nti, “Katonda omwagalwa, nkwegayiridde, ntuuke ku ssomero mu budde.” Omuwulizi n’alowooza nti omulundi guno okusaba tekuyinza kuddibwamu, kubanga omwana yalina olugendo oluwerako okutambula, era ekiseera kyali kituuse dda. Yayagala nnyo okulaba ekinaavaamu. Kaakano kyabaawo ku makya ago nti omusomesa, bwe yali agezaako okuggulawo oluggi lw’essomero, n’akyusa ekisumuluzo mu ludda olukyamu n’atasobola kusika kakomo. Kyabeetaagisa okuyita omukozi w’ebisumuluzo okuggulawo oluggi. Ne wabaawo okulwawo, era oluggi nga lwakaakaba luggulibwawo, mukwano gwaffe omuto n’ayingira wamu n’abalala bonna, mu budde ddala! Katonda alina engeri nnyingi ez’okutuukiriza okwegomba okutuufu. Kyali kya buzaaliranwa ddala nti, mu kifo ky’okukaaba n’okwemulugunya, omwana eyali ayagala Katonda ddala ayogere naye ku buzibu bwe. Tekyandibadde kya buzaaliranwa eri ggwe nange, mu bwangu era awatali kulonzalonza, okubuulira Mukama ennaku zaffe ne tumusaba obuyambi? Kino si kye kyandibadde ekisooka kye tuddukira? Woowe, ng’Ekyawandiikibwa bwe kiraga, n’ebyo bye tulaba—era, kinnakuwaza okwongerako—ng’ebyo bye tuyiseemu bwe biraga, okusaba emirundi mingi kye kintu ekisembayo! Laba omulwadde mu Zabbuli 107. Mikwano gye bamuleetera emmere ey’engeri nnyingi, naye emmeeme ye etamwa emmere yonna. Abasawo bakola kyonna kye basobola okumuwonya, naye agenda yeeyongera okulwala, era abulako katono ddala okufa— “Bwe batyo ne bakaabirira Mukama nga bali mu buzibu obwo.” Ekyo ekyandisoose kyateekebwa ku nkomerero! “Muyite omusawo. Mumuteekereteekere emmere. Mumubikke bulangiti!” Byonna bulungi, naye mulisaba ddi Katonda? Katonda ajja kukoowoolebwa ng’embeera efuuse nnyo embi! Laba abavuzi b’amaato aboogerwako mu Zabbuli y’emu. Eryato kumpi limenyeke. “Ne gagulumira okutuuka ku ggulu, ate ne gakka wansi mu ddubi; akabenje ne kabayitirira, ne baggwaamu amaanyi.” Kyokka bakola kyonna kye basobola okuwonawo mu kibuyaga. Naye bwe “beesunda, eruuyi n’eruuyi ne baba ng’omutamiivu atagala; n’amagezi ne gabaggwaako. Bwe batyo ne bakaabira Mukama nga bali mu buzibu.” Ye; Katonda anoonyezebwa nga tusindikiddwa mu kasonda era nga twetegese okuzikirira! Era nga kisa kya maanyi nnyo nti awulira okusaba okw’ekikeerezi ng’okwo era n’anunula abeegayirira mu bizibu byabwe! Naye kisaanidde okuba bwe kityo ku ggwe ne ku nze, ne ku Kkanisa za Kristo? Okusikirizibwa okusooka okw’Ekkanisa egenda ekendeera tekwandibadde nti, “Tusabe emisana n’ekiro okutuusa Mukama lw’anaatulabikira. Tukuŋŋaane wamu n’omwoyo gumu mu kifo kimu, era tuleme kwawukana okutuusa omukisa lwe gunaatukkako”? Mumanyi, Abooluganda, ebintu ebinene bwe biri ebifunibwa olw’okusaba? Wali okirowoozezzaako? Tekikusikiriza kusaba n’obunyiikivu? Eggulu lyonna liri mu maaso g’omuntu asaba okulikwata! Ebisuubizo byonna ebya Katonda bigagga era tebiggwaawo—era okutuukirizibwa kwabyo kufunibwa lwa kusaba! Yesu agamba nti, “Kitange yankwasa ebintu byonna,” ne Pawulo agamba nti, “byonna byammwe, nammwe muli ba Kristo.” Ani atandisabye ng’ebintu byonna bitukwasiddwa bwe bityo? Ye, n’ebisuubizo ebyasooka okuweebwa abantu ab’enjawulo byonna bituweereddwa ffe, singa tumanya okubiwolereza mu kusaba. Isirayiri yasomoka Ennyanja Emyufu emirembe mingi emabega, naye mu Zabbuli 66 tusoma nti, “kyetuva tujaguza.” Yakobo yekka ye yali e Penieri, naye Koseya ayogera ku Katonda nti “n’ayogera naye”—era mu lulimi Koseya lwe yawandiikamu ebigambo ebyo bitegeeza nti eyo Katonda yayogera naffe. Pawulo ayagala okutuwa ekisuubizo ekinene eky’ebiseera eby’obwetaavu, n’ajjuliza okuva mu Ndagaano Enkadde, nti Katonda yagamba nti, “Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.” Pawulo ekyo yakiggya wa? Ekyo kye kisuubizo Mukama kye yawa Yoswa—“sirikuleka wadde okukwabuulira.” Mazima ekisuubizo ekyo kyali kya Yoswa yekka! Nedda, kyaffe! “Buli bunnabbi obuli mu byawandiikibwa, tewali ayinza kubunnyonnyola ku bubwe yekka.” Ebyawandiikibwa byonna byaffe. Laba Katonda bw’alabikira Sulemaani ekiro n’agamba nti, “Saba ky’oyagala kyonna kye mba nkuwa.” Sulemaani asaba amagezi. “Ah, oyo ye Sulemaani,” bw’ogamba. Wuliriza!—“Obanga omuntu yenna ku mmwe aweebuka mu magezi, asabenga Katonda.” Katonda yawa Sulemaani obugagga n’ettutumu okwongereza ku ebyo. Ekyo si kya Sulemaani yekka? Nedda, kubanga kyogerwa ku magezi ag’amazima nti mu mukono gwago ogwa ddyo mulimu obuwanguzi n’okuwangaala, “ne mu mukono gwago ogwa kkono ne mubaamu obugagga n’ekitiibwa”—era kino tekifaanana nnyo n’ebigambo by’Omulokozi waffe nti, “Musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako”? Bwe mutyo, mulaba, ebisuubizo bya Mukama bituukirizibwa emirundi mingi, era bilindiridde okuyiwa eby’obugagga byabyo mu kifuba ky’okusaba! Kino tekisitula kusaba ku ddaala ery’awaggulu, nga Katonda mwetegefu okuddiŋŋana ebyafaayo by’abatukuvu be mu ffe, ng’alindirira okutukwatirwa ekisa, n’okututikka emikisa gye? Nja kwogera ku Mazima ga Katonda amalala agandituleetedde okusaba, era ge gano, nti bwe tusaba, Katonda ajja kutuwa bingi nnyo okusinga bye tusaba. Ibulayimu yasaba Katonda nti Isimayiri abeere mulamu mu maaso ge. Yalowooza nti, “Mazima ono ye zzadde eryasuubizibwa: siyinza kusuubira nti Saala alizaala omwana mu bukadde bwe. Katonda yansuubiza ezzadde, era mazima liteekwa okuba omwana ono owa Agali. Isimayiri abeerenga mulamu mu maaso go!” Katonda n’amuwa ekyo era n’amuwa ne Isaaka, wamu n’emikisa gyonna egy’Endagaano! Laba ne Yakobo. Afukamira okusaba n’asaba Mukama amuwe emmere okulya era n’ebyokwambala. Naye Katonda we yamuwa ki? Bwe yakomawo e Beseri, yalina ebibinja bibiri, endiga n’eŋŋamira enkumi n’enkumi, n’obugagga bungi! Katonda yali amuwulidde era yali amukoledde nnyo okusinga ennyo bye yasaba! Kyogerwa ku Dawudi, kabaka, nti “Yakusaba obulamu, era n’obumuwa, ennaku ennyingi,” ye, teyamuwa nnaku nnyingi zokka, wabula n’entebe ey’obwakabaka eri batabani be mu mirembe gyonna, okutuusa Dawudi n’ayingira n’atuula mu maaso ga Mukama, ng’awangulwa obulungi bwa Mukama. “Kale,” bw’ogamba, “naye ekyo kya mazima ne ku kusaba okw’omu Ndagaano Empya? “Ye, bwe kiri bwe kityo ku abo abeegayirira mu Ndagaano Empya, ka babe batukuvu oba boonoonyi! Baaleeta eri Kristo omuntu eyali akoozimbye, ne bamusaba amuwonye. N’agamba nti, “Mwana wange ebibi byo bikusonyiyiddwa.” Ekyo tebaali bakisabye, si bwe kiri? Nedda, naye Katonda atuwa ebintu ebisinga ku bye tusaba! Wuliriza okusaba okwetoowaze okw’omubbi oyo omwavu eyali afa, “Yesu, onzijukiranga bw’olijja mu bwakabaka bwo.” Yesu n’amuddamu nti, “Olwa leero ojja kubeera nange mu Lusuku lwa Katonda”! Ekitiibwa ekyo teyali akirooseeko! Era n’olugero lw’omwana omujaajaamya lutuyigiriza kino. Yamalirira okugamba nti, “Sikyasaanira na kuyitibwa mwana wo. Nfunira omulimu mbeere ng’abapakasi bo.” Kitaawe yaddamu ki? “Mutabani wange ono yali afudde kaakano mulamu: Muleete ekkanzu esinga obulungi mugimwambaze. Mumunaanike empeta ku ngalo ye, mumwambaze n’engatto!” Weeteeke mu kifo ky’omuntu asaba, olifuna by’otasabanga era by’otasuubiranga kufuna! Ekyawandiikibwa kino emirundi mingi kijjulizibwa bubi—“Katonda ayinza okukola okusinga ennyo byonna bye tuyinza okusaba, oba ne bye tuyinza okulowooza.” Twandisobodde okusaba, singa twali ba magezi okusingawo era nga tulina okukkiriza okusingawo, ebintu ebisinga obunene, naye Katonda ayagala okutuwa okusinga ennyo ebitaliiko kigero ku bye tusaba! Mu kiseera kino nzikiriza nti Ekkanisa ya Katonda yandifunye emikisa egitayinza na kulowoozebwako, singa ebadde yeetegese, kaakano, okusaba. Wali weetegerezza ekifaananyi ekyo eky’ekitalo mu ssuula 8 ey’Okubikkulirwa? Kisaanidde okwetegerezebwa n’obwegendereza. Sijja kugezaako kukinnyonnyola mu bigambo ebikyetoolodde, wabula nja kulaga bulazi ekifaananyi nga bwe kiwanikiddwa ku kisenge kyokka. Soma—“Omwana gw’Endiga bwe yabembulula akabonero k’envumbo ak’omusanvu ne wabaawo akasiriikiriro mu ggulu lyonna okumala ng’ekitundu ky’essaawa.” Akasiriikiriro mu ggulu!? Tewaali nnyimba, tewaali Aleruuya, tewaali malayika yanyeenya kiwaawaatiro! Akasiriikiriro mu ggulu!? Oyinza okukiteebereza? Era laba! Olaba bamalayika omusanvu abaali bayimiridde mu maaso ga Katonda ne baweebwa amakondeere musanvu. Eyo gye balindirira, nga bakutte amakondeere, naye tewali ddoboozi! Tewali na ddoboozi limu erizzaamu amaanyi oba erirabula mu bbanga eryo eryali eddene ekimala okusiikuula ennyo omutima, naye nga ttono ekimala okuziyiza obutagumiikiriza. Akasiriikiriro akatamenyeka, ak’obuziba, ak’entiisa, kaali kafuga mu ggulu! Emirimu gikomye mu ggulu, ensibuko y’emirimu gyonna. “Awo malayika omulala eyalina ekyoterezo ekya zaabu n’ajja n’ayimirira okuliraana ekyoto.” Ayimiridde awo, naye tewali kiweebwayo kiweebwayo— buli kimu kiyimiridde. Kiki ekiyinza okukizzaamu amaanyi? “N’aweebwa obubaane bungi nnyo abuweeyo, wamu n’okusaba kw’abatukuvu bonna, ku kyoto ekya zaabu ekyali mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka.” Okusaba kuweebwayo wamu n’obulungi bwa Mukama Yesu! Kaakano, laba ekigenda okubaawo—“Akaloosa akalungi n’omukka ebyava mu bubaane obutabuddwamu n’okusaba kw’abatukuvu ne kambuka eri Katonda nga kava mu kyoto malayika mwe yabufuka.” Ekyo kye kisumuluzo ky’ensonga yonna! Kaakano ojja kulaba—malayika atandika okukola—akwata ekyoterezo, akijjuza omuliro ogw’oku kyoto n’agukasuka wansi ku nsi, “ne wabaawo okubwatuka, n’okuwuluguma, n’okwakaayakana, n’okumyansa kw’eggulu era ne wabaawo ne musisi.” “Awo bamalayika omusanvu abaalina amakondeere omusanvu ne beetegeka okufuuwa amakondeere gaabwe.” Buli kimu kitambula kaakano! Amangu ddala okusaba kw’abatukuvu bwe kwatabulwa n’obubaane obw’obulungi bwa Kristo obutaggwaawo ne kutandika okunyooka okuva ku kyoto, okusaba ne kufuuka okw’amaanyi! Amanda agaaka ne gagwa wansi mu baana b’abantu, so nga bamalayika ab’Obulabirizi bwa Katonda, abaali bayimiridde nga basirise edda, bafuuwa amakondeere gaabwe ag’okubwatuka, era Mukama by’ayagala bikolebwa! Eyo y’embeera mu ggulu, mu kigero ekimu, n’okutuusa leero. Muleete wano obubaane! Muleete wano okusaba kw’abatukuvu! Mukukoleeze n’obulungi bwa Kristo era ku kyoto ekya zaabu kunyooke mu maaso g’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo! Olwo tulilaba Mukama ng’akola, era by’ayagala birikolebwa mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu! Katonda aweereze omukisa gwe wamu n’ebigambo bino, ku lwa Kristo. Amiina.

fields.title: Ebisaanyizo by’amaanyi mu kusaba
fields.body_html:
“Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa. Era kino ky’atulagira nti, tukkiririze mu linnya ly’Omwana we Yesu Kristo, era twagalanenga nga ye bwe yatulagira. Kale oyo agondera ebiragiro bye abeera mu Ye, era naye abeera mu ye. Kino tukimanyi ng’ali mu ffe, kubanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu gwe yatuwa abeera mu ffe.” 1 Yokaana 3:22-24.

NNALOWOOZA okubayogerako ku makya gano ku bukulu bw’okusaba, era nnali ŋŋenderedde n’obunyiikivu okubakubiriza okunsabira n’okusabira omulimu gwa Mukama mu kifo kino. Mazima, sirowooza nti nnandifunye omulamwa ogusinga obuzito, oba ogusinga okunyigiriza emmeeme yange. Singa nnakkirizibwa okubasaba ekintu kimu kyokka, kyandibadde kino—“Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Obuweereza bwaffe bwandigasa ki awatali mukisa gwa Katonda, era tuyinza tutya okusuubira omukisa gwa Katonda okuggyako nga gunoonyezebwa Ekkanisa ya Katonda? Nandikyogedde ne mu maziga, “Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Temulekeraawo kusaba—wabula, mweyongere nnyo mu kwegayiririra abalala, kubanga mu ngeri eyo, era mu ngeri eyo yokka, okukulaakulana kwaffe ng’Ekkanisa mwe kuyinza okweyongera, oba wadde okugenda mu maaso.

Naye olwo ekibuuzo ne kinzijira: watya singa mu Kkanisa mubaddemu ekintu ekyandiremesezza okusaba kwaffe okutuuka ku buwanguzi? Ekyo kibuuzo kikulu, era kisaanidde okulowoozebwako n’obunyiikivu bungi ddala nga tetunnaba na kubakubiriza kwegayiririra balala. Nga bwe tumaze okuyigirizibwa essuula esooka eya Isaaya, okusaba kw’abantu abatali batukuvu mangu ddala kufuuka muzizo eri Katonda. “Bwe munaayimusanga emikono gyammwe musabe nnaabakwekanga amaaso gange, era ne bwe munaasabanga ennyo siiwulirenga.” Ekkanisa ziyinza okugwa mu mbeera ey’engeri eyo okusinza kwazo ne kufuuka obutali butuukirivu. Ne “n’enkuŋŋaana zammwe” zifuuka omugugu eri Mukama. Wayinza okubaawo ebibi mu mutima gwa buli omu ku ffe ebiyinza okulemesa Katonda, ng’akuuma Embala ye n’engeri ze, okufaayo n’akatono ku kwegayiririra kwaffe.

Bwe tusirikira ekibi mu mitima gyaffe, Mukama tatuwulira. Ng’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe bwe kiri, waliwo ebintu ebimu ebyetaagisa ddala okuwangula mu kusaba. Katonda ajja kuwulira okusaba kwonna okw’amazima, naye waliwo ebintu ebimu abantu ba Katonda bye bateekwa okuba nabyo, oba si ekyo okusaba kwabwe kujja kulemererwa okutuuka ku kigendererwa. Ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba nti, “Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.” Kale ku makya gano tujja kulowooza ku bintu ebyetaagisa okuba n’amaanyi mu kusaba—kye tuteekwa okukola, kye tuteekwa okuba, kye tuteekwa okuba nakyo—bwe tuba ab’okuwangula ne Katonda mu kusaba bulijjo, ng’ekintu ekibaawo buli kiseera. Ka tuyige engeri y’okufuuka ba Eriya ne ba Yakobo.

I. Nja kusooka nga ndowooza ku BINTU EBYETAAGISA OKUBA N’AMAANYI MU KUSABA. Tuteekwa okwawulamu ebintu ebimu ku ntandikwa. Ndowooza waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’okusaba kw’emmeeme enoonya okusaasirwa n’okusaba kw’omuntu alokoleddwa. Buli muntu ali wano, ka abe wa mbala ki, nnandimugambye nti bw’onoonya okusaasirwa kwa Katonda mu bwesimbu ng’oyita mu Yesu Kristo, ojja kukufuna. Embeera y’obulamu bwo ey’emabega ka ebe nga bwe yali, bw’onoonya kaakano amaaso ga Yakuwa n’okwenenya ng’oyita mu mutabaganya eyalondebwa, onoomulabanga.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’aba akuyigirizza okusaba, tolwawo nate wabula yanguwa ogende ku Musaalaba, era eyo wummuza emmeeme yo erina omusango ku Yesu. Simanyi bisaanyizo birala byonna eby’okusaba okusooka okw’omwonoonyi okuggyako obwesimbu, naye eri abo mu mmwe abalokoleddwa tuteekwa okwogera mu ngeri ndala. Kaakano mufuuse abantu ba Katonda, era wadde nga mujja kuwulirwa nga omwonoonyi bw’andiwuliddwa, era nga buli lunaku mujja kufuna ekisa ekyetaagisa buli anoonya ky’afuna ng’okusaba kwe kuddibwamu, kyokka kaakano oli mwana wa Katonda era oli wansi w’okukangavvulwa okw’enjawulo okw’ab’omu maka abaazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Mu kukangavvula okwo, okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kulina ekifo ekya waggulu era kugasa nnyo.

Waliwo ekintu omukkiriza ky’ayinza okusanyukira ekisukka ku bulokozi bwokka. Waliwo okusaasirwa, emikisa, okubudaabudibwa n’ebirungi ebifuula obulamu bwe obwa kaakano obw’omugaso, obw’essanyu era obw’ekitiibwa. Era bino ajja kubifuna ka abe wa mbala ki. Si bintu bya bulamu oba kufa mu nsonga y’obulokozi—omukkiriza abirina awatali bukwakkulizo, kubanga mikisa gya Ndagaano. Naye kaakano twogera ku bitiibwa n’ebiwoomerera eby’omu nnyumba, ebiweebwa oba ebiziyizibwa okusinziira ku buwulize bwaffe ng’abaana ba Mukama. Bw’onoolagajjalira obukwakkulizo obugattiddwa ku bino, Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu ajja kubikuziyiza. Emikisa egyetaagisa egy’Endagaano ey’Ekisa giyimiridde awatali bukwakkulizo—okuyita okunoonya okusaasirwa kulagiddwa eri abo abatalina bisaanyizo byonna, okuggyako obwetaavu bwabwe.

Naye yingira munda mu maka ga Katonda ng’abasajja n’abakazi abalokoleddwa, ojja kusanga nti emikisa emirala emirungi ennyo giweebwa oba giziyizibwa okusinziira ku ngeri gye tufaayo ku mateeka ga Mukama mu maka ge. Okuwa ekyokulabirako eky’abulijjo—Singa omuntu alumwa enjala abadde ku mulyango gwo n’asaba omugaati, wandimuwadde ka abe wa mbala ki. Era n’omwana wo ojja kumuwa emmere ka abe wa nneeyisa ki—tojja kugaana mwana wo kintu kyonna ekyetaagisa obulamu. Tojja kukwata kkubo lyonna ery’okukangavvula ng’omuziyiza emmere gy’ateekwa okulya, oba ekyambalo eky’okumukuuma obutiti. Naye waliwo ebintu ebirala bingi omwana wo by’ayinza okwegomba, by’ojja okumuwa bw’aba omuwulize, by’otojja kumuwa bw’aba akujeemera. Ndowooza kino kiraga obufuzi bwa Katonda obw’obuzadde we bunaatuusa ensonga eno, ne we butajja kugituusa.

Mutegeere era nti ekyawandiikibwa tekyogera nnyo ku Katonda okuwulira okusaba kw’abaddu be oluusi n’oluusi, kubanga ekyo ajja kukikola, ne bwe baba nga tebatambula bulungi naye era nga abakwese amaaso ge. Amaanyi mu kusaba agategeezebwa wano ga lubeerera era gajjuvu eri Katonda, nga, okujuliza ebigambo by’ekyawandiikibwa, “buli kye tumusaba akituwa.” Okusaba kuno kwetaaga ebintu ebimu ebisooka n’ebyetaagisa bye tugenda okwogerako kaakano, era ekisooka bwe buwulize obw’omwana—“Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye.” Bwe tuba nga tetulina kino, Mukama ayinza okutugamba nga bwe yagamba abantu be Isirayiri nti, “Naye mwanvaako ne muweereza bakatonda abalala, noolwekyo sigenda kubalokola nate. Mugende mukaabire bakatonda abo be mwasalawo okuweereza.”

Buli kitaawe ajja kukugamba nti okukkiriza okusaba kw’omwana omujeemu kwandibadde kuwagira bujeemu mu maka, ne kimulemesa okufuga ennyumba ye. Emirundi mingi kiba kya buvunaanyizibwa eri omuzadde okugamba nti, “Mwana wange, tewawulirizza kigambo kyange mu kaseera akayise, n’olwekyo nange siyinza kuwuliriza kikyo.” Si nti kitaawe tamwagala, wabula amwagala ddala, era olw’okwagala kwe awulira nga kimugwanidde okulaga obutasiima bwe ng’agaana okusaba kw’omwana we akyamye. Katonda atukola nga naffe bwe twandikoze abaana baffe abakakanyavu. Era bw’alaba nga tumaliridde okugenda mu kibi ne tusobya, kiba kitundu ku kukangavvula kwe okw’ekisa okw’obuzadde okugamba nti, “Nnaaziyiza okusaba kwo bw’onookaabira gye ndi; siikuwulirenga bw’onneegayirira; sijja kukuzikiriza, ojja kulokolebwa, ojja kufuna omugaati ogw’obulamu n’amazzi ag’obulamu, naye tojja kufuna kisingawo: ebirungi eby’omu bwakabaka bwange ojja kubiziyizibwa, era tojja kuba na kintu kyonna ekifaanana okuwangula okw’enjawulo gye ndi mu kusaba.”

Nti Mukama akola bw’atyo n’abantu be kyeyoleka bulungi mu Zabbuli 81—“Singa abantu bange bampuliriza; singa Isirayiri agondera ebiragiro byange, mangwago nandirwanyisizza abalabe baabwe, ne mbawangula. Naye ggwe, Isirayiri, nandikuliisizza eŋŋaano esingira ddala obulungi, ne nkukkusa omubisi gw’enjuki nga guva mu lwazi.” Kale, singa omwana wa Katonda omujeemu yateekebwa mu ngalo ekisuubizo kino—“Buli kye munaasabanga nga mukkiriza, munaakiweebwanga,” yandisabye ddala ekintu ekyandimunywezezza mu bujeemu bwe! Yandibadde asaba ebyetaago by’okwegomba kwe, n’obuyambi mu bujeemu bwe. Kino tekiyinza kugumiikirizibwa n’akatono! Katonda anaawagira obwonoonefu bwaffe? Anaaleeta enku ku muliro gw’okwegomba kw’omubiri?

Omutima ogwekkiririzaamu gwegomba eddembe erisingawo gulyoke gweyongere okukakanyala. Omwoyo ogw’amalala gwegomba okugulumizibwa okusingawo gulyoke gweyongere amalala. Omwoyo omugayaavu gusaba okuwummula okusingawo gulyoke gweyongere obugayaavu. Era omwoyo ogwagala okufuga abalala gusaba obuyinza obusingawo gulyoke gufune emikisa emirala egy’okunyigiriza. Omuntu nga bw’ali, n’okusaba kwe bwe kunaaba bwe kutyo—omwoyo omujeemu guwaayo okusaba okw’okwekkiririzaamu n’amalala. Katonda anaawuliriza okusaba ng’okwo? Tekiyinzika! Ajja kutuwa kye tusaba bwe tugondera ebiragiro bye, naye bwe tufuuka abajeemu ne tugaana obufuzi bwe, naye ajja kugaana okusaba kwaffe era agambe nti, “Bwe mweyongera okujeema, kale, nange ndibalaga obukambwe.” Era eri abakyamu yeeraga ng’abasinza amagezi. Tunaaba n’essanyu singa, olw’ekisa kya Katonda, tuyinza okwogera ne Dawudi nti, “Naaba mu ngalo zange okulaga nga bwe sirina misango; ne ndyoka nzija ku Kyoto kyo, Ayi Mukama.” Kino tekiriba bwa butaliiko musango bujjuvu, naye waakiri kiriba obutaliiko musango obw’okwagala ekibi n’okujeemera Katonda mu bugenderevu.

Okuddako ku kino waliwo ekirala ekyetaagisa okusaba okuwangula—ekitiibwa eky’omwana. Weetegereze sentensi eddako. Tufuna kye tusaba, “kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.” Tetukkiriza baana, bwe bafuna ekiragiro okuva eri kitaabwe, okubuusabuusa obutuufu bwakyo oba amagezi gaakyo. Obuwulize bukoma okubuuzibwa we kutandikira. Omwana ky’alowooza nti kye kimugwanira tekiteekwa kufuuka kipimo ky’obuyinza bwa kitaawe obw’okulagira—abaana abalungi bagamba nti, “Taata atulagidde okukola bwe tuti ne bwe tuti, n’olwekyo tujja kukikola, kubanga twagala okumusanyusa bulijjo.” Ensonga esinga obuzito eri omwana ow’okwagala ku by’akola kwe kukakasa nti kyandisanyusizza bazadde be. Era ekintu ekisinga amaanyi ekiyinza okwogerwa okuziyiza omwana omulungi kwe kukakasa nti ekkubo eryo lyandinyiizizza bazadde be. Kye kimu ddala naffe eri Katonda, Omuzadde atuukiridde, n’olwekyo tuyinza, awatali kutya kukyama, bulijjo okufuula okusiima kwe etteeka ly’ekituufu, ate etteeka ly’ekikyamu ne lisigala nga kye ekyo ekyandimunyiizizza.

Kale singa omu ku ffe yandibadde mukakanyavu n’agamba nti, “Sijja kukola ekisanyusa Katonda, nja kukola ekinsanyusa nze.” Olwo, weetegereze, okusaba kwaffe kwandibadde kwa ngeri ki? Okusaba kwaffe kwandifunzibwa mu kusaba kumu nti, “Ka nkole nga bwe njagala.” Era tuyinza okusuubira Katonda okukkiriza ekyo? Tuli ba kuba bakama ku busika bwa Katonda kyokka, oba ne ku Katonda yennyini? Wandyagadde Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna okuva ku Ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka ateekeko omuntu ow’amalala afa? Bw’oba n’omwana mu nnyumba yo atalina kitiibwa n’akatono eri kitaawe, naye agamba nti, “Njagala okukola nga bwe njagala mu buli kintu,” bw’ajja gy’oli n’okusaba, onoomwetoowaliza? Onoomukkiriza okukulagira ne weerabira ekitiibwa ekikugwanira? Onoogamba nti, “Ye, Mwana wange omwagalwa, nkitegeera nti oli wa mugaso nnyo. Ggwe onooba mukama w’ennyumba, era kyonna ky’onoosaba onookifuna”?

Ennyumba eyo yandibadde ya ngeri ki? Ntya nti waliwo ennyumba ezimu ng’ezo, kubanga waliwo abazadde abasirusiru abaganya abaana baabwe okufuuka bakama baabwe, bwe batyo ne beesalira embooko ey’okubakuba bo bennyini. Naye ennyumba ya Katonda tetegekeddwa bw’etyo! Tajja kuwuliriza baana be abakakanyavu, okuggyako okubawulira mu busungu n’okubaddamu mu kiruyi! Mujjukira engeri gye yawuliramu okusaba kwa Isirayiri okw’ennyama, era ennyama yali ekyali mu mannyo gaabwe nga tebannaba kugirya n’efuuka ekikolimo gye bali? Abantu bangi bakangavvulwa nga bafuna kye beegomba, nga bwe kiri nti abadda ennyuma bajjuzibwa empenda zaabwe bennyini. Tuteekwa okuba n’ekitiibwa eky’omwana eri Katonda, ne tuwulira nti, “Mukama, bwe kiba nti kye nsaba tekikusanyusa, nange tekyandinsanyusizza. Okwegomba kwange nkuteeka mu ngalo zo kutereezebwe. Sazaamu buli kye nsaba ekitali kituufu, era, Mukama, teekamu kyonna kye nnalese, ne bwe kiba nti nandibadde sikyegomba singa nnakijjukira. Mukama omulungi, bwe kiba nti nnandisaanidde okukyegomba, mpulira nga bwe nnandibadde nkyegombye. ‘Naye si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula nga ggwe bw’oyagala.’ “ Kaakano ndowooza mulaba nti omwoyo guno ogwewaayo gwetaagisa okuwangula ne Katonda mu kusaba bulijjo. Ekikontana nakyo kiziyiza ddala okukulaakulana mu kwegayirira. Mukama ateekwa okutiibwa abo abamwetooloola. Bateekwa okutunuulira okusiima kwe mu byonna bye bakola ne mu byonna bye basaba, oba si ekyo tajja kubatunuulira n’okusiima.

Mu kifo eky’okusatu, ekyawandiikibwa kiraga obwetaavu bw’okwesiga okw’omwana—“Era kino ky’atulagira nti, tukkiririze mu linnya ly’Omwana we Yesu Kristo.” Buli wamu mu Byawandiikibwa okukkiriza Katonda kwogerwako ng’okwetaagisa okusaba okuwangula. Tuteekwa okukkiriza nti Katonda waali era nti abo abamunoonya n’obwesigwa abawa empeera, oba si ekyo tetunnasaba n’akatono. Okusaba kwaffe kuwangula okusinziira ku kukkiriza kwaffe. Lino tteeka eriyimirivu ery’obwakabaka, “olw’okukkiriza kwammwe, kye musabye mukiweereddwa.” Mujjukira engeri Omwoyo Omutukuvu gy’ayogera ng’ayita mu kamwa k’Omutume Yakobo? “Naye obanga omuntu yenna ku mmwe aweebuka mu magezi, asabenga Katonda agabira bonna atakayuka, galimuweebwa. Kyokka amusabenga mu kukkiriza, nga tabuusabuusa, kubanga oyo abuusabuusa ali ng’ejjengo ery’oku nnyanja erisundibwa empewo. Omuntu ng’oyo bw’atasaba na kukkiriza tasuubira Mukama kumuwaayo kintu kyonna.”

Ekyawandiikibwa kyogera ku kukkiriza mu linnya ly’Omwana we Yesu Kristo, kye ntegeera nti kitegeeza okukkiriza Embala ye eyalangirirwa, okukkiriza Enjiri ye, okukkiriza Amazima agakwata ku kifo kye yatuddira n’Obulokozi bwe. Oba kiyinza okutegeeza okukkiriza obuyinza bwa Kristo, nti bwe nneegayirira Katonda ne ŋŋamba nti, “Kikole mu linnya lya Yesu,” ntegeeza nti, “Nkolera nga bw’owandikoledde Yesu, kubanga ampadde obuyinza okukozesa erinnya lye. Kinkolere nga bw’owandikimukoledde Ye.” Oyo asobola okusaba n’okukkiriza mu linnya lya Yesu tayinza kulemererwa, kubanga Mukama Yesu yagamba nti, “Bwe munaasabanga ekintu kyonna mu linnya lyange nnaakikolanga.” Naye okukkiriza kuteekwa okubaawo, era bwe wataba kukkiriza tetuyinza kusuubira kuwulirwa. Mukitegeera

ekyo?

Ka tuddeyo nate ku byokulabirako byaffe eby’omu maka. Singa omwana mu nnyumba takkiriza kigambo kya kitaawe, era bulijjo agamba nti amagezi ge gajjudde okubuusabuusa ku bwesigwa bwa kitaawe? Singa, mazima, abuulira baganda be ne bannyina nti okukkiriza kwe mu kitaawe kunafu nnyo? Ayogera ekintu ekyo eky’ennaku, era tekimwewuunyisa n’akatono nti ayogera ekintu ng’ekyo, wabula alowooza nti asaanidde okusaasirwa, ng’alinga alina obunafu bw’atayinza

kwewala. Mu ngeri emu oba endala takkiriza nti kitaawe ayogera mazima, era alangirira nti wadde agezaako okukkiriza ekisuubizo kya kitaawe, naye tasobola.

Ndowooza kitaawe atakkiririzibwamu mu ngeri ey’obuswavu bw’etyo teyandyanguyiridde kukkiriza kusaba kwa mutabani ng’oyo. Mazima, kiyinzika nnyo nti okwegayirira kw’omwana atakkiriza kwandibadde kwa ngeri etayinza kukkirizibwa, ne bwe kiba nti kitaawe yandyagadde okukikola, kubanga kwandibadde kusanyusa butakkiriza bwe n’okuswaza omuzadde we! Okugeza, singa omwana ono akwatibwa endowooza ey’okubuusabuusa obanga kitaawe anaamuwanga emmere ye eya buli lunaku? Ayinza, olwo, okujja eri kitaawe n’agamba nti, “Taata, mpa ssente ezimala emyaka 10 egijja, kubanga olwo nnaaba nfuuse musajja era nnaasobola okwerabirira. Mpa ssente kaakano zikkakkanye okutya kwange, kubanga ndi mu kweraliikirira kungi.” Kitaawe n’amuddamu nti, “Mwana wange, lwaki nkola ekyo?”

Era n’afuna okuddibwamu kuno: “Kinnakuwaza okukyogera, Taata omwagalwa, naye siyinza kukwesiga. Okukkiriza kwange mu ggwe ne mu kwagala kwo kunafu nnyo ne ntya nti olunaku lumu olindeka enjala n’enzita. N’olwekyo nnandyagadde okuba n’ekintu ekikakafu mu bbanka.” Ani ku mmwe bakitaabwe eyandiwulirizza okusaba kw’omwana bwe yandisabye ekintu ng’ekyo? Wandinakuwadde nti ebirowoozo ebikuswaza bwe bityo biyita mu mutima gw’omu ku baagalwa bo! Era towandibikkirizza, era towandisobodde kubikkiriza. Kale, ka mbasabe mukozese olugero luno ku mmwe mwennyini. Temuwangayo kusaba okwali kumpi kwa ngeri eyo? Mulemereddwa okwesiga Katonda okubawa, buli lunaku, emmere yammwe eya buli lunaku, n’olwekyo mubadde mwegomba kye muyita, “eby’okwerinda mu biseera eby’omu maaso.”

Mwagala omugabi eyeesigika okusinga enteekateeka ya Katonda, obukakafu obusinga ekisuubizo kya Katonda! Temusobola kwesiga Kigambo kya Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu. Ebiwandiiko by’ebbanja eby’obwakabaka obumu obw’ewala obunaatera okugwa lubege mubitwala nga byesigika nnyo okusingawo. Musobola okwesiga Sulutaani wa Butuluuki, oba Omufuzi wa Misiri, naye si Katonda w’ensi yonna! Mu ngeri lukumi tuvuma Mukama nga tulowooza nti “ebintu ebirabika” bye bisinga obunywevu okusinga Obuyinza bwe bwonna obutalabika. Tusaba Katonda atuwe, mangu ago, bye tutetaaga kaakano era bye tuyinza obutabyetaaga n’akatono! Mu ntobo, ensonga y’okwegomba okwo eyinza okusangibwa mu butamwesiga obw’obuswavu, obutuleetera okulowooza nti ebiterekebwa ebingi byetaagisa okutukakasa nti tujja kugabirwa.

Abooluganda, temuli na musango wano, era musuubira Mukama okuyamba n’okuwagira obusirusiru bwammwe? Katonda anaawagira obutamwesiga bwammwe? Anaabawa entuumu ya zaabu ne ffeeza ebitalagga, ababbi babibbe, n’ebisanduuko by’engoye okuliisa ennyenje? Mwandyagadde Mukama okukola ng’akkiriza nti okuteebereza kwammwe kutuufu, era ng’atula nti si mwesigwa? Kikafuuwe! N’olwekyo temusuubira kuwulirwa okusaba kwammwe bwe kuleetebwa omutima ogutakkiriza— “By’okola byonna byesigamyenga ku Mukama; mwesigenga, anaakukoleranga ky’oyagala.” Ekintu ekiddako ekyetaagisa okuwangula mu kusaba bulijjo kwe kwagala okw’omwana—“tukkiririze mu linnya ly’Omwana we Yesu Kristo, era twagalanenga nga ye bwe yatulagira.”

Ekiragiro ekikulu oluvannyuma lw’okukkiriza kwe kwagala. Nga bwe kyogerwa ku Katonda nti, “Katonda kwagala,” naffe tuyinza okugamba nti, “Obukristaayo kwagala.” Singa buli omu ku ffe yali kwagala okwambadde omubiri, twandibadde tutuuse ku kufaanana Kristo mu bujjuvu. Twandibadde tujjudde okwagala eri Katonda, okwagala eri Kristo, okwagala eri Ekkanisa, okwagala eri aboonoonyi n’okwagala eri abantu buli wamu! Omuntu bw’ataba na kwagala eri Katonda, aba mu mbeera y’omwana atalina kwagala eri kitaawe. Kitaawe anaasuubiza awatali kakwakkulizo konna okutuukiriza byonna omutima gwe ogutalina kwagala, ogutali gwa mwana, bye gwegomba? Oba, omwana bw’ataba na kwagala eri baganda be ne bannyina, kitaawe anaamwesiga n’ekisuubizo ekitaliiko kakwakkulizo, n’amugamba nti, “Musabe, munaaweebwa?” Mazima, omwana atalina kwagala yandyavuwazza amaka gonna olw’okusaba kwe okw’okwefaako yekka! Nga tafaayo ku balala bonna ab’omu nju, yandifuddeyo kwokka ku kusanyusa okwegomba kwe. Mangu ddala okusaba kwe kwandibadde—“Taata, mpa obusika bwonna.” Oba, “Taata, tegeka amaka gansanyuse era olagire baganda bange bonna bagondere bye njagala.”

Ng’eyeewaanira endabika ye, nga Abusaalomu eyali yeenyumiriza mu nviiri ze, mangu yandinoonyezza obwakabaka ku lulwe! Ba Yusufu batono abayinza okwambala ekyambalo eky’amabala amangi ne batafuuka bannakyemalira mu maka. Ani yandikkirizza omwana omujaajaamya okudduka n’ebintu by’amaka? Ani yandibadde musirusiru okuteeka muganda omululu era ayagala okufuga ku ntebe ey’ekitiibwa, waggulu wa baganda be ne bannyina? N’olwekyo, mulaba nti okwefaako wekka tekuyinza kwesigibwa na maanyi mu kusaba. Emyoyo egitalina kwagala, egitayagala Katonda wadde abantu, tegiyinza kwesigibwa na bisuubizo ebinene, ebigazi, ebitaliiko kkomo. Katonda bw’aba wa kutuwulira, tuteekwa okwagala Katonda n’okwagala bantu bannaffe, kubanga bwe twagala Katonda, tetujja kusaba kintu kyonna ekitandiwadde Katonda kitiibwa, era tetujja kwagala kulaba kintu kyonna nga kitutuukako ekitandiwadde n’abooluganda omukisa. Emitima gyaffe gijja kukuba mu bwesigwa eri Katonda n’eri ebitonde bye, era tetujja kwezingiriza mu ffe ffekka. Oteekwa okweggyako okwefaako wekka Katonda nga tannaba

kukwesiga n’ebisumuluzo by’Eggulu. Okwefaako bwe kufa, olwo ajja kukusobozesa okusumulula amawanika ge, era ng’omulangira, olimeggana ne Katonda n’owangula.

Okuddako ku kino, tuteekwa n’okuba n’empisa ez’omwana. Musome olunyiriri oluddako. “Kale oyo agondera ebiragiro bye abeera mu Ye, era naye abeera mu ye.” Emu ku mpisa z’omwana kwe kwagala ewaka. Omwana omulungi, kitaawe gw’awuliriza bulijjo by’asaba, tewali kifo ky’ayagala nga ennyumba enkadde ennyagalwa bazadde be mwe babeera. Kale oyo ayagala era agondera ebiragiro bya Katonda kyogerwa nti abeera mu Ye—afudde Mukama ekifo kye mw’abeera, era abeera mu kukolagana okutukuvu okw’oku lusegere ne Katonda. Mu ye ebigambo bya Mukama waffe bituukirira nti, “bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.” Okukkiriza n’okwagala, ng’ebiwaawaatiro bibiri ebya bakerubi, bisitudde emmeeme y’omukkiriza okusukka ensi ne bimutwala okumpi n’Entebe ya Katonda. Afuuse ng’afaanana Katonda, era kaakano okusaba kwe kufuuse okwo Katonda kw’ayinza okuddamu—naye okutuusa lw’anaafaananyizibwa bw’atyo n’endowooza ya Katonda, amaanyi g’okwegayirira kwe galina okubaako ekkomo. Okubeera mu Katonda kyetaagisa okuba n’amaanyi eri Katonda.

Singa omu ku mmwe yalina omulenzi eyagamba nti, “Taata, saagala waka wange, sikufaako, era sijja kugumiikiriza kukugirwa kwa mateeka g’amaka. Ŋŋenda kubeera n’abagwira, naye weetegereze, Taata, nja kujjanga gy’oli buli wiiki era nja kukusabanga ebintu bingi. Era nja kusuubira nti onoompanga buli kye nkusaba”? Mazima, bw’oba ng’osaanidde n’akatono okuba omukulu w’ennyumba, ojja kugamba nti, “Mwana wange, oyinza otya okwogera nange mu ngeri eyo? Bw’oba nga weekakanyaza n’olekawo ennyumba yange, oyinza okusuubira nti nja kukola by’olagira? Bw’oba nga onnyooma ddala, oyinza okusuubira nti nja kukuwagira mu butali bwa kisa bwo obw’obukambwe n’obujeemu bwo obubi? Nedda, mwana wange, bw’otoobeere nange n’ontwala nga kitaawo, siyinza kukusuubiza kintu kyonna.”

Era bwe kiri ne Katonda. Bwe tunaabeeranga naye ne tukolagana naye, ajja kutuwa ebintu byonna. Bwe tunaamwagala nga bw’asaanidde okwagalibwa, ne tumwesiga nga bw’asaanidde okwesigibwa, olwo ajja kuwulira bye tusaba. Naye bwe kitaba bwe kityo, si kya magezi okukisuubira. Mazima, kyandibadde kiswaza Embala ya Katonda okutuukiriza okwegomba okutali kutukuvu n’okusanyusa obwagazi obubi. “Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga,” naye bw’otosanyukira Katonda era nga si ye kifo ky’obeeramu, tajja kukuddamu. Ayinza okukuwa omugaati ogw’okulaba ennaku, n’amazzi ag’okubonaabona n’afuula obulamu bwo okukaawa, naye ddala tajja kukuwa omutima gwo bye gwegomba.

Ekintu ekimu ekirala—kirabika mu kyawandiikibwa nti tuteekwa okuba n’omwoyo ogw’omwana, kubanga, “Kino tukimanyi ng’ali mu ffe, kubanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu gwe yatuwa abeera mu ffe.” Kino kiki wabula Omwoyo eyatufuula abaana—Omwoyo afuga mu baana ba Katonda bonna? Abakakanyavu abalowooza, abawulira era abakola mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku Katonda tebasaanidde kusuubira nti Katonda ajja kukyuka adde mu ndowooza yaabwe, mu nneewulira yaabwe ne mu bikolwa byabwe! Abeefaako bokka abatambuzibwa omwoyo ogw’amalala, n’abagayaavu abatambuzibwa okwagala okuwummula, tebasaanidde kusuubira nti Katonda ajja kubasanyusa! Omwoyo Omutukuvu, bw’aba afuga mu ffe, ajja kuteeka obutonde bwaffe wansi w’obuyinza bwe, olwo okusaba okuva mu mitima gyaffe egyazzibwa obuggya kujja kukwatagana n’okwagala kwa Katonda—era okusaba ng’okwo kujja kuwulirwa nga bwe kisaanidde.

Tewali muzadde yandirowoozezza kuwuliriza mwana mukakanyavu, omwana agamba nti, “Mmanyi nti kitange tayagala nfune kino, naye nja kukifuna.” Mazima, ng’omusajja towandikkirizza kuzunzibwa bw’otyo muvubuka eyeegulumiza! Katonda anaatuwa kye tusaba nga kikontana n’endowooza ye entukuvu? Tekisaanidde kubaawo! Ekyo tekiyinza na kulowoozebwako! Tuteekwa okubaamu endowooza eri eyali mu Kristo Yesu, olwo tujja kusobola okwogera nti, “Mmanyi nti bulijjo ompulira.” Naye tuteekwa okweyongerayo tubalage, okumala eddakiika ntono, ettabi eddala ery’omulamwa gwe gumu.

II. Mu kifo eky’okubiri tujja kulaba OKUWANGULA KW’EBINTU BINO EBYETAAGISA. Bwe biba mu ffe era nga bisukkirivu, okusaba kwaffe tekuyinza kuba kugumba oba okutaliiko mugaso. Okusooka, bwe tuba n’okukkiriza mu Katonda, tewali kubuusabuusa nti Katonda awulira okusaba kwaffe. Bwe tusobola okuwoza, mu kukkiriza, erinnya n’omusaayi gwa Yesu, tuteekwa okufuna okuddibwamu okw’emirembe. Naye ensonga lukumi zireetebwa. Singa okusaba kuno kukwata ku Mateeka g’Obutonde? Olwo abantu ba ssaayansi batuwakanya. Kiki ekyo? Nja kwenyumiriza okuwa abantu bano aba ssaayansi ebbanga erimala—kumpi nnaagamba ebbanga erimala.

Simanyi kusaba kwonna okugwanira okusabibwa okutakwatagana na tteeka lya butonde limu oba eddala, kyokka nzikiriza nti okusaba kuwulirwa! Kigambibwa nti Katonda tajja kukyusa Mateeka ga Butonde ku lwaffe, nange nziramu nti, “Ani yali agambye nti ajja kukikola?” Mukama alina amakubo ag’okuddamu okusaba kwaffe awatali kukola byamagero oba kuyimiriza mateeka. Edda yawuliranga okusaba ng’akozesa ebyamagero, naye nga bwe mbagambye emirundi mingi, ekyo kirabika ng’engeri esingako obukakanyavu okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kye—kiri ng’okuyimiriza ekyuma ekinene ennyo olw’ekivaamu ekitono—amanyi engeri y’okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bye n’okuwulira okusaba kwaffe mu makubo ag’ekyama ge simanyi.

Oboolyawo waliwo amaanyi n’amateeka amalala ge yategeka okukola mu biseera ddala okusaba nakwo lwe kukola. Amateeka aganywevu ddala era amaanyi ag’obutonde ddala nga ago abayivu baffe abanoonyereza ge basobodde okuzuula. Abantu abasinga amagezi tebamanyi mateeka gonna agafuga ebitonde byonna, nedda, wadde ekitundu kimu eky’ekkumi kyago! Tukkiriza nti okusaba kw’Abakristaayo kitundu ku kyuma ky’enteekateeka ya Katonda, amannyo mu nnamuziga ennene ey’ebigenda okubaawo—era Katonda bw’akulembera abaana be okusaba, aba amaze okutambuza nnamuziga egenda okuleeta ekyo ekisabiddwa, era okusaba okuweereddwayo kutambula ng’ekitundu ku nnamuziga eyo. Bwe wabaawo okukkiriza mu Katonda kwokka, Katonda ateekwa okulekera awo okubaawo, oba okulekera awo okuba ow’amazima, oba si ekyo ateekwa okuwulira okusaba!

Olunyiriri olukulembera ekyawandiikibwa lugamba nti, “omutima gwaffe bwe gutatusalira musango, tuba bagumu mu maaso ga Katonda. Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa.” Oyo alina omutima omulongoofu ajja eri Katonda n’obugumu, era obugumu obwo obw’okukkiriza bumukakasa okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwe. Obugumu bw’omwana butusobozesa okusaba nga tewali mulala ayinza. Buleetera omuntu okusaba ebintu ebinene by’ataandisabye singa teyayiga bugumu buno. Bumuleetera okusaba ebintu ebitono abangi bye batya okusaba, kubanga tebannawulira eri Katonda bugumu bwa baana. Nnagamba emirundi mingi nti kyetaagisa obwesige obusingawo mu Katonda okumusaba ku kantu akatono okusinga ku bintu ebinene. Tulowooza nti ebintu byaffe ebinene bisaanira mu ngeri emu okufiibwako Katonda, wadde mu mazima bitono nnyo gy’ali! Ate ne tulowooza nti ebintu byaffe ebitono biteekwa okuba eby’obwereere ennyo ne kiba nga kumpi kuvvoola okubimuleetera, so nga twandimanyidde nti ekyo ekinene ennyo eri omwana kiyinza okuba ekitono ennyo eri omuzadde we—kyokka omuzadde tapima kintu okusinziira ku ndaba ye, wabula okusinziira ku y’omwana.

Mwawulira mutabani wammwe omuto ennaku ezo ng’akaaba nnyo. Nnyina n’amuyita n’amubuuza ekimuluma. Kaali kati akaamufumita mu lugalo. Kale, ekyo kyali kintu kitono. Temwayagala kuyita basawo basatu kukaggyamu, oba kulaya nnyo mu mpapula z’amawulire! Muleete empiso tujja kukitereeza mangu. Naye, nga kyali kintu kinene eri omubonaabona oyo omuto omulungi bwe yali ayimiridde awo n’amaaso nga gajjudde amaziga ag’obulumi. Kyali kintu kinene gy’ali! Kale, omulenzi oyo yalowooza nti obulumi bwe bwali butono nnyo nnyina okubufaako? N’akatono! Bamaama ne bataata baatondebwa lwa ki, bwe kitaba kufaayo ku byetaago ebitono eby’abaana abato? Era Katonda, Kitaffe, Kitaffe mulungi. Atusaasira nga kitaawe w’abaana bw’asaasira abaana be, era yeetoowaza gye tuli. Mukama ategeka omuwendo gw’emmunyeenye; era buli emu n’agituuma erinnya, kyokka azzaamu amaanyi abo abalina emitima egimenyese, era ajjanjaba ebiwundu byabwe. Katonda oyo akoleeza enjuba yagamba nti, “Sirizikiza olutambi olwaka empola ennyo.” Bw’oba n’obwesige mu Katonda bwokka, ojja kumutwalira ebintu byo ebinene n’ebitono, era tajja kulimbisa bwesige bwo—kubanga yagamba nti abo abamwesiga tebaakwatibwenga nsonyi, tebaaswalenga emirembe gyonna. Okukkiriza kuteekwa okuwangula!

Naye ekiddako, n’okwagala kuteekwa okuwangula, kubanga tumaze okulaba nti omuntu ayagala, mu ngeri y’Ekikristaayo, akwatagana ne Katonda. Bw’okomya okwagala kwo ku maka go gokka, tosaanidde kusuubira Katonda kukola bw’atyo, era okusaba okufunze mu nkulungo eyo tajja kukufaako. Omuntu bw’ayagala nnaggwano we omutono yekka, n’asuubira nti amakungula g’eŋŋaano ga buli muntu galifa, ebibala bye bifune omuwendo omunene, ddala tayinza kusuubira Mukama kukkiriziganya n’okwefaako okw’ekikopo ng’okwo! Omuntu bw’aba n’omutima omugazi ogusobola okwagala ebitonde byonna ebya Katonda, so nga asabira mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ab’omu nnyumba ey’okukkiriza, okusaba kwe kujja kukwatagana n’endowooza ya Katonda. Okwagala kwe n’obulungi bwa Katonda bitambulira wamu. Wadde okwagala kwa Katonda kuli ng’omugga omunene ogukulukuta n’amaanyi, ng’okwe kuli ng’akagga akatonnya, kyokka byombi bikulukutira mu kkubo limu era byombi bijja kutuuka ku nkomerero y’emu. Katonda bulijjo awulira okusaba kw’omuntu ayagala kubanga okusaba okwo kisiikirize ky’ebyo bye yasalawo.

Ate era, omuntu omuwulize gwe muntu Katonda gw’ajja okuwulira, kubanga omutima gwe omuwulize gumuleetera okusaba n’obwetoowaze n’okwewaayo, kubanga awulira nti ky’asinga okwegomba kwe kuba nti okwagala kwa Mukama kukolebwe. N’olwekyo omuntu ow’omutima omuwulize asaba nga nnabbi—okusaba kwe bunnabbi. Si mumu ne Katonda? Tegomba era tasaba ddala ekyo Katonda ky’agenderera? Okusaba okulasiddwa okuva mu mutego ng’ogwo kuyinza kutya obutatuuka ku kiruubirirwa kyakwo? Emmeeme yo bw’ekwatagana n’emmeeme ya Katonda, ojja kwagala Katonda by’ayagala! Obuzibu buli nti tetusigala, nga bwe boogera, nga tukwatagana ne Katonda. Naye singa twakikola, twandikubye eddoboozi lye limu Katonda ly’akuba, era wadde nga erirye lyandiwulikika ng’okubwatuka n’eryaffe ng’okwogera mu kaama, kyokka wandibaddewo okukwatagana okutuukiridde—eddoboozi erikubiddwa okusaba ku nsi lyandikwatagana n’eryo eriva mu biragiro by’omu Ggulu.

Ate era, omuntu abeera mu kukolagana ne Katonda ddala ajja kuwangula mu kusaba, kubanga bw’aba abeera mu Katonda, ne Katonda ng’abeera mu ye, ajja kwegomba Katonda by’ayagala. Omukkiriza ali mu kukolagana ne Mukama ayagala abantu babeere bulungi, ne Katonda bw’atyo. Ayagala Ekitiibwa kya Kristo, ne Katonda bw’atyo. Ayagala Ekkanisa ekulaakulane, ne Katonda bw’atyo. Ayagala ye yennyini okuba ekyokulabirako eky’obutukuvu, ne Katonda naye ky’ayagala. Omuntu oyo bw’aba n’okwegomba okutakwatagana na

kwagala kwa Katonda, kiva mu butamanya, kubanga omuntu muntu buntu so si Katonda. Ne bw’aba mu mbeera ye esinga obulungi ateekwa okukyama, naye kino akigonjoola mu ngeri y’okusaba kwe, okulina bulijjo ekyongerwako kino ku nkomerero yaakwo—“Mukama, bwe mba nga nsabye mu kusaba kwange kuno ekintu kyonna ekitakwatagana na ndowooza yo, nkwegayiridde, tompuliriza. Era bwe wabaawo okwegomba kwonna kwe nkubuulidde—ne bwe kiba nti kwe kwegomba okwokya mu kifuba kyange okusinga ebirala byonna—nga si kutuufu mu maaso go, tompuliriza, Kitange, naye, mu kwagala kwo n’okusaasira kwo okutaliiko kkomo, kolera omuddu wo ekisinga obulungi okusinga omuddu wo by’amanyi okusaba.”

Kaakano, okusaba bwe kuba kwa ngeri eyo, kuyinza kutya okulemererwa? Mukama atunula mu madirisa g’Eggulu n’alaba okusaba ng’okwo nga kujja gy’ali, nga Nuuwa bwe yalaba ejjuba nga likomawo mu lyato, n’agolola omukono gwe eri okusaba okwo. Era nga Nuuwa bwe n’alikwata n’aliyingiza mu lyato, ne Katonda bw’atyo akwata okusaba okwo n’akuyingiza gy’ali, n’akuteeka mu kifuba kye yennyini, n’agamba nti, “Wava mu kifuba kyange, era nkwaniriza okudda gye ndi—Omwoyo wange ye yakubumba, n’olwekyo nja kukuddamu.” Era wano, nate, ka tugambe nti, ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kyogera ku Mukristaayo ng’ajjudde Omwoyo wa Katonda—“Kino tukimanyi ng’ali mu ffe, kubanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu gwe yatuwa abeera mu ffe.” Ani amanyi ebirowoozo by’omuntu okuggyako omwoyo w’omuntu? Bw’atyo, n’ebintu bya Katonda tewali abimanyi okuggyako Omwoyo wa Katonda. Era Omwoyo wa Katonda bw’abeera mu ffe, olwo atubuulira endowooza ya Katonda bw’eri. Ye yeegayiririra abatukuvu ng’okusiima kwa Katonda bwe kuli!

Oluusi kirowoozebwa nti abantu abawangula mu kusaba basobola okusaba kyonna kye baagala, naye mbakakasa nti buli omu ku bo ajja kubagamba nti si bwe kiri. Oyinza okugenda eri omuntu ng’oyo n’omusaba akusabire, naye tayinza kukusuubiza nti ajja kukikola. Waliwo okuziyizibwa okw’ekyewuunyo abantu ng’abo kwe bawulira, nga tebamanyi ngeri wadde ensonga, nti tebasobola kusaba kusaba okw’amaanyi okw’omutima omumalirivu mu nsonga ezimu, wadde nga bandyagadde okukikola. Nga Pawulo bwe yagezaako okugenda e Bisuniya, naye Mwoyo wa Yesu n’atabakkiriza, bwe kityo waliwo bye twandyagadde okusaba mu butonde, naye nga tusibiddwa mu mwoyo. Okusaba kuyinza obutalabika nga kulina kikyamu kyonna, naye ekyama kya Mukama kiri n’abo abamutya, era awa obubonero obw’ekyama ddi era wa abalonde be we bayinza okusuubira okuwangula. Akuwa ekisuubizo nti ajja kuwulira okusaba kwo okw’okukkiriza, ggwe ng’oli muntu atambula naye, ajjudde Omwoyo we. Naye takuwa, mu kiseera kye kimu, kukkiriza ku buli kintu buli muntu ky’ayagala okukuleetera—wabula akuwa okwawula, okusalawo n’amagezi—era Omwoyo yeegayiririra abatukuvu ng’okusiima kwa

Katonda bwe kuli.

Bwe ntyo ndowooza nteese enjigiriza bulungi nnyo. Kaakano eddakiika ntono ez’okulongoosa obulamu, ng’Abapulitaani ab’edda bwe baagambanga. Nsuubira nti ziryongera okulongoosa bangi ku ffe. Ekisooka, twagala okusabira omukisa omunene ng’Ekkanisa. Ndowooza nnandifunye obululu bwammwe singa ŋŋamba nti tugenderera okusaba Katonda aweereze omukisa ku Kkanisa yonna okutwalira awamu. Kale bulungi. Tulina ebyetaagisa okuwangula? Tukkiriza mu linnya lya Yesu Kristo? Kale, ndowooza bwe kiri. Sirowooza nti wandibaddewo ensobi esangibwa mu butuufu bw’okukkiriza kwaffe, wadde nga bingi bye tuteekwa okwatula ku bunafu bwakwo.

Ka tweyongereyo ku kibuuzo ekiddako. Tujjudde okwagala eri Katonda n’eri bannaffe? Ekiragiro eky’emirundi ebiri kiri nti tukkirize mu linnya lya Yesu Kristo era nti twagalane. Twagalana? Tutambulira mu kwagala? Tewali n’omu ku ffe atuukiridde mu kyo. Nja kusooka okwatula nga nzikiriza nti siri nga bwe nsaanidde okuba mu nsonga eyo. Munaaleka okwatula kuno okwetooloola, buli omu alowooze emirundi emeka gye tukoze ebintu ebitali bya kwagala, ne tulowooza ebitali bya kwagala, ne twogera ebitali bya kwagala, ne tuwuliriza olugambo olutali lwa kwagala, ne tuziyiza omukono gwaffe awatali kwagala nga twandiyambye, ne tugolola omukono gwaffe awatali kwagala okusindika wansi omuntu eyali agwa? Bwe wabaawo obutaba na kwagala mu Kkanisa ya Katonda, tetuyinza kusuubira kusaba kuwulirwa, kubanga Katonda ajja kugamba nti, “Musaba okukulaakulana. Lwa ki? Okwongera abalala ku kibiina ekitannaba na kwagalana? Musaba abantu okukyuka. Ki? Okuyingiza abalala okwegatta ku kibiina ekitalina kwagala?”

Musuubira Katonda okulokola aboonoonyi be mutayagala, n’okukyusa emmeeme ze mutafaako n’akatono? Tuteekwa okwagala emmeeme okuzireeta eri Kristo, kubanga, wansi w’Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda, ekikozesebwa ekikulu okuwangula ensi kwe kwagala! Abakristaayo bwe banaayagala okusinga Abasiraamu n’Abayudaaya bwe bayagala, bajja kuwangula Abasiraamu n’Abayudaaya! Era bwe banaalaga okwagala okutono, Abasiraamu n’Abayudaaya bajja kubawangula! Ekigambo kya Katonda, ekitala eky’Omwoyo, kye kyokulwanyisa ekisinga byonna. Naye okuddako ku ekyo ye mpisa ey’okwagala n’enjogera ey’ekisa ey’Abakristaayo eri bantu bannaabwe. Ekyo tukirinaako kyenkana wa? Ŋŋambe nti, kitono kyenkana ki?

Ekiddako, tukola ebyo ebisanyusa mu maaso ga Katonda? Tetuyinza kusuubira kuddibwamu kusaba bwe tutakikola. Buli omu yeebuuze ekibuuzo kino. Buli mmemba w’Ekkanisa, okusingira ddala, addemu ekibuuzo ekyo. Mu kiseera kino ekiyise, obadde okola ebyo by’wandyagadde Yesu Kristo okulaba? Amaka go gategekeddwa mu ngeri esanyusa Katonda? Singa Yesu

Kristo yali akyaliddeko ennyumba yo wiiki eno, nga tayitiddwa era nga tomusuubira—yandirowoozezza ki ku ebyo bye yandirabye? “Woowe,” omu ayogera, “Mmanyi nti gundi akola ebitakwatagana n’ebyo by’ayatula.” Ssebo, nkwegayiridde, weerowoozeeko ggwe kennyini. Eyo ye nsonga. Weetereeze ggwe kennyini. Bammemba b’Ekkanisa ya Katonda bwe batakola ebisanyusa mu maaso ge, baggalawo oluggi ku kukulaakulana—baziyiza okusaba kw’Ekkanisa okuwangula. Ani ayagala okuba omuntu ayimiridde mu kkubo ly’okukulaakulana kw’Ekkanisa ya Katonda olw’enneeyisa etakwatagana na by’ayatula? Ani yandyagadde okuba n’omusango ogwo? Katonda asonyiwe abamu ku mmwe. Twandyogedde ku bamu nga tukaaba, kubanga, mazima, wadde beeyita abagoberezi ba Kristo, bakola ebitakwatagana nnyo ne kiba nti si mikwano, wabula abalabe b’omusaalaba gwa Kristo.

Ekibuuzo ekiddako kiri nti, tubeera mu Katonda? Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti bwe tugondera ebiragiro bye Katonda abeera mu ffe naffe mu Ye. Bwe kiri bwe kityo? Ntegeeza nti, emisana tulowooza ku Katonda? Mu mirimu gyaffe tukyali wamu ne Katonda? Omukristaayo tasaanidde kudduka eri Katonda ku makya ne kawungeezi kyokka, n’amukozesa ng’obuddukiro n’ekintu eky’akaseera obuseera, ng’abantu bwe baddukira wansi w’omulyango omuzimbe oba ekisasi nga enkuba etonnya. Tuteekwa okubeera mu Katonda n’okubeera mu Ye okuva enjuba lw’evaayo okutuusa lw’egwa, nga tumufuula ekyo kye tufumiitirizaako buli lunaku, era nga tutambula ng’abali mu maaso ge, nga tuwulira bulijjo nti, “Oli Katonda alaba.” Kiri kitya gye muli, mikwano gyange abaagalwa? Woowe, ekibuuzo kiyite okuva ku ntebe okudda ku ntebe n’okuva ku mutima okudda ku mutima, era mwetegereze—buli omu yeeddemu yekka.

Ekisembayo, Omwoyo wa Katonda y’atutambuza, oba mwoyo mulala? Tulindirira Katonda ne tugamba nti, “Mukama, Omwoyo wo ambuulire kye nsaanidde okwogera mu nsonga eno, ne kye nsaanidde okukola. Fuga okusalawo kwange, kkakkanya okwegomba kwange, ziyiza obwagazi bwange obwa wansi, era Omwoyo wo ankulembere. Mukama, beera gye ndi ggwe asinga nze kennyini. Beera emmeeme n’obulamu gye ndi, era mu bwakabaka obw’emirundi esatu obw’omwoyo gwange, emmeeme n’omubiri, Mukama omulungi, beera ggwe Mukama asinga byonna, mu buli kitundu ky’obutonde bwange Amateeka go gateekebwewo n’okwagala kwo kufiibweko”? Twandibadde Kkanisa ya maanyi singa ffenna twalina endowooza eno. Naye ekibiina ekitabuddwamu kiri naffe, ekibiina ekitabuddwamu ekyava mu Misiri, era abo bagwa mu kuluulunkana. Akabi bulijjo kava gye bali. Katonda atuwonye, ng’Ekkanisa, okufiirwa Okubeerawo kwe.

Ekibiina ekitabuddwamu kiteekwa okubeera naffe okutugezesa, kubanga Mukama yagamba nti, “Kale mubireke byonna bikulire wamu, okukungula bwe kulituuka,” era bwe tunaagezaako okukuulamu omuddo twandikuuliddemu n’eŋŋaano—naye, ka kibe kityo, ka tusabe Katonda eŋŋaano agifuule ey’amaanyi okusingawo. Wabaawo ekimu ku bibiri bulijjo mu Kkanisa. Oba eŋŋaano ezisa omuddo oba omuddo guzisa eŋŋaano. Katonda akkirize eŋŋaano esukke omuddo mu nsonga yaffe. Katonda awe abaddu be ekisa babe ba maanyi ekimala okuwangula ekibi ekibeetoolodde, era, nga bamaze okukola byonna, basigale nga banywevu olw’ettendo ly’ekitiibwa ky’ekisa kye, oyo era eyatukkiriza mu Mwagalwa. Mukama abawe omukisa, era abeere nammwe emirembe gyonna. Amiina era Amiina.

EKITUNDU KY’EBYAWANDIIKIBWA EKYASOMEBWA NGA OKUBUULIRA TEKUNNATANDIKA—1 Yokaana 3; Isaaya 1:10-20.
fields.body_text: “Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa. Era kino ky’atulagira nti, tukkiririze mu linnya ly’Omwana we Yesu Kristo, era twagalanenga nga ye bwe yatulagira. Kale oyo agondera ebiragiro bye abeera mu Ye, era naye abeera mu ye. Kino tukimanyi ng’ali mu ffe, kubanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu gwe yatuwa abeera mu ffe.” 1 Yokaana 3:22-24. NNALOWOOZA okubayogerako ku makya gano ku bukulu bw’okusaba, era nnali ŋŋenderedde n’obunyiikivu okubakubiriza okunsabira n’okusabira omulimu gwa Mukama mu kifo kino. Mazima, sirowooza nti nnandifunye omulamwa ogusinga obuzito, oba ogusinga okunyigiriza emmeeme yange. Singa nnakkirizibwa okubasaba ekintu kimu kyokka, kyandibadde kino—“Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Obuweereza bwaffe bwandigasa ki awatali mukisa gwa Katonda, era tuyinza tutya okusuubira omukisa gwa Katonda okuggyako nga gunoonyezebwa Ekkanisa ya Katonda? Nandikyogedde ne mu maziga, “Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Temulekeraawo kusaba—wabula, mweyongere nnyo mu kwegayiririra abalala, kubanga mu ngeri eyo, era mu ngeri eyo yokka, okukulaakulana kwaffe ng’Ekkanisa mwe kuyinza okweyongera, oba wadde okugenda mu maaso. Naye olwo ekibuuzo ne kinzijira: watya singa mu Kkanisa mubaddemu ekintu ekyandiremesezza okusaba kwaffe okutuuka ku buwanguzi? Ekyo kibuuzo kikulu, era kisaanidde okulowoozebwako n’obunyiikivu bungi ddala nga tetunnaba na kubakubiriza kwegayiririra balala. Nga bwe tumaze okuyigirizibwa essuula esooka eya Isaaya, okusaba kw’abantu abatali batukuvu mangu ddala kufuuka muzizo eri Katonda. “Bwe munaayimusanga emikono gyammwe musabe nnaabakwekanga amaaso gange, era ne bwe munaasabanga ennyo siiwulirenga.” Ekkanisa ziyinza okugwa mu mbeera ey’engeri eyo okusinza kwazo ne kufuuka obutali butuukirivu. Ne “n’enkuŋŋaana zammwe” zifuuka omugugu eri Mukama. Wayinza okubaawo ebibi mu mutima gwa buli omu ku ffe ebiyinza okulemesa Katonda, ng’akuuma Embala ye n’engeri ze, okufaayo n’akatono ku kwegayiririra kwaffe. Bwe tusirikira ekibi mu mitima gyaffe, Mukama tatuwulira. Ng’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe bwe kiri, waliwo ebintu ebimu ebyetaagisa ddala okuwangula mu kusaba. Katonda ajja kuwulira okusaba kwonna okw’amazima, naye waliwo ebintu ebimu abantu ba Katonda bye bateekwa okuba nabyo, oba si ekyo okusaba kwabwe kujja kulemererwa okutuuka ku kigendererwa. Ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba nti, “Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.” Kale ku makya gano tujja kulowooza ku bintu ebyetaagisa okuba n’amaanyi mu kusaba—kye tuteekwa okukola, kye tuteekwa okuba, kye tuteekwa okuba nakyo—bwe tuba ab’okuwangula ne Katonda mu kusaba bulijjo, ng’ekintu ekibaawo buli kiseera. Ka tuyige engeri y’okufuuka ba Eriya ne ba Yakobo. I. Nja kusooka nga ndowooza ku BINTU EBYETAAGISA OKUBA N’AMAANYI MU KUSABA. Tuteekwa okwawulamu ebintu ebimu ku ntandikwa. Ndowooza waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’okusaba kw’emmeeme enoonya okusaasirwa n’okusaba kw’omuntu alokoleddwa. Buli muntu ali wano, ka abe wa mbala ki, nnandimugambye nti bw’onoonya okusaasirwa kwa Katonda mu bwesimbu ng’oyita mu Yesu Kristo, ojja kukufuna. Embeera y’obulamu bwo ey’emabega ka ebe nga bwe yali, bw’onoonya kaakano amaaso ga Yakuwa n’okwenenya ng’oyita mu mutabaganya eyalondebwa, onoomulabanga. Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’aba akuyigirizza okusaba, tolwawo nate wabula yanguwa ogende ku Musaalaba, era eyo wummuza emmeeme yo erina omusango ku Yesu. Simanyi bisaanyizo birala byonna eby’okusaba okusooka okw’omwonoonyi okuggyako obwesimbu, naye eri abo mu mmwe abalokoleddwa tuteekwa okwogera mu ngeri ndala. Kaakano mufuuse abantu ba Katonda, era wadde nga mujja kuwulirwa nga omwonoonyi bw’andiwuliddwa, era nga buli lunaku mujja kufuna ekisa ekyetaagisa buli anoonya ky’afuna ng’okusaba kwe kuddibwamu, kyokka kaakano oli mwana wa Katonda era oli wansi w’okukangavvulwa okw’enjawulo okw’ab’omu maka abaazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Mu kukangavvula okwo, okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kulina ekifo ekya waggulu era kugasa nnyo. Waliwo ekintu omukkiriza ky’ayinza okusanyukira ekisukka ku bulokozi bwokka. Waliwo okusaasirwa, emikisa, okubudaabudibwa n’ebirungi ebifuula obulamu bwe obwa kaakano obw’omugaso, obw’essanyu era obw’ekitiibwa. Era bino ajja kubifuna ka abe wa mbala ki. Si bintu bya bulamu oba kufa mu nsonga y’obulokozi—omukkiriza abirina awatali bukwakkulizo, kubanga mikisa gya Ndagaano. Naye kaakano twogera ku bitiibwa n’ebiwoomerera eby’omu nnyumba, ebiweebwa oba ebiziyizibwa okusinziira ku buwulize bwaffe ng’abaana ba Mukama. Bw’onoolagajjalira obukwakkulizo obugattiddwa ku bino, Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu ajja kubikuziyiza. Emikisa egyetaagisa egy’Endagaano ey’Ekisa giyimiridde awatali bukwakkulizo—okuyita okunoonya okusaasirwa kulagiddwa eri abo abatalina bisaanyizo byonna, okuggyako obwetaavu bwabwe. Naye yingira munda mu maka ga Katonda ng’abasajja n’abakazi abalokoleddwa, ojja kusanga nti emikisa emirala emirungi ennyo giweebwa oba giziyizibwa okusinziira ku ngeri gye tufaayo ku mateeka ga Mukama mu maka ge. Okuwa ekyokulabirako eky’abulijjo—Singa omuntu alumwa enjala abadde ku mulyango gwo n’asaba omugaati, wandimuwadde ka abe wa mbala ki. Era n’omwana wo ojja kumuwa emmere ka abe wa nneeyisa ki—tojja kugaana mwana wo kintu kyonna ekyetaagisa obulamu. Tojja kukwata kkubo lyonna ery’okukangavvula ng’omuziyiza emmere gy’ateekwa okulya, oba ekyambalo eky’okumukuuma obutiti. Naye waliwo ebintu ebirala bingi omwana wo by’ayinza okwegomba, by’ojja okumuwa bw’aba omuwulize, by’otojja kumuwa bw’aba akujeemera. Ndowooza kino kiraga obufuzi bwa Katonda obw’obuzadde we bunaatuusa ensonga eno, ne we butajja kugituusa. Mutegeere era nti ekyawandiikibwa tekyogera nnyo ku Katonda okuwulira okusaba kw’abaddu be oluusi n’oluusi, kubanga ekyo ajja kukikola, ne bwe baba nga tebatambula bulungi naye era nga abakwese amaaso ge. Amaanyi mu kusaba agategeezebwa wano ga lubeerera era gajjuvu eri Katonda, nga, okujuliza ebigambo by’ekyawandiikibwa, “buli kye tumusaba akituwa.” Okusaba kuno kwetaaga ebintu ebimu ebisooka n’ebyetaagisa bye tugenda okwogerako kaakano, era ekisooka bwe buwulize obw’omwana—“Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye.” Bwe tuba nga tetulina kino, Mukama ayinza okutugamba nga bwe yagamba abantu be Isirayiri nti, “Naye mwanvaako ne muweereza bakatonda abalala, noolwekyo sigenda kubalokola nate. Mugende mukaabire bakatonda abo be mwasalawo okuweereza.” Buli kitaawe ajja kukugamba nti okukkiriza okusaba kw’omwana omujeemu kwandibadde kuwagira bujeemu mu maka, ne kimulemesa okufuga ennyumba ye. Emirundi mingi kiba kya buvunaanyizibwa eri omuzadde okugamba nti, “Mwana wange, tewawulirizza kigambo kyange mu kaseera akayise, n’olwekyo nange siyinza kuwuliriza kikyo.” Si nti kitaawe tamwagala, wabula amwagala ddala, era olw’okwagala kwe awulira nga kimugwanidde okulaga obutasiima bwe ng’agaana okusaba kw’omwana we akyamye. Katonda atukola nga naffe bwe twandikoze abaana baffe abakakanyavu. Era bw’alaba nga tumaliridde okugenda mu kibi ne tusobya, kiba kitundu ku kukangavvula kwe okw’ekisa okw’obuzadde okugamba nti, “Nnaaziyiza okusaba kwo bw’onookaabira gye ndi; siikuwulirenga bw’onneegayirira; sijja kukuzikiriza, ojja kulokolebwa, ojja kufuna omugaati ogw’obulamu n’amazzi ag’obulamu, naye tojja kufuna kisingawo: ebirungi eby’omu bwakabaka bwange ojja kubiziyizibwa, era tojja kuba na kintu kyonna ekifaanana okuwangula okw’enjawulo gye ndi mu kusaba.” Nti Mukama akola bw’atyo n’abantu be kyeyoleka bulungi mu Zabbuli 81—“Singa abantu bange bampuliriza; singa Isirayiri agondera ebiragiro byange, mangwago nandirwanyisizza abalabe baabwe, ne mbawangula. Naye ggwe, Isirayiri, nandikuliisizza eŋŋaano esingira ddala obulungi, ne nkukkusa omubisi gw’enjuki nga guva mu lwazi.” Kale, singa omwana wa Katonda omujeemu yateekebwa mu ngalo ekisuubizo kino—“Buli kye munaasabanga nga mukkiriza, munaakiweebwanga,” yandisabye ddala ekintu ekyandimunywezezza mu bujeemu bwe! Yandibadde asaba ebyetaago by’okwegomba kwe, n’obuyambi mu bujeemu bwe. Kino tekiyinza kugumiikirizibwa n’akatono! Katonda anaawagira obwonoonefu bwaffe? Anaaleeta enku ku muliro gw’okwegomba kw’omubiri? Omutima ogwekkiririzaamu gwegomba eddembe erisingawo gulyoke gweyongere okukakanyala. Omwoyo ogw’amalala gwegomba okugulumizibwa okusingawo gulyoke gweyongere amalala. Omwoyo omugayaavu gusaba okuwummula okusingawo gulyoke gweyongere obugayaavu. Era omwoyo ogwagala okufuga abalala gusaba obuyinza obusingawo gulyoke gufune emikisa emirala egy’okunyigiriza. Omuntu nga bw’ali, n’okusaba kwe bwe kunaaba bwe kutyo—omwoyo omujeemu guwaayo okusaba okw’okwekkiririzaamu n’amalala. Katonda anaawuliriza okusaba ng’okwo? Tekiyinzika! Ajja kutuwa kye tusaba bwe tugondera ebiragiro bye, naye bwe tufuuka abajeemu ne tugaana obufuzi bwe, naye ajja kugaana okusaba kwaffe era agambe nti, “Bwe mweyongera okujeema, kale, nange ndibalaga obukambwe.” Era eri abakyamu yeeraga ng’abasinza amagezi. Tunaaba n’essanyu singa, olw’ekisa kya Katonda, tuyinza okwogera ne Dawudi nti, “Naaba mu ngalo zange okulaga nga bwe sirina misango; ne ndyoka nzija ku Kyoto kyo, Ayi Mukama.” Kino tekiriba bwa butaliiko musango bujjuvu, naye waakiri kiriba obutaliiko musango obw’okwagala ekibi n’okujeemera Katonda mu bugenderevu. Okuddako ku kino waliwo ekirala ekyetaagisa okusaba okuwangula—ekitiibwa eky’omwana. Weetegereze sentensi eddako. Tufuna kye tusaba, “kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.” Tetukkiriza baana, bwe bafuna ekiragiro okuva eri kitaabwe, okubuusabuusa obutuufu bwakyo oba amagezi gaakyo. Obuwulize bukoma okubuuzibwa we kutandikira. Omwana ky’alowooza nti kye kimugwanira tekiteekwa kufuuka kipimo ky’obuyinza bwa kitaawe obw’okulagira—abaana abalungi bagamba nti, “Taata atulagidde okukola bwe tuti ne bwe tuti, n’olwekyo tujja kukikola, kubanga twagala okumusanyusa bulijjo.” Ensonga esinga obuzito eri omwana ow’okwagala ku by’akola kwe kukakasa nti kyandisanyusizza bazadde be. Era ekintu ekisinga amaanyi ekiyinza okwogerwa okuziyiza omwana omulungi kwe kukakasa nti ekkubo eryo lyandinyiizizza bazadde be.
