Temugenda ku mulimu nga temumanyi nti waliwo ekintu kye mugenderedde okukola; kale lwaki mugenda eri Katonda nga temumanyi kye mugenderedde kufuna? Singa mubadde n’ekigendererwa, temwandisanze kusaba nga mulimu omuzibu ogukooya; nkakasa nti mwandikwegombye. Mwandigambye nti, “Waliwo kye nneetaaga. Woowe, singa nnyinza okusemberera Katonda wange ne mmusaba kyo; nnina obwetaavu, njagala bukolebweko, era nneegomba okufuna we nnaabeerera nzekka, ndyoke mmutegeeze byonna ebiri mu mutima gwange, ne mmusaba ekintu kino emmeeme yange kye wejjawejja ennyo.” Mujja kulaba nga kiyamba nnyo okusaba kwammwe bwe muba n’ebintu bye mugenderera, era ndowooza ne bwe muba n’abantu be munaayogerako amannya. Temwegayiririranga Katonda ku lw’aboonoonyi okutwalira awamu kyokka, naye bulijjo mwogere ku abamu ku bo kinnoomu. Bw’oba omusomesa w’essomero lya Ssande, tosaba busabi nti ekibiina kyo kiweebwe omukisa, naye saba ku lw’abaana bo kinnoomu, ng’oyogera amannya gaabwe mu maaso g’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo. Era bwe wabaawo ekisa ky’oyagala mu maka go, togenda kwetooloola, naye beera mwangu era mugolokofu mu kwegayirira kwo eri Katonda. Bw’omusaba, mubuulire ky’oyagala. Bw’oba tolina ssente zimala, bw’oba mwavu, bw’oba mu buzibu, mutegeeze embeera yo. Tokozesa bwetoowaze obw’obulimba eri Katonda. Genda butereevu ku nsonga; yogera naye mu mazima. Teyeetaaga bigambo birungi ebyetooloola, ng’abantu bwe batera okukozesa nga tebaagala kwogera butereevu kye bategeeza. Bw’oba weetaaga ekisa eky’omubiri oba eky’omwoyo, kyogere. Tofuukuula Bayibuli ng’onoonya ebigambo by’onookyogereramu. Kozesa ebigambo ebikujjira mu ngeri ey’obutonde okwogera bye weetaaga. Ebyo bye bigambo ebisinga obulungi, kikakase. Ebigambo bya Ibulayimu bye byali ebisinga obulungi eri Ibulayimu, n’ebibyo bye bijja okusinga obulungi gy’oli. Teweetaaga kuyiga byawandiikibwa byonna mu Byawandiikibwa osobole okusaba nga Yakobo ne Eriya bwe baasaba, ng’okozesa ebigambo byabwe. Bw’onookola bw’otyo, tojja kubagoberera ddala. Oyinza okubakoppa ekigambo ku kigambo era mu ngeri ey’obuddu, naye ng’obulako omwoyo ogwaleeta ebigambo byabwe era ogwabiwa obulamu. Saba mu bigambo byo. Yogera ne Katonda mu bwerufu; saba butereevu ky’oyagala. Yogera amannya g’abantu, yogera amannya g’ebintu, era olase butereevu ku kigendererwa ky’okwegayirira kwo, era nkakasa nti mangu ojja kulaba ng’obukoowu n’obunafu by’otera okwemulugunyaako mu kwegayirira kwo tebikyakugwako; oba waakiri tebikyakugwako bulijjo nga bwe kibadde edda. “Naye,” bw’agamba omu, “sirina bintu bya njawulo bye mpulira nti mbisabe.” Ah! Ow’oluganda omwagalwa, simanyi ggwe ani, oba gy’obeera, n’otaba na bintu bya njawulo by’osaba; kubanga nze nsanga nti buli lunaku luleeta obwetaavu bwalwo oba ekizibu kyalwo, era nti buli lunaku nnina kye ndina okubuulira Katonda wange. Naye singa tetwalina kizibu, abooluganda bange abaagalwa, singa twali tutuuse ku ntikko eyo mu kisa ne tutaba na kye tusaba, tumwagala Kristo nnyo bwe tutyo ne tutaba na bwetaavu bwa kusaba tumwagale n’okusingawo? Tulina okukkiriza kungi bwe kutyo ne tulekera awo okukaaba nti, “Mukama, Twongereko okukkiriza?” Nkakasa nti bulijjo, bwe mwekebera akatono, mujja kuzuula mangu nti waliwo ekintu ekisaanidde kye muyinza okukonkonera ku mulyango gw’Okusaasira, ne mukaaba nti, “Mpa, Mukama, omutima gwange bye gwetaaga.” Era bw’oba tolina ky’oyagala, olina kubuuza bubuuza Omukristaayo eyagezesebwa gw’osooka okusisinkana, ajja kukubuulira kimu. “Woowe,” ajja kukuddamu, “bw’oba tolina ky’osaba ku lulwo, nsabira. Saba mukyala wange omulwadde awone. Saba Mukama amulisize omusana gw’amaaso ge omutima oguweddemu essuubi; saba Mukama aweereze obuyambi omuweereza oyo ateganidde bwereere, amaanyi ge ng’agamalidde bwereere.” Bw’omala ebibyo, wegayiririre abalala; era bw’oba tosobola kusanga muntu akuwa nsonga, tunuulira Sodomu eno ennene, ekibuga kino ekiri nga Ggomola endala ekiri mu maaso go; kitwalenga bulijjo mu kusaba kwo mu maaso ga Katonda, okaaba nti, “Woowe, singa London ebeera nnamu mu maaso go, ekibi kyayo ne kiziyizibwa, obutuukirivu bwayo ne bugulumizibwa, Katonda w’ensi ne yeefunira abantu bangi mu kibuga kino.” Nga bwe kyetaagisa okuba n’ekintu ekimanyiddwa obulungi ky’osaba, bwe kityo bwe kyetaagisa okukyegomba ennyo okukifuna. “Okusaba okunnyogovu,” bw’ayogera omuyigiriza omu ow’edda, “kusaba kugaanibwa.” Bwe tusaba Mukama mu bunnyogovu, nga tetunyiikira, tuba ng’abaziyiza omukono gwe, ne tumuziyiza okutuwa omukisa gwennyini gwe twefuula okunoonya. Bw’oba ng’ekintu ky’oyagala okiraba n’amaaso go, emmeeme yo erina okujjula ennyo omuwendo gw’ekintu ekyo, n’obwetaavu bwo obungi ennyo bw’okifuna, n’akabi k’onoobaamu okuggyako ng’ekintu ekyo kikuweereddwa, ne kiba nti owalirizibwa okukyegayirira ng’omuntu eyeegayirira olw’obulamu bwe. Waaliwo ekyokulabirako ekirungi eky’okusaba okw’amazima okwolekezeddwa eri omuntu mu bikolwa by’abakyala babiri ab’ekitiibwa, abaami baabwe abaali basaliddwa omusango gw’okufa era nga bagenda kuttibwa, bwe bajja mu maaso ga kabaka George ne bamwegayirira asonyiwe abaami baabwe. Kabaka n’abagoba mu bukambwe n’obutaba na kisa. George Eyasooka! Ekyo kyali kye kimu n’obutonde bwe. Era bwe beegayirira nate, ne nate, ne nate, tebaasobola kusituka ku maviivi gaabwe; kyabeetaagisa ddala okubawalula ne bafulumizibwa mu lubiri, kubanga tebaagala kuvaawo okutuusa kabaka lwe yandibamwenyedde n’abagamba nti abaami baabwe bajja kuba balamu. Kitalo! Baalemwa, naye baali bakyala ab’ekitiibwa olw’okugumiikiriza kwabwe mu kwegayiririra obulamu bw’abaami baabwe bwe batyo. Eyo ye ngeri gye tusaanidde okusabamu Katonda. Tulina okuba n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi ennyo eri ekintu kye twetaaga, ne kiba nti tetujja kusituka okutuusa nga tukifunye—naye nga tugondera by’ayagala, newakubadde bwe kityo. Nga tuwulira nti ekintu kye tusaba tekiyinza kuba kibi, era nti ye yennyini yakisuubiza, tumaliridde nti kiteekwa okutuweebwa, era bwe kitaweebwa, tujja kwegayirira nga tulaga ekisuubizo, nate ne nate, okutuusa emiryango gy’eggulu lwe ginaakankana ng’okwegayirira kwaffe tekunnakoma. Tekyewuunyisa nti Katonda tatuwadde mikisa mingi mu kiseera kino, kubanga tetunyiikira mu kusaba nga bwe tusaanidde. Woowe, okusaba okwo okw’emitima eminnyogovu okufiira ku mimwa—okwegayirira okwo okukutte ng’omuzira; tekukwata ku mitima gy’abantu, kale kunaakwata kutya ku mutima gwa Katonda? Tekuva mu mmeeme zaffe, tekubooga okuva mu nzizi ez’ekyama era empanvu ez’omunda mu mitima gyaffe, n’olwekyo tekuyinza kulinnya waggulu eri oyo yekka awulira okukaaba kw’emmeeme, oyo obunnanfuusi gwe butayinza kulukira lugoye lwa kubikka, wadde okusinza okw’empisa obusobola okwefuula ekintu ekirala mu maaso ge. Tulina okunyiikira, bwe kitaba ekyo tetulina ddembe kusuubira nti Mukama ajja kuwulira okusaba kwaffe. Era mazima ddala, abooluganda bange, kyandimaze okuziyiza obutafaayo bwonna n’okutuwaliriza okunyiikira obutakoma, singa twategeera obukulu bw’Oyo gwe tumwegayirira. Nnaayingira mu maaso go, Ayi Katonda wange, ne nkusekerera n’ebigambo eby’omutima omunnyogovu? Bamalayika babikka ku maaso gaabwe mu maaso go, nange nnaamatira okwogeza obwogeza essaala ey’empisa etaliimu mmeeme wadde omutima? Ah, abooluganda bange! tetumanyi nnyo okusaba kwaffe kumeka okuli muzizo eri Mukama. Kyandibadde kya muzizo gy’oli ne gye ndi okuwulira abantu nga batusaba mu nguudo, nga balinga abatayagala bye basaba. Naye tetukoze kye kimu eri Katonda? Ekirabo ky’eggulu ekisinga obukulu eri omuntu, tekifuuse gye tuli mulimu omukalu ogufudde? Kyayogerwa ku John Bradford nti yalina obukugu obw’enjawulo mu kusaba, era bwe baamubuuza ekyama kye, n’agamba nti, “Bwe mmanya kye njagala, bulijjo nnyimirira ku kusaba okwo okutuusa lwe mpulira nti nkyegayiridde Katonda, era okutuusa nze ne Katonda lwe tumaze okukkaanya ku nsonga eyo.” Sigenda ku kusaba okulala okutuusa nga mmaze okusooka.” Zisanze abantu abamu abatandika nti “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe;” era nga tebannaba kutegeera kirowoozo ekyo eky’okusinza—“Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe,”—baba bamaze okutandika okuddamu ebigambo ebiddako—“Obwakabaka bwo bujje;” olwo oboolyawo waliwo ekibajjira mu birowoozo nti, “Ddala njagala obwakabaka bwe bujje? Singa bujja kaakano, nandibadde ludda wa?” Era nga bakyalowooza ku ekyo, eddoboozi lyabwe ligenda mu maaso nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu;” bwe batyo ne batabulatabula okusaba kwabwe ne bagatta ebigambo wamu. Woowe! Muyimirire ku buli kimu okutuusa lwe mukisaba ddala. Temugezaako kuteeka busaale bubiri ku buguwa omulundi gumu; bwombi bujja kusubwa. Oyo ayagala okussa mu mmundu ye amasasi ag’emirundi ebiri tayinza kusuubira kuwangula. Sooka okube essasi limu, olyoke ojjuze nate. Wegayirire Katonda omulundi gumu owangule, olyoke weegayirire nate. Funa ekisa ekisooka, olyoke ogende nate okunoonya eky’okubiri. Tomatira kutabula langi z’okusaba kwo ne ziyingirana, okutuusa nga tewali kifaananyi kya kulaba wabula ekisiige ekinene obunene, ekiteetero kya langi ezaasiigibwa obubi. Mutunuulire Essaala ya Mukama yennyini. Nga erina ensalo ennungi ezirabika obulungi! Mulimu ebisa ebimanyiddwa obulungi, era tebiyingiraganamu. Eyo bw’eri, era bw’ogitunuulira yonna awamu, kifaananyi kya kitalo; si kavuyo, wabula enteekateeka ennungi. Okusaba kwammwe kubeere bwe kutyo. Mubeere ku kumu okutuusa lwe muwangudde ku kyo, mulyoke mugende ku kiddako. Ebintu ebimanyiddwa obulungi n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi bwe bitabulwa wamu, wabaawo okukya kw’essuubi nti mujja kuwangula ne Katonda. Naye nate: ebintu bino ebibiri tebyandigasizza singa tebitabuddwamu ekintu ekisingawo okwetaagisa era eky’obwakatonda, kwe kugamba, okukkiriza okunywevu mu Katonda. Abooluganda, mukkiriza mu kusaba? Mmanyi nti musaba kubanga muli bantu ba Katonda; naye mukkiriza mu maanyi g’okusaba? Waliwo Abakristaayo bangi nnyo abatakkiriza; balowooza nti kintu kirungi, era bakkiriza nti oluusi kikola eby’ekitalo; naye tebalowooza nti okusaba, okusaba okw’amazima, bulijjo kuwangula. Balowooza nti ebivaamu bisinziira ku bintu ebirala bingi, naye nti kwo kwennyini tekulina ngeri nkulu oba maanyi gonna. Kaakano, emmeeme yange ekakasa nti okusaba ge maanyi agasinga obukulu mu butonde bwonna; nti kulina obuyinza obusinga ku masannyalaze, ku maanyi agasikagana, ku maanyi agasika ebintu wansi, oba ku maanyi amalala gonna ag’ekyama abantu ge baatuuma amannya, naye ge batategeera. Okusaba kulina obuyinza obulabika, obw’amazima, obukakafu, obutakyukakyuka ku butonde bwonna, nga amateeka gonna ag’ebintu ebirabika. Omuntu bw’asaba ddala, si kibuuzo oba nga Katonda ajja kumuwulira oba nedda; ateekwa okumuwulira; si lwa kuba nti mu kusaba mulimu okuwaliriza, wabula mu kisuubizo mulimu okuwaliriza okuwoomu era okw’omukisa. Katonda yasuubiza okuwulira okusaba, era ajja kutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye. Nga bw’ali Katonda Ali Waggulu Ennyo era ow’amazima, teyeewakanya. Woowe! okulowooza ku kino; nti ggwe omuntu omunafu oyinza okuyimirira wano n’oyogera ne Katonda, era ng’oyita mu Katonda n’onyeenya ensi zonna. Naye okusaba kwo bwe kuwulirwa, ebitonde tebijja kutabulwa; newakubadde nga ebigendererwa ebisinga obukulu bituukirizibwa, enteekateeka ya Katonda tejja kutaataaganyizibwa wadde akaseera akamu. Tewali kikoola kinaagwa ku muti nga obudde bwakyo tebunnatuuka, tewali mmunyeenye eneeyimirira mu kkubo lyayo, wadde ettondo limu ery’amazzi okutonnya mpola okusinga bulijjo okuva mu nsulo yaalyo; byonna bijja kugenda mu maaso nga bwe bibadde, era naye okusaba kwo kujja kuba kukoze buli kimu. Kujja kwogera n’ebyo Katonda bye yateekawo n’ebigendererwa bye, nga bwe bituukirizibwa buli lunaku; era byonna bijja kuleekaana eri okusaba kwo, nga bikaaba nti, “Oli muganda waffe; ffe tuli biragiro, ggwe oli kusaba; naye ggwe wennyini oli kiragiro, eky’edda, ekikakafu, eky’edda ennyo nga ffe.” Okusaba kwaffe bye biragiro bya Katonda mu kifaananyi ekirala. Okusaba kw’abantu ba Katonda tekuli kirala wabula ebisuubizo bya Katonda nga bissibwa okuva mu mitima emiramu, era ebisuubizo ebyo bye biragiro, nga biteekeddwa bubeezi mu kifaananyi n’engeri endala. Temugamba nti, “Okusaba kwange kuyinza kutya okukwata ku biragiro?” Tekuyinza, okuggyako nti okusaba kwammwe kwe biragiro, era nti nga bwe kuvaayo, buli kusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu kw’assa mu mmeeme yo kwa buyinza bwonna era kwa lubeerera ng’ekiragiro ekyo ekyagamba nti, “Wabeerewo obutangaavu, ne waba obutangaavu;” oba ng’ekiragiro ekyo ekyalonda abantu be, ne kiteekawo okununulibwa kwabwe olw’omusaayi gwa Kristo ogw’omuwendo. Olina obuyinza mu kusaba, era oyimiridde leero mu baweereza abasinga amaanyi mu butonde bwonna Katonda bwe yakola. Olina obuyinza ku bamalayika, bajja kubuuka nga bw’oyagala. Olina obuyinza ku muliro, n’amazzi, n’ebintu eby’ensi. Olina obuyinza okuwulirwa eddoboozi lyo emitala w’emmunyeenye; awo okubwatuka gye kufiira mu kasirise, eddoboozi lyo lijja kuzuukusa amaloboozi g’obutaggwaawo. Okutu kwa Katonda yennyini kujja kuwuliriza, n’omukono gwa Katonda yennyini gujja kugondera by’oyagala. Akulagira okukaaba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe,” era by’oyagala ggwe bijja kukolebwa. Bw’oba osobola okwegayirira ng’olaga ekisuubizo kye, olwo by’oyagala bye by’ayagala. Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, tekirabika nga kintu kya ntiisa okuba n’obuyinza obwenkanidde awo mu mikono gy’omuntu, okusobola okusaba? Mwali muwuliddeko ku bantu abeefuulanga okuba n’obuyinza obw’ekyama obw’ekitalo, mwe baayinzanga okuyita emyoyo okuva mu buziba obunene, okutonnyesa enkuba, oba okuyimiriza enjuba. Ekyo kyonna kyali kirowoozo bulowooza, naye singa kyali kya mazima, Omukristaayo y’asinga n’okusingawo omulogo oyo. Bw’aba ng’alina okukkiriza mu Katonda kyokka, Buli kimu kisoboka gy’ali. Alinunulibwa okuva mu mazzi agasinga obuziba—alirokolebwa okuva mu bizibu ebisinga okulumya—mu njala aliriisibwa—mu kawumpuli alitambula nga talina kabi—wakati mu kabenje aliyimirira nga munywevu era wa maanyi—mu ntalo alikuumibwa bulijjo—era ku lunaku lw’olutalo aliyimusa omutwe gwe, singa asobola okukkiriza bukkiriza ekisuubizo, n’akiyimusa mu maaso ga Katonda, n’akyegayiririra n’obuyinza obw’okwesiga okutakankana. Tewali kintu, nkiddamu, tewali maanyi ga ntiisa bwe gatyo, tewali buyinza bwa kitalo bwe butyo, ng’obuyinza Katonda bw’awadde buli muntu, oyo asobola okumeggana nga Yakobo, era nga Isirayiri, okumeggana ne Katonda mu kusaba n’awangula. Naye tulina okuba n’okukkiriza mu kino; tulina okukkiriza nti okusaba kwe kuli, bwe kitaba ekyo si kwe kusaanidde okuba. Okuggyako nga nzikiriza nti okusaba kwange kukola, tekujja kukola, kubanga kwesigamye nnyo ku kukkiriza kwange. Katonda ayinza okumpa ekisa ne bwe mba sirina kukkiriza; ekyo kiba kisa kye ye ekyetongodde, naye teyakisuubiza. Naye bwe mba n’okukkiriza era nga nsobola okwegayirira nga ndaga ekisuubizo n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi, olwo tekikyali kya kuteebereza oba nga ndifuna omukisa, oba nga bye njagala birikolebwa. Okuggyako nga Ow’olubeerera akyuse okuva ku Kigambo kye, okuggyako ng’ekirayiro kye yalayira kisazibwamu, era ye yennyini n’alekera awo okuba bw’ali, tumanyi nti “buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.” Era kaakano okulinnya eddaala erimu waggulu, wamu n’ebintu ebimanyiddwa obulungi, okwegomba okw’amaanyi n’okukkiriza okunywevu mu buyinza bw’okusaba, wandibaddewo—era Woowe, ekisa kya Katonda kikikole bwe kityo gye tuli!—wandibaddewo okutabulwamu okusuubira okulaba ebintu ng’ebimaze okutuuka. Twandisobodde okubala ebisa nga tetunnaba kubifuna, nga tukkiriza nti biri mu kkubo. Bwe nnali nsoma ennaku ezo ekitabo ekitono ekiwoomu, kye nnandibagaliza mwenna okwetegereza, ekyawandiikibwa omuwandiisi Omumerika alabika ng’amanyi bulungi nnyo amaanyi g’okusaba, era gwe ndi ne bbanja olw’ebirungi bingi—ekitabo ekitono ekiyitibwa The Still Hour, nnasangamu ekigambo ekyogera ku kitundu mu kitabo kya Danyeri, essuula ey’ekkumi bwe ndowooza, awo, nga bw’agamba, ebyuma byonna eby’okusaba we birabikira mu lwatu. Danyeri ali ku maviivi ng’asaba, Mikayiri malayika omukulu n’ajja gy’ali. Ayogera naye n’amubuulira nti amangu ddala nga Danyeri yaakatandika okussa omutima gwe ku kutegeera n’okwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, ebigambo bye byawulirwa, era Mukama yali atumye malayika. Olwo n’amubuulira mu ngeri ey’obwangu obw’omulimu nti, “Nandibadde nzize wano dda, naye omulangira w’e Buperusi yanziyiza; kyokka omulangira w’eggwanga lyo n’ajja n’annyamba, era nzize okukubudaabuda n’okukuyigiriza.” Kale mulabe. Katonda assa okwegomba mu mitima gyaffe, era okwegomba bwe kuba kumaze okubaawo, nga tetunnakoowoola atandika okuddamu. Ebigambo nga tebinnatuuka na kitundu kya kkubo erigenda mu ggulu, nga bikyakankanira ku mimwa—ng’amanyi ebigambo bye tugenda okwogera—atandika okubiddamu, atuma malayika; malayika ajja era n’aleeta omukisa ogwetaagibwa. Kale, ekintu kino kyandibadde kubikkulirwa singa osobola okukiraba n’amaaso go. Abantu abamu balowooza nti ebintu eby’omwoyo birooto, era nti twogera bya kuteebereza. Nedda, nzikiriza nti mu kusaba kw’Omukristaayo mulimu amazima mangi nga mu kumyansa kw’eggulu; era omugaso n’obulungi bw’okusaba kw’Omukristaayo biyinza okutegeerwa obulungi ng’amaanyi g’okumyansa bwe gategeerwa bwe kwasa omuti, ne kumenyamu amatabi gaagwo, ne kuguyuzaayuza okutuuka ku kikolo kyennyini. Okusaba si kirooto wadde olufumo; kintu kya mazima ddala, ekiwaliriza ebitonde byonna, ekisiba amateeka ga Katonda gennyini mu njegere, era ekiwaliriza Omugulumivu Omutukuvu okuwuliriza by’ayagala ekitonde kye ekyavu naye ekyalagibwa ekisa—omuntu. Naye twetaaga bulijjo okukkiriza kino. Twetaaga obukakafu obulaba ebintu ng’ebimaze okutuuka mu kusaba. Okubala ebisa nga tebinnatuuka! Okukakasa nti bijja! Okweyisa ng’abamaze okubifuna! Bw’omala okusaba emmere yo eya buli lunaku, obutaddamu kweraliikirira, wabula okukkiriza nti Katonda akuwulidde, era ajja kugikuwa. Bw’omala okutwala ensonga y’omwana wo omulwadde mu maaso ga Katonda, okukkiriza nti omwana ajja kuwona, oba bw’ataawone, nti kijja kuba mukisa munene gy’oli era ekitiibwa ekisingawo eri Katonda, n’okumulekera ensonga eyo. Okusobola okugamba nti, “Mmanyi nti ampulidde kaakano; ndiyimirira mu kifo kyange we ntera okubeera ntunule; nnindirire Katonda wange, mpulire ky’aligamba emmeeme yange.” Wali omalibwamu essuubi, ggwe Omukristaayo, bwe wasaba mu kukkiriza ng’osuubira okuddibwamu? Ku makya ga leero nnyimiridde wano okuwa obujulizi bwange, nti sinnamwesiga n’alemwa okunnyamba. Neesize abantu ne bannimba, naye Katonda wange tannagaanako n’omulundi gumu kye mmusabye, bwe mbadde nga nnyweza okusaba kwange n’okukkiriza nti ayagala okuwulira, n’obukakafu bw’ekisuubizo kye. Naye mpulira omuntu ng’agamba nti, “Tuyinza okusaba olw’ebintu eby’omubiri?” Weewaawo, muyinza. Mu buli kintu mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. Si lwa bintu bya mwoyo byokka, wabula n’ebyo eby’obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Mumutwalire n’ebigezo byammwe ebisinga obutono. Ye Katonda awulira okusaba; ye Katonda w’amaka gammwe, nga bw’ali Katonda w’Awatukuvu. Mubeerenga bulijjo nga mutwala byonna bye mulina mu maaso ga Katonda. Ng’omusajja omu omulungi agenda okwegatta n’Ekkanisa eno bwe yaŋŋamba ku mukyala we eyafa, “Woowe,” bwe yagamba, “yali mukazi gwe saasobolanga kumukozesa kintu kyonna okutuusa ng’amaze okukifuula ensonga ey’okusaba. Ka kibe ki, yagambanga nti, ‘Nteekwa okukifuula ensonga ey’okusaba;’” Woowe, singa twandibadde n’empisa eno ennungi ey’okwanjuluza buli kintu mu maaso ga Mukama, nga Keezeekiya bwe yakola ebbaluwa ya Labusake, n’akirekayo, ng’agamba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe, nkikukwasizza ggwe!” Abantu bagamba nti Omwami Muller ow’e Bristol ayitirizza mu bunyiikivu, kubanga akuŋŋaanya abaana lusanvu, n’akkiriza nti Katonda ajja kubalabirira; newakubadde nga mu nsawo temuli kantu, akola bukozi ekyo ekyandibadde ekikolwa ekya bulijjo eky’Omukristaayo yenna. Akola ng’agoberera etteeka abantu b’ensi lye bateekwa okusekerera bulijjo, kubanga tebalitegeera; enkola eteekwa bulijjo okulabika ng’etali ya magezi eri okulamula okunafu okw’ebyo ebirabibwa n’amaaso, kubanga teyesigamye ku magezi aga bulijjo, wabula ku kintu ekisinga amagezi aga bulijjo—ku kukkiriza okutali kwa bulijjo. Woowe, singa twalina okukkiriza okwo okutali kwa bulijjo okukkiririza Katonda mu kigambo kye! Tayinza era tajja kuleka muntu amwesiga kuswazibwa oba kutabulwa. Kaakano, nga bwe nsobodde, mbanjulidde bye ndowooza nti bye bintu ebina ebyetaagisa mu kusaba okuwangula—“buli kye munaasabanga, mukkirize nti mukiweereddwa, era kinaabanga bwe kityo gye muli.” II. Bwe mmaze okubasaba okutunuulira ekyawandiikibwa, kaakano njagala MUTUNULE OKUBEETOOLOOLA. Mutunule okwetooloola ku nkuŋŋaana zaffe ez’okusaba, era mutunule okwetooloola ku kwegayirira kwammwe okw’ekyama, era byombi mubisalire omusango okusinziira ku makulu g’ekyawandiikibwa kino. Okusooka, mutunule okwetooloola ku nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba; siyinza kwogera nnyo mu bukambwe ku nsonga eno, kubanga nzikiriza mu mazima nti enkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba ze tutera okukuŋŋaana wano mu ffe zirina ensobi entono nnyo ku ezo ze ŋŋenda okulaga, okusinga endala zonna ze nnali nzizeemu. Naye era zirina ezimu ku nsobi ezo, era nsuubira nti bye tugenda okwogera buli ow’oluganda alina empisa ey’okwegayirira mu lujjudde mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba ajja kubyetwalira ku lulwe. Si kituufu nti amangu ddala nga muyingidde mu lukuŋŋaana, muwulira nti eri abantu bangi abasaba (okwogera mu bukambwe oboolyawo, naye ndowooza mu mazima) ekirabo kiri mu kuba n’okujjukira okulungi okujjukira ebyawandiikibwa bingi, ebibaddenga bijulizibwa okuva mu biseera bya jjajja wa jjajja waffe, n’okusobola okubiddamu mu nteekateeka ennungi? Ekirabo kiri era mu kkanisa ezimu, naddala mu kkanisa ez’omu byalo, mu kuba n’amawuggwe ag’amaanyi, osobole okugumira obutassa mukka okumala eddakiika amakumi abiri mu ttaano bw’oba osaba mu bumpimpi, n’eddakiika amakumi ana mu ttaano bw’oba ogaziyizza. Ekirabo kiri era mu kusobola obutasaba kintu kyonna kya njawulo, wabula okuyita mu buli kimu, ng’okusaba okufuula, si kasaale akalina ensongo, wabula ng’ekyuma ekitategeerekeka, ekitalina nsongo n’emu, naye nga kigendereddwa okuba ensongo yonna, ekiraŋŋanyizibwa ku buli kimu, era n’olwekyo ne kitakuba kintu kyonna. Abooluganda abalina ebirabo ebyo eby’enjawulo, era oboolyawo ebirungi, be batera okusabibwa okusaba emirundi egisinga obungi, newakubadde nga mazima ddala nteekwa okugamba nti siyinza kugondera kiragiro ky’omutume eky’okwegomba ennyo ebirabo ng’ebyo. Kaakano, singa mu kifo ky’ekyo, wasabibwa omuntu atasabangako mu lujjudde; ka tugambe ayimuka n’agamba nti, “Ayi Mukama, mpulira nga ndi mwonoonyi nnyo ne kiba nti nnemererwa n’okwogera naawe, Mukama, nnyamba okusaba! Ayi Mukama, lokola emmeeme yange ennaku! Woowe, singa olokola bannange be nnabeeranga nabo edda! Mukama, wa omukisa omusumba waffe! otukkirize okutuwa okuzuukuka. Ayi Mukama, sisobola kwogera birala; mpulira ku lwa Yesu! Amiina.” Kale, muwulira mu ngeri emu, nga mulinga abatandise okusaba mmwe mwennyini. Mufaayo ku muntu oyo, ekitundu olw’okutya nti ayinza okukoma, era olw’okuba mukakasa nti bye yayogedde yabitegeezezza ddala. Era omulala bw’ayimuka oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, n’asaba mu mwoyo gwe gumu, mufuluma ne mugamba nti, “Kuno kwe kusaba okw’amazima.” Nandisinze okwagala eddakiika ssatu ez’okusaba okw’engeri eyo, okusinga eddakiika amakumi asatu ez’engeri endala, kubanga okumu kusaba, ate okulala kubuulira. Munzikirize mbajulize omubuulizi omu ow’edda bye yayogera ku nsonga y’okusaba, mbibawe ng’ekigambo ekitono eky’okubuulirira—“Jjukira, Mukama tajja kukuwulira olw’okubala kw’okusaba kwo; tabala muwendo gwakwo. Tajja kukuwulira olw’obukugu bw’okwogera mu kusaba kwo; tafaayo ku lulimi olunyuma lwe kwogerwamu. Tajja kukuwuliriza olw’okupima kw’okusaba kwo; takupima na buwanvu bwakwo, wadde obugazi bwakwo. Tajja kukussaako mwoyo olw’ennyimba z’okusaba kwo; tafaayo ku maloboozi amalungi, wadde ku bigambo ebikwatagana obulungi. Era tajja kukutunuulira olw’amagezi ag’okulowooza mu kusaba kwo; kubanga kutegekeddwa bulungi, era kuteekeddwa mu bitundu mu ngeri ennungi. Naye ajja kukuwulira, era ajja kupima obungi bw’omukisa gw’anaakuwa, okusinziira ku bwakatonda bw’okusaba kwo. Bw’oba osobola okwegayirira ng’olaga omuntu wa Kristo, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’akussaamu obunyiikivu n’okwagala okw’amaanyi, emikisa gy’onoosaba gijja kukutuukako mazima ddala.” Abooluganda, nandyagadde okwokya essaala zonna ez’edda ze tubadde tukozesa emyaka gino amakumi ataano. Ago “amafuta agaggibwa mu kibya ekimu okuyiwa mu kirala,”—eyo “embalaasi efubutuka ng’etwalibwa mu lutalo,”—ekyawandiikibwa ekyo ekijuliziddwa obubi era ekyonooneddwa, “ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga, ggwe onoobeeranga wakati waabwe,” era n’okubawa omukisa,”—n’ebijuliziddwa ebirala byonna bye tubadde tukola, ne tubinyoolanyoola, ne tubikoppa okuva ku muntu omu okutuuka ku mulala. Nandyagadde tujje okwogera ne Katonda, nga tuggya mu mitima gyaffe gyennyini. Kyandibadde kintu kya kitalo eri enkuŋŋaana zaffe ez’okusaba; zandijjiddwamu abantu bangi; era nkakasa nti zandibaddemu ebibala bingi, singa buli muntu yandyekunkumuddeko empisa eyo ey’okusinza obusinza olw’empisa, n’ayogera ne Katonda ng’omwana bw’ayogera ne kitaawe; n’amusaba ky’ayagala, n’alyoka atuula, n’akoma awo. Kino nkyogera n’obunyiikivu bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo. Emirundi mingi, olw’okuba sseerondedde kusaba mu ngeri emanyiddwa ey’empisa, abantu bagambye nti, “Omusajja oyo tassaamu Katonda kitiibwa!” Ssebo omwagalwa, si ggwe omulamuzi w’okussaamu kwange ekitiibwa. Mukama wange y’amanya oba nnyimiridde oba ngwa. Sirowooza nti Yobu yajuliza muntu yenna. Sirowooza nti Yakobo yajuliza omutukuvu ow’edda ali mu ggulu,—kitaawe Ibulayimu. Sisanga Yesu Kristo ng’ajuliza Ebyawandiikibwa mu kusaba. Tebaasaba mu bigambo bya bantu balala, naye baasaba mu bigambo byabwe. Katonda tayagala ogende ng’okuŋŋaanya ebyakaloosa ebyo ebirungi naye ebiwunya obukadde eby’omu watukuvu ow’edda. Ayagala amafuta amaggya agaakasogolwa okuva mu muzeyituuni omubisi ogw’emmeeme yo. Ayagala ebyakaloosa n’obubaane, si okuva mu masanduuko ag’edda gye bibadde bigalamidde okutuusa lwe byaggwaamu akawoowo kaabyo, wabula ayagala obubaane obuggya, n’omugavu omuggya, ebiggyiddwa mu Ofiri ey’ebyo emmeeme yo by’eyiseemu. Mwegendereze nnyo nti musaba ddala; temuyiga lulimi lwa kusaba, wabula munoonye omwoyo gw’okusaba, era Katonda Ayinzabyonna abawe omukisa, era abafuule ab’amaanyi n’okusingawo mu kwegayirira kwammwe. Ŋŋambye nti, “Mutunule okubeetooloola.” Njagala mugende mu maaso n’omulimu ogwo, mutunule okwetooloola mu bisenge byammwe eby’okusabiramu. Woowe, abooluganda ab’obusajja n’ab’obukazi, tewali kifo abamu ku ffe kye twandikwatiddwa ensonyi nnyo okutunuulira ng’oluggi lw’ekisenge kyaffe eky’okusabiramu. Siyinza kugamba nti luziyiddwa obusagwa; luggulwa era ne luggalwa mu biseera byalwo ebyateekebwawo. Siyinza kugamba nti oluggi lusibiddwa era nga lukutte obuwuzi bwa nnabbubi. Tetulagajjalira kusaba kwennyini; naye ebisenge ebyo, emikiikiro egyo egy’omu bbugwe, nga byandibadde n’eby’okunyumya! “Woowe!” bbugwe ayinza okukaaba, “Nkuwulidde ng’oli mu kwanguwa okungi ennyo ne kiba nti tosobola na kumala ddakiika bbiri na Katonda wo, era nkuwulidde, ng’oli wakati w’otulo n’okuzuukuka, nga tomanyi by’oyogera.” Olwo omukiikiro gumu guyinza okukaaba nti, “Nkuwulidde ng’ojja n’omala eddakiika kkumi nga tosaba kintu kyonna, oba waakiri omutima gwo nga tegusaba. Emimwa gyanyeenya, naye omutima tegwasaba. Emimwa gyanyeenya, naye omutima gwali gusirise.” Nga omukiikiro omulala bwe gwandikaabye—“Woowe! Nkuwulidde ng’osinda okufulumya emmeeme yo, naye nkulabye ng’ogenda nga tolina bwesige, nga tokkiriza nti okusaba kwo kuwuliddwa, ng’ojuliza ekisuubizo, naye nga tolowooza nti Katonda ajja kukituukiriza.” Mazima ddala ebisenge ebina eby’ekisenge kyaffe eky’okusabiramu byandiyinzizza okugattibwa ne bitugwako olw’obusungu bwabyo, kubanga emirundi mingi tunyoomye Katonda n’obutakkiriza bwaffe, n’okwanguwa kwaffe, n’ebibi ebya buli ngeri. Tumunyoomye ne ku entebe ey’okusaasira ye, mu kifo kyennyini awalabisibwa ennyo okwetoowaza kwe. Si bwe kiri gy’oli? Tetulina buli omu okukyatula mu kiseera kye? Kale mwegendereze, abooluganda Abakristaayo, wabeewo okwetereeza, era Katonda abafuule ab’amaanyi n’okusingawo era abawanguzi mu kusaba kwammwe okusinga bwe kibadde edda. III. Naye obutabalwisa, ensonga esembayo kwe kutunula waggulu, MUTUNULE WAGGULU. Mutunule waggulu. Abooluganda Abakristaayo ab’obusajja n’ab’obukazi, era ka tukaabe. Ayi Katonda, watuwa ekyokulwanyisa eky’amaanyi, naffe ne tukireka ne kirya obusagwa. Watuwa ekyo eky’amaanyi nga ggwe wennyini, naffe ne tuleka amaanyi ago nga gagalamidde gatyo. Teyandibadde musango gwa kivve singa omuntu yaweebwa eriiso n’atayagala kulizibula, oba omukono gw’atayagala kuyimusa, oba ekigere ekikakanyala olw’okuba tayagala kukikozesa? Kale twegambe ki ffe ffennyini, Katonda bw’atuwadde amaanyi mu kusaba, naye amaanyi ago ne gasigala nga gasirise? Woowe, singa ebitonde byonna byali bisirise nga ffe, twandibadde ludda wa? Ayi Katonda, owa enjuba ekitangaala n’eyaka nakyo. Owa n’emmunyeenye ekitangaala ne zimyansa. Empewo oziwa amaanyi ne zikunta. Era omukka oguwa obulamu ne gutambula, abantu ne baguyingiza. Naye abantu bo obawadde ekirabo ekisinga amaanyi, n’obulamu, n’ekitangaala, era naye ne bakireka nga kigalamidde bugalamizi. Nga kumpi beerabidde nti balina obuyinza obwo, nga tebatera kubukozesa, newakubadde nga bwandibadde mukisa eri enkumi n’enkumi ezitabalika. Kaaba, ggwe Omukristaayo. Constantine, Kabaka w’e Rooma, yalaba nti ku nsimbi ez’abakabaka abalala, ebifaananyi byabwe byali nga biyimiridde—nga biwangudde. Mu kifo ky’ekyo n’alagira ekifaananyi kye kikubibwe nga kifukamidde, kubanga yagamba nti—“Eyo ye ngeri gye nnawangulamu.” Tetuliwangula okutuusa ng’ekifaananyi kyaffe kikubiddwa nga kifukamidde. Ensonga lwaki tuwanguddwa, era lwaki bendera zaffe zikululwa mu nfuufu, eri nti tetusabye. Mugende—mugende mudde eri Katonda wammwe, n’ennaku, mwatule mu maaso ge, mmwe Abaana ba Efulayimu, nti mwalina obusaale obw’okulwanyisa, naye ne mudduka mu lutalo. Mugende eri Katonda wammwe mumubuulire nti emmeeme bwe zitalokolebwa, si lwa kuba nti talina maanyi kulokola, wabula lwa kuba nti temulumwangako ng’abali mu kuzaala ku lw’aboonoonyi abazikirira. Emitima gyammwe tegikaabidde mu ddoboozi ng’ery’ennanga olwa Kirukeresi, wadde emyoyo gyammwe okukwatibwako, Olw’enjawukana ezaali mu kika kya Lewubeeni. Muzuukuke, muzuukuke, mmwe abantu ba Isirayiri; mukankane, mmwe abateefiirayo; mmwe abalagajjalidde okusaba; mmwe aboonoonyi abali mu Sayuuni yennyini, era abateefiirayo. Muzuukuke; mumeggane era mufube ne Katonda wammwe, olwo omukisa gulijja—enkuba esooka n’esembayo ey’okusaasira kwe, n’ensi erireeta ebibala bingi, n’amawanga gonna galimuyita aweereddwa omukisa. Kale mutunule waggulu, mukaabe. Ate era mutunule waggulu musanyuke. Newakubadde nga mwamwonoonera, akyabaagala. Temwamusaba wadde okunoonya amaaso ge, naye laba, akyabakoowoola—“Munnoonye;” era tagamba nti, “Munoonyeze bwereere.” Oboolyawo temwagenda ku nsulo, naye ekyakulukuta nga bwe yali. Temwasemberera Katonda, naye akyayagala nnyo okuba ow’ekisa gye muli, era yeetegese okuwulira byonna bye mwegayirira. Laba, abagamba okumubuuza “ebigenda okujja, oba ebikwata ku baana bange,” n’okumuwa ebiragiro. Nga kintu kya mukisa nti Mukama ali mu ggulu bulijjo yeetegese okuwulira! Augustine alina ekirowoozo ekirungi ennyo ku lugero lw’omusajja eyakonkona ku luggi lwa mukwano gwe mu ttumbi, ng’agamba nti, “Mukwano gwange, mpa emigaati esatu.” Enjogera ye ey’olugero olwo eri nga bweti—Nkonkona ku luggi lw’okusaasira, era kiri mu ttumbi ddala. “Abamu ku baddu b’ennyumba tebajja kujja kunziramu?” Nedda; nkonkona, naye beebase. Woowe! mmwe abatume ba Katonda—mmwe abajulizi abaagulumizibwa—mwebase; muwummudde ku bitanda byammwe; temusobola kuwulira kusaba kwange. Naye abaana tebajja kunziramu? Tewali baana abeetegese okujja okuggulirawo muganda waabwe oluggi? Nedda; beebase. Abooluganda bange abaagenda—be nnatambulanga nabo mu ssanyu ng’abooluganda, era abaali bannange ab’omu mutima—temusobola kunziramu kubanga muwummudde mu Yesu; ebikolwa byammwe bibagoberera, naye temusobola kunkolera. Naye ng’abaddu beebase, era ng’abaana tebasobola kuddamu, Mukama w’ennyumba atunula,—atunula ne mu ttumbi. Kiyinza okuba ttumbi mu mmeeme yange, naye ampulira, era bwe mba ŋŋamba nti “Mpa emigaati esatu,” ajja ku luggi n’ampa byonna bye nneetaaga. Kale, ggwe Omukristaayo, tunula waggulu osanyuke. Bulijjo waliwo okutu okuggule bw’oba n’akamwa akaggule. Bulijjo waliwo omukono omwetegefu bw’oba n’omutima omwetegefu. Olina kukaaba bukaabi Mukama n’awulira; nedda, nga tonnakoowoola ajja kukuddamu, era ng’okyayogera ajja kukuwulira. Woowe! kale temulwangamu mu kusaba. Mugende gy’ali nga mutuuse eka; nedda, ne mu kkubo nga mugenda, muyimuse emitima gyammwe mu kasirise; era buli kye mwegayirira oba kye musaba, mukisabe mu linnya lya Yesu, era kinaabakolerwa. Ate era, mutunule waggulu, abooluganda Abakristaayo abaagalwa, mutereeze okusaba kwammwe okuva kaakano. Temukyatunuulira kusaba ng’olugero olw’okwegunja oba ng’omulimu omuzibu; mukutunuulire ng’amaanyi ag’amazima, ng’essanyu ery’amazima. Abafirosoofo bwe bazuula amaanyi agamu agaali gakwekeddwa, balabika ng’abasanyukira okugakozesa. Nzikiriza nti wabaddewo bayinginiya bangi abakulu, abaateekateeka ne bazimba ebimu ku bikolwa by’abantu ebisinga okwewuunyisa, si lwa kuba nti byandibaleetedde amagoba, wabula olw’okwagala bwagazi okulaga amaanyi gaabwe okukola eby’ekitalo. Okulaga ensi obukugu bye busobola okukola n’omuntu by’asobola okutuukiriza, basendasenda kampuni okuyingira mu nteekateeka ez’akabi ezitandiyinzizza kuleeta magoba, nga bwe kirabika, nga bwe nnali nsobola okulaba, balyoke bafune omukisa okwolesa amagezi gaabwe. Ayi mmwe Abakristaayo, yinginiya omukulu alyagala okugezaako emirimu eminene n’okwolesa amaanyi ge, nammwe abalina amaanyi agasinga ago omuntu yenna ge yali akozesezza nga yeeyawudde ku Katonda we—mulikkiriza amaanyi ago gasigale nga gasirise? Nedda, mulowooze ku kigendererwa ekinene ekimu, mugolole ebinywa by’okwegayirira kwammwe ku lwakyo. Buli musuwa gw’omutima gwammwe gujjule okutuuka ku mugo n’omusaayi omungi ogw’okwegomba, mulwane, mumeggane, musike era mufube ne Katonda ku lwakyo, nga mukozesa ebisuubizo era nga mwegayirira nga mulaga engeri ze, mulabe oba Katonda tabawa omutima gwammwe bye gwetaaga. Mbasoomooza leero okusukkuluma ku bugabi bwa Mukama wange mu kusaba. Mbakasukira ekisoomooza. Mumukkirize okuba okusinga bw’ali; mwasamye akamwa kammwe nnyo ne kiba nti tasobola kukajjuza; mugende gy’ali kaakano musabe okukkiriza okusinga ekisuubizo kwe kiwa; mukyetantale, mukigezeeko, musinge Ow’olubeerera bwe kiba kisoboka; mukigezeeko. Oba, nga bwe nandyagadde okukyogera, mutwale bye mwegayirira ne bye mwetaaga mulabe oba tabawa kitiibwa. Mugezeeko oba bwe mumukkiriza tatuukiriza kisuubizo, n’abawa omukisa mu bungi ng’abafukako amafuta g’Omwoyo gwe, mwe mulifunira amaanyi mu kusaba. Siyinza kwekuuma obutayongerako bigambo bino ebitono nga mugenda. Mmanyi nti waliwo abamu ku mmwe abatasabangako mu bulamu bwammwe. Mubadde mwogera essaala ey’empisa, oboolyawo emyaka mingi, naye temusabangako n’omulundi gumu. Ah! emmeeme ennaku, kikugwanira okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, era okutuusa lw’onoozaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri tosobola kusaba nga bwe mbadde ndagirira Omukristaayo okusaba. Naye ka nkugambe kino. Omutima gwo gwegomba obulokozi? Omwoyo akuwunzise nti, “Jjangu eri Yesu, ggwe omwonoonyi, ajja kukuwulira?” Kkiriza okuwunza okwo, kubanga ajja kukuwulira. Okusaba kw’omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa kusiimibwa Katonda. Awulira abalina emitima egimenyese era abajjanjaba. Twala okusinda kwo n’okussa ebikkowe kwo eri Katonda, era ajja kukuddamu. “Ah,” naye omu agamba, “sirina kye nneegayiririza.” Kale, naye weegayirire nga Dawudi bwe yakola—“Onsonyiwe ebibi byange, kubanga bingi.” Ensonga eyo ogirina—gamba nti, ku lw’oyo omwagalwa eyayiwa omusaayi gwe,” era ojja kuwangula, ggwe omwonoonyi. Naye togenda eri Katonda n’osaba okusaasirwa ng’ekibi kyo kikyali mu mukono gwo. Wandirowoozezza ki ku mujeemu eyalabikira mu maaso ga kabaka we n’asaba okusonyiyibwa ng’ekiso kikyakwatiddwa mu lukoba lwe, era n’okulangirira obujeemu bwe nga kuli ku kifuba kye? Yandisaanidde okusonyiyibwa? Teyandikisaanidde mu ngeri yonna, era mazima ddala yandisaanidde ekibonerezo kye emirundi ebiri olw’okusekerera bw’atyo mukama we ng’ate yeefuula okunoonya okusaasirwa. Singa omukazi yali alese bba, olowooza yandibadde n’obutaswala obwenkanidde awo, n’ekyenyi eky’ekikomo, okudda n’asaba okusonyiyibwa ng’ate yeesigamye ku mukono gw’omwagalwa we ow’ekyama? Nedda, teyandibadde na butaswala bwe butyo, era naye bwe kiri bwe kityo gy’oli—oboolyawo ng’osaba okusaasirwa ate ng’ogenda mu maaso mu kibi—ng’osaba okutabaganyizibwa ne Katonda, ate ng’okuuma era ng’owoomerwa okwegomba kwo okubi. Zuukuka! zuukuka! okaabirire Katonda wo, ggwe eyeebase. Eryato lisemberera olwazi, oboolyawo enkya liyinza okulukoona ne limenyekamenyeka, naawe n’osuulibwa mu buziba obutakoma obw’ennaku ey’emirembe gyonna. Kaabirira Katonda wo, ŋŋamba, era bw’onoomukaabirira, suula ekibi kyo, bwe kitaba ekyo tayinza kukuwulira. Bw’onooyimusa emikono gyo egitali mirongoofu ng’olina obulimba mu mukono gwo ogwa ddyo, okusaba kwo tekugasa ku mimwa gyo. Woowe, jjangu gy’ali, omugambe nti, “Tusonyiwe ebibi byaffe byonna, otwanirize n’ekisa, otwagale awatali kye otusalidde kya kusasula,” era ajja kukuwulira, era olisaba ng’abalangira abawangula, era olunaku lumu oliyimirira ng’omuwanguzi n’okukirawo mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka ejjudde emmunyeenye ey’oyo afuga emirembe gyonna, Katonda afuga byonna atenderezebwenga emirembe gyonna.

fields.title: Okusaba okw’okwegayiririra abalala
fields.body_html:
“Naye nnaasabanga bulijjo.” Zabbuli 141:5.

EKYAWANDIIKIBWA kino kizibu nnyo mu lulimi lwakyo olwasooka, era kizibu okunywereza amakulu gaakyo nga tuli bakakafu ddala. Naye kaakano si mulimu gwange okwekenneenya amakulu ag’enjawulo agakiweereddwa, kubanga nnina ekirala kye ndubirira. Ku nsonga gye ndimu kaakano, ndi mumativu ddala n’enkyusa ya Bayibuli ey’Olungereza eyakkirizibwa. Amakulu abavvuunuzi baffe ge baawa ekyawandiikibwa kino ge gano—Dawudi agamba nti omuntu omutuukirivu ne bw’anaamunenya n’obukambwe obungi, okutuuka n’okukwata ku muntu we ow’omunda n’okumulaga ekibi kye—era ne bw’anaakikola n’obukakali bungi, kyokka Dawudi teyandimunyiigidde. Yandyeyongedde okumwagala, n’amwebaza olw’okumukolera n’obwesigwa obwenkanidde awo, era yandiraze okwagala kwe ng’agenda mu maaso n’okusabira oyo eyamunenya, singa omuntu oyo omulungi agwibwako ebizibu ekiseera kyonna.

Dawudi yandibadde bulijjo ng’awa oyo amunenya mu bwesimbu ekifo eky’ebbugumu mu ssaala ze. Kale, bwe kiba nga gano ge makulu, era nze ndowooza bwe kiri, kitulaga nti Dawudi yalina empisa ey’okusabira abatukuvu. Singa teyalina, teyandyogedde nti ne mu bizibu byabwe essaala ze zandibalinnyidde. Yali yafuula empisa ye eya buli lunaku okuleeta mu maaso ga Katonda we, mu ssaala ze ez’ekyama, amannya g’abatuukirivu ba Katonda; bwe kitaba bwe kityo, nzeemu nti, teyandyogedde nti ne bwe wandibaddewo abamu ku bo abamunenya n’okumunenya ennyo, yandyeyongedde okubasabira.

Ensonga yaffe ku makya gano eneebanga omulimu ogw’ekitiibwa ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, omulimu ogufiibwako ekitono ennyo mu nnaku zino. Tujja kugwogerako, okusooka, ng’ekyawandiikibwa bwe kitukulembera, ku bikwata ku batukuvu, era, okwokubiri, tujja kugubakubiriza ku lw’aboonoonyi.

I. Okusooka, kale, tuteekwa okwogera ku mulimu ogw’OKWEGAYIRIRIRA ABANTU BA KATONDA. Okusobola okusengeka ebirowoozo byaffe mu ngeri ennungi, ekigambo ekisooka kye tujja okukwata kiba obuvunaanyizibwa. Kiteekeddwa ku buli mwana wa Katonda okusabira ab’omu maka amatukuvu abalala bonna. Obutonde bwennyini tebutuyigiriza kino? Sitegeeza butonde obukadde, wabula obutonde obuggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yatonda mu ffe. Abooluganda bange, temwakizuula nti amangu ddala nga mumaze okufuna obulamu bwa Katonda, mwatandika okusabira abalala nga tewali abakubirizza? Okukaaba kwammwe okwasooka okw’okukkiriza kwatandika nti, “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu,” era bwe kutyo ne kuzingiramu abalala ng’oggyeeko mmwe mwennyini.

Mu ssaala ezisooka omutima omuzzeemu obuggya z’guwaayo, mulimu esaba ku lw’omuntu eyakozesebwa okuguleeta eri Yesu. Tewali mukkiriza muggya yeerabira kusabira muweereza eyali ekikozesebwa mu kukyuka kwe. Emmeeme eyakawonyezebwa nayo yeegayiririra abalala abakyali mu mbeera embi ennyo ekisa mwe kyagiggya. “Waggya emmeeme yange mu kkomera, Mukama; kaakano teeka eddembe bannange be nnali nabo mu busibe. Olw’okwagala kwo okutaggwaawo, sobozesa abalala okulega ku buwoomi bw’obulokozi bwo.” Awo n’abantu ba Kristo abaali boogeddeko n’omukkiriza oyo omuggya ekiseera kyonna, abaamubudaabuda oba abaamuyigiriza, tebalema kufuna mugabo mu ssaala ze—kubanga omutima omuzzeemu obuggya gwe mutima ogwebaza mu bugonvu—era omuntu tazaaliddwa buggya okuva waggulu bw’atawulira kwebaza eri mikwano gye abanyiikivu ab’oku nsi.

Teeka akanyonyi eddembe okuva mu kakomera kaako, kajja kukuyimbira okwebaza nga kafuumuuka mu bbanga! Bwe kityo, bw’oweebwa amaanyi okuggulawo enzigi z’ekkomera ery’emyoyo egisibiddwa, gijja kusasula okufuba kwo okw’okwagala n’okusaba. Nzeemu nti kiri mu buzaaliranwa bw’omukkiriza azaaliddwa obuggya okutandika okwegayiririra abalala, era obuzaaliranwa buno bubeera naye obulamu bwe bwonna. Kye kimu ku bintu by’ateekwa okukola—kimusanyusa okukikola—tekiyinzika nti alekera ddala awo, kubanga Omwoyo abeera mu kifuba kye yeegayiririra abatukuvu ng’okusiima kwa Katonda bwe kuli.

Era, abooluganda, nga bwe kiri obuzaaliranwa bw’obutonde obwazaalibwa mu ggulu, bwe kityo era lye tteeka ly’ennyumba y’abalonde. Abatukuvu mu nteekateeka yaabwe entuufu bayinza okwogerwako nti “nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera. Mwekuumenga nga mugumiikirizanga, era nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu.” Buli mukkiriza alina ekifo ky’omukuumi ekimuweereddwa mu nsonga y’okusaba, era kimugwanidde obutasirika, wabula obutamuganya Mukama kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi era ng’agifudde ettendo mu

nsi. Ffenna tuli bavunaanyizibwa kyenkanyi okusabira Yerusaalemi emirembe, era okukulaakulana kwaffe kusinziira ku ekyo. Ekiragiro ekiggya Mukama kye yatuwa, mw’atulagira nti, “Mwagalanenga,” kitwetaagisa okusabiragana. Omuntu ayinza atya okugamba nti ayagala muganda we, nga tamwegayiririrangako n’akatono eri Katonda?

Nnyinza okubeera bulijjo ne bakkiriza bannange ne ndaba ennaku zaabwe, ne sikaabirira Katonda ku lwabwe? Nnyinza okulaba obwavu bwabwe, okubonaabona kwabwe, okukemebwa kwabwe, n’obuzito bw’emitima gyabwe, kyokka ne mbeerabira mu kwegayirira kwange? Nnyinza okulaba omulimu gwabwe ogw’okukkiriza, n’okufuba okw’okwagala ne sibasabira mukisa? Nnyinza okwezingira mu nze nzekka ne sifaayo ku bizibu by’abo abali baganda bange ne bannyinaze mu Kristo Yesu? Tekiyinzika! Naye bwe mba nsobola, nteekwa okuba nga ndi wa maka malala so si ga Katonda, kubanga mu maka ag’okwagala, okulumirirwa awamu kuleeta okwegayiririragana obutayosa. Katonda atuwonye okwonoona Mukama nga tulekera awo okusabira abooluganda! Buli njuki mu muzinga gw’Ekkanisa erina okuleeta omugabo gwayo ogw’omubisi guno mu tterekero ery’awamu. Nga emirandira gyonna egy’omuti bwe gitambula mu ttaka nga ginoonya emmere, era gyonna ne ginywa ebyetaagisa olw’obulungi bw’omuti gwonna, bwe kityo buli mukkiriza, ng’ayasamya akamwa ak’okusaba, asaanidde okunoonya n’okunywa emikisa egy’omwoyo olw’obulungi bw’Ekkanisa yonna. Kale, abooluganda bange, temwerabiranga buvunaanyizibwa obuwoomu obubateekeddwako olw’oluganda lwammwe n’abatukuvu awamu ne Mukama waabwe atenderezebwa emirembe gyonna.

Era nate, abaagalwa, tukimanyi nti waliwo okwegatta okw’obulamu wakati w’abakkiriza, obumu obw’okumpi ennyo. Tetuli abooluganda kyokka, naye tuli bitundu “ku mubiri ogumu.” Kristo ye Mutwe gw’omubiri gwe ogw’ekyama, Ekkanisa, era ffenna tuli bitundu by’omubiri gwe. Kale, nga mu mubiri gw’omuntu buli kitundu, buli kinywa, buli musuwa n’obusimu bwe byetaagisa eri omubiri gwonna, bwe kityo mu Kkanisa buli mukkiriza yeetaagibwa abalala, era naye yeetaaga abalala. Tuyinza obutasobola kulaga kabi ki akandituuse ku mukono olw’okulumizibwa kw’evviivi, naye mukakase nti omukono gwandirumiriddwa wamu nalyo. Tewali katundu kamu konna mu mubiri gwonna kayinza kwonooneka nga tekakoseza mu ngeri emu oba endala omubiri gwonna ogusigaddeyo.

Bwe kityo Katonda bw’atufudde abeetaaganye—okusinga ennyo bwe tulowooza. Mu bumu bw’Ekkanisa buli muntu ayamba ku bulamu oba ku bulwadde bw’ekibiina kyonna, era tayinza kukyewala. Tewali n’omu mu Kkanisa ya Katonda abeera omulamu ku bubwe yekka, era tewali n’omu afa ku lulwe. Omukkiriza bw’akula mu kisa, tagaggawala ku lulwe yekka—ekibiina ky’Abakristaayo kyongedde ku bugagga bwakyo obw’omwoyo olw’amagoba ge. Ku luuyi olulala, omuntu bw’aseebengerera mu bintu bya Katonda n’afuuka omwavu era omunafu, okulumizibwa tekumukoma ye yekka, naye Ekkanisa mu kigero ekimu efuuka nnaku, ennafu, era erumiziddwa. Woowe abooluganda, kale nga bwe kiri bwe kityo, ka tutuukirize mu bungi obuvunaanyizibwa bwe tulina eri omubiri gwe tuli ekitundu kyagwo! Era mu mulimu ogusanyusa ogw’okwegayirira, ka tweyongere nnyo nnyo.

Okwegayiririra abalala kusaanidde okukubira mu mubiri gwonna ng’omusuwa, ne kuleetera buli kitundu ekiramu okuwulira amaanyi gaakwo amatukuvu. Okwegayiririra abalala kye kimu ku bintu ebitono ennyo bye tuyinza okukola, kyokka kye kimu ku bisinga obunene—tuleme kukugayaalira. Mmemba w’Ekkanisa atasaba kiziyiza—ali mu mubiri ng’eggumba erivunze, oba erinnyo eryonooneka—era mangu ddala, olw’okuba tayamba ku bulungi bwa booluganda, ajja kubafuukira akabi n’ennaku. Abooluganda, ekyo kireme kuba bwe kityo ku muntu yenna mu mmwe! Ate era, abooluganda, singa wabaddewo okwetaaga ensonga ekwata ku mitima gyaffe, tekiri wala kugifuna. Ffe ffennyini tubanja nnyo essaala z’abalala. Abakristaayo bangi basobola okulondoola okukyuka kwabwe okutuuka ku ssaala za maama baabwe ezaalinnya mu ggulu ku lwabwe nga n’ennimi zaabwe ez’obuto tezinnaba kusobola kwatula linnya ly’Omulokozi.

Maama yabaleeta eri Yesu n’amwegayirira abateekeko emikono gye abawe omukisa. Bangi ku mmwe mubanja okukyuka kwammwe okwegayirira kw’abasomesa b’essomero lya Ssande, oba okusaba kw’abaweereza, oba Abakristaayo abanyiikivu kinnoomu abaakulemberwa okubegayiririra. Kale, bwe kiba nga mwafuna omukisa mu kkubo ery’okusaba, mulage okwebaza kwammwe nga musabira abalala! Mufube okugabira abalala omukisa mu ngeri y’emu gye mwagufunamu. Nze kennyini, nzeemu ku makya gano nti tewali muntu ayinza kunkolera kisa kya mazima okusinga okunsabira mu nsi muno! Ndowooza, abooluganda, nti essaala gye zikoma okuba ennyingi ku lwange, gye nkoma okuba omugagga mu bugagga obwa nnamaddala, mu kika ky’obugagga obusinga zaabu ne ffeeza.

Omupuliitani ow’edda agamba nti omuntu bw’agaggawala mu by’obusuubuzi bwe, ateeka emikono mingi okumukolera, era, bw’agamba, omuntu bw’akula mu kugasa abalala, aleeta emmeeme nnyingi okumusabira, era bw’atyo omulimu gwe ne gutambula. Ekisa kya Katonda gye kikoma okukozesebwa ennyo ku muddu wa Mukama, gy’akoma okwetaaga obuyambi obw’okwegayiririrwa okuva eri baganda be ne bannyina be bonna, alyoke asobole okutambuza omulimu gwe wansi w’omukisa gwa Katonda. Nange nnina obuvunaanyizibwa, abooluganda bange, okubasabira, kubanga mmanyi nti bangi ku mmwe bulijjo mukonkona ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa ku lwange. Kale ensonga eno

ngibateekako mmwe—bwe kiba nga mwafuna emikisa olw’okwegayirira kw’abatukuvu, temwandibadde bantu batasiima ddala singa temwegayiririra balala nammwe?

Essaala za maama zaakuleeta eri Kristo? Kale, ggwe maama omuto omwagalwa, weegayirire Mukama ku lw’abaana bo abato ab’omuwendo. Okwegayirira kwa kitaawo kwakutuusa ku bulokozi? Kale, ggwe omuvubuka, wanirira kitaawo n’essaala zo ezitayosa era bw’otyo ogaggawaze ennaku ze ez’oluvannyuma. Muweereddwa buwa nammwe muwenga buwa. Ettaka eryagimusibwa omusulo lizzaayo amakungula galyo—nammwe musasule bulungi Ekkanisa eyababeerera omukutu gw’omukisa. Kale, leero tekiri nsonga ya kwerondera ffe oba tunaasabira baganda baffe ne bannyinaffe mu Kristo oba nedda! Abooluganda abaagalwa, temuli balamu eri Katonda—temulina buzaaliranwa bwa bulamu obuggya bwe mutaba mwegayiririra ab’omu nnyumba ey’okukkiriza! Temulina kwagala okuva eri Katonda—akabonero akakakafu ak’okuzaalibwa obuggya—bwe mwerabira okwegayiririra abalala! Mwerabidde ebbanja lye mubanja, era mukola ebitasaanira kwegatta kwammwe n’Ekkanisa ya Kristo kwe mwatula, bwe mulagajjalira okwegayiririra abalala. Ng’omuntu afuuwa ekkondeere, nandyagadde okubeegayirira, abooluganda bange, okusabira n’amaanyi n’obunyiikivu ab’omu maka ga Katonda omulamu.

Ka tukyuse ekigambo kyaffe kaakano okuva ku buvunaanyizibwa tudde ku kitiibwa. Nga kitiibwa kinene okukkirizibwa okusabira abatukuvu! Kubanga, mulabe, kino kituleeta mu kussa ekimu okusingayo okuba okw’okumpi ne Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini. Tetuyinza kuyamba mu kuteekateeka kutangirira olw’ekibi ky’omuntu—Omulokozi yagamba nti, “Kiwedde,” era kiwedde ddala. Mu mulimu ogwo tetuyinza kubaamu kussa kimu wabula nga tufuna ebivaamu, kubanga yalinnyirira yekka, nga bw’ayogera nti, “Nva kulinnyirira amawanga nga emizabbibu, tewali n’omu yajja kunnyambako.” Mu kubuulira Enjiri leero, tukola omulimu Mukama waffe Yesu mw’atakyalina mugabo kaakano—Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyamba, naye Omuntu Kristo Yesu ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Kitaffe, era eddoboozi lye teriwulirwa nga lirangirira amawulire amalungi. N’olwekyo, mu ngeri ezimu tulina emirimu egy’enjawulo era tukola obuweereza obwawukana, naye mu mulimu ogw’okwegayiririra abalala tuli bamu—mu kaseera kano kennyini Mukama waffe yeegayirira mu maaso g’entebe ya Katonda, era bwe twegayiririra abantu be tuba tukola kye kimu ddala!

Ffe, nga tusabira abatukuvu, tuba n’okussa ekimu okwa ddala kaakano ne Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu, eyeegayirira munda w’eggigi. Nzeemu nate, bwe mbuulira leero, Kristo tabuulira. Naye bwe nsaba, eddoboozi lyange likwatagana n’erirye! Bwe nsabira abooluganda, nzijukira nti ayimiridde mu maaso g’entebe ey’ekitiibwa ng’ayambadde ekyomukifuba, ng’amannya g’abalonde be bonna gamasamasa ku mayinja gaakyo ag’omuwendo. Kale si kintu kya ssanyu okugabana n’Omwana wa Katonda mu buweereza obw’okwegayiririra abalala? Mu buweereza buno atufudde bakabona eri Katonda waffe! Ye Malayika omukulu alina ekyoterezo ekya zaabu, era omukka gw’obubaane bw’awaayo gulinnya wamu n’okusaba kw’abatukuvu mu maaso ga Mukama! Abaagalwa, mwandyagadde okufaanana Mukama Yesu mu buweereza—omukisa guli mu ngalo zammwe—mwegayiririre nnyo abatukuvu!

Era nga kitiibwa nnyo nti ffe, abaali gye buvuddeko abasabiriza ku lwaffe ku mulyango gw’Okusaasira, kaakano tukkiriziddwa nnyo mu kisa kya kabaka ne kiba nti tusobola n’okwatula ekigambo mu kutu kwa kabaka ku lw’abalala! Kwali kusaasira kwa Katonda okw’obuyinza okwatukkiriza okugamba nti, “Onsaasire!” Naye kwekkakkanya kwa ngeri ki kuno okututuusizza okumpi bwe kutyo, ne kiba nti kaakano tusobola okujja eri Mukama ne tugamba nti, “Nandyagadde okwogera naawe ekigambo ku lwa muganda wange. Nandyagadde okusaba ebirabo okuva mu mikono gyo, Kitange, ku lwa mwannyinaze eyeetaaga okusaasirwa.” Mulabe, abooluganda, nga bwe mwasitulibwa ennyo—mwalondebwa mu buweereza obw’ekitiibwa obw’“abakoowoola Mukama,” okumubuuza ku bintu ebirungi eby’Endagaano ye! Mwafuulibwa omugabi w’ebirabo bya kabaka ku lwa Kabaka! Abateekera mu maaso eggwanika lye eriggule n’abagamba musabe kye mwagala. Woowe, ekisa ekitagerageranyizika!

Bw’oba, ggwe omukkiriza, omanyi okusaba mu kukkiriza, oyinza okugabira baganda bo ne bannyoko obugagga obw’omuwendo okusinga zaabu wa Ofiri, kubanga okwegayiririra abalala kye kisumuluzo ky’embiri ez’amasanga omuli obugagga bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo! Abatukuvu nga beegayiririra abalala batuuka mu kifo bamalayika gye batayinza kuyimirira! Ebitonde ebyo ebitukuvu bisanyukira aboonoonyi abeenenya, naye tetusoma nti bakkirizibwa okwegayiririra abatukuvu. Kyokka ffe, wadde nga tetutuukiridde, tulina ekisa kino! Tukkirizibwa okwasamya akamwa kaffe mu maaso ga Mukama ku lw’abalwadde n’abo abagezesebwa, ku lw’abeeraliikirivu n’abo abaggwaamu amaanyi—nga tuli bakakafu nti buli kye tunaasabanga nga tukkiriza, tunaakiweebwanga. Mu nsonga eno tuweereddwa ekitiibwa kinene. Abooluganda, mukozese ekitiibwa kino!

Mmanyi bulungi nti singa Kwini yawa omuntu yenna ku mmwe olukusa okujja mu lubiri, n’okusaba kyonna ky’ayagala ku lwa mikwano gye, temwandisuddewo mukisa ogwo. Mu nnaku zino, omuntu bw’alowooza nti omubaka wa Paalamenti oba omuntu ali mu buyinza amuwuliriza, tatera kusuulawo mukisa gw’okwogerera kizibwe oba mutabani we ayagala ekifo omuli emirimu mitono n’empeera nnyingi. Mu nsi yonna abanoonya ebifo

bangi nnyo. Abantu ab’obuyinza, abawulirizibwa ab’obuyinza, bulijjo bapikirizibwa okukozesa ekifo kyabwe mu bantu mu ngeri yonna esoboka. Kyokka nze nteekwa okuyimirira wano ku makya gano ne mbakubiriza, abooluganda abaagalwa, abawulirizibwa Katonda, okukozesa enkizo yammwe ey’omuwendo!

Mulina ebisuubizo okuva eri Katonda nti ebyo bye musaba mujja kubiweebwa, era bangi bagamba nti, “Munjogerere eri Kabaka”—mwegendereze obutalwa kuyamba. Mukozese eddembe Omulangira wammwe ly’abawadde, mwegayiririre baganda bammwe ne bannyinammwe! Bwe kiba nga tewali mulala yeetaaga ssaala zammwe, nze nsaba n’omwoyo gwonna ekifo mu zo. “Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga,” bwe yagamba Omutume—kale nze kinsaanira okukyogera n’okusingawo! Nga tuweereza buli lunaku mu bintu ebitukuvu, obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe n’ebyetaago byaffe binene nnyo. Kale temutwerabiranga bwe kinaabanga kibagendedde bulungi. Mwogere ekigambo ekirungi eri Omulangira ku lw’abaddu be, mumusabe atuwe ekisa kye ekisingawo.

Tukyuse ekigambo kaakano okuva ku kitiibwa tudde ku bulungi. Okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba kintu kirungi nnyo, kubanga, okusooka, kugasa abo abakukola. Mmanyi nti mwagala, abaagalwa, okubeera ab’omugaso ddala mu Kkanisa ya Katonda. Nsuubira nti tetulina bammemba mu Kkanisa eno abamativu okuba n’amannya gaabwe mu kitabo, n’okujja mu kusinza, ne bawulira nti byonna biwedde nga kino kikoleddwa. Nedda, mwagala okuyamba ddala n’okuleetera Katonda ekitiibwa. Kale, olw’ekigendererwa ekyo mbakubiriza obulungi bw’okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba! Okusooka, abooluganda, kujja kubaleetera okwagala okumanya baganda bammwe ne bannyinammwe. Temuyinza kusabira bulungi abo be mutalina kye mumanyi ku bo. Kale temujja kuyingira n’okufuluma mu kkuŋŋaaniro nga temumanyi muntu atudde kumpi nammwe mu ntebe, naye mujja kubuuza abooluganda bwe bali, era bwe muwulira nti omuntu ali mu buzibu obw’omu mutima, obw’omubiri oba obw’ebintu, mujja kuba beetegefu okukitegeera, mulyoke mumusabire, era bwe mutyo mujja kubeeramu okumanya baganda bammwe nga mubalumirirwa.

Pawulo atugamba okumanya abafuba okukola emirimu mu ffe era abatukulembera mu Mukama waffe! Era nandyagadde bammemba b’Ekkanisa bonna bamanye nnyo okulwana kw’omusumba waabwe, ennaku ze n’essanyu lye—balyoke bamulumirirwe nnyo. Era kye kimu ku booluganda abalala—gye mukoma okumanya n’okulumirirwa, gye zikoma okuba ennungi essaala zammwe. Era olw’okuba mujja kwetaaga okumanya, okusobola okwegayiririra abalala, kyenva mpita okwegayiririra abalala omulimu omulungi. Okwegayiririra okw’amaanyi tekulema kuleeta kwagala. Sikkiriza nti oyinza okukyawa omuntu gw’osabira bulijjo. Bw’oba toyagala Mukristaayo yenna, musabire emirundi ebiri—si ku lulwe yekka, naye ne ku lulwo—olyoke owonyezebwe okusalira abalala omusango nga tonnategeera, era olokolebwe okuva mu kuwulira kwonna okutaliimu kisa.

Mujjukira olugero olw’edda olw’omusajja eyagenda eri omusumba we okumugamba nti tanyumirwa kubuulira kwe? Omuweereza n’amagezi n’agamba nti, “Muganda wange omwagalwa, nga tetunnaba kwogera ku nsonga eyo, ka tusabe ffembi,” era bwe baamala okusaba bombi, oyo eyeemulugunya n’asanga nga talina kya kwogera, okuggyako okwatula nti ye kennyini abadde mugayaavu nnyo mu kusabira omusumba we. Era n’ateeka obutaganyulwa bwe ku nsonga eyo. Nze okubulwa okwagala kw’oluganda nkussa ku kukendeera kw’okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba. Musabiraganenga n’amaanyi, bulijjo, n’omwoyo ogwaka, era mujja kugatta emitima gyammwe wamu mu kwagala ng’omutima gw’omuntu omu. Eno ye sseminti ey’amabala amalungi mw’erina okuzimbibwamu amayinja g’Ekkanisa bwe gaba ag’okunywerera awamu.

Abooluganda abaagalwa, bwe musabiragana, si kulumirirwagana n’okwagala kwokka kwe kunaakula, naye mujja kuba n’endowooza ez’ekisa ku buli omu ku mmwe. Bulijjo tusalira omusango mu kisa abo be twegayiririra. Omuntu ow’olugambo bw’alaga muganda wange ng’omubi ennyo, okwagala kwange kunkakasa nti akyamu. Saamusabidde ku makya gano, kale nnyinza ntya okuwulira ng’asalirwa omusango? Bwe mba nteekwa okukkiriza nti alina omusango, nnakuwala nnyo, naye sijja kumunyiigira—wabula nja kusaba Mukama amusonyiwe era amuzzeewo—nga nange nneegendereza si kulwa nga nange ngwa mu kukemebwa. Tulowooza nti abaana baffe balungi kubanga baffe era balina ekifo mu mutima gwaffe. Era mu ngeri y’emu tuyanguwa okulaba empisa zonna ennungi eziyinza okubeera mu abo be twegayiririra—era twetegefu okuleeta ensonga ezikendeeza ku buzito bw’ensobi z’empisa zaabwe.

Okusaba kye kigatta emitima mu ngeri ey’ekitalo, era kitonda okwagala okw’amaanyi. Okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba kugasa nnyo mu kuzimba obwegendereza. Ka tugambe nti ggwe, nga oli mmemba w’Ekkanisa eno, osisinkana abaddirira era n’otuuka ku kunoonya okukomawo kwabwe. Essaala zo olw’okukomawo kwabwe zijja kukuleetera mu buzaaliranwa okusaba nti, “Mukama, nkuuma eri obubi buno. Nkuuma obutaddirira. Nkuuma obutafuuka omunnyogovu era atafaayo ng’abooluganda bano bwe bafuuse.” Bwe tusanga abeeyita Abakristaayo abagudde mu kutamiira, ne tunyiikira okwegayirira Mukama abawonye mu kinnya ekyo eky’entiisa, emmeeme zaffe zireetebwa okukyawa ekibi ekyo n’okukyekuuma nga ziri ku munaala gw’omukuumi. Bwe tulaba nga abooluganda babiri tebakkiriziganya era tebasobola kuleetebwa mu mirembe, bwe tusaba Katonda nti obumu

buzzibweewo wakati wabwe, tukulemberwa era okusaba tubeere n’omwoyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu—tuleme kuleeta nkaayana—era nti bwe tuba twali tuleese enkaayana ekiseera kyonna, tubeere beetegefu okwatula ensobi n’okugitereeza.

Bwe kityo abo be tusabira n’okweraliikirira bafuuka gye tuli ng’amataala agalabula. Bw’otunuulira abalala n’omwoyo ogw’okunoonya ensobi n’obanenya n’obwagazi, n’ova mu nnyumba emu n’odda mu ndala ng’osaasaanya ekivundu kino n’obunyiikivu, enneeyisa yo etali ntukuvu ejja kuzaala mu ggwe okwetwala ng’omutuukirivu. Naye bw’ogenda eri Mukama ng’onakuwadde olw’ebikolwa byonna ebibi eby’abooluganda, n’onoonya awatali kukoowa okuzzibwawo kw’abo abakyamye, ojja kukuza mu mutima gwo obugonvu n’obwegendereza eri ekibi. Abo abeegayiririra ennyo abalala emirundi mingi bajja kusanga ku mimwa gyabwe essaala nti, “Nkebera, Ayi Katonda, otegeere omutima gwange. Ngezesa omanye ebirowoozo byange. Olabe obanga mu nze mulimu engeri yonna enkyamu; era onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Siyinza kulwawo kubabuulira bintu birala ebirungi ebiri mu mulimu guno ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, naye nkakasa nti gwe gumu ku mirimu egisinga obutukuvu, egisinga okuleeta obulamu obulungi, era egisinga okuba egy’omu ggulu, omuntu atya Katonda gy’ayinza okwenyigiramu. Temulowooza, abooluganda abaagalwa, nti singa buli omu ku ffe yalagirwa mu kaseera kano kennyini okunnyonnyola bw’afuddeyo ku mulimu guno omulungi, abasinga obungi ku ffe twandiswadde? Nnyinza okugezaako okubuuza buli Mukristaayo ali wano ekibuuzo kino—owadde Katonda n’Ekkanisa ye omugabo gwo ogusaanidde ogw’okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba? Tetwegayiriridde kusukkiridde, ekyo nkikakasa, kubanga ku munnyo guno kiyinza okwogerwa nti, “omunnyo gwe baliba baagala gwonna.” Tewali muntu asabira munne kusukkiridde!

Tusabye ekimala? Mbawa ebbanga era nsiriikiriramu akaseera mulyoke mwebuuze ekibuuzo ekyo. Nja kubawa okuddamu kwange nze. Omutima gwange tegunnenya ku buvunaanyizibwa bwange eri Ekkanisa eno mu nsonga y’okubuulira, kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda kwonna. Singa nnyinza okuyiga okubuulira obulungi okusingawo, nandikikoze n’essanyu. Mmanyi bwe nnemereddwa, naye mbaweerezza n’omutima gwonna era n’obwesigwa mu maaso ga Katonda ku kituuti kino. Naye sisobola kwogera bwe ntyo ku kwegayiririra kwange abalala. Nnina bingi eby’okwatulira Katonda ku bunafu bwange mu nsonga eyo. Era ntya nti bakozi bannange bangi wano bateekwa okukkiriza omusango gwe gumu. Tobulangako ku kibiina kyo eky’okusomesa ku Ssande olweggulo. Bulijjo otuuka ku mulimu gwo mu budde, ng’osomye bulungi essomo ery’Ebyawandiikibwa. Ekyo kirungi, naye, muganda wange omwagalwa, bulijjo osaba essomo eryo liyingire mu mmeeme yo?

Mwannyinaze omwagalwa, wafuula empisa okusabira abawala b’olabirira, kinnoomu, n’omwoyo ogwaka ennyo? Sibalumiriza, naye mbasaba mwekebere munda mu myoyo gyammwe, kubanga ensobi eno si ntono, wabula etuleetera ffe n’Ekkanisa okufiirwa kungi. Abakadde n’Abadiikoni b’Ekkanisa eno, temuliiko musango mu nsonga y’okwegayiririra abalala? Abasajja abamu mu ffe bayinza okuba nga tebaliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu nsonga eno, naye ntya nti abasinga obungi ku ffe tufuddeyo ku mirimu emirala okusinga wala nnyo ku guno. Tusabidde mu lwatu mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba, era nsuubira nti tetwerabidde kwegayiririra batukuvu ku kyoto ky’amaka. Naye era, singa twasabira abooluganda emirundi 10 okusingawo, oba n’emirundi 100, tetwandisukkiridde!

Oluusi tuyimirira mu lwatu ku mikolo egy’olukuŋŋaana ne tulumiriza Ekkanisa ya Katonda nti eyongera kunnyogoga. Ka twebuuze ekibuuzo kino—Tugyongeddeko ebbugumu olw’essaala zaffe? Twegayiridde olw’okuzzibwa obuggya kwayo? Tunenya Ebibiina by’Abaminsani kubanga ebibala ebirabika bitono nnyo. Tusabira emirimu gy’abaminsani nga bwe tusaanidde? Mpulira okwemulugunya okw’ennaku ku mulembe guno n’ogujja ogw’ababuulizi—twegayiriridde abayizi n’abasumba nga bwe kitugwanidde? Mpulira abantu nga boogera ku Bakristaayo nti ba nsi, ab’okungulu oba ab’amalala. Mubasabidde ne bava mu bwensi bwabwe ne mu malala gaabwe? Tekiyinza kuba nti mwandikoze bulungi nnyo singa mwabasabira okusinga okubanenya? Weewaawo, era ensobi ze mulaba mu bo teziyinza, mu kigero ekinene, kuva ku kulagajjalira kwammwe mmwe mwennyini omulimu ogw’okwegayiririra abalala? Woowe, ka tulekeraawo okwemulugunya n’okwekubira enduulu, okunenya n’okunoonya ensobi, ne tutwala byonna ku entebe ey’okusaasira—kubanga singa ekitundu ky’omukka ogumalibwa obwereere mu kwemulugunya okw’okunenya kyakyusibwa ne kifuuka okwegayiririra abalala—Ekkanisa yandibaddemu obutukuvu bungi nnyo!

Kaakano nteekwa okuddayo ku kyawandiikibwa, nga mbawa ekigambo ekirala, era ekyo bwe bugazi. Dawudi agamba mu kyawandiikibwa nti, “Naye nnaasabanga bulijjo,” ng’ategeeza, nga Bayibuli ey’Olungereza bw’ekivvuunula, nti essaala ze zinaabanga ku lwabwe ne mu bizibu byabwe; era amakulu ge gano—singa wabaddewo omu ku batukuvu ba Katonda amunyiiza olw’obwesigwa bwe eri emmeeme ye, yandyeyongedde okumusabira. Abooluganda, tetulina kusabira abo bokka abatusanyusa mu ngeri gye batwogeramu—naye tulina okusabira mu kwagala n’abo abasala ennyo, abakambwe ennyo, abalumya ennyo mu bigambo byabwe.

Kiba kitya singa babeera bakambwe nnyo ne banakuwaza emyoyo gyaffe? Kiba kitya singa okunenya kwabwe kulabika nga tekwetaagisa, kwa kabi era kwa butali bwenkanya? Tukyalina obuvunaanyizibwa okubasabira. Dawudi, mu kyawandiikibwa, alabika ng’agamba kino—abatuukirivu ne bwe bandimukoze kyonna kye baagala, yandyeyongedde okubasabira mu bizibu byabwe. Era mbakubiriza, abooluganda bange, bwe wabaawo mmemba yenna mu

Kkanisa eno akuyisizza obubi, weesasuze ku ye ng’omwagala emirundi 10 okusinga bwe wali omwagala, era ng’omusabira bulijjo n’obunyiikivu okusingawo! Singa waliwo muganda wo eyabetenta omwoyo gwo n’akulumya ne kiba nti okumulowoozaako kukuleetera obulumi, tofaayo! Eddagala erisinga obulungi eri ekiwundu kwe kugenda eri Katonda mu kusaba n’oyiwa emmeeme yo ku lulwe—saba Mukama amuwe omukisa omunene era amufuule Omukristaayo omulungi okusingawo—amujjuze okwagala kwa Katonda!

Era, awo, bw’olimulaba ng’alongoose, ojja kutuuka ku kulowooza nti wakola ensobi mu kusalira omusango bye yayogera, n’otegeera bubi kye yali agenderera okukuyamba, oba ojja kusanga nti ajja kujja gy’oli agambe nti, “Nnali mukyamu, muganda wange.” Oba, bw’ataakyatule mu bigambo, ajja kukikkiriza mu bikolwa bye ng’akulaga ekisa ekisukkiridde. Era, abooluganda, bwe tusanga Omukristaayo munnaffe ali mu kabi, tulina okumusabira emirundi ebiri. Abantu b’ensi baleka bannaabwe bwe bagwa mu buzibu—ng’ekisibo bwe kireka empeewo efumitiddwa. Tuba n’emikwano mingi nga byonna bitambula bulungi. Tuba n’emikwano mitono nnyo ennaku embi bwe zitukka. Naye mu Bakristaayo tekisaanidde kuba bwe kityo! Tusaanidde kuba mikwano gya bwesigwa—tusaanidde okulaga ekisa ekisingawo eri abo abafuuka abaavu okusinga bwe tukiraga abalala.

Bwe tusanga Omukristaayo munnaffe afiiriddwa okubudaabudibwa kwe era aggwaamu essuubi—wadde ng’okubeera naye kuyinza obutaba kwa ssanyu nnyo, era n’okutuleetera ffe ennaku—tusaanidde okumusabira ennyo, n’okugezaako okumuggya mu Ntubiro y’Okuggwaamu Essuubi. Okusingira ddala, muganda waffe mu Kristo bw’awaayirizibwa, tuteekwa okuyimirira naye. Bangi bagoberera empisa embi ey’okwewala ddala omuntu aswaziddwa. Omuntu asuulidde olubatu lw’ettosi ku muntu eyeeyita Omukristaayo—ka tumwewale, kubanga ettosi liyinza okutugwako naffe. Bwe batyo bwe boogera abatiitiizi, naye ffe si bwe tukola! Nedda, muganda wange, bw’oba oli mu ggye lya Emmanweri, era muganda waffe ayigganyizibwa takoze kibi, ka tuyimirire oba tugwe wamu naye! Tetulekanga munnaffe mu lutalo!

Ensi bw’eneegamba nti, “Mumusuule wansi! Mumusuule wansi! Mumusuule wansi!” tujja kudduka ng’omuzira Omuyonaani ow’edda okumutaasa, ne tukwata engabo yaffe waggulu w’oyo agudde, nga tumulwanirira okutuusa lw’anaasobola okuyimuka—kubanga olunaku lumu naffe tuyinza okugwa, ne twetaaga muganda waffe omuserikale okutubikka okuva eri omulabe. Ka tusabire baganda baffe ne bannyinaffe okuva mu bizibu byabwe, so tetubaleka—era singa essaala eyo ebeera ya kiseera kiwanvu nga tennaddibwamu, ka tugumiikirize mu kwegayirira awatali kukoowa, nga twogera ne Dawudi nti, “Naye nnaasabanga bulijjo”—ne mu bizibu byabwe.

Sijja kwongera kwogera ku nsonga eno ey’okwegayiririra abatukuvu, naye nja kugireka mu maaso g’Entebe ey’Olubeerera era mu myoyo gyammwe egy’omunda. Mbeegayiridde, okuggyako nga muli balyamaalyamu eri Kristo—bwe muba muli bitundu by’obumu obw’amazima, bwe muba emyoyo gyammwe gigattiddwa wamu Omwoyo Omutukuvu—mumeggane nnyo mu kusabiragana, so temuleka Malayika w’Endagaano okutuusa ng’omukisa gutuuse ku nnyumba ya Katonda yonna, ne gulyoka gukulukutira mu nsi yonna.

II. Kaakano, okwokubiri, omulimu ogw’ekitiibwa ogw’okwegayiririra ABOONOONYI. Ku kino nja kwogera mu bufunze, naye, nsuubira, n’obunyiikivu. Ng’Ekkanisa tulina engule, era tugirina okumala emyaka mingi. Naye nandyagadde okukozesa ebigambo bya Kristo mu kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa. Bw’aba ayogera n’emu ku Kkanisa, agamba nti, “Nnyweza ky’olina waleme kubaawo akutwalako ngule yo.” Kaakano, engule yaffe ng’Ekkanisa ebadde ki? Tebadde bugagga bwaffe, kubanga mu ekyo tetusinga. Tebadde kusoma kwaffe—tetukwewaanirako. Tebadde kusinza kwaffe okulungi mu ndabika, obulungi bw’ennyimba zaffe, oba obuwoomi bw’amaloboozi gaffe.

Nedda, tetufaayo ku bintu ng’ebyo, naye twagala obwangu obutaliimu kwerimbalimba. Engule yaffe ebadde kino ekimu—nti bwe wabaddewo Ekkanisa mu Bukristaayo bwonna eyeewaayo okuwangula emyoyo, Ekkanisa eno ekikoze. Obuweereza bwaffe bulijjo bubadde bugenderera kino—okukwakula ebisiki ebyaka mu muliro, okuggya aboonoonyi mu kizikiza okubayingiza mu butangaavu obutenkanika. Era sibakolera kirala okuggyako obwenkanya bwokka, abooluganda bange, bwe ngamba nti ekitundu ekisinga obunene ku Kkanisa eno kiramu ddala mu kuwangula emyoyo. Kisanyusa nnyo omutima gwange okusisinkana ebibinja by’abooluganda eby’enjawulo mu mmwe, abali buli wamu mu kibuga kino nga bakola awatali kwelaga naye n’obuwanguzi okuleeta emyoyo eri Kristo. Nsuubira nti bulijjo kinaabanga bwe kityo. Nnyweza, ggwe Kkanisa, ky’olina waleme kubaawo akutwalako ngule yo! Ka libeere ssanyu lyaffe n’ekitiibwa kyaffe bulijjo nti Katonda atuwa abaana ab’omwoyo, era emyoyo ne gizaalibwa gy’ali.

Kaakano twagala okukola kino, era nkakasa nti tukyagala, naye tulina okufaayo ennyo ku kwegayiririra emyoyo gy’abo abatannakyuka. Musooke musabe, kubanga kino kye kisinga obukulu okukola. Ggwe nange tuyinza kukola ki ffekka mu kukyusa omuntu? Tetuyinza kukyusa mutima gwe! Tetuyinza kumussaamu bulamu—kyandibadde kye kimu n’okulowooza okutonda emmeeme munda mu mbiriizi z’okufa! Mulimu gwa Katonda okuzaala emyoyo obuggya. Kale olwo? Bwe mba nga ndi wa kuba kikozesebwa kye mu kukikola, ekikolwa kyange ekisooka kiteekwa kuba kufukamira ne nsaba nti, “Ayi Katonda, kola nange.” Ogenda mu ssomero lyo erya Ssande olweggulo lwa leero, oba ogenda okubuulira ku nguudo. Kale, singa wali osobola okukola omulimu, sandikukubirizza kwonoona budde ng’osaba Katonda akole

ky’oyinza okukola wekka! Naye, olw’okuba toyinza n’akatono kuwangula mmeeme n’emu eri Yesu awatali Mwoyo wa Katonda, ekikolwa kyo ekisooka kibeere kusaba nti, “Ayi amaanyi ga Katonda, jjangu onnyambaze! Ayi olulimi lw’omuliro, weebwe gye ndi, era ggwe Empewo entukuvu, ey’amaanyi ennyo ekunta, jjangu ofuuweemu obulamu mu myoyo emifu!” Okusaba kye kintu ekisinga obukulu mu kukyusa aboonoonyi okuva mu bukyamu bw’amakubo gaabwe.

Era okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba kujja kukutegeka okufuuka ekikozesebwa kya Katonda. Bwe nsaba omuntu akyuke, naddala bwe nnonda omuntu omu kinnoomu, omutima gwange gubuguma mu kumwagala nga bwe ndowooza ku mbeera ye n’ekifo ky’alimu mu kusaba. Kale, ekyo kinjigiriza, era kinnyamba okumuwa ekigambo ekituufu bwe ntuuka okumpi naye. Nninga omusawo alongoosa, bw’atuuka ku mulwadde gw’ateekwa okulongoosa n’ekiso, n’amanya ddala buli ggumba we liri n’ekitundu ki ekyalumizibwa. Okusaba kwange kunnaze embeera y’omuntu oyo. Ngyetegerezza era ne ngifumiitirizaako mu kwegayirira kwange, era bwe ntuuka okumukolako mu bikolwa, nja kuba wa magezi, ku bw’Omwoyo wa Katonda, okukola ekituufu era mu ngeri entuufu.

Singa twali twagala okusindika omuntu mu ttendekero okumufuula omuyambi omulungi eri emitima egyeraliikirivu, twandimusindise mu ttendekero ery’okusaba okw’engeri zonna, kubanga okwegayiririra abalala kye kkubo ery’okufuuka ow’amagezi mu kuwangula emyoyo! Era, abooluganda, okusaba kujja kubakolako kino—mujja kukola omulimu nga mulina essuubi. Kintu kya ntiisa nnyo okulowooza ku bantu abaziikibwa nga balamu, abateekebwa wansi w’ettaka mikwano gyabwe mu ssanduuko zaabwe nga bakyalimu omukka. Ka twegendereze tuleme kuziika mmeeme nga nnamu—ntya nti tulina empisa ey’okukikola. Tusalawo ku muntu omu nti tagenda kukyuka n’akatono—tugamba nti ono muntu ku ye okufuba kwonna tekuliiko kye kugasa. Tulowooza ku muntu omulala nti yeewaayo nnyo mu bubi ne kiba nti tuyinza okumuleka ne tufaayo ku bantu abalimu essuubi.

Mu bino byonna tuli bakyamu, kubanga tetulina buyinza kussa mukono ku kiwandiiko ekisalira emmeeme okufa, oba okugamba ekisa kya Katonda nti, “Wano w’otuuse w’onookoma, tojja kweyongerayo.” Kkiriza nti omuntu ng’akyali mulamu mu nsi muno, ekisa kikyasobola okumutuukako! Musitule mu mikono gyo mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba—era bw’onootandika okumusabira ojja kuwulira nti waliwo essuubi—era oluvannyuma ojja kwogera naye mu ngeri ey’essuubi, era oboolyawo ey’okukkiriza. Sikkiriza nti waliwo omuntu yenna eyali alokoleddwa omulala ng’ayogera naye mu ddoboozi ery’okuggwaamu essuubi, naye eddoboozi eddungi ery’okwagala okulina essuubi lye liwangula. Kkiriza nti omutima omukakanyavu guyinza okumenyebwa, olulimi lw’omuvvoozi ne lulongoosebwa, ebirowoozo by’omuyigganyi ne bikyuka, era nti omujeemu ayinza okugondera Kristo eyakomererwa n’afuuka emmunyeenye eyaka mu ggulu lya Katonda.

Abooluganda abaagalwa, mbeegayiridde, kale, olw’okuba amaanyi ga Katonda, era olw’okuba okwegayiririra abalala kujja kubafuula abasaanira okukozesebwa Katonda, era olw’okuba kujja kubawa essuubi lingi ku abo be mukola nabo—mwenyigire mu kwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Guno mulimu mwenna gwe muyinza okuyambamu. Singa nnajja gye muli ku makya gano ne ngamba nti, “Abooluganda, omulimu gwa Mukama gwetaaga ssente,” mmanyi, okuva mu bumanyirivu obw’ebbanga eddene, nti mwandikoze kyonna kye musobola. Naye waliwo abamu abandiwaliriziddwa okuddamu nti, “Ebyetaago by’amaka gange tebinzikiriza kubaako kye nkola mu nsonga eyo.” Naye bwe tusaba okwegayiririra abalala, tewali Mukristaayo ayinza okugamba nti, “Siyinza kwegayirira Katonda.” Singa nnali wa kubakubiriza mu kaseera kano obwetaavu bw’okubuulira okw’olwatu okusingawo, bangi ku bawuliriza bange bandibadde n’ensonga entuufu ey’okwesonyiyisa, kubanga boogera mpola era tebalina kirabo kya kwogera.

Naye, Woowe abooluganda, bwe kituuka ku kwegayiririra abalala mwenna musobola okutuukiriza omulimu ogwo! Era nga mukikola, musobola okubeera n’omugabo mu mirimu gyonna eminene egy’Ekkanisa. Nawulira ku mukazi omutukuvu eyali agamba nti, “Siyinza kubuulira, naye nsobola okuyamba omuweereza wange okubuulira olw’essaala zange. N’olwekyo, buli lwe mmulaba ng’alinnya ku kituuti, nja kusaba Katonda awe omukisa ekigambo kye, era bwe ntyo nja kuba n’omugabo ku by’akola.” Bw’owulira ku muminsani akola wonna wonna ebweru w’eggwanga, musabire, era olwo ojja kuba mukozi munne. Abaagalwa, abamu ku mmwe mutera okuba abalwadde, era mu kiro ekikooyesa mwebaka kitono nnyo—mumanyi lwaki Mukama abaleka nga mutunula? Kiri bwe kityo nti, abalala ku ffe nga beebase, mmwe mulyoke mutusabire!

Katonda ateekwa okuba n’abantu abakuuma ebiseera eby’ekiro! Asalawo nti abakuumi ab’okusaba bateekebwe okwetooloola Ekkanisa ye emisana n’ekiro—mmwe muli bakuumi ab’ebiseera by’ekiro. Temuyinza kukola kirala kyonna, naye musobola okusaba—era nga musaba musobola okufuna omugabo mu mirimu egisinga ekitiibwa egy’Ekkanisa! Kaakano mwetegereze—Dawudi, mu ngeri etali ya lwatu, atugamba nti abamu ku abo be tusabira bayinza, oboolyawo, obutafaayo ku ssaala zaffe, era bayinza okugwa mu bizibu ebinene olw’ebibi byabwe. Olwo nno kye kiseera kyaffe mwe tusaanidde okweyongera okunyiikira mu kubeegayiririra! Bwe mba nga nnayogera n’omuntu atatya Katonda okumala emyaka mingi, n’asekerera byonna bye nnayogera, olwo nja kumalirira munda yange nti, “Sirikoma kumusabira. Oboolyawo olunaku lumu ndimusanga nga mulwadde, olwo alisaba essaala z’agaana kaakano. Oboolyawo ndimusanga ng’omutima gwe gumenyese, olwo ebigambo by’akudaalira kaakano biriba biwoomu nnyo gy’ali.”

Mmwe abanoonya emyoyo, mulina okumanya okweyongera okuyigga—abo abaggwaamu omukka mu kuwangula emyoyo tebalituuka ku buwanguzi. Mubagoberere! Mubagoberere! Mubagoberere okutuuka ku miryango gy’entaana! Bwe batalokoka oluvannyuma lw’emyaka 20 egy’okusaba, mubagoberere okutuuka ku miryango gya Ggeyeena! Bwe bamala okuyita mu miryango egyo, essaala zammwe tezikkirizibwa era tezigasa, naye okutuuka ddala ku mugo gw’Obunnya obw’emagombe mubagoberere—mubagoberere n’essaala zammwe. Bwe batakkiriza kubawuliriza nga mwogera, tebayinza kubaziyiza kusaba. Basekerera okubuulirira kwammwe? Tebayinza kubatawaanya nga musaba, kubanga tebamanyi lwe musaba. Bali wala nnyo ne kiba nti temusobola kubatuukako? Essaala zammwe zisobola okubatuukako! Mukyasobola okubasabira omukisa. Balangiridde nti tebaliddamu kubawuliriza wadde okulaba amaaso gammwe? Temufaayo, Katonda alina eddoboozi lye bateekwa okuwulira—mwogere naye, era ajja kubaleetera okuwulira.

Wadde nga kaakano babayisa bubi, nga babasasula obubi olw’obulungi bwammwe, mubagoberere, mubagoberere, mubagoberere n’essaala zammwe! Temubaleka kuzikirira olw’okubulwa okwegayirira kwammwe. Ekiseera kiyinza okutuuka abo abaalwawo ennyo okuwaayo emitima gyabwe eri Kristo lwe banaatusasula emirundi lukumi olw’okufuba kwonna n’okwegayirira kwe tuyinza okuteekamu. Oluusi ndabye omwonoonyi omukulu, bw’alokolebwa, n’afuuka ow’omugaso ng’abakkiriza abaakakyuka aba bulijjo 20, kubanga nga bwe yali omuzibu okuwangula, bw’atyo n’afuuka ow’omugaso bwe yawangulwa. Tetusuubira nti buli lunaku tujja kufuna ba Sawulo nga bafuulibwa ba Pawulo, naye bwe kiba bwe kityo, olwo Ekkanisa efuna obugagga bungi ddala, kubanga Pawulo omu asinga omuwendo abakkiriza aba bulijjo lukumi! Amaluulu gano ag’omu buziba bw’ennyanja ga muwendo. Abazibu bano bayinza okufuuka ba Pawulo—n’olwekyo mubeere beetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu—nga mubasabira okutuusa lwe baleetebwa eri Kristo.

Ekintu kimu kye njagala ku makya gano kwe kuba nti abooluganda bange abaagalwa mu Kristo beeyame okweyongera okusaba awatali kukoowa ku lw’aboonoonyi abatwetoolodde. Nga Ibulayimu, ekibuga ekinene kiri mu maaso gaffe—ka tukyegayiririre! Nga Musa, tubeera mu bantu aboonoonyi—ka tuyimirire mu kituli ku lwabwe. Ndagira buli mmemba w’Ekkanisa eno, olw’obwesigwa bwe eri Katonda, bw’aba ddala nga si mulimba mu kwatula kw’akoze, okusabira awatali kukoowa abatatya Katonda balyoke baleetebwe eri Yesu! Mwegayirire Yakuwa! Mwegayirire—ayagala essaala zammwe—okwegayiririra kwammwe kuli ng’obubaane obuwoomu ku kyoto ekya zaabu. Mumwegayirire era mulyoke mulabe empeera y’okwegayirira kwammwe mu kukyuka kw’abaana b’abantu! Mugende eka mufuule abaana bammwe ensonga enkulu ey’okukaaba kwammwe olweggulo lwa leero. Mwegayirire Mukama alokole babbammwe oba bakyala bammwe, ab’enganda zammwe ne baliraanwa bammwe ab’okumpi.

Mwegayirire omukisa ku abo abatuula mu ntebe n’abawuliriza ab’ekibiina kino abatannazaalibwa buggya! Olwo mutwale enguudo zammwe, mutwale ekitundu mwe mubeera, mwegayirire Katonda abakyalire n’ekisa—temulibulwa bantu ba kusabira—n’olwekyo mweyongere mu kwegayirira. Ennaku si nnyingi emabega nalaba abaami bana abaali bakyuse ne badda eri Katonda, naye bakyala baabwe nga basigadde bweru w’Ekkanisa. Era abooluganda abo abana, oboolyawo bonna bali wano ku makya gano, baakuŋŋaana wamu okusabira bakyala baabwe bakyuke—era ku Ssande esooka ey’Ekyeggulo kya Mukama omwezi oguwedde, abakyala abana ne baleetebwa mu Kkanisa nga kye kiddamu eri essaala z’abaami abana!

Buli kintu kisoboka! Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza! Katonda atuyambe okukkiriza n’okwegayiririra abalala, era alyoke atuwe omukisa gwe, ku lwa Kristo. Amiina.
fields.body_text: “Naye nnaasabanga bulijjo.” Zabbuli 141:5. EKYAWANDIIKIBWA kino kizibu nnyo mu lulimi lwakyo olwasooka, era kizibu okunywereza amakulu gaakyo nga tuli bakakafu ddala. Naye kaakano si mulimu gwange okwekenneenya amakulu ag’enjawulo agakiweereddwa, kubanga nnina ekirala kye ndubirira. Ku nsonga gye ndimu kaakano, ndi mumativu ddala n’enkyusa ya Bayibuli ey’Olungereza eyakkirizibwa. Amakulu abavvuunuzi baffe ge baawa ekyawandiikibwa kino ge gano—Dawudi agamba nti omuntu omutuukirivu ne bw’anaamunenya n’obukambwe obungi, okutuuka n’okukwata ku muntu we ow’omunda n’okumulaga ekibi kye—era ne bw’anaakikola n’obukakali bungi, kyokka Dawudi teyandimunyiigidde. Yandyeyongedde okumwagala, n’amwebaza olw’okumukolera n’obwesigwa obwenkanidde awo, era yandiraze okwagala kwe ng’agenda mu maaso n’okusabira oyo eyamunenya, singa omuntu oyo omulungi agwibwako ebizibu ekiseera kyonna. Dawudi yandibadde bulijjo ng’awa oyo amunenya mu bwesimbu ekifo eky’ebbugumu mu ssaala ze. Kale, bwe kiba nga gano ge makulu, era nze ndowooza bwe kiri, kitulaga nti Dawudi yalina empisa ey’okusabira abatukuvu. Singa teyalina, teyandyogedde nti ne mu bizibu byabwe essaala ze zandibalinnyidde. Yali yafuula empisa ye eya buli lunaku okuleeta mu maaso ga Katonda we, mu ssaala ze ez’ekyama, amannya g’abatuukirivu ba Katonda; bwe kitaba bwe kityo, nzeemu nti, teyandyogedde nti ne bwe wandibaddewo abamu ku bo abamunenya n’okumunenya ennyo, yandyeyongedde okubasabira. Ensonga yaffe ku makya gano eneebanga omulimu ogw’ekitiibwa ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, omulimu ogufiibwako ekitono ennyo mu nnaku zino. Tujja kugwogerako, okusooka, ng’ekyawandiikibwa bwe kitukulembera, ku bikwata ku batukuvu, era, okwokubiri, tujja kugubakubiriza ku lw’aboonoonyi. I.
