Okusooka, kale, tuteekwa okwogera ku mulimu ogw’OKWEGAYIRIRIRA ABANTU BA KATONDA. Okusobola okusengeka ebirowoozo byaffe mu ngeri ennungi, ekigambo ekisooka kye tujja okukwata kiba obuvunaanyizibwa. Kiteekeddwa ku buli mwana wa Katonda okusabira ab’omu maka amatukuvu abalala bonna. Obutonde bwennyini tebutuyigiriza kino? Sitegeeza butonde obukadde, wabula obutonde obuggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yatonda mu ffe. Abooluganda bange, temwakizuula nti amangu ddala nga mumaze okufuna obulamu bwa Katonda, mwatandika okusabira abalala nga tewali abakubirizza? Okukaaba kwammwe okwasooka okw’okukkiriza kwatandika nti, “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu,” era bwe kutyo ne kuzingiramu abalala ng’oggyeeko mmwe mwennyini. Mu ssaala ezisooka omutima omuzzeemu obuggya z’guwaayo, mulimu esaba ku lw’omuntu eyakozesebwa okuguleeta eri Yesu. Tewali mukkiriza muggya yeerabira kusabira muweereza eyali ekikozesebwa mu kukyuka kwe. Emmeeme eyakawonyezebwa nayo yeegayiririra abalala abakyali mu mbeera embi ennyo ekisa mwe kyagiggya. “Waggya emmeeme yange mu kkomera, Mukama; kaakano teeka eddembe bannange be nnali nabo mu busibe. Olw’okwagala kwo okutaggwaawo, sobozesa abalala okulega ku buwoomi bw’obulokozi bwo.” Awo n’abantu ba Kristo abaali boogeddeko n’omukkiriza oyo omuggya ekiseera kyonna, abaamubudaabuda oba abaamuyigiriza, tebalema kufuna mugabo mu ssaala ze—kubanga omutima omuzzeemu obuggya gwe mutima ogwebaza mu bugonvu—era omuntu tazaaliddwa buggya okuva waggulu bw’atawulira kwebaza eri mikwano gye abanyiikivu ab’oku nsi. Teeka akanyonyi eddembe okuva mu kakomera kaako, kajja kukuyimbira okwebaza nga kafuumuuka mu bbanga! Bwe kityo, bw’oweebwa amaanyi okuggulawo enzigi z’ekkomera ery’emyoyo egisibiddwa, gijja kusasula okufuba kwo okw’okwagala n’okusaba. Nzeemu nti kiri mu buzaaliranwa bw’omukkiriza azaaliddwa obuggya okutandika okwegayiririra abalala, era obuzaaliranwa buno bubeera naye obulamu bwe bwonna. Kye kimu ku bintu by’ateekwa okukola—kimusanyusa okukikola—tekiyinzika nti alekera ddala awo, kubanga Omwoyo abeera mu kifuba kye yeegayiririra abatukuvu ng’okusiima kwa Katonda bwe kuli. Era, abooluganda, nga bwe kiri obuzaaliranwa bw’obutonde obwazaalibwa mu ggulu, bwe kityo era lye tteeka ly’ennyumba y’abalonde. Abatukuvu mu nteekateeka yaabwe entuufu bayinza okwogerwako nti “nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera. Mwekuumenga nga mugumiikirizanga, era nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu.” Buli mukkiriza alina ekifo ky’omukuumi ekimuweereddwa mu nsonga y’okusaba, era kimugwanidde obutasirika, wabula obutamuganya Mukama kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi era ng’agifudde ettendo mu nsi. Ffenna tuli bavunaanyizibwa kyenkanyi okusabira Yerusaalemi emirembe, era okukulaakulana kwaffe kusinziira ku ekyo. Ekiragiro ekiggya Mukama kye yatuwa, mw’atulagira nti, “Mwagalanenga,” kitwetaagisa okusabiragana. Omuntu ayinza atya okugamba nti ayagala muganda we, nga tamwegayiririrangako n’akatono eri Katonda? Nnyinza okubeera bulijjo ne bakkiriza bannange ne ndaba ennaku zaabwe, ne sikaabirira Katonda ku lwabwe? Nnyinza okulaba obwavu bwabwe, okubonaabona kwabwe, okukemebwa kwabwe, n’obuzito bw’emitima gyabwe, kyokka ne mbeerabira mu kwegayirira kwange? Nnyinza okulaba omulimu gwabwe ogw’okukkiriza, n’okufuba okw’okwagala ne sibasabira mukisa? Nnyinza okwezingira mu nze nzekka ne sifaayo ku bizibu by’abo abali baganda bange ne bannyinaze mu Kristo Yesu? Tekiyinzika! Naye bwe mba nsobola, nteekwa okuba nga ndi wa maka malala so si ga Katonda, kubanga mu maka ag’okwagala, okulumirirwa awamu kuleeta okwegayiririragana obutayosa. Katonda atuwonye okwonoona Mukama nga tulekera awo okusabira abooluganda! Buli njuki mu muzinga gw’Ekkanisa erina okuleeta omugabo gwayo ogw’omubisi guno mu tterekero ery’awamu. Nga emirandira gyonna egy’omuti bwe gitambula mu ttaka nga ginoonya emmere, era gyonna ne ginywa ebyetaagisa olw’obulungi bw’omuti gwonna, bwe kityo buli mukkiriza, ng’ayasamya akamwa ak’okusaba, asaanidde okunoonya n’okunywa emikisa egy’omwoyo olw’obulungi bw’Ekkanisa yonna. Kale, abooluganda bange, temwerabiranga buvunaanyizibwa obuwoomu obubateekeddwako olw’oluganda lwammwe n’abatukuvu awamu ne Mukama waabwe atenderezebwa emirembe gyonna. Era nate, abaagalwa, tukimanyi nti waliwo okwegatta okw’obulamu wakati w’abakkiriza, obumu obw’okumpi ennyo. Tetuli abooluganda kyokka, naye tuli bitundu “ku mubiri ogumu.” Kristo ye Mutwe gw’omubiri gwe ogw’ekyama, Ekkanisa, era ffenna tuli bitundu by’omubiri gwe. Kale, nga mu mubiri gw’omuntu buli kitundu, buli kinywa, buli musuwa n’obusimu bwe byetaagisa eri omubiri gwonna, bwe kityo mu Kkanisa buli mukkiriza yeetaagibwa abalala, era naye yeetaaga abalala. Tuyinza obutasobola kulaga kabi ki akandituuse ku mukono olw’okulumizibwa kw’evviivi, naye mukakase nti omukono gwandirumiriddwa wamu nalyo. Tewali katundu kamu konna mu mubiri gwonna kayinza kwonooneka nga tekakoseza mu ngeri emu oba endala omubiri gwonna ogusigaddeyo. Bwe kityo Katonda bw’atufudde abeetaaganye—okusinga ennyo bwe tulowooza. Mu bumu bw’Ekkanisa buli muntu ayamba ku bulamu oba ku bulwadde bw’ekibiina kyonna, era tayinza kukyewala. Tewali n’omu mu Kkanisa ya Katonda abeera omulamu ku bubwe yekka, era tewali n’omu afa ku lulwe. Omukkiriza bw’akula mu kisa, tagaggawala ku lulwe yekka—ekibiina ky’Abakristaayo kyongedde ku bugagga bwakyo obw’omwoyo olw’amagoba ge. Ku luuyi olulala, omuntu bw’aseebengerera mu bintu bya Katonda n’afuuka omwavu era omunafu, okulumizibwa tekumukoma ye yekka, naye Ekkanisa mu kigero ekimu efuuka nnaku, ennafu, era erumiziddwa. Woowe abooluganda, kale nga bwe kiri bwe kityo, ka tutuukirize mu bungi obuvunaanyizibwa bwe tulina eri omubiri gwe tuli ekitundu kyagwo! Era mu mulimu ogusanyusa ogw’okwegayirira, ka tweyongere nnyo nnyo. Okwegayiririra abalala kusaanidde okukubira mu mubiri gwonna ng’omusuwa, ne kuleetera buli kitundu ekiramu okuwulira amaanyi gaakwo amatukuvu. Okwegayiririra abalala kye kimu ku bintu ebitono ennyo bye tuyinza okukola, kyokka kye kimu ku bisinga obunene—tuleme kukugayaalira. Mmemba w’Ekkanisa atasaba kiziyiza—ali mu mubiri ng’eggumba erivunze, oba erinnyo eryonooneka—era mangu ddala, olw’okuba tayamba ku bulungi bwa booluganda, ajja kubafuukira akabi n’ennaku. Abooluganda, ekyo kireme kuba bwe kityo ku muntu yenna mu mmwe! Ate era, abooluganda, singa wabaddewo okwetaaga ensonga ekwata ku mitima gyaffe, tekiri wala kugifuna. Ffe ffennyini tubanja nnyo essaala z’abalala. Abakristaayo bangi basobola okulondoola okukyuka kwabwe okutuuka ku ssaala za maama baabwe ezaalinnya mu ggulu ku lwabwe nga n’ennimi zaabwe ez’obuto tezinnaba kusobola kwatula linnya ly’Omulokozi. Maama yabaleeta eri Yesu n’amwegayirira abateekeko emikono gye abawe omukisa. Bangi ku mmwe mubanja okukyuka kwammwe okwegayirira kw’abasomesa b’essomero lya Ssande, oba okusaba kw’abaweereza, oba Abakristaayo abanyiikivu kinnoomu abaakulemberwa okubegayiririra. Kale, bwe kiba nga mwafuna omukisa mu kkubo ery’okusaba, mulage okwebaza kwammwe nga musabira abalala! Mufube okugabira abalala omukisa mu ngeri y’emu gye mwagufunamu. Nze kennyini, nzeemu ku makya gano nti tewali muntu ayinza kunkolera kisa kya mazima okusinga okunsabira mu nsi muno! Ndowooza, abooluganda, nti essaala gye zikoma okuba ennyingi ku lwange, gye nkoma okuba omugagga mu bugagga obwa nnamaddala, mu kika ky’obugagga obusinga zaabu ne ffeeza. Omupuliitani ow’edda agamba nti omuntu bw’agaggawala mu by’obusuubuzi bwe, ateeka emikono mingi okumukolera, era, bw’agamba, omuntu bw’akula mu kugasa abalala, aleeta emmeeme nnyingi okumusabira, era bw’atyo omulimu gwe ne gutambula. Ekisa kya Katonda gye kikoma okukozesebwa ennyo ku muddu wa Mukama, gy’akoma okwetaaga obuyambi obw’okwegayiririrwa okuva eri baganda be ne bannyina be bonna, alyoke asobole okutambuza omulimu gwe wansi w’omukisa gwa Katonda. Nange nnina obuvunaanyizibwa, abooluganda bange, okubasabira, kubanga mmanyi nti bangi ku mmwe bulijjo mukonkona ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa ku lwange. Kale ensonga eno ngibateekako mmwe—bwe kiba nga mwafuna emikisa olw’okwegayirira kw’abatukuvu, temwandibadde bantu batasiima ddala singa temwegayiririra balala nammwe? Essaala za maama zaakuleeta eri Kristo? Kale, ggwe maama omuto omwagalwa, weegayirire Mukama ku lw’abaana bo abato ab’omuwendo. Okwegayirira kwa kitaawo kwakutuusa ku bulokozi? Kale, ggwe omuvubuka, wanirira kitaawo n’essaala zo ezitayosa era bw’otyo ogaggawaze ennaku ze ez’oluvannyuma. Muweereddwa buwa nammwe muwenga buwa. Ettaka eryagimusibwa omusulo lizzaayo amakungula galyo—nammwe musasule bulungi Ekkanisa eyababeerera omukutu gw’omukisa. Kale, leero tekiri nsonga ya kwerondera ffe oba tunaasabira baganda baffe ne bannyinaffe mu Kristo oba nedda! Abooluganda abaagalwa, temuli balamu eri Katonda—temulina buzaaliranwa bwa bulamu obuggya bwe mutaba mwegayiririra ab’omu nnyumba ey’okukkiriza! Temulina kwagala okuva eri Katonda—akabonero akakakafu ak’okuzaalibwa obuggya—bwe mwerabira okwegayiririra abalala! Mwerabidde ebbanja lye mubanja, era mukola ebitasaanira kwegatta kwammwe n’Ekkanisa ya Kristo kwe mwatula, bwe mulagajjalira okwegayiririra abalala. Ng’omuntu afuuwa ekkondeere, nandyagadde okubeegayirira, abooluganda bange, okusabira n’amaanyi n’obunyiikivu ab’omu maka ga Katonda omulamu. Ka tukyuse ekigambo kyaffe kaakano okuva ku buvunaanyizibwa tudde ku kitiibwa. Nga kitiibwa kinene okukkirizibwa okusabira abatukuvu! Kubanga, mulabe, kino kituleeta mu kussa ekimu okusingayo okuba okw’okumpi ne Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini. Tetuyinza kuyamba mu kuteekateeka kutangirira olw’ekibi ky’omuntu—Omulokozi yagamba nti, “Kiwedde,” era kiwedde ddala. Mu mulimu ogwo tetuyinza kubaamu kussa kimu wabula nga tufuna ebivaamu, kubanga yalinnyirira yekka, nga bw’ayogera nti, “Nva kulinnyirira amawanga nga emizabbibu, tewali n’omu yajja kunnyambako.” Mu kubuulira Enjiri leero, tukola omulimu Mukama waffe Yesu mw’atakyalina mugabo kaakano—Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyamba, naye Omuntu Kristo Yesu ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Kitaffe, era eddoboozi lye teriwulirwa nga lirangirira amawulire amalungi. N’olwekyo, mu ngeri ezimu tulina emirimu egy’enjawulo era tukola obuweereza obwawukana, naye mu mulimu ogw’okwegayiririra abalala tuli bamu—mu kaseera kano kennyini Mukama waffe yeegayirira mu maaso g’entebe ya Katonda, era bwe twegayiririra abantu be tuba tukola kye kimu ddala! Ffe, nga tusabira abatukuvu, tuba n’okussa ekimu okwa ddala kaakano ne Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu, eyeegayirira munda w’eggigi. Nzeemu nate, bwe mbuulira leero, Kristo tabuulira. Naye bwe nsaba, eddoboozi lyange likwatagana n’erirye! Bwe nsabira abooluganda, nzijukira nti ayimiridde mu maaso g’entebe ey’ekitiibwa ng’ayambadde ekyomukifuba, ng’amannya g’abalonde be bonna gamasamasa ku mayinja gaakyo ag’omuwendo. Kale si kintu kya ssanyu okugabana n’Omwana wa Katonda mu buweereza obw’okwegayiririra abalala? Mu buweereza buno atufudde bakabona eri Katonda waffe! Ye Malayika omukulu alina ekyoterezo ekya zaabu, era omukka gw’obubaane bw’awaayo gulinnya wamu n’okusaba kw’abatukuvu mu maaso ga Mukama! Abaagalwa, mwandyagadde okufaanana Mukama Yesu mu buweereza—omukisa guli mu ngalo zammwe—mwegayiririre nnyo abatukuvu! Era nga kitiibwa nnyo nti ffe, abaali gye buvuddeko abasabiriza ku lwaffe ku mulyango gw’Okusaasira, kaakano tukkiriziddwa nnyo mu kisa kya kabaka ne kiba nti tusobola n’okwatula ekigambo mu kutu kwa kabaka ku lw’abalala! Kwali kusaasira kwa Katonda okw’obuyinza okwatukkiriza okugamba nti, “Onsaasire!” Naye kwekkakkanya kwa ngeri ki kuno okututuusizza okumpi bwe kutyo, ne kiba nti kaakano tusobola okujja eri Mukama ne tugamba nti, “Nandyagadde okwogera naawe ekigambo ku lwa muganda wange. Nandyagadde okusaba ebirabo okuva mu mikono gyo, Kitange, ku lwa mwannyinaze eyeetaaga okusaasirwa.” Mulabe, abooluganda, nga bwe mwasitulibwa ennyo—mwalondebwa mu buweereza obw’ekitiibwa obw’“abakoowoola Mukama,” okumubuuza ku bintu ebirungi eby’Endagaano ye! Mwafuulibwa omugabi w’ebirabo bya kabaka ku lwa Kabaka! Abateekera mu maaso eggwanika lye eriggule n’abagamba musabe kye mwagala. Woowe, ekisa ekitagerageranyizika! Bw’oba, ggwe omukkiriza, omanyi okusaba mu kukkiriza, oyinza okugabira baganda bo ne bannyoko obugagga obw’omuwendo okusinga zaabu wa Ofiri, kubanga okwegayiririra abalala kye kisumuluzo ky’embiri ez’amasanga omuli obugagga bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo! Abatukuvu nga beegayiririra abalala batuuka mu kifo bamalayika gye batayinza kuyimirira! Ebitonde ebyo ebitukuvu bisanyukira aboonoonyi abeenenya, naye tetusoma nti bakkirizibwa okwegayiririra abatukuvu. Kyokka ffe, wadde nga tetutuukiridde, tulina ekisa kino! Tukkirizibwa okwasamya akamwa kaffe mu maaso ga Mukama ku lw’abalwadde n’abo abagezesebwa, ku lw’abeeraliikirivu n’abo abaggwaamu amaanyi—nga tuli bakakafu nti buli kye tunaasabanga nga tukkiriza, tunaakiweebwanga. Mu nsonga eno tuweereddwa ekitiibwa kinene. Abooluganda, mukozese ekitiibwa kino! Mmanyi bulungi nti singa Kwini yawa omuntu yenna ku mmwe olukusa okujja mu lubiri, n’okusaba kyonna ky’ayagala ku lwa mikwano gye, temwandisuddewo mukisa ogwo. Mu nnaku zino, omuntu bw’alowooza nti omubaka wa Paalamenti oba omuntu ali mu buyinza amuwuliriza, tatera kusuulawo mukisa gw’okwogerera kizibwe oba mutabani we ayagala ekifo omuli emirimu mitono n’empeera nnyingi. Mu nsi yonna abanoonya ebifo bangi nnyo. Abantu ab’obuyinza, abawulirizibwa ab’obuyinza, bulijjo bapikirizibwa okukozesa ekifo kyabwe mu bantu mu ngeri yonna esoboka. Kyokka nze nteekwa okuyimirira wano ku makya gano ne mbakubiriza, abooluganda abaagalwa, abawulirizibwa Katonda, okukozesa enkizo yammwe ey’omuwendo! Mulina ebisuubizo okuva eri Katonda nti ebyo bye musaba mujja kubiweebwa, era bangi bagamba nti, “Munjogerere eri Kabaka”—mwegendereze obutalwa kuyamba. Mukozese eddembe Omulangira wammwe ly’abawadde, mwegayiririre baganda bammwe ne bannyinammwe! Bwe kiba nga tewali mulala yeetaaga ssaala zammwe, nze nsaba n’omwoyo gwonna ekifo mu zo. “Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga,” bwe yagamba Omutume—kale nze kinsaanira okukyogera n’okusingawo! Nga tuweereza buli lunaku mu bintu ebitukuvu, obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe n’ebyetaago byaffe binene nnyo. Kale temutwerabiranga bwe kinaabanga kibagendedde bulungi. Mwogere ekigambo ekirungi eri Omulangira ku lw’abaddu be, mumusabe atuwe ekisa kye ekisingawo. Tukyuse ekigambo kaakano okuva ku kitiibwa tudde ku bulungi. Okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba kintu kirungi nnyo, kubanga, okusooka, kugasa abo abakukola. Mmanyi nti mwagala, abaagalwa, okubeera ab’omugaso ddala mu Kkanisa ya Katonda. Nsuubira nti tetulina bammemba mu Kkanisa eno abamativu okuba n’amannya gaabwe mu kitabo, n’okujja mu kusinza, ne bawulira nti byonna biwedde nga kino kikoleddwa. Nedda, mwagala okuyamba ddala n’okuleetera Katonda ekitiibwa. Kale, olw’ekigendererwa ekyo mbakubiriza obulungi bw’okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba! Okusooka, abooluganda, kujja kubaleetera okwagala okumanya baganda bammwe ne bannyinammwe. Temuyinza kusabira bulungi abo be mutalina kye mumanyi ku bo. Kale temujja kuyingira n’okufuluma mu kkuŋŋaaniro nga temumanyi muntu atudde kumpi nammwe mu ntebe, naye mujja kubuuza abooluganda bwe bali, era bwe muwulira nti omuntu ali mu buzibu obw’omu mutima, obw’omubiri oba obw’ebintu, mujja kuba beetegefu okukitegeera, mulyoke mumusabire, era bwe mutyo mujja kubeeramu okumanya baganda bammwe nga mubalumirirwa. Pawulo atugamba okumanya abafuba okukola emirimu mu ffe era abatukulembera mu Mukama waffe! Era nandyagadde bammemba b’Ekkanisa bonna bamanye nnyo okulwana kw’omusumba waabwe, ennaku ze n’essanyu lye—balyoke bamulumirirwe nnyo. Era kye kimu ku booluganda abalala—gye mukoma okumanya n’okulumirirwa, gye zikoma okuba ennungi essaala zammwe. Era olw’okuba mujja kwetaaga okumanya, okusobola okwegayiririra abalala, kyenva mpita okwegayiririra abalala omulimu omulungi. Okwegayiririra okw’amaanyi tekulema kuleeta kwagala. Sikkiriza nti oyinza okukyawa omuntu gw’osabira bulijjo. Bw’oba toyagala Mukristaayo yenna, musabire emirundi ebiri—si ku lulwe yekka, naye ne ku lulwo—olyoke owonyezebwe okusalira abalala omusango nga tonnategeera, era olokolebwe okuva mu kuwulira kwonna okutaliimu kisa. Mujjukira olugero olw’edda olw’omusajja eyagenda eri omusumba we okumugamba nti tanyumirwa kubuulira kwe? Omuweereza n’amagezi n’agamba nti, “Muganda wange omwagalwa, nga tetunnaba kwogera ku nsonga eyo, ka tusabe ffembi,” era bwe baamala okusaba bombi, oyo eyeemulugunya n’asanga nga talina kya kwogera, okuggyako okwatula nti ye kennyini abadde mugayaavu nnyo mu kusabira omusumba we. Era n’ateeka obutaganyulwa bwe ku nsonga eyo. Nze okubulwa okwagala kw’oluganda nkussa ku kukendeera kw’okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba. Musabiraganenga n’amaanyi, bulijjo, n’omwoyo ogwaka, era mujja kugatta emitima gyammwe wamu mu kwagala ng’omutima gw’omuntu omu. Eno ye sseminti ey’amabala amalungi mw’erina okuzimbibwamu amayinja g’Ekkanisa bwe gaba ag’okunywerera awamu. Abooluganda abaagalwa, bwe musabiragana, si kulumirirwagana n’okwagala kwokka kwe kunaakula, naye mujja kuba n’endowooza ez’ekisa ku buli omu ku mmwe. Bulijjo tusalira omusango mu kisa abo be twegayiririra. Omuntu ow’olugambo bw’alaga muganda wange ng’omubi ennyo, okwagala kwange kunkakasa nti akyamu. Saamusabidde ku makya gano, kale nnyinza ntya okuwulira ng’asalirwa omusango? Bwe mba nteekwa okukkiriza nti alina omusango, nnakuwala nnyo, naye sijja kumunyiigira—wabula nja kusaba Mukama amusonyiwe era amuzzeewo—nga nange nneegendereza si kulwa nga nange ngwa mu kukemebwa. Tulowooza nti abaana baffe balungi kubanga baffe era balina ekifo mu mutima gwaffe. Era mu ngeri y’emu tuyanguwa okulaba empisa zonna ennungi eziyinza okubeera mu abo be twegayiririra—era twetegefu okuleeta ensonga ezikendeeza ku buzito bw’ensobi z’empisa zaabwe. Okusaba kye kigatta emitima mu ngeri ey’ekitalo, era kitonda okwagala okw’amaanyi. Okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba kugasa nnyo mu kuzimba obwegendereza. Ka tugambe nti ggwe, nga oli mmemba w’Ekkanisa eno, osisinkana abaddirira era n’otuuka ku kunoonya okukomawo kwabwe. Essaala zo olw’okukomawo kwabwe zijja kukuleetera mu buzaaliranwa okusaba nti, “Mukama, nkuuma eri obubi buno. Nkuuma obutaddirira. Nkuuma obutafuuka omunnyogovu era atafaayo ng’abooluganda bano bwe bafuuse.” Bwe tusanga abeeyita Abakristaayo abagudde mu kutamiira, ne tunyiikira okwegayirira Mukama abawonye mu kinnya ekyo eky’entiisa, emmeeme zaffe zireetebwa okukyawa ekibi ekyo n’okukyekuuma nga ziri ku munaala gw’omukuumi. Bwe tulaba nga abooluganda babiri tebakkiriziganya era tebasobola kuleetebwa mu mirembe, bwe tusaba Katonda nti obumu buzzibweewo wakati wabwe, tukulemberwa era okusaba tubeere n’omwoyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu—tuleme kuleeta nkaayana—era nti bwe tuba twali tuleese enkaayana ekiseera kyonna, tubeere beetegefu okwatula ensobi n’okugitereeza. Bwe kityo abo be tusabira n’okweraliikirira bafuuka gye tuli ng’amataala agalabula. Bw’otunuulira abalala n’omwoyo ogw’okunoonya ensobi n’obanenya n’obwagazi, n’ova mu nnyumba emu n’odda mu ndala ng’osaasaanya ekivundu kino n’obunyiikivu, enneeyisa yo etali ntukuvu ejja kuzaala mu ggwe okwetwala ng’omutuukirivu. Naye bw’ogenda eri Mukama ng’onakuwadde olw’ebikolwa byonna ebibi eby’abooluganda, n’onoonya awatali kukoowa okuzzibwawo kw’abo abakyamye, ojja kukuza mu mutima gwo obugonvu n’obwegendereza eri ekibi. Abo abeegayiririra ennyo abalala emirundi mingi bajja kusanga ku mimwa gyabwe essaala nti, “Nkebera, Ayi Katonda, otegeere omutima gwange. Ngezesa omanye ebirowoozo byange. Olabe obanga mu nze mulimu engeri yonna enkyamu; era onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.” Siyinza kulwawo kubabuulira bintu birala ebirungi ebiri mu mulimu guno ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, naye nkakasa nti gwe gumu ku mirimu egisinga obutukuvu, egisinga okuleeta obulamu obulungi, era egisinga okuba egy’omu ggulu, omuntu atya Katonda gy’ayinza okwenyigiramu. Temulowooza, abooluganda abaagalwa, nti singa buli omu ku ffe yalagirwa mu kaseera kano kennyini okunnyonnyola bw’afuddeyo ku mulimu guno omulungi, abasinga obungi ku ffe twandiswadde? Nnyinza okugezaako okubuuza buli Mukristaayo ali wano ekibuuzo kino—owadde Katonda n’Ekkanisa ye omugabo gwo ogusaanidde ogw’okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba? Tetwegayiriridde kusukkiridde, ekyo nkikakasa, kubanga ku munnyo guno kiyinza okwogerwa nti, “omunnyo gwe baliba baagala gwonna.” Tewali muntu asabira munne kusukkiridde! Tusabye ekimala? Mbawa ebbanga era nsiriikiriramu akaseera mulyoke mwebuuze ekibuuzo ekyo. Nja kubawa okuddamu kwange nze. Omutima gwange tegunnenya ku buvunaanyizibwa bwange eri Ekkanisa eno mu nsonga y’okubuulira, kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda kwonna. Singa nnyinza okuyiga okubuulira obulungi okusingawo, nandikikoze n’essanyu. Mmanyi bwe nnemereddwa, naye mbaweerezza n’omutima gwonna era n’obwesigwa mu maaso ga Katonda ku kituuti kino. Naye sisobola kwogera bwe ntyo ku kwegayiririra kwange abalala. Nnina bingi eby’okwatulira Katonda ku bunafu bwange mu nsonga eyo. Era ntya nti bakozi bannange bangi wano bateekwa okukkiriza omusango gwe gumu. Tobulangako ku kibiina kyo eky’okusomesa ku Ssande olweggulo. Bulijjo otuuka ku mulimu gwo mu budde, ng’osomye bulungi essomo ery’Ebyawandiikibwa. Ekyo kirungi, naye, muganda wange omwagalwa, bulijjo osaba essomo eryo liyingire mu mmeeme yo? Mwannyinaze omwagalwa, wafuula empisa okusabira abawala b’olabirira, kinnoomu, n’omwoyo ogwaka ennyo? Sibalumiriza, naye mbasaba mwekebere munda mu myoyo gyammwe, kubanga ensobi eno si ntono, wabula etuleetera ffe n’Ekkanisa okufiirwa kungi. Abakadde n’Abadiikoni b’Ekkanisa eno, temuliiko musango mu nsonga y’okwegayiririra abalala? Abasajja abamu mu ffe bayinza okuba nga tebaliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu nsonga eno, naye ntya nti abasinga obungi ku ffe tufuddeyo ku mirimu emirala okusinga wala nnyo ku guno. Tusabidde mu lwatu mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba, era nsuubira nti tetwerabidde kwegayiririra batukuvu ku kyoto ky’amaka. Naye era, singa twasabira abooluganda emirundi 10 okusingawo, oba n’emirundi 100, tetwandisukkiridde! Oluusi tuyimirira mu lwatu ku mikolo egy’olukuŋŋaana ne tulumiriza Ekkanisa ya Katonda nti eyongera kunnyogoga. Ka twebuuze ekibuuzo kino—Tugyongeddeko ebbugumu olw’essaala zaffe? Twegayiridde olw’okuzzibwa obuggya kwayo? Tunenya Ebibiina by’Abaminsani kubanga ebibala ebirabika bitono nnyo. Tusabira emirimu gy’abaminsani nga bwe tusaanidde? Mpulira okwemulugunya okw’ennaku ku mulembe guno n’ogujja ogw’ababuulizi—twegayiriridde abayizi n’abasumba nga bwe kitugwanidde? Mpulira abantu nga boogera ku Bakristaayo nti ba nsi, ab’okungulu oba ab’amalala. Mubasabidde ne bava mu bwensi bwabwe ne mu malala gaabwe? Tekiyinza kuba nti mwandikoze bulungi nnyo singa mwabasabira okusinga okubanenya? Weewaawo, era ensobi ze mulaba mu bo teziyinza, mu kigero ekinene, kuva ku kulagajjalira kwammwe mmwe mwennyini omulimu ogw’okwegayiririra abalala? Woowe, ka tulekeraawo okwemulugunya n’okwekubira enduulu, okunenya n’okunoonya ensobi, ne tutwala byonna ku entebe ey’okusaasira—kubanga singa ekitundu ky’omukka ogumalibwa obwereere mu kwemulugunya okw’okunenya kyakyusibwa ne kifuuka okwegayiririra abalala—Ekkanisa yandibaddemu obutukuvu bungi nnyo! Kaakano nteekwa okuddayo ku kyawandiikibwa, nga mbawa ekigambo ekirala, era ekyo bwe bugazi. Dawudi agamba mu kyawandiikibwa nti, “Naye nnaasabanga bulijjo,” ng’ategeeza, nga Bayibuli ey’Olungereza bw’ekivvuunula, nti essaala ze zinaabanga ku lwabwe ne mu bizibu byabwe; era amakulu ge gano—singa wabaddewo omu ku batukuvu ba Katonda amunyiiza olw’obwesigwa bwe eri emmeeme ye, yandyeyongedde okumusabira. Abooluganda, tetulina kusabira abo bokka abatusanyusa mu ngeri gye batwogeramu—naye tulina okusabira mu kwagala n’abo abasala ennyo, abakambwe ennyo, abalumya ennyo mu bigambo byabwe. Kiba kitya singa babeera bakambwe nnyo ne banakuwaza emyoyo gyaffe? Kiba kitya singa okunenya kwabwe kulabika nga tekwetaagisa, kwa kabi era kwa butali bwenkanya? Tukyalina obuvunaanyizibwa okubasabira. Dawudi, mu kyawandiikibwa, alabika ng’agamba kino—abatuukirivu ne bwe bandimukoze kyonna kye baagala, yandyeyongedde okubasabira mu bizibu byabwe. Era mbakubiriza, abooluganda bange, bwe wabaawo mmemba yenna mu Kkanisa eno akuyisizza obubi, weesasuze ku ye ng’omwagala emirundi 10 okusinga bwe wali omwagala, era ng’omusabira bulijjo n’obunyiikivu okusingawo! Singa waliwo muganda wo eyabetenta omwoyo gwo n’akulumya ne kiba nti okumulowoozaako kukuleetera obulumi, tofaayo! Eddagala erisinga obulungi eri ekiwundu kwe kugenda eri Katonda mu kusaba n’oyiwa emmeeme yo ku lulwe—saba Mukama amuwe omukisa omunene era amufuule Omukristaayo omulungi okusingawo—amujjuze okwagala kwa Katonda! Era, awo, bw’olimulaba ng’alongoose, ojja kutuuka ku kulowooza nti wakola ensobi mu kusalira omusango bye yayogera, n’otegeera bubi kye yali agenderera okukuyamba, oba ojja kusanga nti ajja kujja gy’oli agambe nti, “Nnali mukyamu, muganda wange.” Oba, bw’ataakyatule mu bigambo, ajja kukikkiriza mu bikolwa bye ng’akulaga ekisa ekisukkiridde. Era, abooluganda, bwe tusanga Omukristaayo munnaffe ali mu kabi, tulina okumusabira emirundi ebiri. Abantu b’ensi baleka bannaabwe bwe bagwa mu buzibu—ng’ekisibo bwe kireka empeewo efumitiddwa. Tuba n’emikwano mingi nga byonna bitambula bulungi. Tuba n’emikwano mitono nnyo ennaku embi bwe zitukka. Naye mu Bakristaayo tekisaanidde kuba bwe kityo! Tusaanidde kuba mikwano gya bwesigwa—tusaanidde okulaga ekisa ekisingawo eri abo abafuuka abaavu okusinga bwe tukiraga abalala. Bwe tusanga Omukristaayo munnaffe afiiriddwa okubudaabudibwa kwe era aggwaamu essuubi—wadde ng’okubeera naye kuyinza obutaba kwa ssanyu nnyo, era n’okutuleetera ffe ennaku—tusaanidde okumusabira ennyo, n’okugezaako okumuggya mu Ntubiro y’Okuggwaamu Essuubi. Okusingira ddala, muganda waffe mu Kristo bw’awaayirizibwa, tuteekwa okuyimirira naye. Bangi bagoberera empisa embi ey’okwewala ddala omuntu aswaziddwa. Omuntu asuulidde olubatu lw’ettosi ku muntu eyeeyita Omukristaayo—ka tumwewale, kubanga ettosi liyinza okutugwako naffe. Bwe batyo bwe boogera abatiitiizi, naye ffe si bwe tukola! Nedda, muganda wange, bw’oba oli mu ggye lya Emmanweri, era muganda waffe ayigganyizibwa takoze kibi, ka tuyimirire oba tugwe wamu naye! Tetulekanga munnaffe mu lutalo! Ensi bw’eneegamba nti, “Mumusuule wansi! Mumusuule wansi! Mumusuule wansi!” tujja kudduka ng’omuzira Omuyonaani ow’edda okumutaasa, ne tukwata engabo yaffe waggulu w’oyo agudde, nga tumulwanirira okutuusa lw’anaasobola okuyimuka—kubanga olunaku lumu naffe tuyinza okugwa, ne twetaaga muganda waffe omuserikale okutubikka okuva eri omulabe. Ka tusabire baganda baffe ne bannyinaffe okuva mu bizibu byabwe, so tetubaleka—era singa essaala eyo ebeera ya kiseera kiwanvu nga tennaddibwamu, ka tugumiikirize mu kwegayirira awatali kukoowa, nga twogera ne Dawudi nti, “Naye nnaasabanga bulijjo”—ne mu bizibu byabwe. Sijja kwongera kwogera ku nsonga eno ey’okwegayiririra abatukuvu, naye nja kugireka mu maaso g’Entebe ey’Olubeerera era mu myoyo gyammwe egy’omunda. Mbeegayiridde, okuggyako nga muli balyamaalyamu eri Kristo—bwe muba muli bitundu by’obumu obw’amazima, bwe muba emyoyo gyammwe gigattiddwa wamu Omwoyo Omutukuvu—mumeggane nnyo mu kusabiragana, so temuleka Malayika w’Endagaano okutuusa ng’omukisa gutuuse ku nnyumba ya Katonda yonna, ne gulyoka gukulukutira mu nsi yonna. II. Kaakano, okwokubiri, omulimu ogw’ekitiibwa ogw’okwegayiririra ABOONOONYI. Ku kino nja kwogera mu bufunze, naye, nsuubira, n’obunyiikivu. Ng’Ekkanisa tulina engule, era tugirina okumala emyaka mingi. Naye nandyagadde okukozesa ebigambo bya Kristo mu kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa. Bw’aba ayogera n’emu ku Kkanisa, agamba nti, “Nnyweza ky’olina waleme kubaawo akutwalako ngule yo.” Kaakano, engule yaffe ng’Ekkanisa ebadde ki? Tebadde bugagga bwaffe, kubanga mu ekyo tetusinga. Tebadde kusoma kwaffe—tetukwewaanirako. Tebadde kusinza kwaffe okulungi mu ndabika, obulungi bw’ennyimba zaffe, oba obuwoomi bw’amaloboozi gaffe. Nedda, tetufaayo ku bintu ng’ebyo, naye twagala obwangu obutaliimu kwerimbalimba. Engule yaffe ebadde kino ekimu—nti bwe wabaddewo Ekkanisa mu Bukristaayo bwonna eyeewaayo okuwangula emyoyo, Ekkanisa eno ekikoze. Obuweereza bwaffe bulijjo bubadde bugenderera kino—okukwakula ebisiki ebyaka mu muliro, okuggya aboonoonyi mu kizikiza okubayingiza mu butangaavu obutenkanika. Era sibakolera kirala okuggyako obwenkanya bwokka, abooluganda bange, bwe ngamba nti ekitundu ekisinga obunene ku Kkanisa eno kiramu ddala mu kuwangula emyoyo. Kisanyusa nnyo omutima gwange okusisinkana ebibinja by’abooluganda eby’enjawulo mu mmwe, abali buli wamu mu kibuga kino nga bakola awatali kwelaga naye n’obuwanguzi okuleeta emyoyo eri Kristo. Nsuubira nti bulijjo kinaabanga bwe kityo. Nnyweza, ggwe Kkanisa, ky’olina waleme kubaawo akutwalako ngule yo! Ka libeere ssanyu lyaffe n’ekitiibwa kyaffe bulijjo nti Katonda atuwa abaana ab’omwoyo, era emyoyo ne gizaalibwa gy’ali. Kaakano twagala okukola kino, era nkakasa nti tukyagala, naye tulina okufaayo ennyo ku kwegayiririra emyoyo gy’abo abatannakyuka. Musooke musabe, kubanga kino kye kisinga obukulu okukola. Ggwe nange tuyinza kukola ki ffekka mu kukyusa omuntu? Tetuyinza kukyusa mutima gwe! Tetuyinza kumussaamu bulamu—kyandibadde kye kimu n’okulowooza okutonda emmeeme munda mu mbiriizi z’okufa! Mulimu gwa Katonda okuzaala emyoyo obuggya. Kale olwo? Bwe mba nga ndi wa kuba kikozesebwa kye mu kukikola, ekikolwa kyange ekisooka kiteekwa kuba kufukamira ne nsaba nti, “Ayi Katonda, kola nange.” Ogenda mu ssomero lyo erya Ssande olweggulo lwa leero, oba ogenda okubuulira ku nguudo. Kale, singa wali osobola okukola omulimu, sandikukubirizza kwonoona budde ng’osaba Katonda akole ky’oyinza okukola wekka! Naye, olw’okuba toyinza n’akatono kuwangula mmeeme n’emu eri Yesu awatali Mwoyo wa Katonda, ekikolwa kyo ekisooka kibeere kusaba nti, “Ayi amaanyi ga Katonda, jjangu onnyambaze! Ayi olulimi lw’omuliro, weebwe gye ndi, era ggwe Empewo entukuvu, ey’amaanyi ennyo ekunta, jjangu ofuuweemu obulamu mu myoyo emifu!” Okusaba kye kintu ekisinga obukulu mu kukyusa aboonoonyi okuva mu bukyamu bw’amakubo gaabwe. Era okwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba kujja kukutegeka okufuuka ekikozesebwa kya Katonda. Bwe nsaba omuntu akyuke, naddala bwe nnonda omuntu omu kinnoomu, omutima gwange gubuguma mu kumwagala nga bwe ndowooza ku mbeera ye n’ekifo ky’alimu mu kusaba. Kale, ekyo kinjigiriza, era kinnyamba okumuwa ekigambo ekituufu bwe ntuuka okumpi naye. Nninga omusawo alongoosa, bw’atuuka ku mulwadde gw’ateekwa okulongoosa n’ekiso, n’amanya ddala buli ggumba we liri n’ekitundu ki ekyalumizibwa. Okusaba kwange kunnaze embeera y’omuntu oyo. Ngyetegerezza era ne ngifumiitirizaako mu kwegayirira kwange, era bwe ntuuka okumukolako mu bikolwa, nja kuba wa magezi, ku bw’Omwoyo wa Katonda, okukola ekituufu era mu ngeri entuufu. Singa twali twagala okusindika omuntu mu ttendekero okumufuula omuyambi omulungi eri emitima egyeraliikirivu, twandimusindise mu ttendekero ery’okusaba okw’engeri zonna, kubanga okwegayiririra abalala kye kkubo ery’okufuuka ow’amagezi mu kuwangula emyoyo! Era, abooluganda, okusaba kujja kubakolako kino—mujja kukola omulimu nga mulina essuubi. Kintu kya ntiisa nnyo okulowooza ku bantu abaziikibwa nga balamu, abateekebwa wansi w’ettaka mikwano gyabwe mu ssanduuko zaabwe nga bakyalimu omukka. Ka twegendereze tuleme kuziika mmeeme nga nnamu—ntya nti tulina empisa ey’okukikola. Tusalawo ku muntu omu nti tagenda kukyuka n’akatono—tugamba nti ono muntu ku ye okufuba kwonna tekuliiko kye kugasa. Tulowooza ku muntu omulala nti yeewaayo nnyo mu bubi ne kiba nti tuyinza okumuleka ne tufaayo ku bantu abalimu essuubi. Mu bino byonna tuli bakyamu, kubanga tetulina buyinza kussa mukono ku kiwandiiko ekisalira emmeeme okufa, oba okugamba ekisa kya Katonda nti, “Wano w’otuuse w’onookoma, tojja kweyongerayo.” Kkiriza nti omuntu ng’akyali mulamu mu nsi muno, ekisa kikyasobola okumutuukako! Musitule mu mikono gyo mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba—era bw’onootandika okumusabira ojja kuwulira nti waliwo essuubi—era oluvannyuma ojja kwogera naye mu ngeri ey’essuubi, era oboolyawo ey’okukkiriza. Sikkiriza nti waliwo omuntu yenna eyali alokoleddwa omulala ng’ayogera naye mu ddoboozi ery’okuggwaamu essuubi, naye eddoboozi eddungi ery’okwagala okulina essuubi lye liwangula. Kkiriza nti omutima omukakanyavu guyinza okumenyebwa, olulimi lw’omuvvoozi ne lulongoosebwa, ebirowoozo by’omuyigganyi ne bikyuka, era nti omujeemu ayinza okugondera Kristo eyakomererwa n’afuuka emmunyeenye eyaka mu ggulu lya Katonda. Abooluganda abaagalwa, mbeegayiridde, kale, olw’okuba amaanyi ga Katonda, era olw’okuba okwegayiririra abalala kujja kubafuula abasaanira okukozesebwa Katonda, era olw’okuba kujja kubawa essuubi lingi ku abo be mukola nabo—mwenyigire mu kwegayiririra abalala mu kusaba okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Guno mulimu mwenna gwe muyinza okuyambamu. Singa nnajja gye muli ku makya gano ne ngamba nti, “Abooluganda, omulimu gwa Mukama gwetaaga ssente,” mmanyi, okuva mu bumanyirivu obw’ebbanga eddene, nti mwandikoze kyonna kye musobola. Naye waliwo abamu abandiwaliriziddwa okuddamu nti, “Ebyetaago by’amaka gange tebinzikiriza kubaako kye nkola mu nsonga eyo.” Naye bwe tusaba okwegayiririra abalala, tewali Mukristaayo ayinza okugamba nti, “Siyinza kwegayirira Katonda.” Singa nnali wa kubakubiriza mu kaseera kano obwetaavu bw’okubuulira okw’olwatu okusingawo, bangi ku bawuliriza bange bandibadde n’ensonga entuufu ey’okwesonyiyisa, kubanga boogera mpola era tebalina kirabo kya kwogera. Naye, Woowe abooluganda, bwe kituuka ku kwegayiririra abalala mwenna musobola okutuukiriza omulimu ogwo! Era nga mukikola, musobola okubeera n’omugabo mu mirimu gyonna eminene egy’Ekkanisa. Nawulira ku mukazi omutukuvu eyali agamba nti, “Siyinza kubuulira, naye nsobola okuyamba omuweereza wange okubuulira olw’essaala zange. N’olwekyo, buli lwe mmulaba ng’alinnya ku kituuti, nja kusaba Katonda awe omukisa ekigambo kye, era bwe ntyo nja kuba n’omugabo ku by’akola.” Bw’owulira ku muminsani akola wonna wonna ebweru w’eggwanga, musabire, era olwo ojja kuba mukozi munne. Abaagalwa, abamu ku mmwe mutera okuba abalwadde, era mu kiro ekikooyesa mwebaka kitono nnyo—mumanyi lwaki Mukama abaleka nga mutunula? Kiri bwe kityo nti, abalala ku ffe nga beebase, mmwe mulyoke mutusabire! Katonda ateekwa okuba n’abantu abakuuma ebiseera eby’ekiro! Asalawo nti abakuumi ab’okusaba bateekebwe okwetooloola Ekkanisa ye emisana n’ekiro—mmwe muli bakuumi ab’ebiseera by’ekiro. Temuyinza kukola kirala kyonna, naye musobola okusaba—era nga musaba musobola okufuna omugabo mu mirimu egisinga ekitiibwa egy’Ekkanisa! Kaakano mwetegereze—Dawudi, mu ngeri etali ya lwatu, atugamba nti abamu ku abo be tusabira bayinza, oboolyawo, obutafaayo ku ssaala zaffe, era bayinza okugwa mu bizibu ebinene olw’ebibi byabwe. Olwo nno kye kiseera kyaffe mwe tusaanidde okweyongera okunyiikira mu kubeegayiririra! Bwe mba nga nnayogera n’omuntu atatya Katonda okumala emyaka mingi, n’asekerera byonna bye nnayogera, olwo nja kumalirira munda yange nti, “Sirikoma kumusabira. Oboolyawo olunaku lumu ndimusanga nga mulwadde, olwo alisaba essaala z’agaana kaakano. Oboolyawo ndimusanga ng’omutima gwe gumenyese, olwo ebigambo by’akudaalira kaakano biriba biwoomu nnyo gy’ali.” Mmwe abanoonya emyoyo, mulina okumanya okweyongera okuyigga—abo abaggwaamu omukka mu kuwangula emyoyo tebalituuka ku buwanguzi. Mubagoberere! Mubagoberere! Mubagoberere okutuuka ku miryango gy’entaana! Bwe batalokoka oluvannyuma lw’emyaka 20 egy’okusaba, mubagoberere okutuuka ku miryango gya Ggeyeena! Bwe bamala okuyita mu miryango egyo, essaala zammwe tezikkirizibwa era tezigasa, naye okutuuka ddala ku mugo gw’Obunnya obw’emagombe mubagoberere—mubagoberere n’essaala zammwe. Bwe batakkiriza kubawuliriza nga mwogera, tebayinza kubaziyiza kusaba. Basekerera okubuulirira kwammwe? Tebayinza kubatawaanya nga musaba, kubanga tebamanyi lwe musaba. Bali wala nnyo ne kiba nti temusobola kubatuukako? Essaala zammwe zisobola okubatuukako! Mukyasobola okubasabira omukisa. Balangiridde nti tebaliddamu kubawuliriza wadde okulaba amaaso gammwe? Temufaayo, Katonda alina eddoboozi lye bateekwa okuwulira—mwogere naye, era ajja kubaleetera okuwulira. Wadde nga kaakano babayisa bubi, nga babasasula obubi olw’obulungi bwammwe, mubagoberere, mubagoberere, mubagoberere n’essaala zammwe! Temubaleka kuzikirira olw’okubulwa okwegayirira kwammwe. Ekiseera kiyinza okutuuka abo abaalwawo ennyo okuwaayo emitima gyabwe eri Kristo lwe banaatusasula emirundi lukumi olw’okufuba kwonna n’okwegayirira kwe tuyinza okuteekamu. Oluusi ndabye omwonoonyi omukulu, bw’alokolebwa, n’afuuka ow’omugaso ng’abakkiriza abaakakyuka aba bulijjo 20, kubanga nga bwe yali omuzibu okuwangula, bw’atyo n’afuuka ow’omugaso bwe yawangulwa. Tetusuubira nti buli lunaku tujja kufuna ba Sawulo nga bafuulibwa ba Pawulo, naye bwe kiba bwe kityo, olwo Ekkanisa efuna obugagga bungi ddala, kubanga Pawulo omu asinga omuwendo abakkiriza aba bulijjo lukumi! Amaluulu gano ag’omu buziba bw’ennyanja ga muwendo. Abazibu bano bayinza okufuuka ba Pawulo—n’olwekyo mubeere beetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu—nga mubasabira okutuusa lwe baleetebwa eri Kristo. Ekintu kimu kye njagala ku makya gano kwe kuba nti abooluganda bange abaagalwa mu Kristo beeyame okweyongera okusaba awatali kukoowa ku lw’aboonoonyi abatwetoolodde. Nga Ibulayimu, ekibuga ekinene kiri mu maaso gaffe—ka tukyegayiririre! Nga Musa, tubeera mu bantu aboonoonyi—ka tuyimirire mu kituli ku lwabwe. Ndagira buli mmemba w’Ekkanisa eno, olw’obwesigwa bwe eri Katonda, bw’aba ddala nga si mulimba mu kwatula kw’akoze, okusabira awatali kukoowa abatatya Katonda balyoke baleetebwe eri Yesu! Mwegayirire Yakuwa! Mwegayirire—ayagala essaala zammwe—okwegayiririra kwammwe kuli ng’obubaane obuwoomu ku kyoto ekya zaabu. Mumwegayirire era mulyoke mulabe empeera y’okwegayirira kwammwe mu kukyuka kw’abaana b’abantu! Mugende eka mufuule abaana bammwe ensonga enkulu ey’okukaaba kwammwe olweggulo lwa leero. Mwegayirire Mukama alokole babbammwe oba bakyala bammwe, ab’enganda zammwe ne baliraanwa bammwe ab’okumpi. Mwegayirire omukisa ku abo abatuula mu ntebe n’abawuliriza ab’ekibiina kino abatannazaalibwa buggya! Olwo mutwale enguudo zammwe, mutwale ekitundu mwe mubeera, mwegayirire Katonda abakyalire n’ekisa—temulibulwa bantu ba kusabira—n’olwekyo mweyongere mu kwegayirira. Ennaku si nnyingi emabega nalaba abaami bana abaali bakyuse ne badda eri Katonda, naye bakyala baabwe nga basigadde bweru w’Ekkanisa. Era abooluganda abo abana, oboolyawo bonna bali wano ku makya gano, baakuŋŋaana wamu okusabira bakyala baabwe bakyuke—era ku Ssande esooka ey’Ekyeggulo kya Mukama omwezi oguwedde, abakyala abana ne baleetebwa mu Kkanisa nga kye kiddamu eri essaala z’abaami abana! Buli kintu kisoboka! Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza! Katonda atuyambe okukkiriza n’okwegayiririra abalala, era alyoke atuwe omukisa gwe, ku lwa Kristo. Amiina.

fields.title: Amaanyi g’okusaba n’essanyu ery’okutendereza
fields.body_html:
“Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira, bangi balyoke batwebalizeeko olw’ekirabo kye twaweebwa. Tulina okwenyumiriza ng’omwoyo gwaffe gutujulira kubanga twatambulira mu buwombeefu ne mu mazima ga Katonda, so si mu magezi ag’omubiri, naye mu kisa kya Katonda nga tuli mu nsi n’okusingira ddala gye muli.” 2 Abakkolinso 1:11,12.

OMUTUME Pawulo yali awonyeziddwa Katonda mu ngeri ez’ekitalo okuva mu kabi akaali kamutuukiridde mu Asiya. Mu kajagalalo akanene mu Efeso, Demeteriyo ne banne abaakolanga obusabo bwe baamusasamaliza ekibiina ekinene, kubanga baalaba ng’omulimu gwabwe guli mu kabi, obulamu bwa Pawulo bwali mu kabi kanene nnyo. Kyeyava awandiika nti, “Okubonaabona kwe twayitamu mu Asiya kwali kungi ekiyitiridde n’essuubi ery’okuba abalamu ne lituggwaamu.” Omutume okukuumibwa kwe okw’ekitalo akuwa Katonda yekka. Era bwe yali ng’alowooza ne ku lunaku lwe baamukuba amayinja ne bamuleka nga balowooza nti afudde, kyali kisaanira nnyo okwebaza kwe okwogera ku “Katonda azuukiza abafu.”

Ate era, Omutume akuba ensonga nti okuva Katonda bwe yali amuwonyezza bw’atyo mu biseera ebyayita, era ng’akyali mubeezi we mu kiseera kino, yandibadde naye ne mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Pawulo mukugu mu kubala kwonna—okukkiriza kwe bulijjo kwali ng’ekitabo ekibalirirwamu amangu—era wano tumusanga ng’abalirira ng’akozesa Etteeka ly’Essatu ery’Omukkiriza. Akuba ensonga okuva ku byayita okutuuka ku biriwo, n’okuva ku biriwo okutuuka ku bigenda okujja. Olunyiriri olukulembera ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kyakulabirako ekirabika obulungi eky’okutuuka ku kusalawo okubudaabuda ng’okozesa Etteeka ly’Essatu—“Eyatuwonya mu kufa okwo okw’entiisa, era anaatulokolanga, era gwe tulinamu essuubi ery’okutuwonyanga.”

Okuva Katonda waffe bw’ali “nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw’ali era bw’aliba emirembe n’emirembe,” okwagala kwe mu biseera ebyayita kwe kukakasa okutasobola kusobya okw’ekisa kye leero, era kwe kakalu akakakafu ennyo ak’obwesigwa bwe enkya. Embeera zaffe ne bwe ziba ziri zitya, ekkubo lyaffe ne bwe liba nga litabuse litya, n’eggulu lyaffe ne bwe liba nga likutte ekizikiza kitya, bwe tukuba ensonga mu ngeri eya, “Yakola, Akola, Alikola,” okubudaabudibwa kwaffe tekuyinza kuzikirizibwa n’akatono. Kale mugume omwoyo, mmwe ezzadde lya Isirayiri ababonyaabonyezebwa. Singa mubadde n’oyo Katonda akyukakyuka, emmeeme zammwe zandijjudde obukaawu—naye kubanga ye “nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw’ali era bw’aliba emirembe n’emirembe,” buli kweyoleka kw’ekisa kye okuddiŋŋanwa kwandibafuukidde ekyangu okumwesigamako. Buli kulaba okuggya okw’obwesigwa bwe kwandinywezezza obwesige bwammwe mu kisa kye. Omwoyo ow’omukisa ennyo atuyigirize okukula mu bwesige obutukuvu mu Mukama waffe omwesigwa bulijjo.

Newaakubadde ng’Omutume waffe bw’atyo yakkiriza omukono gwa Katonda, era omukono gwa Katonda gwokka, mu kuwonyezebwa kwe, kyokka teyali musirusiru nnyo okwegaana oba okunyooma ensonga ez’okubiri. Wabula, ng’amaze okusooka okutendereza Katonda azaamu bonna amaanyi, kaakano ajjukira n’okwebaza okusaba okw’amaanyi okw’abantu abangi abaamwagala abaamwegayiririranga. Okwebaza Katonda tekusaanidde kufuuka nsonga ya butasiima bantu. Kituufu nti Yakuwa ye yakuuma Omutume w’Abaamawanga, naye yakikola ng’addamu okusaba. Ekibya ekirondemu tekyamenyebwa muggo gw’abakozi b’ebibi, kubanga omukono gwa Katonda w’Eggulu ogwagoloddwa gwe gwali obukuumi bwe—naye omukono ogwo gwagolobwa kubanga abantu b’e Kkolinso, n’abatukuvu ba Katonda wonna wonna, baali bawangudde ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa olw’okwegayirira kwabwe okw’awamu.

Okwegayirira okwo okwawangula kwogerwako n’okwebaza mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe, “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira,” era ayagala abooluganda kaakano begatte ku kutendereza kwe, “bangi balyoke batwebalizeeko olw’ekirabo kye twaweebwa.” Ayongerako nti alina ky’abanja ku kwagala kwabwe kubanga teyali ng’abamu abataali beesigwa mu bye baakwasibwa, wabula omwoyo gwe gwali mulongoofu nti yali abuulidde Ekigambo mu bwesimbu era mu mazima.

Bwe tunaaba twogera ku nsonga zino, Omwoyo afuka amafuta akke kaakano azifuule ez’omugaso gye tuli. Tujja, okusooka, okukkiriza amaanyi g’okusaba okw’awamu. Ekyokubiri, okubakubiriza okutendereza awamu. Ate ekyokusatu, okubanjulira ekyo kye tubabanja mu ssanyu—ekitali kyaffe ffekka, wabula ekya baweereza ba Katonda bonna abateganira emmeeme mu mazima.

I. Okusooka, kale, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, gwe mulimu gwange era gwe mukisa gwange ku makya gano OKUKKIRIZA AMAANYI G’OKUSABA OKW’AWAMU.

Kyasanyusa Katonda okufuula okusaba omugga ogujjudde era ogw’essanyu, ebisa byaffe ebisinga obulungi mwe bisinga okutukulukutira. Kye kisumuluzo ekya zaabu ekisumulula ebyagi ebijjudde ebya Yusufu waffe ow’omu ggulu. Kiwandiikiddwa ku buli kisa ky’Endagaano nti, “Nate ndiwuliriza ennyumba ya Isirayiri ne mbakolera kino.” Waliwo ebisa ebijja nga tebinoonyezeddwa, kubanga Katonda agamba nti Neeraga abo abaali tebannoonya. Naye waliwo ebirabo ebirala ebiweebwa abo bokka abasaba, kale ne baweebwa—abanoonya, kale ne bazuula—abakonkona, kale ne baggulirwawo.

Lwaki Katonda yasiima okutulagira okusaba n’akatono, tekizibu kukizuula, kubanga okusaba kugulumiza Katonda, nga kuteeka omuntu mu mbeera ey’okusinza esinga obwetoowaze. Ekitonde nga kisaba kikkiriza Omutonzi waakyo n’okumutya, era kimwatula nti y’agaba buli kirabo ekirungi ekituukiridde. Amaaso gayimusibwa okulaba Ekitiibwa kya Mukama, so ng’amaviivi gafukamidde ku ttaka mu bwetoowaze obw’obunafu obukkiriziddwa. Newaakubadde okusaba si y’engeri esinga obugulumivu ey’okusinza—kubanga singa kwe kwali, abatukuvu mu ggulu bandikugenzeemu mu maaso—kyokka kwe kusinga obwetoowaze, era bwe kutyo kwe kusinga okusaanira, okulaga Ekitiibwa ky’Oyo Atuukiridde nga bwe kirabibwa omubiri n’omusaayi ebitatuukiridde.

Okuva ku “Kitaffe,” mwe twewanira oluganda lwaffe naye, okutuuka ku, “obwakabaka n’amaanyi n’ekitiibwa,” bye tuwa Katonda omu yekka ow’amazima, buli sentensi ey’okusaba eweesa Oyo Asingayo Obukulu ekitiibwa. Okusinda n’amaziga g’abeegayirizi abeetoowaze bisiimibwa ddala nga bwe kiri ku, “Mutukuvu, mutukuvu, mutukuvu,” okutaggwaawo okwa bakerubi ne basseraafi. Kubanga mu butonde bwakwo ddala, buli kwatula okw’amazima okw’ensobi z’omuntu kwe kuwa ekitiibwa obutuukirivu obutakoma obwa Mukama ow’Eggye. Mukama aweebwa ekitiibwa kingi olw’okusaba kwaffe okusinga omukka ogutakoma ogw’obubaane obutukuvu obw’oku kyoto ekyali mu maaso g’eggigi.

Ate era, ekikolwa eky’okusaba kituyigiriza obutasaana bwaffe, ogwo nga mukisa ogutali mutono eri ebitonde eby’amalala nga ffe. Singa Katonda yatuwa ebirabo nga tatuwalirizza kubisaba, tetwandimanyi bwe tuli abaavu. Naye okusaba okw’amazima lwe lukalala lw’ebyetaago, ekitabo ky’ebibulwa, okuwoza kw’omwavu atalina kantu, okwanika ebiwundu eby’ekyama, okubikkula obwavu obukwekeddwa. Ng’akyali kusaba eri obugagga bwa Katonda, era kwe kwatula obwereere bw’omuntu. Nzikiriza nti embeera esinga obulamu eri Omukristaayo kwe kubeera bulijjo nga tolina kantu—era ng’oyesigama bulijjo ku Mukama okukuwa by’ojula. Okubeera bulijjo omwavu mu ggwe wennyini ate omugagga mu Yesu—omunafu ng’amazzi ku lulwo—naye nga oli wa maanyi mu Katonda okukola ebikolwa ebinene. Era eyo y’ensonga lwaki okusaba kwa mugaso—kubanga nga bwe kusinza Katonda, kuteeka ekitonde we kisaanidde okubeera—mu nfuufu ddala.

Okusaba ku kwokka, nga tolowoozezza ku kuddibwamu kwe kuleeta, mugaso munene eri Omukristaayo. Ng’omuddusi bw’afuna amaanyi ag’empaka mu kwegezaamu buli lunaku, bwe tutyo naffe, ku lw’empaka ennene ez’obulamu, tufuna amaanyi okuyita mu mulimu omutukuvu ogw’okusaba. Okusaba kuweesa ebiwaawaatiro by’empungu ento eza Katonda ebyoya, zisobole okuyiga okutumbiira waggulu w’ebire. Okusaba kusiba ebiwato by’abalwanyi ba Katonda ne kubasindika mu lutalo ng’emisuwa gyabwe gigumu era ng’ebinywa byabwe binywevu. Omwegayirizi omunyiikivu ava mu kisenge kye eky’ekyama, ng’enjuba bw’evaayo mu bisenge eby’ebuvanjuba, ng’omuddusi asinga bonna bw’ajjula essanyu ng’agenda mu mpaka.

Okusaba gwe mukono gwa Musa ogwayimusibwa ogwawangula Abamaleki okusinga ekitala kya Yoswa. Kwe kasaale akalasibwa okuva mu kisenge kya nnabbi, nga kalanga okuwangulwa kw’Abasuuli. Kiki bwe nnaagamba nti okusaba kwambaza Omukkiriza engeri za Katonda, kusiba obunafu bw’omuntu n’amaanyi ga Katonda, kufuula obusirusiru bw’omuntu amagezi ag’omu ggulu, era kuwa abantu abafa abali mu buzibu emirembe gya Katonda atafa? Ssimanyi ekyo okusaba kye kutasobola kukola! Nkwebaza, ai Katonda omukulu, olw’entebe ey’okusaasira, ekirabo eky’omuwendo ekiva mu kisa kyo eky’ekitalo eky’okwagala. Tuyambe okugikozesa obulungi!

Ng’ebisa bingi bwe bituleetebwa okuva mu ggulu mu lyato ly’okusaba, bwe kityo waliwo ebirabo bingi eby’omuwendo era eby’enjawulo ebiyinza okutuleetebwa ebibinja by’amaato eby’okusaba okw’awamu byokka. Bingi ebirungi Katonda by’awa ba Eriya be ne ba Danyeri be abali bokka, naye bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, tewali kkomo ku kuddibwamu kwa Katonda okw’obugabi. Peetero oboolyawo teyandiggyiddwa mu kkomera singa Ekkanisa yonna teyanyiikira nnyo kumusabira eri Katonda obutakoma. Pentekoote oboolyawo teyandituuse singa abayigirizwa bonna tebaali, “bakuŋŋaanidde mu kisenge kimu,” nga balindirira okukka kw’ennimi ez’omuliro. Katonda asiima okuwa omwegayirizi omu ebisa bingi, naye oluusi alabika ng’agamba nti, “Mwenna mujje mu maaso gange mwegayirire ekisa kyange, kubanga temugenda kulaba maaso gange, okuggyako nga ne bato bammwe, abooluganda, bali nammwe.”

Lwaki kiri bwe kityo, mikwano gyange abaagalwa? Ndowooza nti mu ngeri eyo Mukama waffe ow’ekisa alaga bw’assaayo omwoyo ku kussa ekimu kw’abatukuvu. “Nzikiriza okussa ekimu kw’abatukuvu” kye kimu ku bitundu by’Okukkiriza okukulu okw’Ekikristaayo, naye nga batono nnyo abakitegeera! Ai, waliwo ddala obumu obw’amazima mu bantu ba Katonda. Tuyinza okuyitibwa amannya ag’enjawulo—

“Naye abaweereza bonna aba Kabaka waffe Mu ggulu ne ku nsi bali kimu.”

Tetuyinza kwerekereza buyambi n’okwagala kw’abooluganda. Augustine agamba nti, “Abaavu baatondebwa ku lw’abagagga, n’abagagga baatondebwa ku lw’abaavu.” Sibuusabuusa nti abatukuvu ab’amaanyi baatondebwa ku lw’abatukuvu abanafu, era nti abatukuvu abanafu baleetera abakuze emikisa egy’enjawulo. Waliwo okutuukagana mu mubiri gwonna—buli nnyingo erina ky’ebanjibwa endala zonna—era omubiri gwonna gugattirwa obulungi awamu, ne guyungibwa mu buli nnyingo olw’ekyo buli nnyingo ky’ewaayo. Waliwo ebitundu ebimu ebitono munda mu mubiri gw’omuntu omukugu mu by’omubiri by’atannategeera bulungi. Ayinza okwogera ku kibumba, okugeza, nti kivaamu amazzi ag’omugaso ennyo mu nkola y’omubiri. Naye waliwo amazzi amalala ag’omubiri omugaso gwago ogwennyini gw’atasobola kuzuula. Kyokka, awatali kubuusabuusa, singa ekitundu ekyo kiggyibwamu, omubiri gwonna guyinza okubonaabona ennyo.

Era bwe kityo, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, wayinza okubaawo Abakkiriza abamu be tuyinza okwogerako nti, “Ssimanyi mugaso gwabwe. Siyinza kumanya kirungi Omukristaayo oyo ky’akola.” Kyokka singa ekitundu ekyo ekitali kikulu, era ekirabika ng’ekitaliimu mugaso, kiggyibwawo, omubiri gwonna guyinza okubonaabona, ennyingo zonna ziyinza okulwala, n’omutima gwonna ne guzirika. Eno oboolyawo y’ensonga lwaki ebirabo bingi ebizito eby’okwagala kw’eggulu biweebwa kwegayirira okw’awamu kwokka—tulyoke tulabe omugaso gw’omubiri gwonna, era tuwalirizibwe okukkiriza obumu obw’amazima obw’obulamu Ekisa kya Katonda bwe kyakola—era bwe kikuuma buli lunaku mu bantu ba Katonda. Si kirowoozo kya ssanyu, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti n’omwavu ennyo era atamanyiddwa mu bammemba b’Ekkanisa ayinza okwongera ku maanyi g’omubiri?

Ffenna tetuyinza kubuulira. Ffenna tetuyinza kufuga. Ffenna tetuyinza kuwaayo zaabu ne ffeeza—naye ffenna tuyinza okuwaayo okusaba kwaffe. Tewali mukyufu, ne bw’aba wa nnaku bbiri oba ssatu zokka mu Kisa kya Katonda, atayinza kusaba. Tewali mwannyinaffe mu Yesu agalamidde ku kitanda olw’obulwadde atayinza kusaba. Tewali Mukkiriza mulwadde, mukadde, munafu, atamanyiddwa, atamanyi kusoma, oba atalina wadde ssente atayinza kwongera kwegayirira kwe ku ttereka ery’awamu. Buno bwe bugagga bw’Ekkanisa. Tuteeka obusanduuko ku mulyango tulyoke tufune ebirabo byammwe eby’omulimu gwa Katonda—mujjukire nti waliwo essanduuko ey’omwoyo munda mu Kkanisa mwe tusaanidde ffenna okuteeka okwegayiririra abalala kwaffe okw’okwagala, nga mu ggwanika lya Mukama. Ne nnamwandu atalina wadde obutundu bwe obubiri ayinza okuwaayo ekirabo kye mu ggwanika lino. Kale mulabe, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, obumu n’okussa ekimu ebiri mu bantu ba Katonda, okuva bwe waliwo ebisa ebimu ebiweebwa abatukuvu nga basaba wamu kyokka.

Nga tusaanidde okuwulira omukwano guno ogw’obumu! Nga tusaanidde okusabiragana! Buli Kkanisa lw’ekuŋŋaana okwegayirira, nga ffenna tusaanidde okukifuula omulimu gwaffe ogututeekeddwako okubeerawo! Nandyagadde abamu ku mmwe abatabeera mu Lukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba olw’ensonga entono yonna, balowooze nga bwe batunyaga ffenna. Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba nteekateeka ey’omuwendo ennyo, eweereza amaanyi enkuŋŋaana endala zonna n’emirimu emirala. Tewali bangi ku mmwe abayinza, nga mukendeezaako katono ku budde bwammwe ne munyiikira mu mirimu gyammwe, okujja gye tuli emirundi egisingako? Era kiki singa mufiirwa omuguzi lumu na lumu, temulowooza nti okufiirwa okwo kwandibaliyiriddwa obulungi olw’amagoba ge mufuna ennaku endala? Oba bwe kitaba bwe kityo, amagoba ag’omwoyo tegandisinze nnyo okufiirwa kwonna okutono okw’ensi? “Tuleme kulekayo kukuŋŋaana, ng’abamu bwe bakola.”

Kaakano tweteeseteese okwongera okwetegereza ekirala. Okusaba kuno okw’awamu kusaanidde okukolebwa naddala ku lw’abaweereza ba Katonda. Gye bali, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, okusaba kuno okw’olukale kwe kugendererwa. Pawulo akusaba—“Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Era abaweereza ba Katonda bonna okutuusa ku biseera ebisembayo baliyatula bulijjo nti eno ye nsulo ey’ekyama ey’amaanyi gaabwe. Okusaba kw’abantu kuteekwa okuba amaanyi g’abaweereza. Nnaagezaako okubalaga lwaki omuweereza, okusinga omuntu omulala yenna mu Kkanisa, yeetaaga okusaba okw’amaanyi okw’abantu? Ekifo kye si kye kisinga okuba eky’akabi? Ekiragiro kya Setaani eri eggye lya Ggeyeena kiri nti, “Temulwanagana na muntu yenna, kabe mutono oba mukulu, wabula abaweereza ba Katonda bokka.” Amanyi nti bw’anaasobola omulundi gumu okufumita omutima gw’omu ku bano, wajja kubaawo okutabukatabuka okw’awamu. Kubanga bwe balaba omuzira waabwe ng’afudde, abantu badduka.

Okulwana kusinga okuba okw’amaanyi okwetooloola oyo akutte bendera. Eyo embazzi z’olutalo gye zivugira ku nkuufiira z’ebyuma. Eyo obusaale gye bukoonera ku byambalo by’olutalo, kubanga omulabe amanyi nti bw’anaasobola okusuula bendera, oba okwasa omutwe gw’oyo agikutte, ajja kukuba ekikonde ekizito n’aleeta okuggwamu amaanyi okw’amaanyi. Kale mutwetooloole, mmwe abasajja abalina eby’okulwanyisa! Mmwe abalwanyi ab’omusaalaba omumyufu, mukuŋŋaane mutulwanirire, kubanga olutalo lweyongedde okubuguma! Tubeegayirira, bwe mutulonda okuba mu buweereza, muyimirire nga munywevu ku mabbali gaffe mu ntalo zaffe eza buli ssaawa. Nalaba bwe nnali nkomawo okuva e Rotterdam, bwe twali tusomoka omusenyu ku mumwa gw’omugga Maas, eyo amazzi gye gaali amatono era n’empewo nga mbi, ne kiba nti okutambuza eryato kwali kwa kabi nnyo, nti ekiragiro kyafulumizibwa—“Abakozi bonna waggulu ku lyato!”

Bwe ntyo ndowooza nti obulamu bw’omuweereza buli mu kabi nnyo, ne kiba nti nsaanidde okukaaba nti, “Abakozi bonna waggulu ku lyato”—buli muntu asabe! N’omutukuvu asinga obunafu anyiikire okwegayirira. Omuweereza, ng’ayimiridde mu kifo eky’akabi bwe kityo, ate era alina obuvunaanyizibwa obuzito obumuteekeddwako. Buli muntu asaanidde okuba mukuumi wa muganda we mu kigera ekimu, naye zisanze abakuumi ba Katonda bwe batabeera beesigwa, kubanga omusaayi gw’emmeeme gulivunaanibwa bo. Ku mulyango gwabwe Katonda gy’alissa okuzikirira kw’abantu bwe bataabuulire Njiri mu bujjuvu era n’obwesigwa.

Waliwo ebiseera omugugu guno ogwa Mukama lwe guzitoowerera abaweereza ba Katonda okutuusa lwe bakaaba olw’obulumi, ng’emitima gyabwe gyagala okwabika olw’ennaku. Nalaba kapiteeni, bwe twali tusomoka omusenyu ogwo, ng’asuula ye yennyini ekyuma ekipima obuziba mu nnyanja. Era omuntu omu bwe yamubuuza lwaki taleka bagoba b’eryato kukikola, n’agamba nti, “Mu kifo kino, kaakano kennyini, siyinza kwesiga muntu yenna okuggyako nze nzekka okusuula ekipima, kubanga wakati w’eryato lyaffe ne wansi w’ennyanja tewali yinsi mukaaga.” Era, ddala, twawulira eryato nga likwata wansi omulundi gumu oba ebiri, ekintu ekitaali kisanyusa n’akatono. Bwe kityo bwe kirijja eri buli mubuulizi w’Enjiri—bw’aba nga bw’asaanidde okuba— ebiseera lw’aliba mu kweraliikirira okw’amaanyi ku lw’abamuwuliriza. Taasobole kutuukiriza mulimu gwe ng’ayita mu muntu omulala, naye ateekwa yennyini okuteganira abantu—nga teyeesiga na ye yennyini kubuulira—naye ng’akoowoola Katonda we amuyambe kubanga kaakano omugugu gw’emmeeme z’abantu gumuzitoowerera.

Ai, mutusabire nnyo! Katonda bw’atubawa, era nammwe ne mukkiriza ekirabo n’essanyu, temunyooma Katonda naffe bwe mutyo ne mutuleka nga tetulina kantu era nga tuli baavu olw’okusaba kwammwe kwe mutatuwa. Ate era, okukuumibwa kw’omuweereza kye kimu ku bintu ebikulu ennyo eri Ekkanisa. Muyinza okufiirwa omugoba w’eryato omu, era ekyo kibi nnyo, gy’ali ne gye muli. Naye omulungamya w’eryato bw’agwa mu nnyanja, oba kapiteeni bw’akubibwa endwadde, oba oyo akyusa eryato bw’akuulibwa amayengo n’ava ku nnamuziga, olwo eryato lyandikoze ki? Noolwekyo, newaakubadde okusaba kusaanidde okuweebwayo ku lwa buli muntu omulala mu Kkanisa, naye ku lw’omuweereza kwe kusaanidde okuweebwayo okusooka era okusinga byonna, olw’ekifo ky’alimu.

Era nga bingi bye basaba gy’ali okusinga bye babasaba mmwe! Bwe muba nga mulina okuteekateeka emmeeza ey’ekyama ey’okuyigiriza omuntu kinnoomu, ye, mu ngeri emu, alina okuteekateeka emmeeza ey’olukale, embaga ey’ebintu ebirungi eri buli ajja. Era alikikola atya okuggyako nga Mukama we amuwa eby’okulya ebingi? Mmwe mulina okwaka ng’ettaala mu nnyumba—omuweereza ateekwa okuba ng’ekigulumu ky’ettaala ekiraga amaato ekkubo—okulabibwa ewala ennyo ku nnyanja. Era anaayaka atya ekiro kyonna okuggyako nga Mukama we amulongoosa, era n’aweebwa amafuta amaggya okuva mu ggulu? Obuyinza bwe bubuna okusinga obwammwe—bwe buba obw’ebibi, aliba ng’omuti gwa upas ogutta, ng’amatabi gaagwo agagaziye gaweta obutwa buli ali wansi w’ekisiikirize kyagwo. Naye Katonda bw’amufuula emmunyeenye mu mukono gwe ogwa ddyo, ekitangaala kye kirisanyusa n’obuyinza bwakyo obw’ekisa amawanga gonna, n’emirembe gyonna egy’ebiseera. Bwe wabaawo amazima gonna mu bino byonna, mbeegayirira, mutuwe n’omutima omugabi era bulijjo obuyambi bw’okusaba kwammwe.

Nzuula nti mu lulimi olwasooka, ekigambo ekivvuunulwa, “okukolera awamu,” kitegeeza OMULIMU ogw’amaanyi ennyo. Okusaba kw’abantu abamu tekuliimu mulimu. Naye okusaba kwokka okuwangula eri Katonda kwe kusaba okw’omukozi ow’amazima—omwegayirizi, nga Samusooni, bw’anyeenya enzigi za wankaaki w’Okusaasira, n’ateganira okuzisimbula okusinga okugaanibwa okuyingira. Tetwetaaga kusaba kwa ku nsonda za ngalo, okukwata obukwasi ku mugugu—twetaaga okusaba okw’ebibegaabega—okusitula omugugu ogw’obunyiikivu, era okutayinza kugaanibwa kye kwegomba. Tetwetaaga kukonkona kwa bugonvu okw’abakonkona ne badduka ku mulyango gw’okusaasira, abeeyita abakkiriza kwe bakonkona nga beeraga mu Nkuŋŋaana z’Okusaba. Tusaba okukonkona kw’omuntu amaliridde okufuna, era amaliridde okusigala ku mulyango gw’Okusaasira okutuusa lwe gunaggulwawo, ebyetaago bye byonna ne bimalirizibwa.

Amaanyi n’obukambwe bw’obunyiikivu obw’omuntu atayinza kugaanibwa, naye amaliridde okuwamba Eggulu ng’alirumba okutuusa lw’afuna omutima gwe kye gwegomba—okwo kwe kusaba abaweereza kwe beegomba okuva mu bantu baabwe. Kigambibwa nti Melancthon yafuna okubudaabudibwa kungi bwe yategeezebwa nti abalusi b’engoye abamu abaavu, abakazi n’abaana, baali bakuŋŋaanye okusabira Okulongoosa Ekkanisa. Yee, Melancthon—waaliwo ensonga ennywevu ey’okubudaabudibwa wano. Mukakase nti tekyali Luther yekka, wabula enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu abaavu abaayimbanga zabbuli nga balima mu nnimiro, n’ebikumi by’abaddu n’abazaana abaawangayo okwegayirira, abaafuula Okulongoosa Ekkanisa kye kyali.

Tubuulirwa ku Paulus Phagius, omuyivu omumanyifu ow’Olwebbulaniya, eyali ow’omugaso ennyo mu kuleeta Okulongoosa Ekkanisa mu nsi eno, nti kimu ku bye yasabanga emirundi mingi abayizi be abato kwali nti bagende mu maaso n’okusaba, Katonda asiime okufuka omukisa ng’abaddamu. Saagamba emirundi kikumi nti emikisa gyonna Katonda gy’atuwadde wano, okweyongera kwonna mu Kkanisa yaffe, kwavudde, wansi wa Katonda, mu kwegayirira kwammwe okunyiikivu era okwokya? Wabaddewo ebiseera ebinyeenya Eggulu mu nnyumba eno ne ku New Park Street. Tubaddeko n’ebiseera lwe twawulira nga twandisinze kufa okusinga obutawulirwa. Lwe twasitula Ekkanisa yaffe mu kifuba kyaffe nga maama bw’asitula omwana we. Lwe twawulira okwegomba n’okulumwa ng’alumwa okuzaala olw’emmeeme z’abantu.

Tuyinza okwogera mu mazima, bwe tulaba Ekkanisa yaffe ng’eyeyongera buli lunaku, n’ebibiina ebinene nga bikyawuliriza emimwa gyaffe okuwulira Ekigambo, nti, “Mulabe Katonda ky’akoze!” Kaakano tuleke okusaba kwaffe? Kaakano tugambe Kabona Asinga Obukulu nti, “Kinaamala”? Kaakano tuggye amanda agaaka ku kyoto ne tuzikiza obubaane obwaka? Kaakano tugaane okuleeta abaana b’endiga ab’okusaba n’okutendereza ab’oku makya n’ab’akawungeezi ku ssaddaaka? Ai mmwe abaana ba Efulayimu abaalina obusaale obw’okulwanyisa, mulikyusa amabega gammwe ku lunaku lw’olutalo? Amazzi gayawuddwamu mu maaso gammwe. Yoludaani azzibwa emabega! Mulimma okutambula okuyita mu buziba? Katonda, ye Katonda wammwe, abakulembera ng’ayambuka. Eddoboozi lya kabaka ery’omwanguka liwulirwa wakati mu ggye lyammwe!

Kaakano mulifuuka abatali beesigwa ne mugaana okwambuka okulya ensi? Kaakano mulifiirwa okwagala kwammwe okwasooka? “Ikabodi” kiriwandiikibwa ku maaso ga weema eno? Kiryogerwa nti Katonda abalese? Olunaku lulituuka abawala b’Abafirisuuti lwe balisanyuka, n’abaana b’Abasuuli lwe balijaguza? Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, mudde ku maviivi gammwe nate, n’amaanyi gonna ag’okusaba! Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, mudde nate mu kwegayirira kwammwe okw’amaanyi! Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, bwe muba nga temwagala kulaba birungi nga bizikirira n’ebibi nga biwangula, mukwatagane emikono nate—era mu linnya ly’Oyo abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza—mubeere nate abawanguzi mu kusaba omukisa gulyoke gukke nate! “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira.”

II. Kaakano tuteekwa OKUBAKUBIRIZA OKUTENDEREZA. Okutendereza kusaanidde bulijjo okugoberera okusaba okuddiddwamu. Olufu olw’okwebaza kw’ensi lusaanidde okulinnya ng’enjuba ey’okwagala kw’eggulu bw’ebugumya ettaka. Mukama abadde wa kisa gy’oli, n’ateze okutu kwe eri eddoboozi ly’okwegayirira kwo? Kale mutendereze ebbanga lyonna ly’olimala ng’okyali mulamu. Togaana luyimba eri oyo eyaddamu okusaba kwo, n’akuwa omutima gwo bye gwetaaga. Okusirika ku bisa bya Katonda kwe kwetikka omusango ogw’obutasiima obw’ekivve, era obutasiima kye kimu ku bisobyo ebisinga obubi.

Nsuubira, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti temujja kweyisa mu ngeri ey’obuswavu ng’abagenge omwenda, abo bwe baamala okuwonyezebwa ebigenge byabwe, ne batadda kwebaza Mukama eyabawonya. Okwerabira okutendereza Katonda kwe kugaana okwegasa, kubanga okutendereza, ng’okusaba, kwa mugaso nnyo eri omuntu ow’omwoyo. Kwegezaamu okw’awaggulu era okuleeta obulamu. Okuzina mu maaso ga Mukama, nga Dawudi, kwe kwanguya omusaayi mu misuwa, n’okufuula okukuba kw’omutima okw’obulamu obulungi. Okutendereza kutuwa embaga ennene, ng’eya Sulemaani, eyawa buli muntu ekitundu ky’ennyama ekirungi n’ensumbi y’omwenge.

Okutendereza kwe kusinga okuba okw’omu ggulu mu mirimu gy’Omukristaayo. Bamalayika tebasaba, naye emisana n’ekiro, awatali kuwummula, batendereza. Okwebaza Katonda olw’ebisa bye tufunye kwe kugasa bantu bannaffe—“ababonyaabonyezebwa bawulire bajaguzenga.” Abalala abaali mu mbeera efaanana bwe batyo banaabudaabudibwa bwe tunaasobola okwogera nti, “Kale tutendereze Mukama, ffenna tugulumizenga erinnya lye. Omunaku ono yakoowoola Mukama n’amwanukula.” Abakristaayo abasibiddwa ennimi kivume kya nnaku eri Ekkanisa. Tulina abamu ng’abo—abamu Setaani be yasiba emimwa—era eddoboozi erisinga obunene lye bakola kwe kugaaya ekyuma eky’omu kamwa eky’okusirika kwabwe. Nandyagadde, abooluganda bange, mu mbeera ezo zonna olulimi lw’abatayogera luyimbe.

Tugende eddaala erimu okweyongerayo wano. Ng’okutendereza bwe kuli okulungi era okusanyusa, nga kuwa omuntu omukisa era nga kugulumiza Katonda, okutendereza okw’awamu kulina okusiimibwa okw’enjawulo ennyo. Okutendereza okw’awamu kuli ng’ennyimba ezikubirwa awamu. Eddoboozi ly’ekivuga ekimu liwooma nnyo, naye ebikumi n’ebikumi by’ebivuga, ebifuuyibwa n’eby’enkoba, bwe bigattibwa wamu, olwo ekibiina ky’abakubi kifulumya eddoboozi ery’ekitiibwa ery’okukwatagana. Okutendereza kw’Omukristaayo omu kusiimibwa mu maaso ga Katonda ng’akaweke k’obubaane, naye okutendereza kw’abangi kuli ng’ekyoterezo ekijjudde obubaane obw’omugavu nga bunyooka omukka mu maaso ga Mukama. Okutendereza okw’awamu kwe kulegako ku Ggulu nga tekunnatuuka, kubanga mu lukuŋŋaana olunene olwo bonna wamu, n’omutima gumu n’eddoboozi limu, batendereza Mukama—

“Ennimi zaabwe nkumi na nkumi, Naye essanyu lyabwe lyonna limu.”

Okutendereza okw’olukale kusanyusa nnyo Omukristaayo yennyini. Emigugu emeka gye kuggyeewo? Nkakasa nti bwe mpulira eddoboozi ery’omwanguka ery’okutendereza mu nnyumba eno, libugumya omutima gwange. Oluusi kugenda mpola katono okusinga bwe njagala, era nteekwa okubakubiriza okwanguyirako, amayengo agayiringita ag’okutendereza okw’ekitiibwa galyoke galage amaanyi gaago gonna! Naye ne bwe wabaawo ebibulamu byonna, eri omutima gwange tewali nnyimba ng’ezammwe. Mikwano gyange Abadaaki batendereza Mukama mpola nnyo ne kiba nti omuntu ayinza bulungi okwebaka, ng’alulungibwa ennyimba zaabwe empanvu. Kyokka ne eyo, amaloboozi amangi gakola okukwatagana okw’ekitiibwa okw’okutendereza.

Njagala okuwulira abantu ba Katonda nga bayimba bwe baba bayimba ddala, so si nga kiba kuwalula ddoboozi wakati w’okukwatagana n’obutakwatagana. Ai, singa tufuna oluyimba olutukuvu, eddoboozi ery’omwanguka ery’okutendereza okw’awaggulu, buli mmeeme y’omuntu mw’ekuba ekipimo, ne buli lulimi lw’omuntu ne luvuga eddoboozi—era buli muyimbi n’abeera n’okwegomba okw’awaggulu okusinga munne mu kwebaza n’okwagala! Waliwo ekintu ekisanyusa ennyo mu bumu bw’emitima egy’amazima mu kusinza Katonda—era emitima egyo bwe gyolesebwa mu luyimba— amaloboozi ago agasanyusa nga gawooma! Ndowooza twandibadde n’Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okutendereza omulundi gumu buli wiiki. Tulina Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba buli Bbalaza, n’Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba buli Lwamukaaga, n’Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba buli ku makya, naye lwaki tetulina Lukuŋŋaana lwa Kutendereza? Mazima ebiseera bisaanidde okwawulibwa olw’okusinza okujjudde okutendereza okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Tugezeeko enteekateeka eyo mangu ddala.

Nga bwe nnayogera ku kusaba okw’awamu, nti kusaanidde okuweebwayo naddala ku lw’abaweereza, bwe kityo n’okutendereza okw’awamu kusaanidde emirundi mingi okufuna endabika y’emu. Ekibiina kyonna kisaanidde okutendereza n’okwebaza Katonda olw’ekisa ekiweebwa Ekkanisa okuyita mu basumba baayo. Muwulire Omutume waffe bw’akyogera nate—“Bangi balyoke batwebalizeeko olw’ekirabo kye twaweebwa.” Abooluganda, tusaanidde okutendereza Katonda olw’abaweereza abalungi kubanga balamu—kubanga bwe bafa, omulimu gwabwe mungi gufa nabo. Kyewuunyisa engeri okulongoosa Ekkanisa bwe kweyongera mu maaso nga Luther ne Calvin bakyali balamu, n’engeri gye kukoma amangu ddala ng’abalongoosa bafudde.

Emyoyo gy’abantu abalungi tegifa, naye mu ngeri emu yokka. Ekkanisa za Katonda mu mulembe guno ziri ng’Abayisirayiri mu biseera by’Abalamuzi. Abalamuzi bwe baafanga, baddangamu okugoberera ebifaananyi ebyole. Era bwe kiri ne kaakano. Katonda bw’aba ng’akyakuuma omuntu oyo mu bulamu, Ekkanisa ekulaakulana, naye omuntu oyo bw’afa, obunyiikivu bwe yafuuwa ne bufuuka ennimi z’omuliro busigala nga bunyooka bunyoosi mu vvu mu mbeera mwenda ku kkumi, oba n’okusingawo, mu kyenda mu mwenda ku buli kikumi. Okukulaakulana kw’Ekkanisa kwesigama ku bulamu bw’omuweereza. Katonda akiteekateeka bw’atyo okutwetoowaza. Kale, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza olw’obulamu obukuumiddwa.

Naye wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza okungi olw’empisa ezikuumiddwa, kubanga ai, omuweereza bw’agwa, nga kiba kiswazo kinene! Lwaki, bwe musoma mu mawulire ga poliisi ensonga ey’ennaku eya Rev. Omwami _, eyasalawo okweyita omuweereza w’Ababatisti, buli muntu agamba nti, “Nga kintu kya kivve! Ababatisti nga bateekwa okuba ekibiina ekibi.” Kaakano, omusirusiru yenna mu nsi ayinza okweyita omuweereza w’Ababatisti. Eddembe lyaffe lijjuvu nnyo ne kiba nti tewali tteeka wadde nteekateeka. Omuntu yenna asobola okufuna abantu kkumi na babiri okumuwuliriza ng’abuulira aba muweereza, waakiri gye bali. Noolwekyo temuyinza kulowooza nti tewalibaawo bannanfuusi abamu abalyetwalira erinnya eryo balyoke bafune ekitiibwa eky’engeri emu.

Omuweereza ow’amazima bw’akuumibwa n’aweebwa okunywerera ku bugolokofu bwe, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza Katonda okutakoma ku lulwe. Omuweereza bw’akuumibwa ng’alina bulijjo eby’okubuulira ebirungi. Bw’aba ng’oluzzi olukulukuta. Katonda bw’amuwa okuggya mu tterekero lye ebipya n’ebikadde okuliisa abantu be, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza okw’omutima gwonna. Era bw’akuumibwa nga mulamu mu kuyigiriza, bw’atakyama kudda mu bufirosoofo ku ludda olumu, wadde mu kufunda kw’enjigiriza ku ludda olulala, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza awo. Katonda bw’awa ebibiina okwagala okumuwuliriza, era okusinga byonna, emmeeme bwe zikyusibwa n’abatukuvu ne bazimbibwa, wasaanidde okubaawo ekitiibwa n’ettendo eritakoma eri Katonda.

Ah, kaakano njogera ku bintu bye mumanyi mwenna, era mubikkiriza bukkiriza nga munyeenya emitwe, ne mulowooza nti tebirimu bingi. Naye singa mwali mulagiddwa okubeera mu Holland okumala akaseera katono, mwandisiimye mangu ebigambo bino. Bwe nnali ntambula eyo, nasula mu maka g’abasajja abatya Katonda—abantu ba Katonda be nnayinza okussa nabo ekimu okuwoomu—abatasobola kugenda mu kifo we baasinzizanga edda. Lwaki? “Ssebo,” bwe bagamba, “nnyinza ntya okugenda mu kifo eky’okusinza ng’abaweereza abasinga obungi beegaana buli Kigambo eky’Ebyawandiikibwa? Si ab’Ekkanisa Ennongoose bokka, naye ab’enzikiriza zonna mu Holland! Nnyinza ntya okuwuliriza abalyamu b’olukwe abalayira okukuuma ennyiriri z’okukkiriza eza Calvin oba eza Luther, ate ne balinnya ku kituuti ne beegaana amazima g’okuzuukira, oba ne bagamba nti okulinnya kwa Yesu mu ggulu lugero bugero olw’omwoyo?”

Nzuula nti mu Netherlands batusingako emyaka ataano mu butakkiriza. Tujja kubatuukako mangu singa abasajja ab’ekibiina ekimu kye mmanyi bakkirizibwa okweyongera obungi. Abasomi b’eddiini Abadaaki batambudde ebigere bingi mu Neologism, okutuusa kaakano abantu baagala Amazima ga Katonda era waliwo ebibiina bingi ebyagala okugawulira. Naye bano bawalirizibwa ddala okugaana okugenda mu Kkanisa n’akatono, baleme okulabika ng’abawagira enjigiriza ez’obukyamu n’ez’obulimba ezibabuulirwa buli Ssande.

Ah, singa Katonda yandiggye mu Bungereza abaweereza ababuulira Enjiri n’obuvumu era mu ngeri etegeerekeka, mwandikaabidde Katonda abazzeeyo ekikondo ky’ettaala. Mazima tuyinza okwogera ku Bungereza—

“Wadde ng’olina ensobi zonna, nkyakwagala.” Tulina omulabirizi omu mu matwale eyeerangirira obutakkiriza bwe. Tulina abasajja batono mu bibiina by’eddiini byonna abaseeseetuka mpola okuva ku Mazima. Naye, Katonda yeebazibwe, tebannaba kuba kintu. Bali ng’ettondo eriri mu nsuwa bw’obageraageranya n’Ekkanisa za Kristo, n’abo mu ffe abatali ba Calvin nnyo nga bwe twandyagadde. Neebaza Katonda, waliwo bangi abatawakanya kuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Ebyawandiikibwa, wadde okubuusabuusa Amazima amakulu ag’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza. Tukyalina mu ffe abasajja abeesigwa eri Katonda, ababuulira Amazima gonna ng’amazima bwe gali mu Yesu.

Mwebaze olw’abaweereza bammwe, nziramu okwogera, kubanga singa mwali muteekeddwa we bali Abakkiriza abamu, mwandikaabidde Katonda wammwe nti—“Mukama, tuzzeeyo bannabbi bo. Tusindikire enjala ya mmere oba ennyonta y’amazzi, naye totusindikira njala y’ekigambo kya Katonda!”

Nsaba ku lwange ku makya gano, nga omuweereza wammwe, okwebaza kwammwe kutabulwe n’okwange mu kutendereza Katonda olw’obuyambi bw’ampadde mu mulimu omuzibu ennyo ogw’ennaku kkumi n’ennya eziyise. Katonda atenderezebwe olw’okusiimibwa kwe yampa mu nsi eyo mu mitendera gyonna egy’abantu. Njogera olw’ettendo lye so si olwange, kubanga kino kibadde kirayiro kyange, nti Katonda bw’anampa amakungula, sijja kutwala wadde ekirimba kimu eky’empeke, naye ye anaakifuna kyonna. Nasanga, mu bifo byonna gye nnagenda, ebibiina ebinene eby’abantu, abantu abangi abaali batasobola kutegeera mubuulizi, naye abaayagala okulaba amaaso ge, kubanga Katonda yali awadde omukisa obubaka bwe obwavvuunulwa eri emmeeme zaabwe.

Abangi nnyo bampa omukono ogw’okwagala kw’abooluganda, era, nga bajjudde amaziga mu maaso, ne bansabira, mu lulimi Oludaaki, buli mukisa ku mutwe gwange. Nasuubira okubuulira abantu ataano ataano n’ekikumi kikumi, naye mu kifo ky’ekyo, ne baba bangi nnyo ne kiba nti n’amakanisa amanene ennyo tegaali manene kusukka. Kino kyanneewuunyisa, ne kinsanyusa—ne kindeetera okusanyukira mu Katonda—era mbasaba musanyuke nange. Neebaza Katonda olw’okusiimibwa kwe yampa mu mitendera gyonna egy’abantu. Abaavu bwe beekuŋŋaananga okunkwata mu ngalo, okutuusa lwe baali kumpi okunnyuluza ebitundu, Katonda yasiima okukwata ku mutima gwa Nnaabagereka wa Holland okuntumya, era okumala essaawa emu n’eddakiika kkumi n’ettaano nafuna omukisa okwogera naye ku bintu ebireeta emirembe gyaffe.

Saasaba kusisinkana naye. Kyali kye yayagala yennyini. Awo ne nnyimusa emmeeme yange eri Katonda ndyoke nneme kwogera ku kintu kirala kyonna wabula Kristo, era ndyoke mmubuulire Yesu yekka. Era bw’atyo Mukama yasiima okunnyamba. Ne ndeka omukyala oyo ow’empisa ennungi ennyo, nga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mmubuulira okwagala kwa Katonda kwonna. Nasanyuka nnyo, ddala, okulaba nga nnaniriziddwa n’omutima ogw’ekisa mu bibiina by’eddiini byonna, ne kiba nti ku Lwamukaaga mu Amsterdam nabuulira mu Kkanisa y’Abamennonite ku makya, ne mu Kkanisa Enkadde Ennongoose ey’Abadaaki akawungeezi. Ssande eyaddako ku makya nabuulira mu Kkanisa ya Presbyterian ey’Abangereza, ate nate, akawungeezi, mu Kkanisa ey’Eddembe ey’Abadaaki.

Oluusi nakkirizibwanga okubuulira mu makanisa amanene, nga mu Dom Kirk e Utrecht, ne mu Peter’s Kirk e Leyden, nga sirina baavu bokka, wabula n’abakungu n’ab’ebitiibwa ab’ensi, abaali, kya bulijjo, basobola okutegeera Olungereza okusinga abaavu abasinga obungi, abataafuna kakisa ka kuluyiga. Nawulira, nga ntambula okuva mu kibuga okudda mu kirala, Mukama ng’annyamba bulijjo okubuulira. Mu bulamu bwange bwonna saali mmanyi kugumira kwa mwoyo kwenkana awo, wadde omutima okubuukabuuka bwe gutyo. Era nkomyewo, sikooye wadde okuggwaamu amaanyi, newaakubadde nga nabuuliranga emirundi ebiri buli lunaku, naye nga njjudde amaanyi n’obuvumu okusinga bwe nnali nga nsimbula!

Mpa Katonda ekitiibwa olw’emmeeme ennyingi ze mpulidde nti zikyusiddwa olw’okusoma obubaka obwakubibwa mu kyapa, n’olw’emikisa egy’okwagala egy’abo abaatugoberera okutuuka ku lubalama lw’amazzi nga bakaaba amaziga mangi, nga batugamba nti—“Fuba ojje ng’ebiseera by’obutiti tebinnaba kutuuka,” era nga batukubiriza okuddayo nate okubuulira Ekigambo mu nsi eyo. Wayinza okubaamu akantu k’okwegulumiza mu kino. Mukama amanyi oba bwe kiri oba nedda, naye nze sikimanyi mu nze. Ntendereza era neebaza erinnya lye, nti mu nsi omuli obufirosoofo bungi, annyambye okubuulira Amazima ge mu ngeri ennyangu bw’etyo, ne kiba nti sayogera kigambo ng’omuyigiriza w’enjigiriza obuyigiriza, naye nabuulira Kristo era Kristo yekka. Musanyuke nange, abooluganda bange abaagalwa. Nteekwa okubalaba nga musanyuka, oba bwe mutaagale, nteekwa okusanyuka nzekka, naye omugaati gwange ogw’okutendereza munene nnyo sisobola kugulya gwonna nzekka.

III. Era tutuuse ku nkomerero. Nteekwa okubakubiriza ku BYE TUBABANJA MU SSANYU Omutume by’awa mu lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’ebbiri, ng’ensonga LWAKI WASAANIDDE OKUBAAWO OKUSABA N’OKUTENDEREZA. “Tulina okwenyumiriza ng’omwoyo gwaffe gutujulira kubanga twatambulira mu buwombeefu ne mu mazima ga Katonda, so si mu magezi ag’omubiri, naye mu kisa kya Katonda nga tuli mu nsi n’okusingira ddala gye muli.”

Ah, ku nkomerero ya byonna, okubudaabudibwa kw’omuntu kuteekwa okuva, oluvannyuma lw’obulokozi bwa Katonda obwaggwa, mu kujulira kw’omwoyo gwe ye. Era eri omuweereza, nga bujulirwa bwa kitalo nti abuulidde Enjiri mu bwesimbu, ekirina amakulu abiri— yagibuulira nga talina mitima ebiri—ng’ayogera kimu ng’ategeeza kirala. Era yagibuulira, si ng’abavuzi b’amaato bwe bavuga—nga batunuulira oludda olumu ne bavugira ku lulala—naye yagibuulira ng’ategeeza ky’ayogera, ng’alina omutima gumu, ng’ayagala Ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’obulokozi bw’abantu.

Era nga mukisa nnyo okugibuulira mu ngeri ennyangu, kwe kugamba, awatali bigambo bizibu, awatali bigambo binyirira, nga tasoma bukugu bwa kwogera, nga teyeekakaatika ku by’okwewunda mu kwogera. Obulamu bw’omuntu avvoola ekituuti ng’akifuula eky’okwolesa obwogezi nga bwa kikolimo! Ekitanda kye eky’okufiirako kiriba kya kwennyamira nnyo bw’alijjukira nti yayolesa amaanyi ge ag’okwogera okusinga ebintu ebinywevu ebireeta okuwangula emmeeme! Omwoyo ogwo guyinza bulungi okuba nga gutereddwa ogusobola okwogera nti gwakwata Amazima ga Katonda mu bwesimbu.

Omutume era agamba nti yali agibuulidde mu mazima. Kwe kugamba, yagibuulira ng’ategeeza ky’ayogera, ng’akiwulira—yagibuulira mu ngeri nti tewali yali ayinza kumuvunaana bulimba. Ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani kirimu akantu k’omusana gw’enjuba, era oyo ye muweereza wa Katonda ow’amazima abuulira ekyo ky’andyagadde okuwanikibwa mu musana gw’enjuba, oba omusana gw’enjuba gwe guyitamu ddala. Ntya nti tewali n’omu ku ffe ali ng’endabirwamu enjeru—abasinga obungi ku ffe tuliko langi katono—naye alina essanyu oyo anoonya okuggyawo langi eyo nga bw’asobola, ekitangaala ky’Enjiri kiyitemu ddala mu ye, nga kitangalijja nga bwe kiva eri enjuba ey’obutuukirivu.

Pawulo yali abuulidde mu bwesimbu ne mu mazima. Era ayongerako nti, “So si mu magezi ag’omubiri.” Ai, nga mpulidde emboozi nnyingi ku ebyo amagezi ag’omubiri bye gayinza okukola! Era nnyize ekyokuyiga mu nnaku kkumi n’ennya eziyise kye nnandyagadde Bungereza okuyiga. Waliwo ebibinja bisatu eby’obukyamu mu by’eddiini emitala eyo, era buli kimu kibuuka ku mugongo gwa kinnaakyo. Ebimu bikkiriza nti ebyabaawo byonna mu Byawandiikibwa nfumo bufumo. Ebirala bigamba nti waliwo ebirungi ebimu mu Bayibuli, newaakubadde nga mulimu ensobi nnyingi nnyo. N’ebirala bigenda wala n’okusingawo, ne bisuula Bayibuli yonna ku bikwata ku kuluŋŋamizibwa kwayo, newaakubadde nga bakyagibuulira, era nga bakyagyesigamako, nga bagamba nti bakikola olw’okuzimba abantu ab’awansi bokka—nga bagiwanirira bugiwanirizi ku lw’ebibiina by’abantu—newaakubadde nga nsaanidde okwongerako nti n’okufuna eky’okulya kyabwe nakyo.

Kya nnaku! Kya nnaku! Kya nnaku nti Ekkanisa etuuse ku kigero ekyo—Ekkanisa Enkadde Ennongoose ey’Abadaaki—endabirwamu ddala ey’enjigiriza ya Calvin, eyanywera era ennywevu mu nnyiriri z’okukkiriza kwayo ku njigiriza zonna ze twagala, kyokka n’ekyama n’egenda mu ddembe ery’okukkiriza buli kimu era ery’obugwenyufu. Ai, nga tusaanidde okuvumirira amagezi ag’omubiri n’amaanyi! Ntya, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti oluusi abamu ku mmwe, bwe muwulira omuweereza, mwagala akyogere mu ngeri ennungi, era mumunenya okuggyako ng’alaga ekigero ekimu eky’obukugu. Neebuuza oba ekyo si kibi? Kumpi ndowooza nti kye kiri.

Oluusi ndowooza oba tetwandisanidde kutunuulira nnyo bukugu buli lunaku, ne tweyongera okutunuulira ebiri mu Njiri ebuulirwa. Oba omuntu bw’aba yaweebwa omukisa ogw’obukugu bw’okwogera tuyinza, oboolyawo, okugasibwa ennyo ku ye—oba ekyo si bunafu. Oba tekyandibadde kirungi okuddayo mu nnaku z’abavubi omulundi omulala, ne tutawa bantu kusomesebwa kwa ngeri yonna, wabula ne tubasindika bubasindika okubuulira Amazima ga Katonda mu ngeri ennyangu. Kino, okusinga okugenda ewala nga bwe bagenda kaakano, nga bawa abantu, ssimanyi ki, eby’okuyiga ebya buli ngeri ebitalina mugaso gwonna ku nsi gye bali, naye ebibayamba bubayambi okukyamya obwesimbu bwa Katonda. Njagala ekigambo ekyo mu kyawandiikibwa kyange—“So si mu magezi ag’omubiri.”

Era kaakano mbanja ekyange, ng’omwoyo gwange bwe gunjulira—mbanja ekyange ku kwenyumiriza kuno okw’Omutume waffe. Mbuulidde Enjiri ya Katonda mu bwesimbu. Ssimanyi nga bwe nnyinza okugibuulira mu ngeri ennyangu okusingawo, era siyinza kugirangirira n’obugolokofu okusingawo. Ngibuulidde mu mazima—Oyo akebera emitima gyonna akimanyi. Era sigibuulidde mu magezi ag’omubiri, era olw’ensonga emu ennungi ennyo—kubanga sirina gonna—era mbadde mpaliriziddwa okunywerera ku bujulirwa bwa Mukama obutaliimu bukodyo. Naye bwe mba nga nkoze ekintu kyonna, kikoleddwa ekisa kya Katonda.
