Bwe wabaawo obuwanguzi bwonna obutuukiddwako, kyabadde Kisa kya Katonda ekyakikola kyonna. “N’okusingira ddala gye muli.” Kubanga newaakubadde ekigambo kyaffe kibunye mu nsi nnyingi, n’obujulirwa bwaffe ne bwetooloola ensi yonna, kyokka, “n’okusingira ddala gye muli.” Mmwe twabalabula. Mmwe twabeegayirira. Mmwe twabakubiriza. Nammwe twawoza. Ku lwammwe twakaaba amaziga. Ku lwammwe twasaba. Eri abamu ku mmwe tubadde bazadde ab’omwoyo mu Kristo. Eri bangi ku mmwe nga kitammwe omulezi. Eri bangi ku mmwe ng’omuyigiriza era omuzimbi mu Njiri. Era tusuubira nti eri mwenna tubadde mukwano gwammwe ow’amazima mu Kristo Yesu. Noolwekyo mbanja okusaba kwammwe—okwammwe okusinga okw’abantu abalala bonna.

Era newaakubadde waliwo abatali batono abatujjukira mu kwegayirira kwabwe, mbeegayiridde nnyo, okuva bwe kibadde “okusingira ddala gye muli,” nfune okusingira ddala okusaba kwammwe. Abamu bajja kugamba nti si kya kisa nze okulowooza nti temusaba. Kale, sirowooza bwe ntyo olw’obutaba na kisa, naye wayinza okubaawo abamu abeerabira—abamu abeerabira okuwoza. Ai, mugende mu maaso okunsabira! Ekibiina kyonna tekinnalokolebwa. Waliwo abamu abatuwuliriza abatannakyuka. Muwoleze Katonda ku lwabwe. Waliwo emitima egimu emikakanyavu egitannamenyebwa! Musabe Katonda ennyondo ekube. Era nga wakyaliwo abamu abatannasaanuuka, musabe Katonda afuule Ekigambo kibe ng’omuliro!

London eno ennene yeetaaga okunyeenyezebwa okuva ku nkomerero emu okutuuka ku ndala. Musabire abaweereza bammwe bonna, Katonda abafuule ab’amaanyi. Ekkanisa ekyetaaga nnyo eddoboozi ery’omwanguka erya Katonda okugizuukusa mu tulo twayo. Musabe Katonda awe omukisa abaddu be bonna b’atumye. Muwoleze naye n’amaanyi ga Katonda, obwakabaka bwe bulyoke bujje, era by’ayagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.

Ai, singa mwenna mwakkiriza Yesu! Kubanga okutuusa lwe munaakkiriza, temuyinza kusaba wadde okutendereza! Ai, singa mwenna mwakkiriza Yesu! Mujjukire, lino lye kkubo lyokka ery’obulokozi. Mwesige Yesu, kubanga amukkiriza tasalibwa musango, naye atakkiriza gumaze okumusinga kubanga takkiririza mu linnya ly’Omwana oyo omu yekka owa Katonda. Mwesige Yesu era munaalokolebwa. Kristo abakkirize kaakano, ku lw’okwagala kwe yennyini. Amiina.
fields.body_text: “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira, bangi balyoke batwebalizeeko olw’ekirabo kye twaweebwa. Tulina okwenyumiriza ng’omwoyo gwaffe gutujulira kubanga twatambulira mu buwombeefu ne mu mazima ga Katonda, so si mu magezi ag’omubiri, naye mu kisa kya Katonda nga tuli mu nsi n’okusingira ddala gye muli.” 2 Abakkolinso 1:11,12. OMUTUME Pawulo yali awonyeziddwa Katonda mu ngeri ez’ekitalo okuva mu kabi akaali kamutuukiridde mu Asiya. Mu kajagalalo akanene mu Efeso, Demeteriyo ne banne abaakolanga obusabo bwe baamusasamaliza ekibiina ekinene, kubanga baalaba ng’omulimu gwabwe guli mu kabi, obulamu bwa Pawulo bwali mu kabi kanene nnyo. Kyeyava awandiika nti, “Okubonaabona kwe twayitamu mu Asiya kwali kungi ekiyitiridde n’essuubi ery’okuba abalamu ne lituggwaamu.” Omutume okukuumibwa kwe okw’ekitalo akuwa Katonda yekka. Era bwe yali ng’alowooza ne ku lunaku lwe baamukuba amayinja ne bamuleka nga balowooza nti afudde, kyali kisaanira nnyo okwebaza kwe okwogera ku “Katonda azuukiza abafu.” Ate era, Omutume akuba ensonga nti okuva Katonda bwe yali amuwonyezza bw’atyo mu biseera ebyayita, era ng’akyali mubeezi we mu kiseera kino, yandibadde naye ne mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Pawulo mukugu mu kubala kwonna—okukkiriza kwe bulijjo kwali ng’ekitabo ekibalirirwamu amangu—era wano tumusanga ng’abalirira ng’akozesa Etteeka ly’Essatu ery’Omukkiriza. Akuba ensonga okuva ku byayita okutuuka ku biriwo, n’okuva ku biriwo okutuuka ku bigenda okujja. Olunyiriri olukulembera ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kyakulabirako ekirabika obulungi eky’okutuuka ku kusalawo okubudaabuda ng’okozesa Etteeka ly’Essatu—“Eyatuwonya mu kufa okwo okw’entiisa, era anaatulokolanga, era gwe tulinamu essuubi ery’okutuwonyanga.” Okuva Katonda waffe bw’ali “nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw’ali era bw’aliba emirembe n’emirembe,” okwagala kwe mu biseera ebyayita kwe kukakasa okutasobola kusobya okw’ekisa kye leero, era kwe kakalu akakakafu ennyo ak’obwesigwa bwe enkya. Embeera zaffe ne bwe ziba ziri zitya, ekkubo lyaffe ne bwe liba nga litabuse litya, n’eggulu lyaffe ne bwe liba nga likutte ekizikiza kitya, bwe tukuba ensonga mu ngeri eya, “Yakola, Akola, Alikola,” okubudaabudibwa kwaffe tekuyinza kuzikirizibwa n’akatono. Kale mugume omwoyo, mmwe ezzadde lya Isirayiri ababonyaabonyezebwa. Singa mubadde n’oyo Katonda akyukakyuka, emmeeme zammwe zandijjudde obukaawu—naye kubanga ye “nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw’ali era bw’aliba emirembe n’emirembe,” buli kweyoleka kw’ekisa kye okuddiŋŋanwa kwandibafuukidde ekyangu okumwesigamako. Buli kulaba okuggya okw’obwesigwa bwe kwandinywezezza obwesige bwammwe mu kisa kye. Omwoyo ow’omukisa ennyo atuyigirize okukula mu bwesige obutukuvu mu Mukama waffe omwesigwa bulijjo. Newaakubadde ng’Omutume waffe bw’atyo yakkiriza omukono gwa Katonda, era omukono gwa Katonda gwokka, mu kuwonyezebwa kwe, kyokka teyali musirusiru nnyo okwegaana oba okunyooma ensonga ez’okubiri. Wabula, ng’amaze okusooka okutendereza Katonda azaamu bonna amaanyi, kaakano ajjukira n’okwebaza okusaba okw’amaanyi okw’abantu abangi abaamwagala abaamwegayiririranga. Okwebaza Katonda tekusaanidde kufuuka nsonga ya butasiima bantu. Kituufu nti Yakuwa ye yakuuma Omutume w’Abaamawanga, naye yakikola ng’addamu okusaba. Ekibya ekirondemu tekyamenyebwa muggo gw’abakozi b’ebibi, kubanga omukono gwa Katonda w’Eggulu ogwagoloddwa gwe gwali obukuumi bwe—naye omukono ogwo gwagolobwa kubanga abantu b’e Kkolinso, n’abatukuvu ba Katonda wonna wonna, baali bawangudde ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa olw’okwegayirira kwabwe okw’awamu. Okwegayirira okwo okwawangula kwogerwako n’okwebaza mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe, “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira,” era ayagala abooluganda kaakano begatte ku kutendereza kwe, “bangi balyoke batwebalizeeko olw’ekirabo kye twaweebwa.” Ayongerako nti alina ky’abanja ku kwagala kwabwe kubanga teyali ng’abamu abataali beesigwa mu bye baakwasibwa, wabula omwoyo gwe gwali mulongoofu nti yali abuulidde Ekigambo mu bwesimbu era mu mazima. Bwe tunaaba twogera ku nsonga zino, Omwoyo afuka amafuta akke kaakano azifuule ez’omugaso gye tuli. Tujja, okusooka, okukkiriza amaanyi g’okusaba okw’awamu. Ekyokubiri, okubakubiriza okutendereza awamu. Ate ekyokusatu, okubanjulira ekyo kye tubabanja mu ssanyu—ekitali kyaffe ffekka, wabula ekya baweereza ba Katonda bonna abateganira emmeeme mu mazima. I. Okusooka, kale, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, gwe mulimu gwange era gwe mukisa gwange ku makya gano OKUKKIRIZA AMAANYI G’OKUSABA OKW’AWAMU. Kyasanyusa Katonda okufuula okusaba omugga ogujjudde era ogw’essanyu, ebisa byaffe ebisinga obulungi mwe bisinga okutukulukutira. Kye kisumuluzo ekya zaabu ekisumulula ebyagi ebijjudde ebya Yusufu waffe ow’omu ggulu. Kiwandiikiddwa ku buli kisa ky’Endagaano nti, “Nate ndiwuliriza ennyumba ya Isirayiri ne mbakolera kino.” Waliwo ebisa ebijja nga tebinoonyezeddwa, kubanga Katonda agamba nti Neeraga abo abaali tebannoonya. Naye waliwo ebirabo ebirala ebiweebwa abo bokka abasaba, kale ne baweebwa—abanoonya, kale ne bazuula—abakonkona, kale ne baggulirwawo. Lwaki Katonda yasiima okutulagira okusaba n’akatono, tekizibu kukizuula, kubanga okusaba kugulumiza Katonda, nga kuteeka omuntu mu mbeera ey’okusinza esinga obwetoowaze. Ekitonde nga kisaba kikkiriza Omutonzi waakyo n’okumutya, era kimwatula nti y’agaba buli kirabo ekirungi ekituukiridde. Amaaso gayimusibwa okulaba Ekitiibwa kya Mukama, so ng’amaviivi gafukamidde ku ttaka mu bwetoowaze obw’obunafu obukkiriziddwa. Newaakubadde okusaba si y’engeri esinga obugulumivu ey’okusinza—kubanga singa kwe kwali, abatukuvu mu ggulu bandikugenzeemu mu maaso—kyokka kwe kusinga obwetoowaze, era bwe kutyo kwe kusinga okusaanira, okulaga Ekitiibwa ky’Oyo Atuukiridde nga bwe kirabibwa omubiri n’omusaayi ebitatuukiridde. Okuva ku “Kitaffe,” mwe twewanira oluganda lwaffe naye, okutuuka ku, “obwakabaka n’amaanyi n’ekitiibwa,” bye tuwa Katonda omu yekka ow’amazima, buli sentensi ey’okusaba eweesa Oyo Asingayo Obukulu ekitiibwa. Okusinda n’amaziga g’abeegayirizi abeetoowaze bisiimibwa ddala nga bwe kiri ku, “Mutukuvu, mutukuvu, mutukuvu,” okutaggwaawo okwa bakerubi ne basseraafi. Kubanga mu butonde bwakwo ddala, buli kwatula okw’amazima okw’ensobi z’omuntu kwe kuwa ekitiibwa obutuukirivu obutakoma obwa Mukama ow’Eggye. Mukama aweebwa ekitiibwa kingi olw’okusaba kwaffe okusinga omukka ogutakoma ogw’obubaane obutukuvu obw’oku kyoto ekyali mu maaso g’eggigi. Ate era, ekikolwa eky’okusaba kituyigiriza obutasaana bwaffe, ogwo nga mukisa ogutali mutono eri ebitonde eby’amalala nga ffe. Singa Katonda yatuwa ebirabo nga tatuwalirizza kubisaba, tetwandimanyi bwe tuli abaavu. Naye okusaba okw’amazima lwe lukalala lw’ebyetaago, ekitabo ky’ebibulwa, okuwoza kw’omwavu atalina kantu, okwanika ebiwundu eby’ekyama, okubikkula obwavu obukwekeddwa. Ng’akyali kusaba eri obugagga bwa Katonda, era kwe kwatula obwereere bw’omuntu. Nzikiriza nti embeera esinga obulamu eri Omukristaayo kwe kubeera bulijjo nga tolina kantu—era ng’oyesigama bulijjo ku Mukama okukuwa by’ojula. Okubeera bulijjo omwavu mu ggwe wennyini ate omugagga mu Yesu—omunafu ng’amazzi ku lulwo—naye nga oli wa maanyi mu Katonda okukola ebikolwa ebinene. Era eyo y’ensonga lwaki okusaba kwa mugaso—kubanga nga bwe kusinza Katonda, kuteeka ekitonde we kisaanidde okubeera—mu nfuufu ddala. Okusaba ku kwokka, nga tolowoozezza ku kuddibwamu kwe kuleeta, mugaso munene eri Omukristaayo. Ng’omuddusi bw’afuna amaanyi ag’empaka mu kwegezaamu buli lunaku, bwe tutyo naffe, ku lw’empaka ennene ez’obulamu, tufuna amaanyi okuyita mu mulimu omutukuvu ogw’okusaba. Okusaba kuweesa ebiwaawaatiro by’empungu ento eza Katonda ebyoya, zisobole okuyiga okutumbiira waggulu w’ebire. Okusaba kusiba ebiwato by’abalwanyi ba Katonda ne kubasindika mu lutalo ng’emisuwa gyabwe gigumu era ng’ebinywa byabwe binywevu. Omwegayirizi omunyiikivu ava mu kisenge kye eky’ekyama, ng’enjuba bw’evaayo mu bisenge eby’ebuvanjuba, ng’omuddusi asinga bonna bw’ajjula essanyu ng’agenda mu mpaka. Okusaba gwe mukono gwa Musa ogwayimusibwa ogwawangula Abamaleki okusinga ekitala kya Yoswa. Kwe kasaale akalasibwa okuva mu kisenge kya nnabbi, nga kalanga okuwangulwa kw’Abasuuli. Kiki bwe nnaagamba nti okusaba kwambaza Omukkiriza engeri za Katonda, kusiba obunafu bw’omuntu n’amaanyi ga Katonda, kufuula obusirusiru bw’omuntu amagezi ag’omu ggulu, era kuwa abantu abafa abali mu buzibu emirembe gya Katonda atafa? Ssimanyi ekyo okusaba kye kutasobola kukola! Nkwebaza, ai Katonda omukulu, olw’entebe ey’okusaasira, ekirabo eky’omuwendo ekiva mu kisa kyo eky’ekitalo eky’okwagala. Tuyambe okugikozesa obulungi! Ng’ebisa bingi bwe bituleetebwa okuva mu ggulu mu lyato ly’okusaba, bwe kityo waliwo ebirabo bingi eby’omuwendo era eby’enjawulo ebiyinza okutuleetebwa ebibinja by’amaato eby’okusaba okw’awamu byokka. Bingi ebirungi Katonda by’awa ba Eriya be ne ba Danyeri be abali bokka, naye bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, tewali kkomo ku kuddibwamu kwa Katonda okw’obugabi. Peetero oboolyawo teyandiggyiddwa mu kkomera singa Ekkanisa yonna teyanyiikira nnyo kumusabira eri Katonda obutakoma. Pentekoote oboolyawo teyandituuse singa abayigirizwa bonna tebaali, “bakuŋŋaanidde mu kisenge kimu,” nga balindirira okukka kw’ennimi ez’omuliro. Katonda asiima okuwa omwegayirizi omu ebisa bingi, naye oluusi alabika ng’agamba nti, “Mwenna mujje mu maaso gange mwegayirire ekisa kyange, kubanga temugenda kulaba maaso gange, okuggyako nga ne bato bammwe, abooluganda, bali nammwe.” Lwaki kiri bwe kityo, mikwano gyange abaagalwa? Ndowooza nti mu ngeri eyo Mukama waffe ow’ekisa alaga bw’assaayo omwoyo ku kussa ekimu kw’abatukuvu. “Nzikiriza okussa ekimu kw’abatukuvu” kye kimu ku bitundu by’Okukkiriza okukulu okw’Ekikristaayo, naye nga batono nnyo abakitegeera! Ai, waliwo ddala obumu obw’amazima mu bantu ba Katonda. Tuyinza okuyitibwa amannya ag’enjawulo— “Naye abaweereza bonna aba Kabaka waffe Mu ggulu ne ku nsi bali kimu.” Tetuyinza kwerekereza buyambi n’okwagala kw’abooluganda. Augustine agamba nti, “Abaavu baatondebwa ku lw’abagagga, n’abagagga baatondebwa ku lw’abaavu.” Sibuusabuusa nti abatukuvu ab’amaanyi baatondebwa ku lw’abatukuvu abanafu, era nti abatukuvu abanafu baleetera abakuze emikisa egy’enjawulo. Waliwo okutuukagana mu mubiri gwonna—buli nnyingo erina ky’ebanjibwa endala zonna—era omubiri gwonna gugattirwa obulungi awamu, ne guyungibwa mu buli nnyingo olw’ekyo buli nnyingo ky’ewaayo. Waliwo ebitundu ebimu ebitono munda mu mubiri gw’omuntu omukugu mu by’omubiri by’atannategeera bulungi. Ayinza okwogera ku kibumba, okugeza, nti kivaamu amazzi ag’omugaso ennyo mu nkola y’omubiri. Naye waliwo amazzi amalala ag’omubiri omugaso gwago ogwennyini gw’atasobola kuzuula. Kyokka, awatali kubuusabuusa, singa ekitundu ekyo kiggyibwamu, omubiri gwonna guyinza okubonaabona ennyo. Era bwe kityo, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, wayinza okubaawo Abakkiriza abamu be tuyinza okwogerako nti, “Ssimanyi mugaso gwabwe. Siyinza kumanya kirungi Omukristaayo oyo ky’akola.” Kyokka singa ekitundu ekyo ekitali kikulu, era ekirabika ng’ekitaliimu mugaso, kiggyibwawo, omubiri gwonna guyinza okubonaabona, ennyingo zonna ziyinza okulwala, n’omutima gwonna ne guzirika. Eno oboolyawo y’ensonga lwaki ebirabo bingi ebizito eby’okwagala kw’eggulu biweebwa kwegayirira okw’awamu kwokka—tulyoke tulabe omugaso gw’omubiri gwonna, era tuwalirizibwe okukkiriza obumu obw’amazima obw’obulamu Ekisa kya Katonda bwe kyakola—era bwe kikuuma buli lunaku mu bantu ba Katonda. Si kirowoozo kya ssanyu, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti n’omwavu ennyo era atamanyiddwa mu bammemba b’Ekkanisa ayinza okwongera ku maanyi g’omubiri? Ffenna tetuyinza kubuulira. Ffenna tetuyinza kufuga. Ffenna tetuyinza kuwaayo zaabu ne ffeeza—naye ffenna tuyinza okuwaayo okusaba kwaffe. Tewali mukyufu, ne bw’aba wa nnaku bbiri oba ssatu zokka mu Kisa kya Katonda, atayinza kusaba. Tewali mwannyinaffe mu Yesu agalamidde ku kitanda olw’obulwadde atayinza kusaba. Tewali Mukkiriza mulwadde, mukadde, munafu, atamanyiddwa, atamanyi kusoma, oba atalina wadde ssente atayinza kwongera kwegayirira kwe ku ttereka ery’awamu. Buno bwe bugagga bw’Ekkanisa. Tuteeka obusanduuko ku mulyango tulyoke tufune ebirabo byammwe eby’omulimu gwa Katonda—mujjukire nti waliwo essanduuko ey’omwoyo munda mu Kkanisa mwe tusaanidde ffenna okuteeka okwegayiririra abalala kwaffe okw’okwagala, nga mu ggwanika lya Mukama. Ne nnamwandu atalina wadde obutundu bwe obubiri ayinza okuwaayo ekirabo kye mu ggwanika lino. Kale mulabe, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, obumu n’okussa ekimu ebiri mu bantu ba Katonda, okuva bwe waliwo ebisa ebimu ebiweebwa abatukuvu nga basaba wamu kyokka. Nga tusaanidde okuwulira omukwano guno ogw’obumu! Nga tusaanidde okusabiragana! Buli Kkanisa lw’ekuŋŋaana okwegayirira, nga ffenna tusaanidde okukifuula omulimu gwaffe ogututeekeddwako okubeerawo! Nandyagadde abamu ku mmwe abatabeera mu Lukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba olw’ensonga entono yonna, balowooze nga bwe batunyaga ffenna. Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba nteekateeka ey’omuwendo ennyo, eweereza amaanyi enkuŋŋaana endala zonna n’emirimu emirala. Tewali bangi ku mmwe abayinza, nga mukendeezaako katono ku budde bwammwe ne munyiikira mu mirimu gyammwe, okujja gye tuli emirundi egisingako? Era kiki singa mufiirwa omuguzi lumu na lumu, temulowooza nti okufiirwa okwo kwandibaliyiriddwa obulungi olw’amagoba ge mufuna ennaku endala? Oba bwe kitaba bwe kityo, amagoba ag’omwoyo tegandisinze nnyo okufiirwa kwonna okutono okw’ensi? “Tuleme kulekayo kukuŋŋaana, ng’abamu bwe bakola.” Kaakano tweteeseteese okwongera okwetegereza ekirala. Okusaba kuno okw’awamu kusaanidde okukolebwa naddala ku lw’abaweereza ba Katonda. Gye bali, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, okusaba kuno okw’olukale kwe kugendererwa. Pawulo akusaba—“Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Era abaweereza ba Katonda bonna okutuusa ku biseera ebisembayo baliyatula bulijjo nti eno ye nsulo ey’ekyama ey’amaanyi gaabwe. Okusaba kw’abantu kuteekwa okuba amaanyi g’abaweereza. Nnaagezaako okubalaga lwaki omuweereza, okusinga omuntu omulala yenna mu Kkanisa, yeetaaga okusaba okw’amaanyi okw’abantu? Ekifo kye si kye kisinga okuba eky’akabi? Ekiragiro kya Setaani eri eggye lya Ggeyeena kiri nti, “Temulwanagana na muntu yenna, kabe mutono oba mukulu, wabula abaweereza ba Katonda bokka.” Amanyi nti bw’anaasobola omulundi gumu okufumita omutima gw’omu ku bano, wajja kubaawo okutabukatabuka okw’awamu. Kubanga bwe balaba omuzira waabwe ng’afudde, abantu badduka. Okulwana kusinga okuba okw’amaanyi okwetooloola oyo akutte bendera. Eyo embazzi z’olutalo gye zivugira ku nkuufiira z’ebyuma. Eyo obusaale gye bukoonera ku byambalo by’olutalo, kubanga omulabe amanyi nti bw’anaasobola okusuula bendera, oba okwasa omutwe gw’oyo agikutte, ajja kukuba ekikonde ekizito n’aleeta okuggwamu amaanyi okw’amaanyi. Kale mutwetooloole, mmwe abasajja abalina eby’okulwanyisa! Mmwe abalwanyi ab’omusaalaba omumyufu, mukuŋŋaane mutulwanirire, kubanga olutalo lweyongedde okubuguma! Tubeegayirira, bwe mutulonda okuba mu buweereza, muyimirire nga munywevu ku mabbali gaffe mu ntalo zaffe eza buli ssaawa. Nalaba bwe nnali nkomawo okuva e Rotterdam, bwe twali tusomoka omusenyu ku mumwa gw’omugga Maas, eyo amazzi gye gaali amatono era n’empewo nga mbi, ne kiba nti okutambuza eryato kwali kwa kabi nnyo, nti ekiragiro kyafulumizibwa—“Abakozi bonna waggulu ku lyato!” Bwe ntyo ndowooza nti obulamu bw’omuweereza buli mu kabi nnyo, ne kiba nti nsaanidde okukaaba nti, “Abakozi bonna waggulu ku lyato”—buli muntu asabe! N’omutukuvu asinga obunafu anyiikire okwegayirira. Omuweereza, ng’ayimiridde mu kifo eky’akabi bwe kityo, ate era alina obuvunaanyizibwa obuzito obumuteekeddwako. Buli muntu asaanidde okuba mukuumi wa muganda we mu kigera ekimu, naye zisanze abakuumi ba Katonda bwe batabeera beesigwa, kubanga omusaayi gw’emmeeme gulivunaanibwa bo. Ku mulyango gwabwe Katonda gy’alissa okuzikirira kw’abantu bwe bataabuulire Njiri mu bujjuvu era n’obwesigwa. Waliwo ebiseera omugugu guno ogwa Mukama lwe guzitoowerera abaweereza ba Katonda okutuusa lwe bakaaba olw’obulumi, ng’emitima gyabwe gyagala okwabika olw’ennaku. Nalaba kapiteeni, bwe twali tusomoka omusenyu ogwo, ng’asuula ye yennyini ekyuma ekipima obuziba mu nnyanja. Era omuntu omu bwe yamubuuza lwaki taleka bagoba b’eryato kukikola, n’agamba nti, “Mu kifo kino, kaakano kennyini, siyinza kwesiga muntu yenna okuggyako nze nzekka okusuula ekipima, kubanga wakati w’eryato lyaffe ne wansi w’ennyanja tewali yinsi mukaaga.” Era, ddala, twawulira eryato nga likwata wansi omulundi gumu oba ebiri, ekintu ekitaali kisanyusa n’akatono. Bwe kityo bwe kirijja eri buli mubuulizi w’Enjiri—bw’aba nga bw’asaanidde okuba— ebiseera lw’aliba mu kweraliikirira okw’amaanyi ku lw’abamuwuliriza. Taasobole kutuukiriza mulimu gwe ng’ayita mu muntu omulala, naye ateekwa yennyini okuteganira abantu—nga teyeesiga na ye yennyini kubuulira—naye ng’akoowoola Katonda we amuyambe kubanga kaakano omugugu gw’emmeeme z’abantu gumuzitoowerera. Ai, mutusabire nnyo! Katonda bw’atubawa, era nammwe ne mukkiriza ekirabo n’essanyu, temunyooma Katonda naffe bwe mutyo ne mutuleka nga tetulina kantu era nga tuli baavu olw’okusaba kwammwe kwe mutatuwa. Ate era, okukuumibwa kw’omuweereza kye kimu ku bintu ebikulu ennyo eri Ekkanisa. Muyinza okufiirwa omugoba w’eryato omu, era ekyo kibi nnyo, gy’ali ne gye muli. Naye omulungamya w’eryato bw’agwa mu nnyanja, oba kapiteeni bw’akubibwa endwadde, oba oyo akyusa eryato bw’akuulibwa amayengo n’ava ku nnamuziga, olwo eryato lyandikoze ki? Noolwekyo, newaakubadde okusaba kusaanidde okuweebwayo ku lwa buli muntu omulala mu Kkanisa, naye ku lw’omuweereza kwe kusaanidde okuweebwayo okusooka era okusinga byonna, olw’ekifo ky’alimu. Era nga bingi bye basaba gy’ali okusinga bye babasaba mmwe! Bwe muba nga mulina okuteekateeka emmeeza ey’ekyama ey’okuyigiriza omuntu kinnoomu, ye, mu ngeri emu, alina okuteekateeka emmeeza ey’olukale, embaga ey’ebintu ebirungi eri buli ajja. Era alikikola atya okuggyako nga Mukama we amuwa eby’okulya ebingi? Mmwe mulina okwaka ng’ettaala mu nnyumba—omuweereza ateekwa okuba ng’ekigulumu ky’ettaala ekiraga amaato ekkubo—okulabibwa ewala ennyo ku nnyanja. Era anaayaka atya ekiro kyonna okuggyako nga Mukama we amulongoosa, era n’aweebwa amafuta amaggya okuva mu ggulu? Obuyinza bwe bubuna okusinga obwammwe—bwe buba obw’ebibi, aliba ng’omuti gwa upas ogutta, ng’amatabi gaagwo agagaziye gaweta obutwa buli ali wansi w’ekisiikirize kyagwo. Naye Katonda bw’amufuula emmunyeenye mu mukono gwe ogwa ddyo, ekitangaala kye kirisanyusa n’obuyinza bwakyo obw’ekisa amawanga gonna, n’emirembe gyonna egy’ebiseera. Bwe wabaawo amazima gonna mu bino byonna, mbeegayirira, mutuwe n’omutima omugabi era bulijjo obuyambi bw’okusaba kwammwe. Nzuula nti mu lulimi olwasooka, ekigambo ekivvuunulwa, “okukolera awamu,” kitegeeza OMULIMU ogw’amaanyi ennyo. Okusaba kw’abantu abamu tekuliimu mulimu. Naye okusaba kwokka okuwangula eri Katonda kwe kusaba okw’omukozi ow’amazima—omwegayirizi, nga Samusooni, bw’anyeenya enzigi za wankaaki w’Okusaasira, n’ateganira okuzisimbula okusinga okugaanibwa okuyingira. Tetwetaaga kusaba kwa ku nsonda za ngalo, okukwata obukwasi ku mugugu—twetaaga okusaba okw’ebibegaabega—okusitula omugugu ogw’obunyiikivu, era okutayinza kugaanibwa kye kwegomba. Tetwetaaga kukonkona kwa bugonvu okw’abakonkona ne badduka ku mulyango gw’okusaasira, abeeyita abakkiriza kwe bakonkona nga beeraga mu Nkuŋŋaana z’Okusaba. Tusaba okukonkona kw’omuntu amaliridde okufuna, era amaliridde okusigala ku mulyango gw’Okusaasira okutuusa lwe gunaggulwawo, ebyetaago bye byonna ne bimalirizibwa. Amaanyi n’obukambwe bw’obunyiikivu obw’omuntu atayinza kugaanibwa, naye amaliridde okuwamba Eggulu ng’alirumba okutuusa lw’afuna omutima gwe kye gwegomba—okwo kwe kusaba abaweereza kwe beegomba okuva mu bantu baabwe. Kigambibwa nti Melancthon yafuna okubudaabudibwa kungi bwe yategeezebwa nti abalusi b’engoye abamu abaavu, abakazi n’abaana, baali bakuŋŋaanye okusabira Okulongoosa Ekkanisa. Yee, Melancthon—waaliwo ensonga ennywevu ey’okubudaabudibwa wano. Mukakase nti tekyali Luther yekka, wabula enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu abaavu abaayimbanga zabbuli nga balima mu nnimiro, n’ebikumi by’abaddu n’abazaana abaawangayo okwegayirira, abaafuula Okulongoosa Ekkanisa kye kyali. Tubuulirwa ku Paulus Phagius, omuyivu omumanyifu ow’Olwebbulaniya, eyali ow’omugaso ennyo mu kuleeta Okulongoosa Ekkanisa mu nsi eno, nti kimu ku bye yasabanga emirundi mingi abayizi be abato kwali nti bagende mu maaso n’okusaba, Katonda asiime okufuka omukisa ng’abaddamu. Saagamba emirundi kikumi nti emikisa gyonna Katonda gy’atuwadde wano, okweyongera kwonna mu Kkanisa yaffe, kwavudde, wansi wa Katonda, mu kwegayirira kwammwe okunyiikivu era okwokya? Wabaddewo ebiseera ebinyeenya Eggulu mu nnyumba eno ne ku New Park Street. Tubaddeko n’ebiseera lwe twawulira nga twandisinze kufa okusinga obutawulirwa. Lwe twasitula Ekkanisa yaffe mu kifuba kyaffe nga maama bw’asitula omwana we. Lwe twawulira okwegomba n’okulumwa ng’alumwa okuzaala olw’emmeeme z’abantu. Tuyinza okwogera mu mazima, bwe tulaba Ekkanisa yaffe ng’eyeyongera buli lunaku, n’ebibiina ebinene nga bikyawuliriza emimwa gyaffe okuwulira Ekigambo, nti, “Mulabe Katonda ky’akoze!” Kaakano tuleke okusaba kwaffe? Kaakano tugambe Kabona Asinga Obukulu nti, “Kinaamala”? Kaakano tuggye amanda agaaka ku kyoto ne tuzikiza obubaane obwaka? Kaakano tugaane okuleeta abaana b’endiga ab’okusaba n’okutendereza ab’oku makya n’ab’akawungeezi ku ssaddaaka? Ai mmwe abaana ba Efulayimu abaalina obusaale obw’okulwanyisa, mulikyusa amabega gammwe ku lunaku lw’olutalo? Amazzi gayawuddwamu mu maaso gammwe. Yoludaani azzibwa emabega! Mulimma okutambula okuyita mu buziba? Katonda, ye Katonda wammwe, abakulembera ng’ayambuka. Eddoboozi lya kabaka ery’omwanguka liwulirwa wakati mu ggye lyammwe! Kaakano mulifuuka abatali beesigwa ne mugaana okwambuka okulya ensi? Kaakano mulifiirwa okwagala kwammwe okwasooka? “Ikabodi” kiriwandiikibwa ku maaso ga weema eno? Kiryogerwa nti Katonda abalese? Olunaku lulituuka abawala b’Abafirisuuti lwe balisanyuka, n’abaana b’Abasuuli lwe balijaguza? Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, mudde ku maviivi gammwe nate, n’amaanyi gonna ag’okusaba! Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, mudde nate mu kwegayirira kwammwe okw’amaanyi! Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, bwe muba nga temwagala kulaba birungi nga bizikirira n’ebibi nga biwangula, mukwatagane emikono nate—era mu linnya ly’Oyo abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza—mubeere nate abawanguzi mu kusaba omukisa gulyoke gukke nate! “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira.” II. Kaakano tuteekwa OKUBAKUBIRIZA OKUTENDEREZA. Okutendereza kusaanidde bulijjo okugoberera okusaba okuddiddwamu. Olufu olw’okwebaza kw’ensi lusaanidde okulinnya ng’enjuba ey’okwagala kw’eggulu bw’ebugumya ettaka. Mukama abadde wa kisa gy’oli, n’ateze okutu kwe eri eddoboozi ly’okwegayirira kwo? Kale mutendereze ebbanga lyonna ly’olimala ng’okyali mulamu. Togaana luyimba eri oyo eyaddamu okusaba kwo, n’akuwa omutima gwo bye gwetaaga. Okusirika ku bisa bya Katonda kwe kwetikka omusango ogw’obutasiima obw’ekivve, era obutasiima kye kimu ku bisobyo ebisinga obubi. Nsuubira, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti temujja kweyisa mu ngeri ey’obuswavu ng’abagenge omwenda, abo bwe baamala okuwonyezebwa ebigenge byabwe, ne batadda kwebaza Mukama eyabawonya. Okwerabira okutendereza Katonda kwe kugaana okwegasa, kubanga okutendereza, ng’okusaba, kwa mugaso nnyo eri omuntu ow’omwoyo. Kwegezaamu okw’awaggulu era okuleeta obulamu. Okuzina mu maaso ga Mukama, nga Dawudi, kwe kwanguya omusaayi mu misuwa, n’okufuula okukuba kw’omutima okw’obulamu obulungi. Okutendereza kutuwa embaga ennene, ng’eya Sulemaani, eyawa buli muntu ekitundu ky’ennyama ekirungi n’ensumbi y’omwenge. Okutendereza kwe kusinga okuba okw’omu ggulu mu mirimu gy’Omukristaayo. Bamalayika tebasaba, naye emisana n’ekiro, awatali kuwummula, batendereza. Okwebaza Katonda olw’ebisa bye tufunye kwe kugasa bantu bannaffe—“ababonyaabonyezebwa bawulire bajaguzenga.” Abalala abaali mu mbeera efaanana bwe batyo banaabudaabudibwa bwe tunaasobola okwogera nti, “Kale tutendereze Mukama, ffenna tugulumizenga erinnya lye. Omunaku ono yakoowoola Mukama n’amwanukula.” Abakristaayo abasibiddwa ennimi kivume kya nnaku eri Ekkanisa. Tulina abamu ng’abo—abamu Setaani be yasiba emimwa—era eddoboozi erisinga obunene lye bakola kwe kugaaya ekyuma eky’omu kamwa eky’okusirika kwabwe. Nandyagadde, abooluganda bange, mu mbeera ezo zonna olulimi lw’abatayogera luyimbe. Tugende eddaala erimu okweyongerayo wano. Ng’okutendereza bwe kuli okulungi era okusanyusa, nga kuwa omuntu omukisa era nga kugulumiza Katonda, okutendereza okw’awamu kulina okusiimibwa okw’enjawulo ennyo. Okutendereza okw’awamu kuli ng’ennyimba ezikubirwa awamu. Eddoboozi ly’ekivuga ekimu liwooma nnyo, naye ebikumi n’ebikumi by’ebivuga, ebifuuyibwa n’eby’enkoba, bwe bigattibwa wamu, olwo ekibiina ky’abakubi kifulumya eddoboozi ery’ekitiibwa ery’okukwatagana. Okutendereza kw’Omukristaayo omu kusiimibwa mu maaso ga Katonda ng’akaweke k’obubaane, naye okutendereza kw’abangi kuli ng’ekyoterezo ekijjudde obubaane obw’omugavu nga bunyooka omukka mu maaso ga Mukama. Okutendereza okw’awamu kwe kulegako ku Ggulu nga tekunnatuuka, kubanga mu lukuŋŋaana olunene olwo bonna wamu, n’omutima gumu n’eddoboozi limu, batendereza Mukama— “Ennimi zaabwe nkumi na nkumi, Naye essanyu lyabwe lyonna limu.” Okutendereza okw’olukale kusanyusa nnyo Omukristaayo yennyini. Emigugu emeka gye kuggyeewo? Nkakasa nti bwe mpulira eddoboozi ery’omwanguka ery’okutendereza mu nnyumba eno, libugumya omutima gwange. Oluusi kugenda mpola katono okusinga bwe njagala, era nteekwa okubakubiriza okwanguyirako, amayengo agayiringita ag’okutendereza okw’ekitiibwa galyoke galage amaanyi gaago gonna! Naye ne bwe wabaawo ebibulamu byonna, eri omutima gwange tewali nnyimba ng’ezammwe. Mikwano gyange Abadaaki batendereza Mukama mpola nnyo ne kiba nti omuntu ayinza bulungi okwebaka, ng’alulungibwa ennyimba zaabwe empanvu. Kyokka ne eyo, amaloboozi amangi gakola okukwatagana okw’ekitiibwa okw’okutendereza. Njagala okuwulira abantu ba Katonda nga bayimba bwe baba bayimba ddala, so si nga kiba kuwalula ddoboozi wakati w’okukwatagana n’obutakwatagana. Ai, singa tufuna oluyimba olutukuvu, eddoboozi ery’omwanguka ery’okutendereza okw’awaggulu, buli mmeeme y’omuntu mw’ekuba ekipimo, ne buli lulimi lw’omuntu ne luvuga eddoboozi—era buli muyimbi n’abeera n’okwegomba okw’awaggulu okusinga munne mu kwebaza n’okwagala! Waliwo ekintu ekisanyusa ennyo mu bumu bw’emitima egy’amazima mu kusinza Katonda—era emitima egyo bwe gyolesebwa mu luyimba— amaloboozi ago agasanyusa nga gawooma! Ndowooza twandibadde n’Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okutendereza omulundi gumu buli wiiki. Tulina Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba buli Bbalaza, n’Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba buli Lwamukaaga, n’Olukuŋŋaana lw’Okusaba buli ku makya, naye lwaki tetulina Lukuŋŋaana lwa Kutendereza? Mazima ebiseera bisaanidde okwawulibwa olw’okusinza okujjudde okutendereza okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Tugezeeko enteekateeka eyo mangu ddala. Nga bwe nnayogera ku kusaba okw’awamu, nti kusaanidde okuweebwayo naddala ku lw’abaweereza, bwe kityo n’okutendereza okw’awamu kusaanidde emirundi mingi okufuna endabika y’emu. Ekibiina kyonna kisaanidde okutendereza n’okwebaza Katonda olw’ekisa ekiweebwa Ekkanisa okuyita mu basumba baayo. Muwulire Omutume waffe bw’akyogera nate—“Bangi balyoke batwebalizeeko olw’ekirabo kye twaweebwa.” Abooluganda, tusaanidde okutendereza Katonda olw’abaweereza abalungi kubanga balamu—kubanga bwe bafa, omulimu gwabwe mungi gufa nabo. Kyewuunyisa engeri okulongoosa Ekkanisa bwe kweyongera mu maaso nga Luther ne Calvin bakyali balamu, n’engeri gye kukoma amangu ddala ng’abalongoosa bafudde. Emyoyo gy’abantu abalungi tegifa, naye mu ngeri emu yokka. Ekkanisa za Katonda mu mulembe guno ziri ng’Abayisirayiri mu biseera by’Abalamuzi. Abalamuzi bwe baafanga, baddangamu okugoberera ebifaananyi ebyole. Era bwe kiri ne kaakano. Katonda bw’aba ng’akyakuuma omuntu oyo mu bulamu, Ekkanisa ekulaakulana, naye omuntu oyo bw’afa, obunyiikivu bwe yafuuwa ne bufuuka ennimi z’omuliro busigala nga bunyooka bunyoosi mu vvu mu mbeera mwenda ku kkumi, oba n’okusingawo, mu kyenda mu mwenda ku buli kikumi. Okukulaakulana kw’Ekkanisa kwesigama ku bulamu bw’omuweereza. Katonda akiteekateeka bw’atyo okutwetoowaza. Kale, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza olw’obulamu obukuumiddwa. Naye wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza okungi olw’empisa ezikuumiddwa, kubanga ai, omuweereza bw’agwa, nga kiba kiswazo kinene! Lwaki, bwe musoma mu mawulire ga poliisi ensonga ey’ennaku eya Rev. Omwami _, eyasalawo okweyita omuweereza w’Ababatisti, buli muntu agamba nti, “Nga kintu kya kivve! Ababatisti nga bateekwa okuba ekibiina ekibi.” Kaakano, omusirusiru yenna mu nsi ayinza okweyita omuweereza w’Ababatisti. Eddembe lyaffe lijjuvu nnyo ne kiba nti tewali tteeka wadde nteekateeka. Omuntu yenna asobola okufuna abantu kkumi na babiri okumuwuliriza ng’abuulira aba muweereza, waakiri gye bali. Noolwekyo temuyinza kulowooza nti tewalibaawo bannanfuusi abamu abalyetwalira erinnya eryo balyoke bafune ekitiibwa eky’engeri emu. Omuweereza ow’amazima bw’akuumibwa n’aweebwa okunywerera ku bugolokofu bwe, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza Katonda okutakoma ku lulwe. Omuweereza bw’akuumibwa ng’alina bulijjo eby’okubuulira ebirungi. Bw’aba ng’oluzzi olukulukuta. Katonda bw’amuwa okuggya mu tterekero lye ebipya n’ebikadde okuliisa abantu be, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza okw’omutima gwonna. Era bw’akuumibwa nga mulamu mu kuyigiriza, bw’atakyama kudda mu bufirosoofo ku ludda olumu, wadde mu kufunda kw’enjigiriza ku ludda olulala, wasaanidde okubaawo okwebaza awo. Katonda bw’awa ebibiina okwagala okumuwuliriza, era okusinga byonna, emmeeme bwe zikyusibwa n’abatukuvu ne bazimbibwa, wasaanidde okubaawo ekitiibwa n’ettendo eritakoma eri Katonda. Ah, kaakano njogera ku bintu bye mumanyi mwenna, era mubikkiriza bukkiriza nga munyeenya emitwe, ne mulowooza nti tebirimu bingi. Naye singa mwali mulagiddwa okubeera mu Holland okumala akaseera katono, mwandisiimye mangu ebigambo bino. Bwe nnali ntambula eyo, nasula mu maka g’abasajja abatya Katonda—abantu ba Katonda be nnayinza okussa nabo ekimu okuwoomu—abatasobola kugenda mu kifo we baasinzizanga edda. Lwaki? “Ssebo,” bwe bagamba, “nnyinza ntya okugenda mu kifo eky’okusinza ng’abaweereza abasinga obungi beegaana buli Kigambo eky’Ebyawandiikibwa? Si ab’Ekkanisa Ennongoose bokka, naye ab’enzikiriza zonna mu Holland! Nnyinza ntya okuwuliriza abalyamu b’olukwe abalayira okukuuma ennyiriri z’okukkiriza eza Calvin oba eza Luther, ate ne balinnya ku kituuti ne beegaana amazima g’okuzuukira, oba ne bagamba nti okulinnya kwa Yesu mu ggulu lugero bugero olw’omwoyo?” Nzuula nti mu Netherlands batusingako emyaka ataano mu butakkiriza. Tujja kubatuukako mangu singa abasajja ab’ekibiina ekimu kye mmanyi bakkirizibwa okweyongera obungi. Abasomi b’eddiini Abadaaki batambudde ebigere bingi mu Neologism, okutuusa kaakano abantu baagala Amazima ga Katonda era waliwo ebibiina bingi ebyagala okugawulira. Naye bano bawalirizibwa ddala okugaana okugenda mu Kkanisa n’akatono, baleme okulabika ng’abawagira enjigiriza ez’obukyamu n’ez’obulimba ezibabuulirwa buli Ssande. Ah, singa Katonda yandiggye mu Bungereza abaweereza ababuulira Enjiri n’obuvumu era mu ngeri etegeerekeka, mwandikaabidde Katonda abazzeeyo ekikondo ky’ettaala. Mazima tuyinza okwogera ku Bungereza— “Wadde ng’olina ensobi zonna, nkyakwagala.” Tulina omulabirizi omu mu matwale eyeerangirira obutakkiriza bwe. Tulina abasajja batono mu bibiina by’eddiini byonna abaseeseetuka mpola okuva ku Mazima. Naye, Katonda yeebazibwe, tebannaba kuba kintu. Bali ng’ettondo eriri mu nsuwa bw’obageraageranya n’Ekkanisa za Kristo, n’abo mu ffe abatali ba Calvin nnyo nga bwe twandyagadde. Neebaza Katonda, waliwo bangi abatawakanya kuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Ebyawandiikibwa, wadde okubuusabuusa Amazima amakulu ag’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza. Tukyalina mu ffe abasajja abeesigwa eri Katonda, ababuulira Amazima gonna ng’amazima bwe gali mu Yesu. Mwebaze olw’abaweereza bammwe, nziramu okwogera, kubanga singa mwali muteekeddwa we bali Abakkiriza abamu, mwandikaabidde Katonda wammwe nti—“Mukama, tuzzeeyo bannabbi bo. Tusindikire enjala ya mmere oba ennyonta y’amazzi, naye totusindikira njala y’ekigambo kya Katonda!” Nsaba ku lwange ku makya gano, nga omuweereza wammwe, okwebaza kwammwe kutabulwe n’okwange mu kutendereza Katonda olw’obuyambi bw’ampadde mu mulimu omuzibu ennyo ogw’ennaku kkumi n’ennya eziyise. Katonda atenderezebwe olw’okusiimibwa kwe yampa mu nsi eyo mu mitendera gyonna egy’abantu. Njogera olw’ettendo lye so si olwange, kubanga kino kibadde kirayiro kyange, nti Katonda bw’anampa amakungula, sijja kutwala wadde ekirimba kimu eky’empeke, naye ye anaakifuna kyonna. Nasanga, mu bifo byonna gye nnagenda, ebibiina ebinene eby’abantu, abantu abangi abaali batasobola kutegeera mubuulizi, naye abaayagala okulaba amaaso ge, kubanga Katonda yali awadde omukisa obubaka bwe obwavvuunulwa eri emmeeme zaabwe. Abangi nnyo bampa omukono ogw’okwagala kw’abooluganda, era, nga bajjudde amaziga mu maaso, ne bansabira, mu lulimi Oludaaki, buli mukisa ku mutwe gwange. Nasuubira okubuulira abantu ataano ataano n’ekikumi kikumi, naye mu kifo ky’ekyo, ne baba bangi nnyo ne kiba nti n’amakanisa amanene ennyo tegaali manene kusukka. Kino kyanneewuunyisa, ne kinsanyusa—ne kindeetera okusanyukira mu Katonda—era mbasaba musanyuke nange. Neebaza Katonda olw’okusiimibwa kwe yampa mu mitendera gyonna egy’abantu. Abaavu bwe beekuŋŋaananga okunkwata mu ngalo, okutuusa lwe baali kumpi okunnyuluza ebitundu, Katonda yasiima okukwata ku mutima gwa Nnaabagereka wa Holland okuntumya, era okumala essaawa emu n’eddakiika kkumi n’ettaano nafuna omukisa okwogera naye ku bintu ebireeta emirembe gyaffe. Saasaba kusisinkana naye. Kyali kye yayagala yennyini. Awo ne nnyimusa emmeeme yange eri Katonda ndyoke nneme kwogera ku kintu kirala kyonna wabula Kristo, era ndyoke mmubuulire Yesu yekka. Era bw’atyo Mukama yasiima okunnyamba. Ne ndeka omukyala oyo ow’empisa ennungi ennyo, nga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mmubuulira okwagala kwa Katonda kwonna. Nasanyuka nnyo, ddala, okulaba nga nnaniriziddwa n’omutima ogw’ekisa mu bibiina by’eddiini byonna, ne kiba nti ku Lwamukaaga mu Amsterdam nabuulira mu Kkanisa y’Abamennonite ku makya, ne mu Kkanisa Enkadde Ennongoose ey’Abadaaki akawungeezi. Ssande eyaddako ku makya nabuulira mu Kkanisa ya Presbyterian ey’Abangereza, ate nate, akawungeezi, mu Kkanisa ey’Eddembe ey’Abadaaki. Oluusi nakkirizibwanga okubuulira mu makanisa amanene, nga mu Dom Kirk e Utrecht, ne mu Peter’s Kirk e Leyden, nga sirina baavu bokka, wabula n’abakungu n’ab’ebitiibwa ab’ensi, abaali, kya bulijjo, basobola okutegeera Olungereza okusinga abaavu abasinga obungi, abataafuna kakisa ka kuluyiga. Nawulira, nga ntambula okuva mu kibuga okudda mu kirala, Mukama ng’annyamba bulijjo okubuulira. Mu bulamu bwange bwonna saali mmanyi kugumira kwa mwoyo kwenkana awo, wadde omutima okubuukabuuka bwe gutyo. Era nkomyewo, sikooye wadde okuggwaamu amaanyi, newaakubadde nga nabuuliranga emirundi ebiri buli lunaku, naye nga njjudde amaanyi n’obuvumu okusinga bwe nnali nga nsimbula! Mpa Katonda ekitiibwa olw’emmeeme ennyingi ze mpulidde nti zikyusiddwa olw’okusoma obubaka obwakubibwa mu kyapa, n’olw’emikisa egy’okwagala egy’abo abaatugoberera okutuuka ku lubalama lw’amazzi nga bakaaba amaziga mangi, nga batugamba nti—“Fuba ojje ng’ebiseera by’obutiti tebinnaba kutuuka,” era nga batukubiriza okuddayo nate okubuulira Ekigambo mu nsi eyo. Wayinza okubaamu akantu k’okwegulumiza mu kino. Mukama amanyi oba bwe kiri oba nedda, naye nze sikimanyi mu nze. Ntendereza era neebaza erinnya lye, nti mu nsi omuli obufirosoofo bungi, annyambye okubuulira Amazima ge mu ngeri ennyangu bw’etyo, ne kiba nti sayogera kigambo ng’omuyigiriza w’enjigiriza obuyigiriza, naye nabuulira Kristo era Kristo yekka. Musanyuke nange, abooluganda bange abaagalwa. Nteekwa okubalaba nga musanyuka, oba bwe mutaagale, nteekwa okusanyuka nzekka, naye omugaati gwange ogw’okutendereza munene nnyo sisobola kugulya gwonna nzekka. III. Era tutuuse ku nkomerero. Nteekwa okubakubiriza ku BYE TUBABANJA MU SSANYU Omutume by’awa mu lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’ebbiri, ng’ensonga LWAKI WASAANIDDE OKUBAAWO OKUSABA N’OKUTENDEREZA. “Tulina okwenyumiriza ng’omwoyo gwaffe gutujulira kubanga twatambulira mu buwombeefu ne mu mazima ga Katonda, so si mu magezi ag’omubiri, naye mu kisa kya Katonda nga tuli mu nsi n’okusingira ddala gye muli.” Ah, ku nkomerero ya byonna, okubudaabudibwa kw’omuntu kuteekwa okuva, oluvannyuma lw’obulokozi bwa Katonda obwaggwa, mu kujulira kw’omwoyo gwe ye. Era eri omuweereza, nga bujulirwa bwa kitalo nti abuulidde Enjiri mu bwesimbu, ekirina amakulu abiri— yagibuulira nga talina mitima ebiri—ng’ayogera kimu ng’ategeeza kirala. Era yagibuulira, si ng’abavuzi b’amaato bwe bavuga—nga batunuulira oludda olumu ne bavugira ku lulala—naye yagibuulira ng’ategeeza ky’ayogera, ng’alina omutima gumu, ng’ayagala Ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’obulokozi bw’abantu. Era nga mukisa nnyo okugibuulira mu ngeri ennyangu, kwe kugamba, awatali bigambo bizibu, awatali bigambo binyirira, nga tasoma bukugu bwa kwogera, nga teyeekakaatika ku by’okwewunda mu kwogera. Obulamu bw’omuntu avvoola ekituuti ng’akifuula eky’okwolesa obwogezi nga bwa kikolimo! Ekitanda kye eky’okufiirako kiriba kya kwennyamira nnyo bw’alijjukira nti yayolesa amaanyi ge ag’okwogera okusinga ebintu ebinywevu ebireeta okuwangula emmeeme! Omwoyo ogwo guyinza bulungi okuba nga gutereddwa ogusobola okwogera nti gwakwata Amazima ga Katonda mu bwesimbu. Omutume era agamba nti yali agibuulidde mu mazima. Kwe kugamba, yagibuulira ng’ategeeza ky’ayogera, ng’akiwulira—yagibuulira mu ngeri nti tewali yali ayinza kumuvunaana bulimba. Ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani kirimu akantu k’omusana gw’enjuba, era oyo ye muweereza wa Katonda ow’amazima abuulira ekyo ky’andyagadde okuwanikibwa mu musana gw’enjuba, oba omusana gw’enjuba gwe guyitamu ddala. Ntya nti tewali n’omu ku ffe ali ng’endabirwamu enjeru—abasinga obungi ku ffe tuliko langi katono—naye alina essanyu oyo anoonya okuggyawo langi eyo nga bw’asobola, ekitangaala ky’Enjiri kiyitemu ddala mu ye, nga kitangalijja nga bwe kiva eri enjuba ey’obutuukirivu. Pawulo yali abuulidde mu bwesimbu ne mu mazima. Era ayongerako nti, “So si mu magezi ag’omubiri.” Ai, nga mpulidde emboozi nnyingi ku ebyo amagezi ag’omubiri bye gayinza okukola! Era nnyize ekyokuyiga mu nnaku kkumi n’ennya eziyise kye nnandyagadde Bungereza okuyiga. Waliwo ebibinja bisatu eby’obukyamu mu by’eddiini emitala eyo, era buli kimu kibuuka ku mugongo gwa kinnaakyo. Ebimu bikkiriza nti ebyabaawo byonna mu Byawandiikibwa nfumo bufumo. Ebirala bigamba nti waliwo ebirungi ebimu mu Bayibuli, newaakubadde nga mulimu ensobi nnyingi nnyo. N’ebirala bigenda wala n’okusingawo, ne bisuula Bayibuli yonna ku bikwata ku kuluŋŋamizibwa kwayo, newaakubadde nga bakyagibuulira, era nga bakyagyesigamako, nga bagamba nti bakikola olw’okuzimba abantu ab’awansi bokka—nga bagiwanirira bugiwanirizi ku lw’ebibiina by’abantu—newaakubadde nga nsaanidde okwongerako nti n’okufuna eky’okulya kyabwe nakyo. Kya nnaku! Kya nnaku! Kya nnaku nti Ekkanisa etuuse ku kigero ekyo—Ekkanisa Enkadde Ennongoose ey’Abadaaki—endabirwamu ddala ey’enjigiriza ya Calvin, eyanywera era ennywevu mu nnyiriri z’okukkiriza kwayo ku njigiriza zonna ze twagala, kyokka n’ekyama n’egenda mu ddembe ery’okukkiriza buli kimu era ery’obugwenyufu. Ai, nga tusaanidde okuvumirira amagezi ag’omubiri n’amaanyi! Ntya, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti oluusi abamu ku mmwe, bwe muwulira omuweereza, mwagala akyogere mu ngeri ennungi, era mumunenya okuggyako ng’alaga ekigero ekimu eky’obukugu. Neebuuza oba ekyo si kibi? Kumpi ndowooza nti kye kiri. Oluusi ndowooza oba tetwandisanidde kutunuulira nnyo bukugu buli lunaku, ne tweyongera okutunuulira ebiri mu Njiri ebuulirwa. Oba omuntu bw’aba yaweebwa omukisa ogw’obukugu bw’okwogera tuyinza, oboolyawo, okugasibwa ennyo ku ye—oba ekyo si bunafu. Oba tekyandibadde kirungi okuddayo mu nnaku z’abavubi omulundi omulala, ne tutawa bantu kusomesebwa kwa ngeri yonna, wabula ne tubasindika bubasindika okubuulira Amazima ga Katonda mu ngeri ennyangu. Kino, okusinga okugenda ewala nga bwe bagenda kaakano, nga bawa abantu, ssimanyi ki, eby’okuyiga ebya buli ngeri ebitalina mugaso gwonna ku nsi gye bali, naye ebibayamba bubayambi okukyamya obwesimbu bwa Katonda. Njagala ekigambo ekyo mu kyawandiikibwa kyange—“So si mu magezi ag’omubiri.” Era kaakano mbanja ekyange, ng’omwoyo gwange bwe gunjulira—mbanja ekyange ku kwenyumiriza kuno okw’Omutume waffe. Mbuulidde Enjiri ya Katonda mu bwesimbu. Ssimanyi nga bwe nnyinza okugibuulira mu ngeri ennyangu okusingawo, era siyinza kugirangirira n’obugolokofu okusingawo. Ngibuulidde mu mazima—Oyo akebera emitima gyonna akimanyi. Era sigibuulidde mu magezi ag’omubiri, era olw’ensonga emu ennungi ennyo—kubanga sirina gonna—era mbadde mpaliriziddwa okunywerera ku bujulirwa bwa Mukama obutaliimu bukodyo. Naye bwe mba nga nkoze ekintu kyonna, kikoleddwa ekisa kya Katonda. Bwe wabaawo obuwanguzi bwonna obutuukiddwako, kyabadde Kisa kya Katonda ekyakikola kyonna. “N’okusingira ddala gye muli.” Kubanga newaakubadde ekigambo kyaffe kibunye mu nsi nnyingi, n’obujulirwa bwaffe ne bwetooloola ensi yonna, kyokka, “n’okusingira ddala gye muli.” Mmwe twabalabula. Mmwe twabeegayirira. Mmwe twabakubiriza. Nammwe twawoza. Ku lwammwe twakaaba amaziga. Ku lwammwe twasaba. Eri abamu ku mmwe tubadde bazadde ab’omwoyo mu Kristo. Eri bangi ku mmwe nga kitammwe omulezi. Eri bangi ku mmwe ng’omuyigiriza era omuzimbi mu Njiri. Era tusuubira nti eri mwenna tubadde mukwano gwammwe ow’amazima mu Kristo Yesu. Noolwekyo mbanja okusaba kwammwe—okwammwe okusinga okw’abantu abalala bonna. Era newaakubadde waliwo abatali batono abatujjukira mu kwegayirira kwabwe, mbeegayiridde nnyo, okuva bwe kibadde “okusingira ddala gye muli,” nfune okusingira ddala okusaba kwammwe. Abamu bajja kugamba nti si kya kisa nze okulowooza nti temusaba. Kale, sirowooza bwe ntyo olw’obutaba na kisa, naye wayinza okubaawo abamu abeerabira—abamu abeerabira okuwoza. Ai, mugende mu maaso okunsabira! Ekibiina kyonna tekinnalokolebwa. Waliwo abamu abatuwuliriza abatannakyuka. Muwoleze Katonda ku lwabwe. Waliwo emitima egimu emikakanyavu egitannamenyebwa! Musabe Katonda ennyondo ekube. Era nga wakyaliwo abamu abatannasaanuuka, musabe Katonda afuule Ekigambo kibe ng’omuliro! London eno ennene yeetaaga okunyeenyezebwa okuva ku nkomerero emu okutuuka ku ndala. Musabire abaweereza bammwe bonna, Katonda abafuule ab’amaanyi. Ekkanisa ekyetaaga nnyo eddoboozi ery’omwanguka erya Katonda okugizuukusa mu tulo twayo. Musabe Katonda awe omukisa abaddu be bonna b’atumye. Muwoleze naye n’amaanyi ga Katonda, obwakabaka bwe bulyoke bujje, era by’ayagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu. Ai, singa mwenna mwakkiriza Yesu! Kubanga okutuusa lwe munaakkiriza, temuyinza kusaba wadde okutendereza! Ai, singa mwenna mwakkiriza Yesu! Mujjukire, lino lye kkubo lyokka ery’obulokozi. Mwesige Yesu, kubanga amukkiriza tasalibwa musango, naye atakkiriza gumaze okumusinga kubanga takkiririza mu linnya ly’Omwana oyo omu yekka owa Katonda. Mwesige Yesu era munaalokolebwa. Kristo abakkirize kaakano, ku lw’okwagala kwe yennyini. Amiina.

fields.title: Okusaba, eddagala ly’okweraliikirira
fields.body_html:
“Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Abafiripi 4:6,7.

Tulina obusobozi obw’okulowooza ku bya mu maaso, naye, nga bwe kiri ku busobozi bwaffe bwonna, bwonooneka, era emirundi mingi bukozesebwa bubi. Kirungi omuntu okuba n’okufaayo okutukuvu, n’assaayo omwoyo nga bwe kisaanidde ku buli kantu mu bulamu bwe; naye, woowe, kyangu nnyo okukufuula okweraliikirira okutali kutukuvu, n’agezaako okusika okuva mu mukono gwa Katonda omulimu ogw’okulabirira ebintu byonna, ogugwana ye so si ffe. Luther yayagalanga nnyo okwogera ku nnyonyi ne ku ngeri Katonda gy’azirabiriramu! Bwe yabanga ajjudde okweraliikirira, yakwatibwanga obuggya olw’ennyonyi, kubanga zibeera mu bulamu obw’eddembe era obw’essanyu bwe butyo. Ayogera ku Dokita Nkazaluggya, ne Dokita Thrush, n’abalala, abajjanga okwogera ne Dokita Luther ne bamubuulira ebintu ebirungi bingi! Mumanyi, abooluganda, ennyonyi ziri eyo mu bbanga eggazi, Katonda z’alabirira, zibeera bulungi nnyo okusinga ezo abantu ze balabirira. Akawala akato ak’e London, akaali kagenze mu kyalo, lumu kaagamba nti, “Maama, laba ku kanyonyi kano akaavu. Tekalina kiyumba!” Ekyo nze tekyandindowoozezza nti kufiirwa eri ennyonyi—era singa ggwe nange tubadde tetulina kiyumba kyaffe, n’akasanduuko k’ensigo, n’egiraasi y’amazzi, tekyandibadde kufiirwa kunene singa tusuulibwa mu ddembe ery’ekitiibwa ery’obulamu obw’okwesigama ku Katonda mu buwombeefu!

Kye kiyumba ekyo eky’okwesiga eby’omubiri, n’akasanduuko ako ak’ensigo bye tufuba buli kiseera okujjuza, ebireeta okweraliikirira kw’obulamu buno obufa. Naye oyo alina ekisa okwanjuluza ebiwaawaatiro bye n’abuuka n’agenda waggulu—n’atuuka mu ttale eggazi ery’okwesiga Katonda—ayinza okuyimba olunaku lwonna, era bulijjo n’aba n’eno ng’ennyimba ye—

“Ggwe omuntu afa, lekeraawo okutegana n’okunakuwala; Katonda ye ateekateeka eby’enkya.”

Kale, kuno kwe kuyigiriza kw’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe—“Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu.” Ekigambo ekiri mu Bayibuli y’Olungereza, “careful,” kaakano tekikyategeeza kyennyini kye kyategeezanga Bayibuli bwe yavvuunulwa. Waakiri nze kintegeeza ekirala okwawukana ku kye kyategeezanga abavvuunuzi. Nze nandigambye nti tusaanidde okwegendereza. “Mwegenderezenga,” lye ssomo eddungi eri abalenzi n’abavubuka nga batandika obulamu; naye mu makulu ekigambo, “care-full,” mwe kyategeerwanga mu biseera by’abavvuunuzi—kwe kugamba, okujjula okweraliikirira—tetusaanidde kweraliikirira. Ekyawandiikibwa kitegeeza nti temubanga na kyeraliikirivu—temulowoozanga buli kiseera ku byetaago by’obulamu buno obufa. Ka nkisome nate, nga nkigaziyaamu katono, olwo mujja kutegeera amakulu gaakyo—“Temubanga n’omutima ogujjudde okweraliikirira olw’ekintu na kimu.” Woowe, singa Katonda atuyigiriza okwewala ekibi ekiziyizibwa wano, n’okubeera mu bulamu obw’obutafaayo obutukuvu, bwe bulungi bwennyini obw’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo—nga byonna bye tweraliikirira tubisudde ku Katonda, era nga tusobola okusanyuka n’okujaguza olw’engeri gy’atulabiriramu!

“Woowe,” omuntu omu agamba, “sisobola kulekera awo kweraliikirira.” Kale, ekigendererwa ky’okubuulira kw’ekiro kino kwe kubayamba okulekera awo okweraliikirira n’okutawaana; era, okusooka, mulowooze wano ku kiddira okweraliikirira mu kifo kyakwo. Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, naye musabenga olw’ebintu byonna—ekyo kye kiddira okweraliikirira mu kifo kyakwo, “mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga.” Eky’okubiri, mwetegereze engeri ey’enjawulo ey’okusaba kuno okugenda okudda mu kifo ky’okweraliikirira—“mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Oluvannyuma nsuubira nti tujja kusigaza eddakiika ntono okulowooza ku kibala ekiwoomu eky’okusaba kuno—“emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

I. Kale, okutandika, kino kye kisooka, EKIDDIRA OKWERALIIKIRIRA N’OKUTAWAANA MU KIFO KYABYO.

Ndowooza kya mazima eri bangi ku ffe nti ebitweraliikiriza bingi. Bw’otandika okweraliikirira, okutawaana n’okwemulugunya, tolisobola kubala bikweraliikiriza, newaakubadde ng’oyinza okubala enviiri ez’oku mutwe gwo. Era ebyeraliikiriza bitera okweyongera eri

abo abajjudde okweraliikirira, era bw’oba ng’ojjudde okweraliikirira nga bw’olowooza nti tosobola kusukka awo, tolirema kulaba kikungulo kirala eky’ebikweraliikiriza nga kimeze okukwetooloola. Okwemanyiiza omuze guno omubi ogw’okweraliikirira kiguwa okufuga obulamu, okutuusa obulamu lwe butaba na mugaso olw’okweraliikirira kwe tubulinamu. Ebitweraliikiriza bingi, n’olwekyo okusaba kwammwe ka kube kungi nga bwe biri. Buli ekikweraliikiriza kifuule okusaba. Ebyo by’oweraliikirira bibeere ebikozesebwa mu kusaba kwo; era, ng’abakugu ab’edda bwe baasuubira okufuula ebisigalira by’ekyuma okuba zaabu, naawe bw’otyo, mu bukugu obutukuvu, okyuse ddala ekyandibadde ekikweraliikiriza mu butonde okuba eky’obugagga eky’omwoyo mu kifaananyi ky’okusaba! Buli ekikweraliikiriza kibatize mu linnya lya Kitaffe, Omwana era Mwoyo Mutukuvu—bw’otyo okifuule omukisa!

Olina ky’oyagala okufuna? Weegendereze kireme kukufuna ggwe! Oyagala okufuna amagoba? Weekuume oleme kufiirwa okusinga by’ofuna olw’amagoba go. Mbeegayirira, temubanga na kwagala kufuna okusinga ku kye muyinza okuguma okufuula okusaba! Toyaayaaniranga kuba na kintu ky’otoguma kusaba Katonda kukuwa. Pima by’oyaayaanira n’ekipimo eky’omwoyo, olwo bw’otyo ojja kukuumibwa obutaba na kintu kyonna ekifaanana omululu. Abangi bajjirwa okweraliikirira olw’okufiirwa kwabwe—bafiirwa bye baafuna. Kale, eno nsi omutera okubeera okufiirwa. Amazzi agaayanjaala gakendeera, n’ebiseera eby’obutiti bisaanyaawo ebimuli eby’omu biseera eby’ebbugumu. Teweewuunyanga bw’ofiirwa nga n’abantu abalala bwe bafiirwa, naye saba ku kufiirwa kwo. Genda nakwo eri Katonda—era mu kifo ky’okwemulugunya, kifuule omukisa ogw’okulindirira Mukama n’okugamba nti—“Mukama ye yawa era Mukama y’aggyeewo, erinnya lya Mukama Katonda lyebazibwe. Ayi Mukama, ntegeeza ky’onvunaana, era omuddu wo, nkwegayiridde, omuwonye okwemulugunya ku ggwe emirundi gyonna, ka kibe kiki ky’onokkiriza nfiirwe!”

Oboolyawo ogamba nti by’oweraliikirira tebikwata ku kufuna kwo wadde ku kufiirwa kwo, wabula ku mmere yo eya buli lunaku. Kale, ku ekyo olina ebisuubizo, ggwe omanyi! Mukama yagamba nti, “onoobeeranga n’emirembe mu nsi n’ofuna ebirungi.” Akuzzaamu amaanyi mu ngeri ennungi bw’agamba nti ayambaza omuddo ogw’omu nsiko—kale talisingawo nnyo okukwambaza ggwe, ggwe alina okukkiriza okutono? Era Mukama Yesu akulagira okulabira ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga: Tezisiga so tezikungula so tezikuŋŋaanyiza mmere mu tterekero, naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu aziriisa. Kale, genda eri Katonda wo n’ebikweraliikiriza byonna! Bw’oba olina ab’omu maka bangi, ng’enfuna yo ntono, era nga kikukaluubirira okufuna ebibamala n’okukola ebirungi byereere eri bonna, olina ensonga nnyingi bwe zityo ez’okukonkona ku luggi lwa Katonda—ensonga nnyingi nnyo ez’okusangibwanga emirundi mingi ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa! Mbeegayirira, mubikozese bulungi. Nze seetya kukyalira mukwano gwange bwe mba nga ddala nnina ensonga gye njagala okumutuukirizaamu—naawe oyinza okugumira okukyalira Katonda ng’ebyetaago bikunyigiriza. Mu kifo ky’okweraliikirira ku kintu kyonna n’okweraliikirira okw’ennaku, amangu ago kifuule ensonga ey’okweyongera okusaba.

“Woowe,” omu agamba, “naye ndi mu kusoberwa. Simanyi kya kukola.” Kale, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, mazima oteekwa okusaba bw’oba tosobola kumanya oba kkubo lya ku mukono ogwa ddyo, oba erya kkono, oba ogende butereevu, oba oddeyo emabega! Mazima, bw’oba mu lufu olunene ennyo nga tosobola kulaba ttaala eddako, olwo kye kiseera ky’oteekwa okusaba. Ekkubo lijja kweyerula mu maaso go mangu ddala. Emirundi mingi nange nzennyini mbadde ngezaako engeri eno—era nnyinza okuwa obujulirwa nti bwe neesiga nze nzennyini, nnabanga musirusiru nnyo nnyini! Naye bwe neesiga Katonda, yankulembera butereevu mu kkubo ettuufu, era tewaabaddewo nsobi yonna! Nzikiriza nti abaana ba Katonda batera okukola ensobi ennene ku bintu ebyangu okusinga ku bintu ebizibu. Mumanyi ebyatuuka ku Isirayiri, abantu b’e Gibyoni bwe bajja n’engatto zaabwe enkadde n’ebyambalo, ne babalaga emmere eyakukula, gye baagamba nti baagiggya mu mpogero zaabwe ng’ekyayokya. Abayisirayiri ne balowooza nti, “Kino kyeyoleka bulungi. Abasajja bano bagenyi, bavudde mu nsi ey’ewala, kale tuyinza okukola nabo endagaano.” Baali bakakasa nti ebyo amaaso gaabwe bye galaba byakakasa nti abo tebaali Bakanani, kale ne batebuuza ku Katonda! Ensonga yonna yalabika nga nnyangu nnyo, ne bakola endagaano n’abantu b’e Gibyoni, eyabaleetera emitawaana emirembe gyonna oluvannyuma! Singa, mu buli kintu, tugenda eri Katonda mu kusaba, ebitusobera tebyanditutwala mu nsobi okusinga ebyangu bwe bitutwala—era mu bintu ebyangu ne mu bizibu twandikulembeddwa Ali Waggulu Ennyo.

Oboolyawo mukwano gwaffe omulala agamba nti, “Naye ndowooza ku bya mu maaso.” Bw’otyo? Kale, okusooka, nkusaba nkubuuze: ebya mu maaso bikukwatako ki? Omanyi olunaku bye lunaaleeta? Obadde olowooza ku ekyo ekirikutuukako ng’okaddiye, naye okakasa nti olikaddiwa? Nnamanya omukazi omu Omukristaayo eyeeraliikiriranga ku ngeri gye yandiziikiddwamu. Ekibuuzo ekyo tekyanteganya n’akatono, era waliwo ensonga endala nnyingi ze tutalina kweraliikirira. Bulijjo oyinza okufuna omuggo gw’okukuba embwa, era bw’oba oyagala ekikweraliikiriza, bulijjo ofuna ekikweraliikiriza ky’okubonyaabonya emmeeme yo! Naye ogwo mulimu mubi eri buli omu ku mmwe. Mu kifo ky’okukola ekyo, buli ekiyinza okukweraliikiriza kifuule ensonga y’okusaba. Tewaliyitawo kiseera kinene nga tonnafuna kikweraliikiriza, kale tolimala bbanga ddene nga tolina nsonga ya kusaba. Sazaamu ekigambo ekyo, “okweraliikirira,” owandiike mu kifo kyakyo ekigambo kino, “okusaba”—olwo, newaakubadde nga by’oweraliikirira bingi, n’okusaba kwo kunaaba kungi.

Mwetegereze, ekiddako, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, nti okweraliikirira okusukkiridde kwe kuyingirira ekitundu kya Katonda. Kwe kwefuula kitaawe w’amaka mu kifo ky’okuba omwana—kwe kwefuula mukama mu kifo ky’okuba omuddu mukama we gw’awa emmere ye. Kaakano, mu kifo ky’okukola ekyo, bw’onoofuula okweraliikirira okusaba, tewajja kubaawo kuyingirira, kubanga oyinza okujja eri Katonda mu kusaba awatali kuvunaanibwa malala. Akuyita okusaba. Nedda, wano, ng’ayita mu muweereza we, akulagira nti, “mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Era nate, okweraliikirira tekutugasa, era kutuleetera akabi kanene. Singa weeraliikirira ebbanga lyonna ly’oyagala, tewandisobodde kwongerako ku buwanvu bwo yinci emu, oba kumeza luviiri lulala ku mutwe gwo, oba kufuula luviiri lwo olumu okuba olweru oba oluddugavu! Bw’atyo Omulokozi bw’atubuulira, era abuuza nti, obanga okweraliikirira kulemwa mu bintu ebitono ng’ebyo, okweraliikirira kuyinza kukola ki mu bintu ebisingako obukulu eby’okulabirira kwa Katonda? Tekuyinza kukola kintu na kimu! Omulimi yayimirira mu nnimiro ze n’agamba nti, “Simanyi kinaatutuukako ffenna. Eŋŋaano ejja kuzikirira enkuba bw’eneeyongera okutonnya. Tetujja kukungula n’akatono okuggyako nga tufunye obudde obulungi.” N’atambula eruuyi n’eruuyi, ng’anyiga emikono gye, ng’alumwa era ng’aleetera ab’omu nnyumba ye bonna obutaba na mirembe. Era okweraliikirira kwe kwonna tekwaleeta wadde ekitangaala ky’enjuba kimu—teyasobola kufuuwa kire na kimu kukigoba n’ebigambo bye byonna eby’obusungu, era teyasobola kuyimiriza wadde ettondo limu ery’enkuba n’okwemulugunya kwe kwonna.

Kale, kugasa ki okwekulukuunya omutima gwo, so nga tolina ky’oyinza kufunamu? Ate era, kunafuya amaanyi gaffe ag’okweyamba, n’okusingira ddala amaanyi gaffe ag’okugulumiza Katonda. Omutima ogujjudde okweraliikirira gutulemesa okusalawo obulungi mu bintu bingi. Emirundi mingi nkozesezza ekyokulabirako kino (simanyi kisingawo) eky’okutwala endabirwamu ey’okulengera ewala, n’ogifuuyira omukka omwokya ogw’okweraliikirira kwaffe, n’ogiteeka ku liiso lyaffe, n’oluvannyuma ne tugamba nti tetulaba kintu kyonna okuggyako ebire! Kya lwatu tetuyinza, era tetulisobola nga tukyagifuuyira. Singa tubadde bakkakkamu, abasirifu, abeefuga, era nga Katonda ye atufuga, twandikoze ekituufu. Twandibadde, nga bwe tugamba, “nga tuli bulindaala,” mu kiseera eky’obuzibu. Omuntu alina Katonda ng’ali naye ayinza okusuubira obutabula birowoozo. Bwe twerabira okusaba, weewuunya nti tutawaana ne tweraliikirira, ne tukola ekintu ekisooka okutujjira mu birowoozo—ekitera okuba ekisinga obubi—mu kifo ky’okulindirira okutuusa lwe tulaba ekiteekwa okukolebwa, n’oluvannyuma ne tukikola nga twesiga era nga tukkiriza, ng’abali mu maaso ga Katonda? Okweraliikirira, oba okutawaana, kwonoona, naye bw’onookyusa okweraliikirira kuno n’okufuula okusaba, buli kikweraliikiriza kijja kukugasa.

Okusaba kye kintu eky’ekitalo eky’okuzimbisa ennyumba ey’omwoyo. Ffe ffennyini tuzimbibwa okusaba. Tukula mu kisa olw’okusaba, era singa tujja eri Katonda buli kaseera n’okwegayirira, tujja kuba Bakristaayo abakula amangu! Ku makya ga leero nnagamba omu nti, “Nsabira, kino kiseera kya bwetaavu,” n’anziramu nti, “Sikoze kirala kyonna kasookedde nzuukuka.” Nsabye n’abalala abawerako ekintu kye kimu era bagambye nti babadde bansabira. Nnasanyuse nnyo, si ku lwange nzekka, eyafunye omugaso mu kusaba kwabwe, naye ne ku lwabwe, kubanga tebalema kukula olw’ekyo! Obunyonyi obuto bwe bweyongera okukuba ebiwaawaatiro byabwo, buba buyiga okubuuka. Ebinywa bijja kweyongera amaanyi, era obunyonyi bujja kuva mu kisu mu bbanga ttono. Okukuba ebiwaawaatiro okwo kwennyini kwe kuyiga—era okugezaako okusaba—okusinda, okussa ebikkowe, okukaaba kw’omwoyo ogusaba, kwo kwennyini mukisa! Kale, mulekere awo omuze guno ogwonoona ogw’okweraliikirira, mukwate omuze guno ogugaggawaza ogw’okusaba! Mulabe bwe munaafuna amagoba ga mirundi ebiri—okusooka, nga mwewala okufiirwa, ate okw’okubiri, nga mufuna ekyo ekinaabagasa ddala mmwe n’abalala nabo!

Ate era, okweraliikirira kuva mu kwerabira nti Kristo ali kumpi naffe. Mwetegerezza ebigambo ebikyetoolodde bwe biri? “Mukama waffe, ali kumpi. Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu.” Mukama Yesu Kristo yasuubiza okudda nate, era ayinza okujja ekiro kino. Essaawa yonna ayinza okulabika! Kale Pawulo awandiika nti, “Mukama waffe, ali kumpi. Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Woowe, singa tusobola okuyimirira ku nsi eno nga ku kisiikirize obusiikirize! Singa tusobola okubeera ng’abo abanaatera okumaliriza obulamu buno obwavu obuyita obuyisi! Singa tukwata buli kintu eky’ensi n’omukono ogutakinyweza, olwo tetwandyeraliikiridde, ne tutawaana, ne twemulugunya—naye twandyewaddeyo okusaba, kubanga bwe tutyo twandikutte ebya ddala era ebinywevu, ne tuteeka ebigere byaffe ku bitalabika, ebyo, ku nkomerero, bye by’olubeerera! Woowe, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ekyawandiikibwa, kye mbasomedde emirundi n’emirundi, kaakano kigwe mu mitima gyammwe ng’akayinja bwe kagwa mu nnyanja ey’oku lusozi, era, nga bwe kiyingira, kikole enkulungo ez’okubudaabudibwa ku ngulu ddala ku mmeeme yammwe!

II. Kaakano twetaaga okwetegereza ekyawandiikibwa n’obwegendereza obusingako, tulabe, mu kifo eky’okubiri, ENGERI EY’ENJAWULO EY’OKUSABA KUNO. Kusaba kwa ngeri ki okunaatuggyako okweraliikirira?

Kale, okusooka, kwe kusaba okukwata ku buli kintu. “Mu buli kintu” “mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Oyinza okusaba ku kantu akasingira ddala obutono ne ku kintu ekisingira ddala obunene—toyinza kusaba Mwoyo Mutukuvu kyokka, naye oyinza n’okusaba engatto empya. Oyinza okugenda eri Katonda ku mmere gy’olya, amazzi g’onywa, ekyambalo ky’oyambala, n’omusaba ku buli kintu. Tokuba lukoloboze n’ogamba nti, “Ebintu bino byokka bye binaabeera wansi w’okulabirira kwa Katonda.” Kale, obulamu obusigaddeyo onoobukola otya? Bunaabeerwamu wansi w’ekikolimo ekiwotoka eky’engeri y’obutakkiriza nti Katonda waali? Kikafuuwe! Woowe, singa tusobola okubeera mu Katonda mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna, kubanga obulamu bwaffe buli bwe butyo ne tutasobola kubwawulamu! Omubiri gwaffe, emmeeme n’omwoyo kimu, era Katonda ng’akyatuleka mu nsi eno era nga tulina ebyetaago ebiva mu mbeera y’emibiri gyaffe,

tuteekwa okuleeta ebyetaago byaffe eby’omubiri mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba. Era mujja kulaba nti Katonda omukulu ajja kubawulira mu nsonga zino. Togamba nti bitono nnyo ye okubifaako—buli kintu kitono bw’okigeraageranya naye! Bwe ndowooza ku bukulu bwa Katonda, kindabikira nti ensi yaffe eno entono ennyo kaweke kamu katono akatalina mugaso ku lubalama lw’ennyanja ey’obutonde bwonna—ate nga tesaanira kufiibwako n’akatono. Ensi yonna katundu katono nnyo mu nsi ennene ey’obutonde, era, Katonda bw’akkiriza okugifaako, ayinza n’okukka wansi katono n’atufaako ffe! Era bw’akola bw’atyo, kubanga agamba nti, “Era buli luviiri oluli ku mitwe gyammwe lwabalibwa.” Kale, mu buli kintu mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.

Okusaba okututaasa okuva mu kweraliikirira kwe kusaba okuddibwamu—“Mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga.” Saba Katonda, oluvannyuma osabe nate—“mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga.” Mukama bw’atakuddamu omulundi ogusooka, weebaze nnyo nti olina ensonga ennungi ey’okuddamu okusaba! Bw’atakuwa ky’osaba ku mulundi ogw’okubiri, kkiriza nti akwagala nnyo nnyini nga ayagala okuddamu okuwulira eddoboozi lyo! Era bw’akulindiriza okutuusa lw’omaze okugenda gy’ali emirundi musanvu, weegambe nti, “Kaakano mmanyi nti nsinza Katonda wa Eriya, kubanga Katonda wa Eriya yamuleka n’addayo emirundi musanvu omukisa nga tegunnaweebwa.” Kibale ng’ekitiibwa okukkirizibwa okumeggana ne Malayika wa Katonda! Eno ye ngeri Katonda gy’afuulamu abalangira be! Yakobo teyandifuuse Isirayiri singa yafuna omukisa okuva eri Malayika ku kusaba okusooka—naye bwe yalina okweyongera okumeggana okutuusa lwe yawangula, olwo n’afuuka omulangira eri Katonda! Okusaba okutta okweraliikirira kwe kusaba okugenda mu maaso era okutakoowa.

Ekiddako, kwe kusaba okw’amagezi—“Mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Nawulira ku Musiraamu eyamalanga, ndowooza, essaawa mukaaga buli lunaku ng’asaba, era, aleme okwebaka ng’ali ku kyombo, yayimiriranga busimba, nga waliwo omuguwa gwokka ogwaliiriddwa mu maaso ge, alyoke agwesigame. Era bwe yandibadde yeebase, yandigudde. Ekigendererwa kye kyali kweyongera okumala essaawa mukaaga mu ekyo kye yayitanga okusaba. “Kale,” nnagamba omu eyali amumanyi, era eyali amulabye ku lyato lye ku mugga Kiyira, “kwali kusaba kwa ngeri ki?” “Kale,” mukwano gwange n’anziramu, “yali addiŋŋana nti, ‘Tewali Katonda wabula Katonda, era Mohammed ye nnabbi wa Katonda,’ ekintu kye kimu emirundi n’emirundi n’emirundi.” Ne mbuuza nti, “Yalina ky’asaba?” “Nedda!” “Yali yeegayirira Katonda amuwe ekintu kyonna?” “Nedda, yali addiŋŋana bulijjo ebigambo ebimu, ng’omulogo bw’ayinza okuddiŋŋana ebigambo bye eby’obulogo.”

Mulowooza waliwo ekintu mu ngeri eyo ey’okusaba? Bw’ofukamira n’oddiŋŋana bubeezi ebigambo ebimu ebyategekebwa, kunaaba kujjuza kamwa bigambo kwokka. Katonda afaayo ki ku ngeri eyo ey’okusaba? “Mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Okwo kwe kusaba okwa nnamaddala! Katonda amanyi by’osaba, naye olina okumusaba nga gy’obeera nti tamanyi. Olina okutegeeza by’osaba, si lwa kubanga Mukama tamanyi, naye, oboolyawo, lwa kubanga ggwe tomanyi. Era bw’omala okumutegeeza by’osaba, nga ekyawandiikibwa bwe kikugamba, ojja kuba obitegeezezza ggwe wennyini mu ngeri esingako obutangaavu. Bw’omala okusaba n’amagezi, ng’omanyi ky’osabye, era ng’omanyi lwaki okisabye, oboolyawo ojja kuyimirira weegambe nti, “Nedda, ekyo sisaanye kukisaba.” Oluusi, bw’omala ebbanga ng’osaba ekyo Katonda ky’atakuwa, kiyinza okubaawo nti okukakasa kujja kuyingira mpolampola mu birowoozo byo nti toli mu kkubo ttuufu, era ekyo ekiva mu kusaba kwo kijja kukugasa ku bwakyo, era kibe mukisa gy’oli.

Naye olina okusaba nga otegeeza Katonda by’oyagala. Kwe kugamba, mu bigambo ebyangu, yogera ky’oyagala, kubanga okwo kwe kusaba okwa nnamaddala. Genda mu kyama obuulire Mukama ky’oyagala—mutegeeze byonna ebiri mu mutima gwo. Tolowooza nti Katonda yeetaaga ebigambo ebinyirira! Nedda, teweetaaga kudduka waggulu kuleeta kitabo kyo eky’okusaba n’onoonya essaala ewandiikiddwa—ojja kumala ebbanga ddene nga tonnazuula ssaala ewandiikiddwa ekugwanira bw’oba ng’osaba ddala! Saba olw’ebyo by’oyagala nga bw’obuulira maama wo oba mukwano gwo gw’osinga okwagala ekyo ky’oyagala. Genda eri Katonda mu ngeri eyo, kubanga okwo kwe kusaba okwa ddala, era okwo kwe kusaba okunaagoba okweraliikirira kwo.

Kale, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ate era, okusaba okuleeta eddembe okuva mu kweraliikirira kwe kukolagana ne Katonda. Bw’oba toyogedde na Katonda, tonnasaba ddala. Waali wabaddewo omwana omuto (nnyinza okugamba nti n’abaana bammwe bakikoze) eyagenda n’ateeka ebbaluwa mu kituli ky’omukutu gw’amazzi amakyafu, era, kya lwatu, ebbaluwa eyasindikibwa mu ngeri eyo teyaddibwamu. Ebbaluwa bw’eteteekebwa mu kasanduuko k’ebbaluwa, egende eri omuntu gw’eweerezebwa, egasa ki? Bwe kityo, okusaba kwe kwogera ne Katonda okwa ddala. Oteekwa okutegeera nti Katonda waali era n’abo abamunoonya n’obwesigwa abawa empeera, bwe kitaba ekyo toyinza kusaba. Ateekwa okuba owa ddala gy’oli, owa ddala omulamu, era oteekwa okukkiriza nti awulira okusaba, n’oluvannyuma oteekwa okwogera naye n’okkiriza nti buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa—era bw’otyo bw’onookifuna. Tannalemwa kuwa kitiibwa kusaba okw’okukkiriza. Ayinza okukulindiriza okumala akaseera, naye okulwawo si kugaana, era emirundi mingi azzeemu okusaba okwasaba ffeeza ng’awa zaabu! Ayinza okuba yagaana eby’obugagga eby’ensi, naye yawaayo obugagga obw’omu ggulu obusinga omuwendo emirundi omutwalo—era eyeegayirira n’asanyuka nnyo okusinga olw’okuwaanyisiganya okwo! “Mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.”

Mmanyi kye mukola nga muli mu buzibu—mugenda eri muliraanwa wammwe, naye muliraanwa wammwe tayagala kubalaba buli kiseera ku nsonga ng’ezo. Oboolyawo ogenda eri muganda wo, naye waliwo ekyawandiikibwa ekikulabula obutagenda ewa muganda wo ng’ogudde mu mitawaana. Oyinza okukyalira mukwano gwo emirundi emingi ennyo ng’oli mu bwetaavu—ayinza okusanyuka ennyo okukulaba okutuusa lw’awulira ky’onoonya! Naye bw’ogenda eri Katonda wo, talikukyuusiza mabega. Talikugamba nti ojja nnyo. Wabula, alikunenya olw’okuba tojja gy’ali mirundi gimala!

Waliwo ekigambo kimu kye mbuuseeko gye buvuddeko, kubanga nnayagadde kukitereka kibeere eky’enkomerero kye nnaayogera ku nsonga eno— “Mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Kino kitegeeza ki? Kitegeeza nti okusaba okutta okweraliikirira kwe kusaba okusaba n’omutima omusanyufu, n’essanyu, n’okwebaza. “Mukama, ndi mwavu. Ka nkwebaze olw’obwavu bwange, era olwo, Ayi Mukama, tolimpa buli kye neetaaga?” Eyo ye ngeri y’okusabamu. “Mukama, ndi mulwadde. Nkwebaza olw’okubonaabona kuno, kubanga nkakasa nti kirina ekirungi kye kintegeeza. Kaakano, nkwegayiridde, kikusanyuse ompooze!” “Mukama, ndi mu buzibu bunene, naye nkutendereza olw’obuzibu buno, kubanga mmanyi nti bulimu omukisa wadde ng’ebbaasa yaabwo eriko ensalosalo enzirugavu ez’okukungubaga! Mukama, nnyamba mpite mu buzibu bwange!” Okwo kwe kusaba okutta okweraliikirira—“kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga.” Bitabule bino ebibiri bulungi! Ekipimo kimu—nedda, ebipimo bibiri eby’okusaba—okusaba n’okwegayirira, olwo ekipimo kimu eky’okwebaza! Bisekulire wamu bijja kukola eddagala ery’omukisa eriwonya okweraliikirira. Mukama atuyigirize okukola omulimu guno omutukuvu ogw’omukozi w’eddagala!

III. Nkomekkereza n’ensonga eno ey’okusatu, EKIBALA EKIWOOMU EKY’OKUSABA KUNO—“N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

Bw’oba ng’osobola okusaba mu ngeri eno, mu kifo ky’okwekkiriza okweraliikirira okubi, ekiriva mu kyo kwe kuba nti emirembe egitali gya bulijjo gijja kuyingira mpolampola mu mutima gwo ne mu magezi go. Egitali gya bulijjo, kubanga gijja kuba “emirembe gya Katonda.” Emirembe gya Katonda kye ki? Obukkakkamu obutatabulwatabulwa obwa Katonda alina essanyu eritakoma, okuteeka okutaggwaawo okwa Katonda amatidde ddala! Kino kye kijja okufuga omutima gwo n’amagezi go. Mwetegereze Pawulo bw’agannyonnyola—“Emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe.” Abantu abalala tebajja kugitegeera. Tebajja kusobola kutegeera ngeri gy’oyinza kubeera mukkakkamu bw’otyo. Ekisingawo, naawe toli kusobola kubabuulira, kubanga obanga gisukkiridde okutegeera kwonna, mazima gisukkiridde n’okwogerwa kwonna! Era ekisinga okwewuunyisa—naawe wennyini toli kugitegeera!

Gijja kuba mirembe gy’otosobola kupima buziba wadde obunene. Omu ku bajulizi bwe yali anaatera okwokebwa olwa Kristo, yagamba omulamuzi eyali alagira okukoleeza entuumu y’enku nti, “Onoojja n’oteeka omukono gwo ku mutima gwange? “Omulamuzi n’akola bw’atyo. “Gukuba mangu?” omujulizi bwe yabuuza. “Ndaga akabonero konna ak’okutya?” “Nedda,” omulamuzi bwe yagamba. “Kaakano teeka omukono gwo ku mutima gwo ggwe, olabe obanga toli mutabuliddwa okunsinga.” Lowooza ku musajja oyo owa Katonda, ku makya ge yali ag’okwokebwa, eyali yeebase otulo tungi nnyo ne kiba nti baalina okumunyeenya okumuzuukusa—yalina okugolokoka okwokebwa! Naye, wadde ng’amanyi nti bwe kyali kinaaba bwe kityo, yalina okwesiga okw’engeri eyo mu Katonda n’yeebaka bulungi. Gino gye “emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe.” Mu kuyigganyizibwa okw’edda okwa Diocletian, abajulizi bwe baaleetebwanga mu kisaawe ekinene okutaagulwataagulwa ensolo enkambwe—omu bwe yatuuzibwanga mu ntebe ey’ekyuma eyokya ennyo, omulala n’asiigibwa omubisi gw’enjuki okubojjebwa ennumba n’enjuki okutuusa lw’afa—tebaatekemuka n’akatono!

Lowooza ku musajja oyo omuzira eyateekebwa ku kyuma eky’okwokerako okwokebwa okutuusa lw’afa, eyagamba abaali bamuyigganya nti, “Ludda lumu mumaze okulwokya. Kaakano munkyuse ku ludda olulala.” Lwaki emirembe gino mu mbeera ng’ezo? Gyali “emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe.” Ffe tetwetaaga kubonaabona bwe tutyo mu biseera bino, naye singa kigenda kituuka ku kintu ekiringa ekyo, kya kitalo emirembe Omukristaayo gy’afuna! Oluvannyuma lw’omuyaga ogw’amaanyi, Omusomesa yayimirira mu kyombo n’agamba omuyaga n’ennyanja nti, “Tteeka, sirika.” Era tusoma nti, “Omuyaga ne gusirika n’ennyanja n’eteekera ddala.” Wali okiwuliddeko? Okiwulira ekiro kino bw’oba nga wayiga obukugu buno obutukuvu obw’okutegeeza Katonda by’oyagala mu buli kintu, era nga emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe gikuuma omutima gwo n’amagezi go mu Kristo Yesu.

Emirembe gino egy’omukisa gikuuma emitima gyaffe n’amagezi gaffe—mirembe egikuuma. Ekigambo eky’Oluyonaani kitegeeza ekibinja ky’abaserikale abakuuma ekibuga. Si kya kitalo nti wano kukozesebwa ekigambo eky’eby’entalo, era nti emirembe gye gikola ng’omukuumi w’omutima n’amagezi? Emirembe gya Katonda gye girina okukuuma omwana wa Katonda—kifaananyi kya kitalo naye kirungi! Nawulira nti okutya kwe kulabirira ennyumba y’Omukristaayo. Kale, okutya kuyinza okuba omukuumi omulungi okugoba embwa, naye tekulina kabada kajjudde! Naye emirembe, newaakubadde nga girabika ng’obunafu, ge maanyi gennyini, era, nga bwe gikuuma, era gituliisa ne gituwa buli kye twetaaga.

Era gye mirembe egitugatta ne Yesu—“Emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe.” Kwe kugamba, okwagala kwammwe n’ebirowoozo byammwe, bye mwegomba n’amagezi gammwe—omutima gwammwe—gulemenga okutya.

Amagezi gammwe, galemenga okumanya ngeri yonna ey’okusoberwa—“emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Byonna biri “mu Kristo Yesu,” era, n’olwekyo, biwooma era bya muwendo gye tuli emirundi ebiri!

Abampuliriza abaagalwa, abamu ku mmwe mujja wano ku Lwokuna ekiro, era temumanyi kintu kyonna ku mirembe gino egya Katonda, era, oboolyawo, mwewuunya lwaki ffe Abakristaayo tussa essira lingi bwe lityo ku ddiini yaffe! Woowe, singa mumanyi, oboolyawo mwandigissizzaako essira okusinga ffe, kubanga singa tewaali bulamu oluvannyuma—era tumanyi nti gubaawo—naye omuze omulungi ogw’okugenda eri Katonda mu kusaba n’okumutwalira byonna bye tweraliikirira gutuyamba okubeera n’essanyu lingi, ne mu bulamu buno! Tetukkiriza ndowooza egamba nti ebya mu nsi eno byokka bye bikulu, naye singa twagikkiriza, tewandibaddewo kwetegekera bulamu bwa ku nsi kwenkana nga kuno okubeera mu bulamu obw’okuweereza Katonda n’okubeera mu Katonda! Bw’oba olina katonda ow’obulimba, n’ogenda bugenzi mu kkanisa oba mu kifo ekirala eky’okusinzizaamu, n’otwala ekitabo kyo eky’okusaba oba ekitabo kyo eky’ennyimba, n’olowooza nti olw’ekyo muli Bakristaayo, mwerimba! Naye bw’oba olina Katonda omulamu era nga mukolagana naye ddala, era bulijjo, ng’omuze, ng’obeera wansi w’ekisiikirize ky’ebiwaawaatiro bya Ayinzabyonna, olwo olifuna emirembe egirireetera abalala okwewuunya era ne gikuleetera naawe wennyini okwewuunya, ye “emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe.” Katonda abibawe, abampuliriza abaagalwa, ku lwa Kristo! Amiina.

OKUNNYONNYOLA KWA C. H. SPURGEON: Abafiripi 4

Olunyiriri 1. Kale, baganda bange abaagalwa, era be nnumirirwa omwoyo, mmwe ssanyu lyange era mmwe ngule yange; noolwekyo abaagalwa, muyimirire mu Mukama waffe. Mumanyi nti ekkanisa ey’e Firipi yali ya muwendo nnyo ku mutima gw’Omutume. Teyasobola kwerabira kiseera ye ne Siira lwe baasabira wamu n’abakazi ku lubalama lw’omugga, n’oluvannyuma ne basaba era ne bayimba ennyimba ez’okutendereza Katonda mu kkomera, abasibe abalala nga babawuliriza. Ludiya n’ab’omu nnyumba ye, n’omukuumi w’ekkomera ow’e Firipi, be baali ku babereberye mu bibala by’omulimu gwa Pawulo e Firipi, era bulijjo waaliwo okwagala okw’oku lusegere wakati we n’ab’ekkanisa ey’omu kifo ekyo. Baamufangako, naye n’abafangako. Emirundi ebiri mu lunyiriri luno lumu abayita “abaagalwa” be. Agamba nti “yabalumirirwa omwoyo, yalumirirwa okujja okubalaba amaaso n’amaaso, yalumirirwa babeere n’essanyu mu Mukama okutuuka ku ddaala erisingira ddala waggulu. Kyava agamba nti, “baganda bange abaagalwa, era be nnumirirwa omwoyo, mmwe ssanyu lyange.” Kyali kimusanyusa nnyo, ne kuba okubalowoozaako obulowooza ng’abaana be ab’omwoyo, n’okusingira ddala okulaba engeri ey’okutya Katonda era ey’obugabi gye beeyisaamu. Weewaawo, era abayita “ngule yange”—engule gye yawangula mu kumeggana okw’omwoyo! Abo Omukristaayo b’akyusa be ssanyu lye wano, era balibeera ngule ye emirembe gyonna mu ggulu. Pawulo yalagira Abafiripi bano nti, “muyimirire mu Mukama waffe.” Kirabika ng’ekintu ekyangu ennyo okuyimirira nga banywevu, naye abo abagezaako okukikola bamanyi nga bwe kiri omulimu omuzibu.

2. Ewudiya ne Sintuke mbeegayirira mukkiriziganye mu Mukama waffe. Abakazi babiri bokka abaali bayombye bokka na bokka, naye Omutume yeegomba nnyo obumu obutuukiridde, ne kiba nti mu lulimi olwasooka ateekayo “nkwegayirira” eri buli omu ku bo. Tagamba ani yali mutuufu era ani yali mukyamu, naye ayagala nti “mukkiriziganye mu Mukama waffe.” Enjawukana entono, ne wakati w’ab’ekkanisa abatamanyiddwa, ziyinza okulemesa omulimu gw’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali ng’ejjiba—era amayiba gaagala ebifo ebisirifu—tegajja we wali oluyoogaano n’enkaayana. Woowe, ka tukuze okwagala eri buli omu! Era bwe kiba nti ku nsonga yonna twali tetukkaanyizza mu kiseera kyonna, ka tulowooze nti tuwulira Pawulo ng’agamba, ekiro kino, nti, “Nkwegayirira Ewudiya, era nkwegayirira Sintuke, mukkiriziganye mu Mukama waffe.” Mutabagane, Bannyinaze! Mutabagane, Baganda bange! Ennyombo ka zibe ziri ki, muzikomye era “mukkiriziganye mu Mukama waffe.” Abaagulibwa n’omusaayi gwe gumu ogw’omuwendo, abambazibwa obutuukirivu obumu obutuukiridde, abali mu kkubo erigenda mu ggulu limu, “mukkiriziganye mu Mukama waffe.”

3. Era ggwe mukozi munnange, nkusaba oyambenga abakazi abo, kubanga baakolera wamu nange omulimu gw’okubunyisa Enjiri. Abo awamu ne Kerementi, era ne bakozi bannange abalala, amannya gaabwe gawandiikiddwa mu kitabo ky’obulamu. Tetumanyi “mukozi munnange” ono wa ddala yali ani. Kirabika nnyo yali Epafuladito eyatwala Ebbaluwa eno e Firipi. Ka abe yali ani, yali muntu eyali akoze ne Pawulo nga beetikkidde wamu, ekibegabega ku kibegabega. Ekigambo ekyakozesebwa mu lulimi olwasooka kitegeeza munno gwe musikira awamu ekikoligo. Ente ennume bbiri bwe zeetikka ekikoligo kimu naye nga tezikkaanya, zireetera buli emu obutaba na ddembe. Emu bw’egezaako okugalamira ate endala ng’eyagala okuyimirira, oba emu bw’etambula amangu okusinga endala, ekikoligo kyeyongera okulumya emirundi ebiri. Pawulo ayogera ku muntu wano nti yali “mukozi munnange” wa ddala—era amugamba nti, “Oyambenga abakazi abo, kubanga baakolera wamu nange omulimu gw’okubunyisa Enjiri.”

Abakazi nga bulijjo babadde n’ekifo eky’oku ntikko mu kuweereza Mukama Yesu Kristo, era wano Pawulo ayogera ku bo nti baakolera wamu naye mu Njiri! Mazima Ludiya ateekwa okuba nga yali omu ku bo. “Abo awamu ne Kerementi, era ne bakozi bannange abalala, amannya gaabwe gawandiikiddwa mu kitabo ky’obulamu.” Ng’abamu ku bannyonnyozi abayivu bwe bagamba, erinnya ly’omuntu liyinza okubeera mu kitabo ky’obulamu okumala ekiseera, naye ne liggibwamu. Singa okuyigiriza kwabwe kwa mazima, ekitabo ekyo kyandibadde kisiiguddwasiiguddwa nnyo era nga kijjudde ebbala. Nneebaza Katonda nti sikkiriza mu kitabo ekiri bwe kityo! Mukama Yesu Kristo bw’aba nga yawandiika erinnya lyange mu kitabo ky’obulamu, mu kitabo ekinene eky’olulyo lw’abanunule, nsoomooza emyoyo emibi gyonna egy’omu ggeyeena okulisangulamu!

4. Musanyukirenga mu Mukama waffe bulijjo. Nziramu okubagamba nti musanyukenga. Bw’oba nga wali osanyukidde mu Mukama, oyinza okusanyukira mu Mukama bulijjo, kubanga bulijjo y’oyo omu, era bulijjo wa kisa! Waliwo ensonga zenkanankana ez’okusanyukira mu Katonda mu kiseera ekimu nga mu kirala, kubanga takyukakyuka.

5. Era mubeere n’okuzibiikiriza eri abantu bonna. Ekigambo ekiri wano mu Luyonaani kizibu nnyo okuvvuunulwa mu Lungereza; Bayibuli y’Olungereza ekivvuunula “moderation” (okwefuga). Tekitegeeza kwefuga mu makulu abantu abamu mwe bakozesa ekigambo ekyo, kubanga bakifuula, nga bwe ndowooza, kumpi ekikolimiddwa. “Mubeere n’okuzibiikiriza”—obugonvu bwammwe, obwagazi bwammwe, okugumiikiriza kwammwe—“eri abantu bonna.” Ekyo kye kitegeeza.
